We evaluate human, leading proprietary models (e.g., Claude and Gemini), and 14 representative open-source MLLMs. Humans achieve near-perfect performance (around 0.95 accuracy) and proprietary models demonstrate robust understanding (achieving up to 0.88 accuracy), standard open-source instruction-tuned models perform at the chance level. Further analysis demonstrates that this failure is driven by a strong language prior: rather than trusting the visual input, they automatically override the anomalous visual signals with statistically common text descriptions. Although introducing Chain-of-Thought reasoning mechanisms can improve accuracy, it significantly slows down the response and generates a new failure mode: models overthink the scenario and refuse to accept the actual visual content simply because it violates real-world physical laws. Finally, we demonstrate that targeted fine-tuning and structured prompting can effectively mitigate this reliance on language priors, enabling open-source models to accurately ground their reasoning in actual visual evidence.

</details>


### [170] [Source-Free Domain Adaptation for Geospatial Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08375)
*Yuan Gao,Di Cao,Xiaohuan Xi,Sheng Nie,Shaobo Xia,Cheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LoGo，一种无需源数据的无监督域适应框架，通过局部类平衡原型估计和全局最优传输分布对齐，结合双一致性伪标签过滤机制，有效解决了3D地理空间点云语义分割中的域偏移和长尾分布问题，在跨场景和跨传感器任务上均取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D地理空间点云的语义分割中，由于区域和采集条件差异导致的域偏移会降低模型性能。现有域适应方法通常需要访问源域数据，但因隐私和法规限制往往不可行。因此需一种无需源数据的无监督域适应方法。

Method: 提出LoGo框架：(1) 局部层面：类平衡原型估计模块，为样本稀少的尾部类生成鲁棒特征原型，缓解长尾分布导致的特征坍缩；(2) 全局层面：基于最优传输的全局分布对齐模块，将伪标签分配建模为全局优化问题，纠正局部贪婪分配中头部类的过度主导；(3) 双一致性伪标签过滤机制，仅保留局部多增强集成预测与全局最优传输分配一致的高置信度伪标签用于自训练。

Result: 在跨场景和跨传感器两个挑战性基准上，LoGo一致优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: LoGo框架通过局部-全局双一致性设计，在无需源数据的情况下有效解决了域适应中的长尾分布和头部类偏置问题，为隐私受限场景下的3D点云语义分割提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation of 3D geospatial point clouds is fundamental to remote sensing applications, yet domain shifts caused by regional and acquisition-related variations often degrade model performance. Although domain adaptation can mitigate such shifts, existing methods typically require access to source-domain data, which is often infeasible due to privacy concerns and regulatory policies. To address this, we propose LoGo (Local-Global Dual-Consensus), a novel source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (SFUDA) framework requiring only a pretrained model and unlabeled target data. At the local level, we introduce a class-balanced prototype estimation module that ensures that robust feature prototypes can be generated even for sample-scarce tail classes, effectively mitigating the feature collapse caused by long-tailed distributions. At the global level, we introduce an optimal transport-based global distribution alignment module that formulates pseudo-label assignment as a global optimization problem, effectively correcting the over-dominance of head classes inherent in local greedy assignments, and thereby preventing model predictions from being severely biased towards majority classes. Finally, we propose a dual-consistency pseudo-label filtering mechanism that retains only high-confidence pseudo-labels where local multi-augmented ensemble predictions align with global optimal transport assignments for self-training. Extensive experiments on two challenging benchmarks, encompassing cross-scene and cross-sensor settings, demonstrate that LoGo consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/GYproject/LoGo-SFUDA.

</details>


### [171] [Left-Right Symmetry Breaking in CLIP-style Vision-Language Models Trained on Synthetic Spatial-Relation Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.12809)
*Takaki Yamamoto,Chihiro Noguchi,Toshihiro Tanizawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究通过可控1D图像-文本测试环境，探究CLIP-style对比学习模型中左右空间关系的理解机制，发现标签多样性比布局多样性更能驱动泛化，并通过注意力分解揭示了位置编码与token嵌入交互产生的水平注意力梯度是打破左右对称性的关键机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型中的空间理解能力是否真正获得以及通过何种机制获得尚不明确，当前缺乏对CLIP-style模型如何习得左右关系等空间理解能力的深入机制性理解。

Method: 构建可控的1D图像-文本测试环境，训练基于Transformer的轻量级视觉和文本编码器，使用CLIP-style对比目标在单对象和双对象场景的描述对上进行端到端训练，系统变化标签多样性和布局多样性以评估泛化能力，并通过注意力分解分析位置编码与token嵌入的交互机制。

Result: 对比训练能够学习左右关系；标签多样性相比布局多样性是泛化的主要驱动力；位置编码与token嵌入的交互产生了水平注意力梯度，打破了编码器中的左右对称性；消融该贡献会显著降低左右判别能力。

Conclusion: 提供了CLIP-style模型何时以及如何获得关系能力的机制性见解，揭示了水平注意力梯度是左右空间关系理解的关键机制。

Abstract: Spatial understanding remains a key challenge in vision-language models. Yet it is still unclear whether such understanding is truly acquired, and if so, through what mechanisms. We present a controllable 1D image-text testbed to probe how left-right relational understanding emerges in Transformer-based vision and text encoders trained with a CLIP-style contrastive objective. We train lightweight Transformer-based vision and text encoders end-to-end on paired descriptions of one- and two-object scenes and evaluate generalization to unseen object pairs while systematically varying label and layout diversity. We find that contrastive training learns left-right relations and that label diversity, more than layout diversity, is the primary driver of generalization in this setting. To gain the mechanistic understanding, we perform an attention decomposition and show that interactions between positional and token embeddings induce a horizontal attention gradient that breaks left-right symmetry in the encoders; ablating this contribution substantially reduces left-right discrimination. Our results provide a mechanistic insight of when and how CLIP-style models acquire relational competence.

</details>


### [172] [LuxRemix: Lighting Decomposition and Remixing for Indoor Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15283)
*Ruofan Liang,Norman Müller,Ethan Weber,Duncan Zauss,Nandita Vijaykumar,Peter Kontschieder,Christian Richardt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于生成式图像光照分解模型的交互式室内场景光照编辑方法，能够从多视图捕获中分解出独立光源，支持开关、色度和强度的实时控制，并通过多视图光照协调和可重光照的3D高斯泼溅表示实现高质量重光照效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有室内场景光照编辑方法难以实现对独立光源的灵活控制，缺乏多视图一致性和实时交互能力。

Method: 1) 基于生成式图像的光照分解模型，将复杂室内照明分解为独立光源；2) 多视图光照协调机制，保证不同视角间光照分解的一致性；3) 将光照分解集成到可重光照的3D高斯泼溅表示中，实现实时交互控制。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上实现了高度真实感的光照分解和重光照效果，与SOTA方法相比在定量和定性上均表现优异。

Conclusion: 提出的方法能够有效实现室内场景中独立光源的实时交互编辑，具有良好的真实感和多视图一致性。

Abstract: We present a novel approach for interactive light editing in indoor scenes from a single multi-view scene capture. Our method leverages a generative image-based light decomposition model that factorizes complex indoor scene illumination into its constituent light sources. This factorization enables independent manipulation of individual light sources, specifically allowing control over their state (on/off), chromaticity, and intensity. We further introduce multi-view lighting harmonization to ensure consistent propagation of the lighting decomposition across all scene views. This is integrated into a relightable 3D Gaussian splatting representation, providing real-time interactive control over the individual light sources. Our results demonstrate highly photorealistic lighting decomposition and relighting outcomes across diverse indoor scenes. We evaluate our method on both synthetic and real-world datasets and provide a quantitative and qualitative comparison to state-of-the-art techniques. For video results and interactive demos, see https://luxremix.github.io.

</details>


### [173] [RadJEPA: Radiology Encoder for Chest X-Rays via Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15891)
*Anas Anwarul Haq Khan,Mariam Husain,Pratik Jalan,Kshitij Jadhav*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RadJEPA是一种基于联合嵌入预测架构的自监督框架，仅使用约84万张无标注胸部X光图像进行预训练，无需任何语言监督即可学到与视觉-语言预训练方法相媲美的放射学图像表征。在冻结Vicuna-7B解码器的报告生成任务中，RadJEPA匹配或超越了最强的纯图像和视觉-语言基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言预训练虽推动了医学图像表示学习，但受限于配对的图像-文本数据可用性以及临床叙述中的报告偏差。作者探究是否可以在没有任何语言监督的情况下学习具有竞争力的放射学编码器。

Method: 提出RadJEPA框架，基于联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)，在约84万张无标注胸部X光图像上预训练。模型学习从可见上下文区域预测被遮蔽目标区域的潜在表示，该目标函数不同于图像-文本对比预训练和DINO风格的自蒸馏，通过在表示空间中显式建模条件结构来工作。

Result: 在两个数据集和四个指标上，使用ViT-B/14骨干网络和224×224分辨率，RadJEPA匹配或超越了最强的纯图像和视觉-语言基线方法。在放射学报告生成任务中表现突出，并可替代四种广泛使用的视觉-语言骨干网络(MedLLaVA、Qwen-2.5、BLIP-2、Phi-4)的编码器。疾病分类和语义分割结果也有报告。

Conclusion: 无需语言监督的自监督方法可以学习到与视觉-语言预训练相竞争的医学图像表征，为突破配对数据限制和报告偏差提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Vision-language pretraining has driven much of the recent progress in medical image representation learning, but this paradigm is constrained by the availability of paired image-text data and by the reporting bias of clinical narratives. We ask whether competitive radiology encoders can be learned without any language supervision. We introduce RadJEPA, a self-supervised framework built on a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture and pretrained on approximately 840K unlabeled chest X-ray images. The model learns to predict latent representations of masked target regions from a visible context region, an objective that differs from both image-text contrastive pretraining and DINO-style self-distillation by explicitly modelling conditional structure in representation space. We evaluate RadJEPA primarily on radiology report generation with a frozen Vicuna-7B decoder, and additionally substitute its encoder into four widely used vision-language backbones (MedLLaVA, Qwen-2.5, BLIP-2, and Phi-4). For completeness we also report disease classification and semantic segmentation results. Across two datasets and four metrics, RadJEPA matches or exceeds the strongest image-only and vision-language baselines while using a ViT-B/14 backbone at 224 x 224 resolution.

</details>


### [174] [MVISTA-4D: View-Consistent 4D World Model with Test-Time Action Inference for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09878)
*Jiaxu Wang,Yicheng Jiang,Tianlun He,Jingkai Sun,Qiang Zhang,Junhao He,Jiahang Cao,Zesen Gan,Mingyuan Sun,Qiming Shao,Xiangyu Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种具身4D世界模型，能够从单视图RGBD输入生成几何一致的任意视角RGBD序列，并通过逆动力学和测试时优化将生成的未来场景转化为可执行动作，在三维场景生成和下游操作任务上取得优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型要么只支持纯图像预测，要么只推理部分3D几何信息，无法预测完整的4D场景动态，限制了机器人在复杂操作任务中的规划能力。

Method: 1) 提出多视图、跨模态的4D世界模型，从单视图RGBD输入生成任意视角的RGBD序列；2) 设计跨视图和跨模态特征融合模块，保持RGB与深度一致性及几何对齐；3) 采用测试时动作优化策略，通过反向传播生成模型推断轨迹级潜在变量；4) 结合残差逆动力学模型将轨迹先验转化为精确可执行动作。

Result: 在三个数据集上，4D场景生成和下游操作任务均取得强性能，消融实验验证了关键设计选择的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提出的4D世界模型有效解决了多视图几何一致生成和动作推断的欠定问题，为机器人具身操作提供了一种新的想象-行动范式。

Abstract: World-model-based imagine-then-act becomes a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches typically support either purely image-based forecasting or reasoning over partial 3D geometry, limiting their ability to predict complete 4D scene dynamics. This work proposes a novel embodied 4D world model that enables geometrically consistent, arbitrary-view RGBD generation: given only a single-view RGBD observation as input, the model imagines the remaining viewpoints, which can then be back-projected and fused to assemble a more complete 3D structure across time. To efficiently learn the multi-view, cross-modality generation, we explicitly design cross-view and cross-modality feature fusion that jointly encourage consistency between RGB and depth and enforce geometric alignment across views. Beyond prediction, converting generated futures into actions is often handled by inverse dynamics, which is ill-posed because multiple actions can explain the same transition. We address this with a test-time action optimization strategy that backpropagates through the generative model to infer a trajectory-level latent best matching the predicted future, and a residual inverse dynamics model that turns this trajectory prior into accurate executable actions. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate strong performance on both 4D scene generation and downstream manipulation, and ablations provide practical insights into the key design choices.

</details>


### [175] [Olaf-World: Orienting Latent Actions for Video World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10104)
*Yuxin Jiang,Yuchao Gu,Ivor W. Tsang,Mike Zheng Shou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SeqΔ-REPA目标，通过将潜在动作与冻结的自监督视频编码器的时间特征差异对齐，从无标签视频中学习可跨场景迁移的结构化潜在动作空间，构建了基于大规模被动视频预训练的动作条件视频世界模型Olaf-World。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可缩放的动作可控世界模型受限于动作标签的稀缺性。现有潜在动作学习方法学到的潜在变量会纠缠场景特定线索且缺乏共享坐标系，因为标准目标仅在每个片段内操作，无法跨上下文对齐动作语义。

Method: 提出SeqΔ-REPA（序列级控制效果对齐目标），将集成的潜在动作与来自冻结的自监督视频编码器的时间特征差异进行对齐。基于此构建Olaf-World流水线，从大规模被动视频中预训练动作条件视频世界模型。

Result: 相比最先进基线，该方法学习到更结构化的潜在动作空间，在零样本动作迁移上表现更强，对新控制接口的数据效率适应更好。

Conclusion: 通过利用动作的语义效果作为共享参考（而非依赖动作标签），实现了跨上下文的潜在动作语义对齐，从而构建可迁移的动作空间。

Abstract: Scaling action-controllable world models is limited by the scarcity of action labels. While latent action learning promises to extract control interfaces from unlabeled video, learned latents often fail to transfer across contexts: they entangle scene-specific cues and lack a shared coordinate system. This occurs because standard objectives operate only within each clip, providing no mechanism to align action semantics across contexts. Our key insight is that although actions are unobserved, their semantic effects are observable and can serve as a shared reference. We introduce Seq$Δ$-REPA, a sequence-level control-effect alignment objective that anchors integrated latent action to temporal feature differences from a frozen, self-supervised video encoder. Building on this, we present Olaf-World, a pipeline that pretrains action-conditioned video world models from large-scale passive video. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method learns a more structured latent action space, leading to stronger zero-shot action transfer and more data-efficient adaptation to new control interfaces than state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [176] [Adapting Actively on the Fly: Relevance-Guided Online Meta-Learning with Latent Concepts for Geospatial Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17605)
*Jowaria Khan,Anindya Sarkar,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,Elizabeth Bondi-Kelly*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对PFAS污染等环境监测中数据稀疏、标签有偏且采样预算有限的问题，本文提出了一个集成主动学习、在线元学习和概念引导推理的统一地理空间发现框架，通过概念加权不确定性采样和相关性感知元批次形成两种创新策略，在有限数据和动态环境下实现了稳健的目标发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境监测中的数据采集成本高昂、稀疏且受公共健康需求驱动，尤其对于PFAS污染这类致癌物，亟需在有限采样预算下策略性地识别高风险且缺乏观测的区域。类似的挑战在灾害响应和公共卫生领域同样存在，而稀疏且有偏的地理空间标签限制了现有学习方法（如强化学习）的适用性。

Method: 提出统一的地理空间发现框架，核心创新基于"概念相关性"概念：（1）概念加权不确定性采样策略——利用土地覆盖、污染源距离等易获取概念对不确定性的影响进行加权；（2）相关性感知元批次形成策略——在在线元更新过程中促进语义多样性，提升动态环境下的泛化能力。框架整合了主动学习、在线元学习和概念引导推理。

Result: 以PFAS污染发现为实际环境监测任务进行评估，展示了在有限数据和动态变化条件下稳健的目标发现能力。

Conclusion: 该框架有效解决了稀疏、有偏地理空间标签下的目标发现难题，为环境监测、灾害响应和公共卫生等领域的主动采样策略提供了新思路。

Abstract: In environmental monitoring, data collection is often costly, sparse, and shaped by urgent public-health needs. This is particularly true for cancer-causing PFAS (Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) contamination, where discussions with domain experts and environmental organizations highlight the need to strategically identify high-risk, under-observed regions under tight sampling budgets. More broadly, similar challenges arise in disaster response and public health settings, where dynamic environments make it essential to efficiently uncover hidden targets from limited ground truth. Yet sparse and biased geospatial labels limit the applicability of existing learning-based methods, such as reinforcement learning. To address this, we propose a unified geospatial discovery framework that integrates active learning, online meta-learning, and concept-guided reasoning. Our approach introduces two key innovations built on a shared notion of *concept relevance*, capturing how domain-specific factors influence target presence: a *concept-weighted uncertainty sampling strategy*, where uncertainty is modulated by learned relevance from readily available concepts such as land cover and source proximity; and a *relevance-aware meta-batch formation strategy* that promotes semantic diversity during online-meta updates, improving generalization in dynamic environments. We evaluate our framework on PFAS contamination discovery as a real-world inspired environmental monitoring task, demonstrating robust target discovery under limited data and changing conditions.

</details>


### [177] [GS-CLIP: Zero-shot 3D Anomaly Detection by Geometry-Aware Prompt and Synergistic View Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.19206)
*Zehao Deng,An Liu,Yan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GS-CLIP框架，通过几何感知提示和协同视图表示学习两阶段流程，在零样本3D异常检测任务中有效识别几何异常，在四个大规模公开数据集上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本3D异常检测方法通过将3D点云投影为2D表示来适配CLIP，但投影过程会丢失几何细节，且仅依赖单一2D模态导致视觉理解不完整，限制了检测多样化异常类型的能力。

Method: 提出GS-CLIP框架，包含两阶段学习：第一阶段通过几何缺陷蒸馏模块（GDDM）动态生成嵌入3D几何先验的文本提示，包含全局形状上下文和局部缺陷信息；第二阶段引入协同视图表示学习架构，并行处理渲染图像和深度图像，并通过协同精炼模块（SRM）融合两个流的特征。

Result: 在四个大规模公开数据集上的综合实验结果表明，GS-CLIP在零样本3D异常检测任务中取得了优越的检测性能。

Conclusion: GS-CLIP通过引入几何感知提示和双视图协同学习，有效弥补了现有方法在几何细节保留和多模态理解上的不足，为样本稀缺和数据隐私受限场景下的3D异常检测提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Zero-shot 3D Anomaly Detection is an emerging task that aims to detect anomalies in a target dataset without any target training data, which is particularly important in scenarios constrained by sample scarcity and data privacy concerns. While current methods adapt CLIP by projecting 3D point clouds into 2D representations, they face challenges. The projection inherently loses some geometric details, and the reliance on a single 2D modality provides an incomplete visual understanding, limiting their ability to detect diverse anomaly types. To address these limitations, we propose the Geometry-Aware Prompt and Synergistic View Representation Learning (GS-CLIP) framework, which enables the model to identify geometric anomalies through a two-stage learning process. In stage 1, we dynamically generate text prompts embedded with 3D geometric priors. These prompts contain global shape context and local defect information distilled by our Geometric Defect Distillation Module (GDDM). In stage 2, we introduce Synergistic View Representation Learning architecture that processes rendered and depth images in parallel. A Synergistic Refinement Module (SRM) subsequently fuses the features of both streams, capitalizing on their complementary strengths. Comprehensive experimental results on four large-scale public datasets show that GS-CLIP achieves superior performance in detection. Code can be available at https://github.com/zhushengxinyue/GS-CLIP.

</details>


### [178] [Axial-Centric Cross-Plane Attention for 3D Medical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.21636)
*Doyoung Park,Jinsoo Kim,Lohendran Baskaran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种以轴向为中心的跨平面注意力架构（AC-XNet），用于3D医学图像分类。该方法利用大规模轴向CT图像预训练的MedDINOv3作为冻结的特征提取器，通过RICA块、平面内Transformer编码器和轴向中心跨平面Transformer编码器，模拟临床中轴向平面为主、辅助平面为辅的非对称解读策略。在MedMNIST3D六个数据集上，该方法在ACC和AUC上持续优于现有3D和多平面模型；轻量版本AC-Tiny以更少参数取得竞争性能。消融实验验证了轴向中心查询、QKV分配、方向性跨平面融合、无残差交叉注意力及分类头设计的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床医生解读3D医学影像时，通常以轴向平面为主要诊断参考，辅助平面提供补充空间信息，形成非对称的解读策略。然而现有3D深度学习方法要么整体处理体积数据，要么平等对待所有平面，未能反映这种轴向中心、非对称的临床解读模式。

Method: 提出轴向中心跨平面注意力架构（AC-XNet），包含：(1) 使用大规模轴向CT预训练的MedDINOv3作为冻结特征提取器，分别提取轴向、冠状和矢状面特征；(2) RICA块和平面内Transformer编码器捕获各平面特定的位置和上下文信息；(3) 轴向中心跨平面Transformer编码器，选择性地以轴向表示作为查询，条件性地融合辅助平面表示。

Result: 在MedMNIST3D六个数据集上，该方法在ACC和AUC指标上持续优于现有3D及多平面模型。轻量变体AC-Tiny以显著更少的可训练参数取得竞争性能。消融实验验证了轴向中心查询、QKV分配、方向性跨平面融合等各组件的重要性。

Conclusion: 将架构设计与临床解读流程对齐（即轴向中心、非对称的跨平面注意力机制）对于鲁棒的3D医学图像分析具有重要价值。性能提升更多来源于架构设计而非模型规模扩大。

Abstract: Abridged: Clinicians commonly interpret 3D medical images by examining multiple anatomical planes rather than relying on volumetric views. In clinical CT workflows, the axial plane often serves as the primary diagnostic reference, while the auxiliary planes provide complementary spatial context. However, many existing 3D deep learning approaches either process volumetric data holistically or assign equal importance to all planes, failing to reflect this asymmetric, axial-centric interpretation strategy. To address this, we propose an axial-centric cross-plane attention architecture for 3D medical image classification that models asymmetric dependencies between anatomical planes. The architecture employs large-scale axial CT images pretrained MedDINOv3 as a frozen feature extractor for axial, coronal, and sagittal planes. RICA blocks and intra-plane transformer encoders capture plane-specific positional and contextual information, while axial-centric cross-plane transformer encoders selectively condition axial representations on complementary auxiliary representations. Experiments on six datasets from the MedMNIST3D benchmark show that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing 3D and multi-plane models in ACC and AUC. A lightweight variant, AC-Tiny, achieves competitive performance with substantially fewer trainable parameters, suggesting that architectural design contributes more to performance gains than increased model scale. Ablation studies further validate the importance of axial-centric querying, QKV allocation, directional cross-plane fusion, residual-free cross-attention, and classification head design. Slice-level Grad-CAM visualizations demonstrate that the model identifies diagnostically relevant regions across all planes. These findings highlight the value of aligning architectural design with clinical interpretation workflows for robust 3D medical image analysis.

</details>


### [179] [LDP-Slicing: Local Differential Privacy for Images via Randomized Bit-Plane Slicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03711)
*Yuanming Cao,Chengqi Li,Wenbo He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LDP-Slicing框架，通过将图像像素分解为二进制位平面，使得局部差分隐私（LDP）机制能够高效应用于高维图像数据，在满足ε-LDP的同时保留了下游任务的高效用，且无需训练、计算开销极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局部差分隐私（LDP）在图像数据上的应用长期以来被认为不切实际，因为像素空间的高维性导致传统LDP机制效用严重下降。本文旨在证明这种效用损失并非LDP本身的问题，而是源于将其应用于不恰当的数据表示形式。

Method: 提出LDP-Slicing框架，核心思路是将像素值分解为二进制位平面序列，将LDP机制直接应用于位级表示；同时集成感知混淆模块以减少人眼可感知的信息泄露，以及基于优化的隐私预算分配策略；整个流程无需训练，满足严格的像素级ε-LDP。

Result: 在人脸识别和图像分类任务上的大量实验表明，LDP-Slicing在相当隐私预算下优于现有的DP/LDP基线方法，且计算开销可忽略不计。

Conclusion: LDP应用于图像数据的效用损失并非固有缺陷，通过合适的数据表示（位平面分解）可以有效解决；LDP-Slicing为图像领域提供了一种轻量级、无需训练的隐私保护方案。

Abstract: Local Differential Privacy (LDP) is the gold standard trust model for privacy-preserving machine learning by guaranteeing privacy at the data source. However, its application to image data has long been considered impractical due to the high dimensionality of pixel space. Canonical LDP mechanisms are designed for low-dimensional data, resulting in severe utility degradation when applied to high-dimensional pixel spaces. This paper demonstrates that this utility loss is not inherent to LDP, but from its application to an inappropriate data representation. We introduce LDP-Slicing, a lightweight, training-free framework that resolves this domain mismatch. Our key insight is to decompose pixel values into a sequence of binary bit-planes. This transformation allows us to apply the LDP mechanism directly to the bit-level representation. To further strengthen privacy and preserve utility, we integrate a perceptual obfuscation module that mitigates human-perceivable leakage and an optimization-based privacy budget allocation strategy. This pipeline satisfies rigorous pixel-level $\varepsilon$-LDP while producing images that retain high utility for downstream tasks. Extensive experiments on face recognition and image classification demonstrate that LDP-Slicing outperforms existing DP/LDP baselines under comparable privacy budgets, with negligible computational overhead.

</details>


### [180] [GeoSolver: Scaling Test-Time Reasoning in Remote Sensing with Fine-Grained Process Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09551)
*Lang Sun,Ronghao Fu,Zhuoran Duan,Haoran Liu,Xueyan Liu,Bo Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoSolver是一个面向遥感推理的框架，通过构建大规模过程监督数据集Geo-PRM-2M、训练token级过程奖励模型GeoPRM，并采用Process-Aware Tree-GRPO强化学习算法，实现了可验证的、视觉忠实的链式推理，9B参数模型在多项遥感基准上达到SOTA，且GeoPRM作为通用地理空间验证器具备跨模型泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在遥感领域虽取得进展，但确保中间推理步骤的视觉忠实性（即推理与视觉证据一致）仍是关键瓶颈。

Method: 1) 通过熵引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索和目标视觉幻觉注入，构建token级过程监督数据集Geo-PRM-2M；2) 训练token级过程奖励模型GeoPRM提供细粒度忠实性反馈；3) 提出Process-Aware Tree-GRPO强化学习算法，结合树结构探索与忠实性加权奖励机制，对中间步骤进行精确信用分配。

Result: GeoSolver-9B在多种遥感基准上达到SOTA性能；GeoPRM实现了鲁棒的测试时扩展（TTS），作为通用地理空间验证器可提升GeoSolver-9B及通用VLM的性能，具备显著的跨模型泛化能力。

Conclusion: 本文证明了通过过程监督强化学习可以有效提升遥感推理的视觉忠实性和推理能力，且训练得到的过程奖励模型具有跨模型泛化的通用验证能力。

Abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced remote sensing interpretation, enabling them to perform complex, step-by-step reasoning remains highly challenging. Recent efforts to introduce Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to this domain have shown promise, yet ensuring the visual faithfulness of these intermediate steps remains a critical bottleneck. To address this, we introduce GeoSolver, a novel framework that transitions remote sensing reasoning toward verifiable, process-supervised reinforcement learning. We first construct Geo-PRM-2M, a large-scale, token-level process supervision dataset synthesized via entropy-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and targeted visual hallucination injection. Building upon this dataset, we train GeoPRM, a token-level process reward model (PRM) that provides granular faithfulness feedback. To effectively leverage these verification signals, we propose Process-Aware Tree-GRPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that integrates tree-structured exploration with a faithfulness-weighted reward mechanism to precisely assign credit to intermediate steps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our resulting model, GeoSolver-9B, achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse remote sensing benchmarks. Crucially, GeoPRM unlocks robust Test-Time Scaling (TTS). Serving as a universal geospatial verifier, it seamlessly scales the performance of GeoSolver-9B and directly enhances general-purpose VLMs, highlighting its remarkable cross-model generalization.

</details>


### [181] [LR-SGS: Robust LiDAR-Reflectance-Guided Salient Gaussian Splatting for Self-Driving Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12647)
*ZY Chen,F Zhu,H Zhu,DY Kong,XK Kuang,YJ Zhang,CM Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LR-SGS 是一种利用激光雷达反射率引导的显著高斯泼溅方法，通过结构感知的显著高斯表示、反射率校准与RGB联合对齐，在自驾驶场景中实现了更高效、更鲁棒的新视角合成与场景重建，在复杂光照条件下相比OmniRe提升了1.18 dB PSNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS方法在自驾驶场景中未能充分利用点云中的丰富信息（如反射率）以及激光雷达与RGB之间的互补性，导致在高运动与复杂光照等挑战性场景下性能退化。

Method: 提出了LR-SGS方法，包括：(1) 从激光雷达提取几何与反射率特征点，通过显著变换和密度控制初始化结构感知的显著高斯表示；(2) 将激光雷达强度标定为反射率，作为光照不变的材料通道附着到每个高斯上，与RGB联合对齐以强制边界一致性。

Result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上，LR-SGS使用更少的高斯和更短的训练时间实现了更优的重建性能，在复杂光照场景下PSNR比OmniRe高1.18 dB。

Conclusion: LR-SGS通过融合激光雷达反射率引导与RGB信息，显著提升了自驾驶场景下3DGS的鲁棒性和效率，验证了多模态信息互补的有效性。

Abstract: Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have demonstrated the feasibility of self-driving scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis. However, most existing methods either rely solely on cameras or use LiDAR only for Gaussian initialization or depth supervision, while the rich scene information contained in point clouds, such as reflectance, and the complementarity between LiDAR and RGB have not been fully exploited, leading to degradation in challenging self-driving scenes, such as those with high ego-motion and complex lighting. To address these issues, we propose a robust and efficient LiDAR-reflectance-guided Salient Gaussian Splatting method (LR-SGS) for self-driving scenes, which introduces a structure-aware Salient Gaussian representation, initialized from geometric and reflectance feature points extracted from LiDAR and refined through a salient transform and improved density control to capture edge and planar structures. Furthermore, we calibrate LiDAR intensity into reflectance and attach it to each Gaussian as a lighting-invariant material channel, jointly aligned with RGB to enforce boundary consistency. Extensive experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate that LR-SGS achieves superior reconstruction performance with fewer Gaussians and shorter training time. In particular, on Complex Lighting scenes, our method surpasses OmniRe by 1.18 dB PSNR.

</details>


### [182] [Demystifying Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.16870)
*Ruisi Wang,Zhongang Cai,Fanyi Pu,Junxiang Xu,Wanqi Yin,Maijunxian Wang,Ran Ji,Chenyang Gu,Bo Li,Ziqi Huang,Hokin Deng,Dahua Lin,Ziwei Liu,Lei Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文挑战了视频生成模型中推理机制源于帧间链式推理（Chain-of-Frames）的既有假设，发现推理实际上主要沿扩散去噪步骤展开（Chain-of-Steps），并识别出工作记忆、自我修正、感知先于行动等涌现行为，以及DiT中层的功能特化。提出了一种无需训练的集成策略作为概念验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战视频扩散模型中推理机制源于Chain-of-Frames（帧间顺序推理）的既有假设，揭示其真实机理。

Method: 通过定性分析和定向探针实验，研究扩散去噪步骤中的推理动态；分析Diffusion Transformer中层的功能特化；提出基于不同随机种子的潜在轨迹集成的训练无关策略。

Result: 发现推理主要在扩散去噪步骤中涌现（Chain-of-Steps），模型在早期探索多个候选解并逐步收敛；识别出工作记忆、自我修正与增强、感知先于行动三种涌现行为；揭示DiT中早期层编码感知结构、中间层执行推理、后期层整合潜在表征的功能特化。

Conclusion: 为视频生成模型中推理能力的涌现机制提供了系统理解，并提出了一个简单的训练无关策略作为增强推理的概念验证，为未来利用视频模型内在推理动态作为智能新基础铺平道路。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generation have revealed an unexpected phenomenon: diffusion-based video models exhibit non-trivial reasoning capabilities. Prior work attributes this to a Chain-of-Frames (CoF) mechanism, where reasoning is assumed to unfold sequentially across video frames. In this work, we challenge this assumption and uncover a fundamentally different mechanism. We show that reasoning in video models instead primarily emerges along the diffusion denoising steps. Through qualitative analysis and targeted probing experiments, we find that models explore multiple candidate solutions in early denoising steps and progressively converge to a final answer, a process we term Chain-of-Steps (CoS). Beyond this core mechanism, we identify several emergent reasoning behaviors critical to model performance: (1) working memory, enabling persistent reference; (2) self-correction and enhancement, allowing recovery from incorrect intermediate solutions; and (3) perception before action, where early steps establish semantic grounding and later steps perform structured manipulation. During a diffusion step, we further uncover self-evolved functional specialization within Diffusion Transformers, where early layers encode dense perceptual structure, middle layers execute reasoning, and later layers consolidate latent representations. Motivated by these insights, we present a simple training-free strategy as a proof-of-concept, demonstrating how reasoning can be improved by ensembling latent trajectories from identical models with different random seeds. Overall, our work provides a systematic understanding of how reasoning emerges in video generation models, offering a foundation to guide future research in better exploiting the inherent reasoning dynamics of video models as a new substrate for intelligence.

</details>


### [183] [To See or To Please: Uncovering Visual Sycophancy and Split Beliefs in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18373)
*Rui Hong,Shuxue Quan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出三层诊断框架，发现当前VLM中72.9%样本存在视觉迎合现象（Visual Sycophancy），即模型内部保留正确视觉证据却解码出幻觉答案，且零样本出现稳健拒绝（Robust Refusal）。随着模型规模扩大，语言捷径减少但视觉迎合加剧，表明扩展规模无法解决视觉接地问题。诊断分数可用于无需训练的预测策略，在50%覆盖率下提升+9.5%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究视觉语言模型（VLM）在回答正确时是否真正依赖视觉信息，即诊断模型的视觉接地（grounding）能力，区分感知、依赖和对齐三类失败模式。

Method: 提出三层诊断框架（Tri-Layer Diagnostic Framework），包含三个每样本指标：潜在异常检测（Latent Anomaly Detection）、视觉必要性分数（Visual Necessity Score）和竞争分数（Competition Score）。通过反事实盲视、噪声和冲突三种干预，对9个VLM和9000个模型-样本对进行系统分析。

Result: 72.9%样本表现出视觉迎合现象（Visual Sycophancy），即内部证据保留但输出幻觉答案；零样本出现稳健拒绝（Robust Refusal）。在Qwen-VL家族中，跨代际扩展单调减少语言捷径但加剧视觉迎合。诊断分数可实现无需训练的选择性预测策略，在50%覆盖率下准确率提升+9.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 当前对齐训练消除了拒绝作为解码结果的可能性，但视觉接地问题并未解决。仅靠模型规模扩展和更新的后训练方法无法从根本上解决VLM的视觉接地问题，需要新的训练范式。

Abstract: When VLMs answer correctly, do they genuinely rely on visual information? We introduce a Tri-Layer Diagnostic Framework with three per-sample metrics: Latent Anomaly Detection, Visual Necessity Score, and Competition Score, which disentangle perception, dependency, and alignment failures. Across 9 VLMs and 9,000 model-sample pairs under counterfactual blind, noise, and conflict interventions, 72.9% of samples exhibit Visual Sycophancy, a Split Beliefs pattern in which internal evidence is preserved yet a hallucinated answer is decoded, while zero samples show Robust Refusal, indicating that current alignment training has eliminated refusal as a decoding outcome. Scaling within the Qwen-VL family, both within- and across-generation, monotonically reduces Language Shortcuts but amplifies Visual Sycophancy, showing that scale and newer post-training alone cannot resolve the grounding problem. Diagnostic scores further enable a training-free selective-prediction strategy yielding up to +9.5 percentage points accuracy at 50% coverage.

</details>


### [184] [Detached Skip-Links and $R$-Probe: Decoupling Feature Aggregation from Gradient Propagation for MLLM OCR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20020)
*Ziye Yuan,Ruchang Yao,Chengxin Zheng,Yusheng Zhao,Daxiang Dong,Ming Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现多模态大语言模型中跳跃连接（skip pathways）会导致梯度干扰，破坏低层视觉信号。提出**Detached Skip-Links**（前向保留浅层特征，反向切断梯度）和诊断指标**R-Probe**（像素级重建性度量），在不增加参数的情况下提升OCR任务表现和训练稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在高层次推理表现出色，但在需要细粒度视觉细节的OCR任务上表现不佳。作者发现多层特征融合中存在被忽视的优化问题——跳跃连接引入从高层语义目标到早期视觉层的直接反向传播路径，覆盖了低层信号并导致训练不稳定。

Method: 1) **Detached Skip-Links**：前向传播时重用浅层特征，但反向传播时切断跳过分支的梯度，以非对称设计减少梯度干扰。2) **R-Probe**：利用LLM前四分之一层初始化的浅层解码器，衡量投影视觉令牌的像素级可重建性，用于诊断细粒度信息是否保留且可被LLM使用。

Result: 在多种ViT骨干网络和多模态基准测试上，以及高达7M训练样本的规模下，该方法持续提升OCR相关基准性能，并在通用多模态任务上取得明显改进。

Conclusion: Detached Skip-Links是一种最小化修改，无需额外可学习参数即可改善梯度干扰、提升训练稳定性和收敛性。R-Probe提供了一种有效的诊断手段。该方法在OCR和通用多模态任务上均有效。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at high-level reasoning yet fail on OCR tasks where fine-grained visual details are compromised or misaligned. We identify an overlooked optimization issue in multi-layer feature fusion. Skip pathways introduce direct back-propagation paths from high-level semantic objectives to early visual layers. This mechanism overwrites low-level signals and destabilizes training. To mitigate this gradient interference, we propose Detached Skip-Links, a minimal modification that reuses shallow features in the forward pass while stopping gradients through the skip branch during joint training. This asymmetric design reduces gradient interference, improving stability and convergence without adding learnable parameters. To diagnose whether fine-grained information is preserved and usable by an LLM, we introduce $R$-Probe, which measures pixel-level reconstructability of projected visual tokens using a shallow decoder initialized from the first quarter of the LLM layers. Across multiple ViT backbones and multimodal benchmarks, and at scales up to 7M training samples, our approach consistently improves OCR-centric benchmarks and delivers clear gains on general multimodal tasks.

</details>


### [185] [DirectFisheye-GS: Enabling Native Fisheye Input in Gaussian Splatting with Cross-View Joint Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.00648)
*Zhengxian Yang,Fei Xie,Xutao Xue,Rui Zhang,Taicheng Huang,Yang Liu,Mengqi Ji,Tao Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了DirectFisheye-GS，将鱼眼相机模型直接集成到3D Gaussian Splatting框架中，避免了传统先去畸变再训练带来的信息丢失和细节稀释问题。同时引入特征重叠驱动的跨视图联合优化策略，解决了边缘区域因畸变增大和随机视图选择导致的漂浮物伪影，在公开数据集上达到或超越SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS方法处理鱼眼图像时需先进行去畸变预处理，这导致两个问题：1) 去畸变产生的黑边造成信息丢失，丧失鱼眼大FOV的优势；2) 去畸变的拉伸插值重采样使像素值扩散到更大区域，稀释了细节密度，导致3DGS过拟合低频区域，产生模糊和漂浮伪影。因此需要一种能直接处理鱼眼图像输入的3DGS方法。

Method: 1) 将鱼眼相机模型直接集成到原始3DGS框架中，实现原生鱼眼图像输入训练，无需预处理；2) 提出特征重叠驱动的跨视图联合优化策略，建立高斯在跨视图间一致的几何和光度约束，克服随机视图选择忽略跨视图相关性导致的极端形状（过大或拉长）问题。

Result: 在公开数据集上，DirectFisheye-GS匹配或超越了当前最先进方法的性能。

Conclusion: 直接集成鱼眼相机模型结合跨视图联合优化策略，能有效提升鱼眼图像输入的3D重建质量，且该跨视图优化技术同样适用于现有针孔相机管线的3DGS方法。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled efficient 3D scene reconstruction from everyday images with real-time, high-fidelity rendering, greatly advancing VR/AR applications. Fisheye cameras, with their wider field of view (FOV), promise high-quality reconstructions from fewer inputs and have recently attracted much attention. However, since 3DGS relies on rasterization, most subsequent works involving fisheye camera inputs first undistort images before training, which introduces two problems: 1) Black borders at image edges cause information loss and negate the fisheye's large FOV advantage; 2) Undistortion's stretch-and-interpolate resampling spreads each pixel's value over a larger area, diluting detail density -- causes 3DGS overfitting these low-frequency zones, producing blur and floating artifacts. In this work, we integrate fisheye camera model into the original 3DGS framework, enabling native fisheye image input for training without preprocessing. Despite correct modeling, we observed that the reconstructed scenes still exhibit floaters at image edges: Distortion increases toward the periphery, and 3DGS's original per-iteration random-selecting-view optimization ignores the cross-view correlations of a Gaussian, leading to extreme shapes (e.g., oversized or elongated) that degrade reconstruction quality. To address this, we introduce a feature-overlap-driven cross-view joint optimization strategy that establishes consistent geometric and photometric constraints across views-a technique equally applicable to existing pinhole-camera-based pipelines. Our DirectFisheye-GS matches or surpasses state-of-the-art performance on public datasets. Project Page: https://yzxqh.github.io/DirectFisheye-GS/ .

</details>


### [186] [SenBen: Sensitive Scene Graphs for Explainable Content Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08819)
*Fatih Cagatay Akyon,Alptekin Temizel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SenBen基准和轻量级学生模型，实现敏感内容的可解释性场景图生成，在多项指标上超越大多数VLM和商业API，且推理速度提升7.6倍、显存节省16倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有内容审核系统仅将图像分类为安全/不安全，缺乏空间定位和可解释性，无法解释检测到的敏感行为、涉及人员或发生位置。

Method: 构建SenBen基准（13999帧来自157部电影，含场景图标注和16个敏感标签）；将前沿VLM蒸馏为241M学生模型，采用多任务训练策略，包括基于后缀的对象身份、词汇感知召回（VAR）损失、解耦的Query2Label标签头与非对称损失。

Result: 学生模型在SenBen召回率上比标准交叉熵训练提升+6.4个百分点；在有根场景图指标上超越除Gemini外的所有VLM和所有商业安全API；目标检测和字幕得分最高；推理速度7.6倍、显存16倍更优。

Conclusion: 提出的轻量级模型在敏感内容的空间可解释性分析上达到领先水平，同时大幅提升推理效率，适用于实际部署场景。

Abstract: Content moderation systems classify images as safe or unsafe but lack spatial grounding and interpretability: they cannot explain what sensitive behavior was detected, who is involved, or where it occurs. We introduce the Sensitive Benchmark (SenBen), the first large-scale scene graph benchmark for sensitive content, comprising 13,999 frames from 157 movies annotated with Visual Genome-style scene graphs (25 object classes, 28 attributes including affective states such as pain, fear, aggression, and distress, 14 predicates) and 16 sensitivity tags across 5 categories. We distill a frontier VLM into a compact 241M student model using a multi-task recipe that addresses vocabulary imbalance in autoregressive scene graph generation through suffix-based object identity, Vocabulary-Aware Recall (VAR) Loss, and a decoupled Query2Label tag head with asymmetric loss, yielding a +6.4 percentage point improvement in SenBen Recall over standard cross-entropy training. On grounded scene graph metrics, our student model outperforms all evaluated VLMs except Gemini models and all commercial safety APIs, while achieving the highest object detection and captioning scores across all models, at $7.6\times$ faster inference and $16\times$ less GPU memory.

</details>


### [187] [Mining Attribute Subspaces for Efficient Fine-tuning of 3D Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10095)
*Yu Jiang,Hanwen Jiang,Ahmed Abdelkader,Wen-Sheng Chu,Brandon Y. Feng,Zhangyang Wang,Qixing Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从合成数据中提取与3D数据变化（纹理、几何、相机运动、光照）相关联的LoRA子空间的方法，证明了这些子空间近似解耦，并利用它们构建约简LoRA子空间，从而在下游任务中实现更高效的微调和更好的预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着3D基础模型的出现，LoRA成为下游任务微调的主流范式。但3D数据集在纹理、几何、相机运动和光照等方面存在显著差异，目前尚不清楚LoRA微调中是否存在与这些变化类型对应的子空间，以及这些子空间是否解耦。本文旨在回答这些基础性问题。

Method: 1) 生成具有受控变化的合成数据集；2) 在每个合成数据集上微调LoRA适配器；3) 提取与每种变化类型关联的LoRA子空间；4) 将多个子空间整合为约简LoRA子空间。

Result: 这些子空间近似解耦；约简LoRA子空间能提升下游任务微调的效率和预测精度；尽管完全从合成数据中导出，该约简子空间能够泛化到真实数据集。

Conclusion: 本文验证了3D数据中不同变化类型对应解耦的LoRA子空间的存在性，并提出了一种有效的子空间提取与整合方法，为LoRA在3D基础模型微调中的高效应用提供了理论依据和实践指导。

Abstract: With the emergence of 3D foundation models, there is growing interest in fine-tuning them for downstream tasks, where LoRA is the dominant fine-tuning paradigm. As 3D datasets exhibit distinct variations in texture, geometry, camera motion, and lighting, there are interesting fundamental questions: 1) Are there LoRA subspaces associated with each type of variation? 2) Are these subspaces disentangled (i.e., orthogonal to each other)? 3) How do we compute them effectively? This paper provides answers to all these questions. We introduce a robust approach that generates synthetic datasets with controlled variations, fine-tunes a LoRA adapter on each dataset, and extracts a LoRA sub-space associated with each type of variation. We show that these subspaces are approximately disentangled. Integrating them leads to a reduced LoRA subspace that enables efficient LoRA fine-tuning with improved prediction accuracy for downstream tasks. In particular, we show that such a reduced LoRA subspace, despite being derived entirely from synthetic data, generalizes to real datasets. An ablation study validates the effectiveness of the choices in our approach.

</details>


### [188] [Degradation-Consistent Paired Training for Robust AI-Generated Image Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10102)
*Zongyou Yang,Yinghan Hou,Xiaokun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出退化一致性配对训练（DCPT），通过对每张训练图像构建干净视图和退化视图，并施加特征一致性损失和预测一致性损失，在不增加参数和推理开销的情况下，显著提升AI生成图像检测器在真实世界图像退化（如JPEG压缩、高斯模糊、分辨率下降）下的鲁棒性。在Synthbuster基准上，退化条件下平均准确率提升9.1个百分点，干净准确率仅下降0.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法在处理真实世界图像退化（如JPEG压缩、高斯模糊、分辨率下采样）时性能严重下降。当前最先进方法（如B-Free）将退化鲁棒性视为数据增强的副产品，而非明确的训练目标，缺乏对退化鲁棒性的直接优化。

Method: 提出DCPT训练策略：为每张训练图像构建干净视图和退化视图，施加两种一致性约束——(1) 特征一致性损失：最小化干净视图与退化视图表示之间的余弦距离；(2) 预测一致性损失：基于对称KL散度对齐两个视图的输出分布。该方法不引入额外参数，推理时无额外开销。

Result: 在Synthbuster基准（9个生成器、8种退化条件）上，DCPT相比未使用配对训练的基线在退化条件下平均准确率提升9.1个百分点，干净准确率仅下降0.9%。JPEG压缩条件下提升最为显著（+15.7%至+17.9%）。消融实验表明，添加架构组件在有限训练数据上会导致过拟合，训练目标改进比架构增强更有效。

Conclusion: DCPT通过明确的配对一致性训练目标，在不增加模型复杂度的情况下，显著提升了AI生成图像检测器对图像退化的鲁棒性，验证了改进训练目标比增强架构更有效的观点。

Abstract: AI-generated image detectors suffer significant performance degradation under real-world image corruptions such as JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and resolution downsampling. We observe that state-of-the-art methods, including B-Free, treat degradation robustness as a byproduct of data augmentation rather than an explicit training objective. In this work, we propose Degradation-Consistent Paired Training (DCPT), a simple yet effective training strategy that explicitly enforces robustness through paired consistency constraints. For each training image, we construct a clean view and a degraded view, then impose two constraints: a feature consistency loss that minimizes the cosine distance between clean and degraded representations, and a prediction consistency loss based on symmetric KL divergence that aligns output distributions across views. DCPT adds zero additional parameters and zero inference overhead. Experiments on the Synthbuster benchmark (9 generators, 8 degradation conditions) demonstrate that DCPT improves the degraded-condition average accuracy by 9.1 percentage points compared to an identical baseline without paired training, while sacrificing only 0.9% clean accuracy. The improvement is most pronounced under JPEG compression (+15.7% to +17.9%). Ablation further reveals that adding architectural components leads to overfitting on limited training data, confirming that training objective improvement is more effective than architectural augmentation for degradation robustness.

</details>


### [189] [Radar-Camera BEV Multi-Task Learning with Cross-Task Attention Bridge for Joint 3D Detection and Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12918)
*Ahmet İnanç,Özgür Erkent*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CTAB是一个跨任务注意力桥梁模块，通过在共享BEV空间中利用多尺度可变形注意力在检测和分割分支间双向交换特征，提升了自动驾驶中雷达-相机融合的3D感知性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有雷达-相机融合方法将检测和分割任务孤立处理，忽略了跨任务特征共享的机会：检测的几何线索可提升分割，分割的密集道路布局上下文可辅助检测。

Method: 提出CTAB（Cross-Task Attention Bridge），一个双向模块，通过多尺度可变形注意力在共享BEV空间中交换检测和分割分支的特征；结合基于实例归一化的分割解码器和可学习BEV上采样以提供更精细的BEV表示。

Result: 在nuScenes上，CTAB在7个类别上提升了分割性能，同时检测性能基本持平；在4类子集（可行驶区域、人行横道、人行道、车辆）上，联合多任务模型达到51.0 mIoU-4，同时提供有竞争力的3D检测结果。

Conclusion: 跨任务特征共享在BEV多任务感知中有效，CTAB能在不牺牲检测性能的前提下显著提升分割效果，验证了双向注意力桥接机制的价值。

Abstract: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations are the dominant paradigm for 3D perception in autonomous driving, providing a unified spatial canvas where detection and segmentation features are geometrically registered to the same physical coordinate system. However, existing radar-camera fusion methods treat these tasks in isolation, missing the opportunity for cross-task feature sharing: object-level geometric cues from detection can sharpen segmentation, while dense road-layout context from segmentation can anchor detection. We propose \textbf{CTAB} (Cross-Task Attention Bridge), a bidirectional module that exchanges features between detection and segmentation branches via multi-scale deformable attention in shared BEV space. CTAB is integrated into a multi-task framework with an Instance Normalization-based segmentation decoder and learnable BEV upsampling to provide a more detailed BEV representation. On nuScenes, CTAB improves segmentation on 7 classes over the joint multi-task baseline at essentially neutral detection. On a 4-class subset (drivable area, pedestrian crossing, walkway, vehicle), our joint multi-task model achieves 51.0 mIoU-4 while simultaneously providing competitive 3D detection.

</details>


### [190] [FiRe: Fine-grained Multimodal Reasoning for Enhanced Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13491)
*Yongjin Kim,Yoonjin Oh,Yerin Kim,Hyomin Kim,Jeeyoung Yun,Yujung Heo,Minjun Kim,Sungwoong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FiRe，一种用于增强MLLM文本到图像生成的细粒度多模态推理方法，通过将提示分解为关键视觉需求、自判断生成图像中的满足情况并进行局部精细化修正。同时提出FiRe-GRPO强化学习方法，在GRPO中引入步骤级奖励和粒度信用分配以增强多步推理能力。实验表明FiRe在组合性文本到图像生成任务上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一MLLM虽具备自反思和自精炼的推理能力，但在文本到图像生成中未被充分利用；已有的多模态推理方法仅依赖提示增强或整体图像-文本对齐评估，缺乏对细粒度提示属性的反射和精炼，导致细粒度控制能力有限。

Method: FiRe方法包含三个步骤：1) 将提示分解为关键视觉需求；2) 自判断生成图像中这些需求的满足情况；3) 根据自生成的精确反馈进行局部精细化修正。FiRe-GRPO将推理过程建模为步骤级决策问题，设计步骤特定奖励并计算步骤级优势以实现粒度信用分配，从而增强MLLM的多模态推理能力。

Result: FiRe在多种文本到图像基准上一致优于竞争性基线方法，包括现有基于推理的方法，尤其在组合性文本到图像基准上取得了显著提升。

Conclusion: 细粒度多步推理和步骤级强化学习能够有效提升统一MLLM在文本到图像生成中的细粒度控制能力，FiRe方法在该任务上展现出显著优势。

Abstract: With the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), unified MLLMs that jointly perform image understanding and generation have advanced significantly. However, despite the inherent reasoning capabilities of unified MLLMs for self-reflection and self-refinement, their use in text-to-image generation remains largely underexplored. Meanwhile, existing multimodal reasoning-based image generation methods mostly rely on prompt augmentation or holistic image-text alignment judgments, without fine-grained reflection and refinement of detailed prompt attributes, leading to limited fine-grained control. To address this limitation, we propose FiRe, a Fine-grained Multimodal Reasoning method for enhanced image generation by MLLM. In specific, FiRe performs a fine-grained multi-step reasoning by first decomposing the prompt into key visual requirements and then self-judging their satisfaction in the generated image, followed by localized refinement according to self-generated precise feedback. In addition, to further strengthen the MLLM's multimodal reasoning ability, we introduce FiRe-GRPO, a reinforcement learning method tailored to FiRe. Since standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) suffers from sparse, outcome-based rewards in multi-step reasoning, we formulate our reasoning process as a step-level decision-making problem, design step-specific rewards, and compute step-level advantages for granular credit assignment within GRPO. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FiRe consistently outperforms competitive text-to-image baselines, including existing reasoning-based methods, with particularly substantial gains on compositional text-to-image benchmarks.

</details>


### [191] [DETR-ViP: Detection Transformer with Robust Discriminative Visual Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14684)
*Bo Qian,Dahu Shi,Xing Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DETR-ViP框架，通过全局提示集成和视觉-文本提示关系蒸馏增强视觉提示的全局可区分性，并采用选择性融合策略，显著提升了视觉提示目标检测的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉提示检测被忽视且性能次优，根本原因在于视觉提示缺乏全局可区分性，现有方法仅将其作为文本提示检测的副产品。

Method: 提出DETR-ViP框架，包含三个核心组件：1）全局提示集成（Global Prompt Integration）；2）视觉-文本提示关系蒸馏（Visual-Textual Prompt Relation Distillation）；3）选择性融合策略（Selective Fusion Strategy），基于图像-文本对比学习训练。

Result: 在COCO、LVIS、ODinW和Roboflow100数据集上，DETR-ViP在视觉提示检测任务上显著优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过增强视觉提示的全局可区分性和采用选择性融合，DETR-ViP有效释放了视觉提示检测的潜力，消融实验验证了各改进模块的有效性。

Abstract: Visual prompted object detection enables interactive and flexible definition of target categories, thereby facilitating open-vocabulary detection. Since visual prompts are derived directly from image features, they often outperform text prompts in recognizing rare categories. Nevertheless, research on visual prompted detection has been largely overlooked, and it is typically treated as a byproduct of training text prompted detectors, which hinders its development. To fully unlock the potential of visual-prompted detection, we investigate the reasons why its performance is suboptimal and reveal that the underlying issue lies in the absence of global discriminability in visual prompts. Motivated by these observations, we propose DETR-ViP, a robust object detection framework that yields class-distinguishable visual prompts. On top of basic image-text contrastive learning, DETR-ViP incorporates global prompt integration and visual-textual prompt relation distillation to learn more discriminative prompt representations. In addition, DETR-ViP employs a selective fusion strategy that ensures stable and robust detection. Extensive experiments on COCO, LVIS, ODinW, and Roboflow100 demonstrate that DETR-ViP achieves substantially higher performance in visual prompt detection compared to other state-of-the-art counterparts. A series of ablation studies and analyses further validate the effectiveness of the proposed improvements and shed light on the underlying reasons for the enhanced detection capability of visual prompts.

</details>


### [192] [InHabit: Leveraging Image Foundation Models for Scalable 3D Human Placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19673)
*Nikita Kister,Pradyumna YM,István Sárándi,Jiayi Wang,Anna Khoreva,Gerard Pons-Moll*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 InHabit，一种利用2D基础模型知识自动生成3D人-场景交互数据的方法，通过渲染-生成-提升流程创建大规模数据集 InHabitants，实验证明该数据能提升3D人-场景重建和接触估计性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练具身智能体理解3D场景需要大量真实的人-环境交互数据，但真实数据采集成本高且局限于受控环境，现有合成数据仅依赖简单几何启发式，缺乏丰富的场景上下文信息。

Method: 采用渲染-生成-提升三阶段流程：(1) 渲染3D场景图像，使用视觉-语言模型提出符合场景上下文的交互动作；(2) 使用图像编辑模型将人体插入场景；(3) 通过优化过程将编辑结果提升为物理合理的SMPL-X人体模型，使其与场景几何对齐。

Result: 生成 InHabitants 数据集，包含约800个建筑级场景中的78K样本，具备完整3D几何、SMPL-X人体和图像。该数据增强后提升了RGB-based 3D人-场景重建和接触估计性能，在感知用户研究中78%情况下优于先前方法。

Conclusion: 证明了利用2D基础模型的常识知识可有效迁移到3D场景，自动生成高质量的人-场景交互数据，为具身智能研究提供重要数据资源。

Abstract: Training embodied agents to understand 3D scenes as humans do requires large-scale data of people meaningfully interacting with diverse environments, yet such data is scarce. Real-world capture is costly and limited to controlled settings, while existing synthetic datasets rely on simple geometric heuristics, ignoring rich scene context. In contrast, 2D foundation models trained at internet scale have acquired commonsense knowledge of human-environment interactions. To transfer this knowledge to 3D, we introduce InHabit, an automatic and scalable data generator for populating 3D scenes with interacting humans. InHabit follows a render-generate-lift principle: given a rendered 3D scene, a vision-language model proposes contextually meaningful actions, an image-editing model inserts a human, and an optimization procedure lifts the edited result into physically plausible SMPL-X bodies aligned with the scene geometry. Applied to Habitat-Matterport3D, InHabit produces InHabitants, the first large-scale photorealistic 3D human-scene interaction dataset, with 78K samples across $\sim$800 building-scale scenes with complete 3D geometry, SMPL-X bodies, and images. Augmenting standard training data with InHabitants improves RGB-based 3D human-scene reconstruction and contact estimation, and in a perceptual user study our data is preferred in 78% of cases over prior art.

</details>


### [193] [World-R1: Reinforcing 3D Constraints for Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24764)
*Weijie Wang,Xiaoxuan He,Youping Gu,Yifan Yang,Zeyu Zhang,Yefei He,Yanbo Ding,Xirui Hu,Donny Y. Chen,Zhiyuan He,Yuqing Yang,Bohan Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: World-R1通过强化学习框架，利用Flow-GRPO和预训练3D模型反馈，在不修改基础架构的前提下对齐视频生成与3D几何约束，显著提升3D一致性同时保持视觉质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频基础模型在视觉合成上表现出色但频繁出现几何不一致问题。已有方法通过架构修改注入3D先验，但计算成本高且限制可扩展性。

Method: 提出World-R1框架：1) 构建专门用于世界模拟的纯文本数据集；2) 采用Flow-GRPO算法，利用预训练3D基础模型和视觉语言模型的反馈进行优化；3) 使用周期性解耦训练策略平衡刚体几何一致性与动态场景流畅性。

Result: 该方法显著提升了3D一致性，同时保持了基础模型原有的视觉质量，有效弥合了视频生成与可扩展世界模拟之间的差距。

Conclusion: World-R1通过强化学习实现了视频生成与3D约束的对齐，无需修改底层架构即可增强几何一致性，为可扩展的世界模拟提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Recent video foundation models demonstrate impressive visual synthesis but frequently suffer from geometric inconsistencies. While existing methods attempt to inject 3D priors via architectural modifications, they often incur high computational costs and limit scalability. We propose World-R1, a framework that aligns video generation with 3D constraints through reinforcement learning. To facilitate this alignment, we introduce a specialized pure text dataset tailored for world simulation. Utilizing Flow-GRPO, we optimize the model using feedback from pre-trained 3D foundation models and vision-language models to enforce structural coherence without altering the underlying architecture. We further employ a periodic decoupled training strategy to balance rigid geometric consistency with dynamic scene fluidity. Extensive evaluations reveal that our approach significantly enhances 3D consistency while preserving the original visual quality of the foundation model, effectively bridging the gap between video generation and scalable world simulation.

</details>


### [194] [Decoding Scientific Experimental Images: The SPUR Benchmark for Perception, Understanding, and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27604)
*Junpeng Ding,Zichen Tang,Haihong E,Mengyuan Ji,Yang Liu,Haolin Tian,Haiyang Sun,Pengqi Sun,Yang Xu,Yichen Liu,Haocheng Gao,Zijie Xi,Ruomeng Jiang,Peizhi Zhao,Rongjin Li,Yuanze Li,Jiacheng Liu,Zhongjun Yang,Jintong Chen,Siying Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SPUR基准，包含4,264个QA对和1,084张专家精选图像，从面板级细粒度感知、跨面板关系理解和专家级推理三个维度评估多模态大模型在科学实验图像理解上的能力。实验表明现有模型远未达到专家水平，揭示了AI4S研究的关键瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前缺乏针对科学实验图像的细粒度、多维度评估基准，现有MLLMs在科学图像理解上的能力瓶颈尚未被系统揭示。

Method: 构建了包含1,084张专家精选图像和4,264个QA对的SPUR基准，从三个创新维度评估：面板级细粒度感知（数值、形态、信息定位）、跨面板关系理解（平均每样本14.3个面板）、专家级推理（五种实验范式的定性和定量推理）。

Result: 对20个MLLMs和4种MCoT方法的全面评估显示，现有模型远未达到科学图像解释的专家级要求。

Conclusion: 当前MLLMs在科学图像理解上存在显著瓶颈，亟需进一步提升以推动AI for Science研究。

Abstract: We introduce SPUR, a comprehensive benchmark for scientific experimental image perception, understanding, and reasoning, comprising 4,264 question-answering (QA) pairs derived from 1,084 expert-curated images. SPUR features three key innovations: (1) Panel-Level Fine-Grained Perception: evaluating the visual perception of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) across three dimensions (numerical, morphological, and information localization) on six fine-grained panel types; (2) Cross-Panel Relation Understanding: utilizing complex images with an average of 14.3 panels per sample to evaluate MLLMs' ability to decipher intricate cross-panel relations; (3) Expert-Level Reasoning: assessment of qualitative and quantitative reasoning across five experimental paradigms to determine if models can infer conclusions from evidence as human experts do. Comprehensive evaluation of 20 MLLMs and four multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) methods reveals that current models fall significantly short of the expert-level requirements for scientific image interpretation, underscoring a critical bottleneck in AI for Science (AI4S) research.

</details>


### [195] [MultiSense-Pneumo: A Multimodal Learning Framework for Pneumonia Screening in Resource-Constrained Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02207)
*Dineth Jayakody,Pasindu Thenahandi,Chameli Dommanige*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MultiSense-Pneumo，一个整合症状描述、咳嗽音频、语音和胸片的多模态肺炎筛查与分诊研究原型，采用确定性症状分诊、LightGBM声学分类、域对抗ResNet-18影像分析、Transformer语音识别及可解释后期融合，但未进行临床验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺炎在低资源环境中诊断困难，现有方法多依赖单一模态（如胸片），而临床评估本质上是多模态的（症状、呼吸模式、语音描述、影像），因此需要探索多模态融合的筛查框架。

Method: 集成五种模态：结构化症状分诊、LightGBM咳嗽音频分类、域对抗ResNet-18胸片分析、Transformer语音识别，通过可解释的后期融合算子将各模态转化为归一化关注信号并聚合为统一筛查估计，融合权重为启发式手工指定参数。

Result: 胸片通路在合成域偏移下表现良好，但咳嗽声学的异常类召回率较低，且缺乏端到端的多模态患者评估。

Conclusion: MultiSense-Pneumo作为筛查与分诊研究的框架和组件级原型，尚未达到临床验证或部署就绪状态，旨在为多模态肺炎筛查研究提供基础架构。

Abstract: Pneumonia remains a leading global cause of morbidity and mortality, particularly in low-resource settings where access to imaging, laboratory testing, and specialist care is limited. Clinical assessment relies on heterogeneous evidence, including symptoms, respiratory patterns, spoken descriptions, and chest imaging, making frontline screening inherently multimodal. However, many existing computational approaches remain unimodal and focus primarily on radiographs. In this work, we present MultiSense-Pneumo, a multimodal research prototype for pneumonia-oriented screening and triage support that integrates structured symptom descriptors, cough audio, spoken language, and chest radiographs. The system combines deterministic symptom triage, LightGBM-based acoustic classification, domain-adversarial radiograph analysis using ResNet-18, transformer-based speech recognition, and an interpretable late-fusion operator. Each modality is transformed into a normalized concern signal and aggregated into a unified screening estimate. The fusion weights are hand-specified and are treated as heuristic, interpretable parameters rather than learned or clinically optimized values. MultiSense-Pneumo is implemented with offline execution in mind on standard laptop-class hardware, but it is not presented as a deployment-validated or clinically validated diagnostic system. Experimental results demonstrate strong component-level performance of the radiograph pathway under synthetic domain shifts, while also highlighting important limitations, especially reduced abnormal-class recall for cough acoustics and the absence of paired end-to-end multimodal patient evaluation. MultiSense-Pneumo is therefore intended as a framework and component-level prototype for screening and triage research.

</details>


### [196] [UniPCB: A Generation-Assisted Detection Framework for PCB Defect Inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04635)
*Huan Zhang,Lianghong Tan,Yichu Xu,Zishan Su,Jiangzhong Cao,Huanqi Wu,Linwei Zhu,Xu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对工业物联网中PCB缺陷检测面临的数据稀缺、样本不平衡及复杂背景下特征表示不足的双重挑战，本文提出UniPCB生成-检测联合框架：生成端利用多模态条件生成器（边缘、深度、文本）结合ScaleEncoder与条件调制模块进行受控缺陷合成；检测端采用倒残差移位注意力与跨级互补融合模块实现全局-局部特征融合。在DsPCBSD+数据集上，检测mAP@0.5达98.0%，生成FID达129.61，全面超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业物联网中基于视觉的PCB缺陷检测面临两大相互加剧的挑战：一是缺陷样本稀缺且类别不平衡，严重限制模型训练效果；二是复杂电路背景下特征表示能力不足。现有生成方法依赖单模态条件且结构控制粗糙，检测方法虽改进架构却未解决数据瓶颈问题。

Method: 提出UniPCB生成辅助检测框架：(1) 生成侧：多模态条件生成器并行提取边缘、深度、文本条件，ScaleEncoder将条件嵌入扩散U-Net的四个分辨率层级，条件调制模块在每个尺度上施加FiLM风格的空间自适应调制，实现结构对齐、缺陷感知的样本合成；(2) 检测侧：倒残差移位注意力机制耦合自注意力与移位卷积以捕捉全局上下文与局部纹理，跨级互补融合模块通过像素级门控实现选择性跨层特征融合。合成样本直接扩充检测训练集，使生成与检测相互增益。

Result: 在DsPCBSD+数据集上，UniPCB缺陷检测达到mAP@0.5为98.0%、mAP@0.5:0.95为61.8%，超越所有对比方法；生成分支FID为129.61、SSIM为0.619，优于现有条件生成方法。

Conclusion: 本文通过生成-检测联合框架有效解决了IIoT PCB缺陷检测中的数据稀缺与特征表示不足问题，验证了生成模型与检测模型协同优化的可行性，为工业场景下的智能质检提供了新范式。

Abstract: In the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), enabling intelligent, real-time Printed Circuit Board (PCB) defect inspection is critical for ensuring product reliability. However, existing IIoT-based visual inspection systems face two compounding challenges: scarce and imbalanced defect samples that limit model training, and insufficient feature representation under complex circuit backgrounds. Existing generation methods rely on single-modality conditions with coarse structural control, while detection methods improve architectures without addressing the data bottleneck. To resolve both challenges jointly, we propose a generation-assisted PCB defect inspection framework that integrates controlled defect synthesis with task-specific defect detection within an IIoT-enabled pipeline. On the generation side, a Multi-modal Condition Generator extracts complementary edge, depth, and text conditions in parallel. A ScaleEncoder then embeds these conditions into the diffusion U-Net at four resolutions, and a Condition Modulation applies FiLM-style spatially-adaptive modulation at each scale, enabling structurally aligned and defect-aware sample synthesis to augment the scarce IIoT dataset. On the detection side, an Inverted Residual Shift Attention couples self-attention with shift-wise convolution to jointly capture global context and local texture, and a Cross-level Complementary Fusion Block generates pixel-level gates for selective cross-level feature fusion. The synthesized samples directly enrich the detection training set, so that improvements in generation compound with improvements in detection. Extensive experiments on DsPCBSD+ demonstrate that UniPCB achieves mAP@0.5 of 98.0% and mAP@0.5:0.95 of 61.8% on defect detection, surpassing all compared methods, while the generation branch attains an FID of 129.61 and SSIM of 0.619, outperforming existing conditional generation approaches.

</details>


### [197] [ScriptHOI: Learning Scripted State Transitions for Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05057)
*Minh Anh Nguyen,Quang Huy Tran,Bao Ngoc Le,SuiYang Guang,Tuan Kiet Pham,Linh Chi Vo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ScriptHOI将交互短语分解为多个语义槽（如身体角色、接触、几何、 affordance、运动、物体状态），通过视觉状态分词器解析人-物对的状态令牌，并利用槽位匹配器估算脚本覆盖度和冲突度来校准HOI预测，同时引入区间部分标签学习和反事实脚本对比损失，以减少物体 affordance 主导的误检，提升罕见和未见交互的识别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇HOI检测器过度依赖物体 affordance 和短语共现模式，导致模型仅凭物体存在（如刀和蛋糕）就预测"切蛋糕"，而忽略了手、工具、目标、接触模式和物体状态等多维证据是否真正支持该交互动作。

Method: 1) 将交互短语分解为身体角色、接触、几何、 affordance、运动和物体状态六个语义槽位；2) 视觉状态分词器将检测到的人-物对解析为对应的状态令牌；3) 槽位匹配器估算脚本覆盖度（匹配程度）和脚本冲突度（矛盾程度），用于校准HOI logits；4) 区间部分标签学习为未标注的候选交互提供基于脚本的上下界概率约束；5) 反事实脚本对比损失通过交换单个脚本槽位来抑制物体主导的捷径学习。

Result: 在HICO-DET、V-COCO和开放词汇HOI数据集上，ScriptHOI显著提升了罕见和未见交互的识别性能，同时大幅减少了因物体 affordance 冲突导致的假阳性预测。

Conclusion: 将交互短语结构化为状态转移脚本，并通过脚本覆盖度和冲突度进行显式验证，能够有效缓解物体 affordance 偏差，提升开放词汇HOI检测的语义泛化能力和细粒度判别能力。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection requires recognizing interaction phrases that may not appear as annotated categories during training. Recent vision-language HOI detectors improve semantic transfer by matching human-object features with text embeddings, but their predictions are often dominated by object affordance and phrase-level co-occurrence. As a result, a model may predict \textit{cut cake} from the presence of a knife and a cake without verifying whether the hand, tool, target, contact pattern, and object state jointly support the action. We propose \textbf{ScriptHOI}, a structured framework that represents each interaction phrase as a soft scripted state transition. Rather than treating a phrase as a single class token, ScriptHOI decomposes it into body-role, contact, geometry, affordance, motion, and object-state slots. A visual state tokenizer parses each detected human-object pair into corresponding state tokens, and a slot-wise matcher estimates both script coverage and script conflict. These two quantities calibrate HOI logits, expose missing visual evidence, and provide training constraints for incomplete annotations. To avoid suppressing valid but unannotated interactions, we further introduce interval partial-label learning, which constrains unannotated candidates with script-derived lower and upper probability bounds instead of assigning closed-world negatives. A counterfactual script contrast loss swaps individual script slots to discourage object-only shortcuts. Experiments on HICO-DET, V-COCO, and open-vocabulary HOI splits show that ScriptHOI improves rare and unseen interaction recognition while substantially reducing affordance-conflict false positives.

</details>


### [198] [D-OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continuously Tuning Step-Distilled Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05204)
*Dengyang Jiang,Xin Jin,Dongyang Liu,Zanyi Wang,Mingzhe Zheng,Ruoyi Du,Xiangpeng Yang,Qilong Wu,Zhen Li,Peng Gao,Harry Yang,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了D-OPSD，一种用于步骤蒸馏扩散模型的新训练范式，通过在监督微调过程中进行在策略自蒸馏学习，使模型能够学习新概念而不损失其原有的少步推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前高性能图像生成模型正从多步模型转向少步模型（如Z-Image-Turbo和FLUX.2-klein），但这些模型直接进行连续监督微调会损害其固有的少步推理能力，亟需一种能保留少步能力的微调方法。

Method: D-OPSD利用现代扩散模型中LLM/VLM编码器的上下文能力，将训练构建为在策略自蒸馏过程：训练时模型同时扮演教师和学生角色，学生仅以文本特征为条件，教师以文本和目标图像的多模态特征为条件，通过最小化学生在自身轨迹上的预测分布与教师的预测分布之间的差异来优化。

Result: D-OPSD使模型能够在自身轨迹上、在自身监督下学习新概念、风格等，同时不牺牲原有的少步推理能力。

Conclusion: D-OPSD是一种有效的训练范式，解决了少步扩散模型在监督微调中保持少步能力的关键问题，为后续研究提供了新方向。

Abstract: The landscape of high-performance image generation models is currently shifting from the inefficient multi-step ones to the efficient few-step counterparts (e.g, Z-Image-Turbo and FLUX.2-klein). However, these models present significant challenges for direct continuous supervised fine-tuning. For example, applying the commonly used fine-tuning technique would compromise their inherent few-step inference capability. To address this, we propose D-OPSD, a novel training paradigm for step-distilled diffusion models that enables on-policy learning during supervised fine-tuning. We first find that the modern diffusion models, where the LLM/VLM serves as the encoder, can inherit its encoder's in-context capabilities. This enables us to formulate the training as an on-policy self-distillation process. Specifically, during training, we make the model act as both the teacher and the student with different contexts, where the student is conditioned only on the text feature, while the teacher is conditioned on the multimodal feature of both the text prompt and the target image. Training minimizes the two predicted distributions over the student's own roll-outs. By optimizing on the model's own trajectory and under its own supervision, D-OPSD enables the model to learn new concepts, styles, etc., without sacrificing the original few-step capacity.

</details>


### [199] [VT-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Visual-Tabular Multi-Modal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08146)
*Zi-Yi Jia,Zi-Jian Cheng,Xin-Yue Zhang,Kun-Yang Yu,Zhi Zhou,Yu-Feng Li,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VT-Bench是首个统一的视觉-表格数据基准，涵盖14个数据集、9个领域和75.6万样本，评估了23个代表性模型，旨在推动多模态视觉-表格基础模型的研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态学习在视觉-文本任务中备受关注，但视觉-表格数据（在医疗、工业等高风险领域至关重要）尚未得到充分探索，缺乏统一的基准来标准化该领域的研究。

Method: 构建了VT-Bench基准，聚合14个数据集覆盖9个领域（以医疗为主，兼宠物、媒体、交通等），包含75.6万样本；评估23个代表性模型，涵盖单模态专家、专用视觉-表格模型、通用视觉语言模型（VLM）及工具增强方法。

Result: 评估结果揭示了视觉-表格学习面临的显著挑战，现有模型在该任务上表现有限。

Conclusion: VT-Bench将为社区构建更强大的多模态视觉-表格基础模型提供推动力，相关基准已开源。

Abstract: Multi-model learning has attracted great attention in visual-text tasks. However, visual-tabular data, which plays a pivotal role in high-stakes domains like healthcare and industry, remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce \textit{VT-Bench}, the first unified benchmark for standardizing vision-tabular discriminative prediction and generative reasoning tasks. VT-Bench aggregates 14 datasets across 9 domains (medical-centric, while covering pets, media, and transportation) with over 756K samples. We evaluate 23 representative models, including unimodal experts, specialized visual-tabular models, general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs), and tool-augmented methods, highlighting substantial challenges of visual-tabular learning. We believe VT-Bench will stimulate the community to build more powerful multi-modal vision-tabular foundation models.
  Benchmark: https://github.com/Ziyi-Jia990/VT-Bench

</details>


### [200] [Hide to See: Reasoning-prefix Masking for Visual-anchored Thinking in VLM Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11651)
*Seonghoon Yu,Dongjun Nam,Byung-Kwan Lee,Jeany Son*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新颖的思考-回答蒸馏框架，通过遮蔽学生模型中显著的推理前缀，迫使模型在蒸馏过程中更依赖视觉证据，从而将大型VLM的思考能力蒸馏到紧凑模型中，缓解视觉遗忘问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）采用"先思考再回答"范式虽能提升推理性能，但计算成本高昂。将其蒸馏到紧凑模型时，学生模型在长推理轨迹中容易遗忘视觉信息（视觉遗忘问题），现有蒸馏方法未有效解决这一挑战。

Method: 1）Token级显著推理前缀遮蔽：选择性地遮蔽对下一个token预测影响最大的推理前缀；2）自步调遮蔽预算调度：根据教师-学生分布差异动态增加遮蔽强度；3）在蒸馏阶段用显著推理前缀遮蔽替代标准因果遮蔽，同时阻断未来token和显著推理线索。

Result: 在多模态推理基准上，该方法超越了现有开源VLM、VLM蒸馏方法和自蒸馏方法。进一步分析证实，学生模型在思考过程中对视觉信息的利用增强。

Conclusion: 通过强制学生模型在缺失文本推理线索时依赖视觉证据，能有效缓解思考轨迹中的视觉遗忘问题，实现高效的多模态推理能力蒸馏。

Abstract: Recent think-answer approaches in VLMs, such as Qwen3-VL-Thinking, boost reasoning performance by leveraging intermediate thinking steps before the final answer, but their computational cost becomes substantial, especially for larger VLMs. To distill such capabilities into compact think-answer VLMs, a primary objective is to improve the student's ability to utilize visual evidence throughout its reasoning trace, as long think-answer traces suffer from visual forgetting issues. To this end, we introduce a novel think-answer distillation framework that encourages the student to anchor its thinking on visual information by masking the student's salient reasoning prefixes. To compensate for such masked textual cues, the student is encouraged to rely more on visual evidence as an alternative source of information during distillation. Our masking strategies include: 1) token-wise salient reasoning-prefix masking, which masks high-influence reasoning prefixes selectively for each next-token prediction, and 2) self-paced masking budget scheduling, which gradually increases the masking scale according to distillation difficulty, measured by the discrepancy between teacher--student distributions. In the distillation phase, the student is guided by our salient reasoning-prefix mask, which blocks both future tokens and salient reasoning cues, in place of the standard causal mask used for auto-regressive language modeling. Experimental results show that our approach outperforms recent open-source VLMs, VLM distillation, and self-distillation methods on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, while further analyzes confirm enhanced visual utilization along the student thinking process.

</details>


### [201] [When Brains Disagree: Biological Ambiguity Underlies the Challenge of Amyloid PET Synthesis from Structural MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11867)
*Louise E. G. Baron,Ross Callaghan,David M. Cash,Philip S. J. Weston,Hojjat Azadbakht,Hui Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验证明，MRI到淀粉样蛋白PET合成性能受限的根本原因在于数据中固有的生物学歧义性（神经退行性与淀粉样蛋白病理在时间上的解耦导致的一对多映射），而非模型架构复杂度不足；引入正交生物学信息（如血浆生物标志物）的多模态融合可解决该歧义性，实现性能提升和稳定性恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MRI-to-amyloid PET合成模型在不同研究报告中的性能差异大且不一致，增加架构复杂度并未带来持续性能提升。研究者怀疑这种不一致性源于根本性的生物学歧义：MRI捕获神经退行性变化，而PET测量淀粉样蛋白病理，两者在阿尔茨海默病中常时间解耦，导致类似MRI模式可能对应不同淀粉样蛋白状态，形成一对多模糊映射。然而这一假设尚未得到科学验证。

Method: 通过两个控制实验进行假设检验：(1) 按淀粉样蛋白和神经退行状态对配对MRI-PET数据进行分层，控制训练分布，在受控设计下使用两种标准合成模型，评估生物学明确映射的可学习性及引入数据歧义后的性能变化；(2) 引入血浆生物标志物作为正交生物学信息，检验多模态输入能否解决歧义并改善性能。

Result: (1) 生物学明确的映射可被单独学习，但当引入数据歧义后性能崩溃，表明数据分布中的歧义性（而非架构容量）限制了性能；(2) 引入血浆生物标志物等多模态输入后，性能提升且稳定性恢复。

Conclusion: MRI-to-amyloid PET合成中有限且不一致的性能由内在生物学歧义性解释，实现稳定且有意义的进展需要多模态融合而非增加架构复杂度。

Abstract: Structural MRI-to-amyloid PET synthesis has been proposed as a non-invasive alternative for amyloid assessment in Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, reported performance of identical models varies widely across studies, and increasingly complex architectures have not led to consistent gains. This inconsistency is thought to be caused by a fundamental biological ambiguity: MRI captures neurodegeneration, while PET measures amyloid pathology - two processes that are often temporally decoupled in AD. As a result, similar MRI patterns may correspond to different amyloid states, creating ambiguous one-to-many mappings. MRI-to-amyloid PET synthesis may therefore be intrinsically ill-posed; however, this idea has yet to be tested scientifically. The aim of this work is to test this hypothesis through two controlled experiments. We first control the training distribution by stratifying paired MRI-PET data by amyloid and neurodegeneration status. Using two standard synthesis models under a controlled design, we show that biologically unambiguous mappings are learnable in isolation, but performance collapses when data ambiguity is introduced. This demonstrates that ambiguity in the data distribution, rather than architectural capacity, constrains performance. Second, we show that introducing orthogonal biological information in the form of plasma biomarkers resolves this ambiguity. When multimodal inputs are incorporated, performance improves and stability is restored. Together, these findings suggest that limited and inconsistent performance in MRI-to-amyloid PET synthesis is explained by intrinsic biological ambiguity, and that stable, meaningful progress requires multimodal integration rather than architectural complexity.

</details>


### [202] [Beyond Text Prompts: Visual-to-Visual Generation as A Unified Paradigm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12271)
*Yaofang Liu,Kangning Cui,Meng Chu,Zhaoqing Li,Suiyun Zhang,Jean-Michel Morel,Xiaodong Cun,Haoxuan Che,Rui Liu,Raymond H. Chan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出视觉到视觉（V2V）生成范式，用户通过视觉规格页面（而非文本提示）控制生成模型。提出的V2V-Zero框架无需训练，通过将视觉页面隐藏状态注入VLM条件生成器，在GenEval上达0.85分，并引入Simple-V2V Bench评估七个视觉条件任务。机制分析显示95%注意力集中于视觉页面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉生成器要求用户将视觉意图序列化为文本提示，这成为信息瓶颈，压缩了空间结构、精确外观和字形形状等关键信号。为突破这一限制，提出直接以视觉规格页面作为条件输入的生成范式。

Method: 提出V2V-Zero，一种无需训练框架。利用冻结的VLM已能将文本和图像映射到生成器条件空间的特点，用视觉页面的最终层隐藏状态替换纯文本条件，实现视觉到视觉的生成。

Result: 在GenEval上V2V-Zero达到0.85，匹配置文本到图像性能。Simple-V2V Bench上V2V-Zero得32.7/100，优于开放权重基线。属性绑定能力强，内容生成不可靠，结构控制仍困难。视频扩展得20.2/100。95%条件token注意力集中在视觉页面隐藏状态。

Conclusion: 视觉到视觉生成范式可行且有效，能突破文本提示的信息瓶颈。当前模型在属性绑定上表现出色，但在内容生成和结构控制上仍有提升空间。该接口可扩展至视频生成领域。

Abstract: Humans often specify and create through visual artifacts: typography sheets, sketches, reference images, and annotated scenes. Yet modern visual generators still ask users to serialize this intent into text, a bottleneck that compresses signals like spatial structure, exact appearance, and glyph shape. We propose \textbf{\emph{visual-to-visual} (V2V)} generation, in which the user conditions a generative model with a visual specification page rather than a text prompt. The page is not an edit target, but a visual document that specifies the desired output. We introduce \textbf{V2V-Zero}, a training-free framework that exposes this interface in existing vision-language model (VLM) conditioned generators by replacing text-only conditioning with final-layer hidden states extracted from visual pages, exploiting the fact that the frozen VLM already maps both text and images into the generator's conditioning space.
  On GenEval, V2V-Zero reaches 0.85 with a frozen Qwen-Image backbone, closely matching its optimized text-to-image performance without fine-tuning. To evaluate the broader V2V space, we introduce \textbf{Simple-V2V Bench}, spanning seven visual-conditioning tasks and seven models, including GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, Seedream 5.0 Lite, open-weight baselines, and a video extension. V2V-Zero scores 32.7/100, outperforming evaluated open-weight image baselines and revealing a clear capability hierarchy: attribute binding is strong, content generation is unreliable, and structural control remains hard even for commercial systems. A HunyuanVideo-1.5 extension scores 20.2/100, showing the interface transfers beyond images. Mechanistic analysis shows the default reasoning path is primarily visually routed, with 95.0\% of conditioning-token attention mass on visual-page hidden states.

</details>


### [203] [Bayesian In Vivo Tracking of Synapses using Joint Poisson Deconvolution and Diffeomorphic Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13455)
*Shashwat Kumar,Dominic M. Padova,Binish Narang,Gabrielle I. Coste,Austin R. Graves,Richard L. Huganir,Adam S. Charles,Michael I. Miller,Anuj Srivastava*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于模板的贝叶斯框架，用于建模突触作为变化亮度点光源在非线性组织变形下的运动，同步实现突触模板构建、图像去噪去卷积、荧光强度推断、组织运动校正和参数置信区间估计，并在2D+t模拟数据和两周内小鼠3D+t活体显微数据上验证了效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 活体双光子显微镜成像由于低激光功率导致低信噪比、高散粒噪声、非线性组织运动、荧光非平稳波动以及点扩散函数造成的模糊，使得在高密度突触区域检测和追踪突触变得极为困难，亟需一种统一的建模方法来同时解决这些挑战。

Method: 采用统一的贝叶斯方法，将突触建模为变化的亮度点光源，在非线性组织变形下运动。后验模型整合了用于域变形的微分同胚映射、用于成像过程的高斯点扩散函数以及用于原始光子计数的泊松观测模型，从而实现模板构建、去噪去卷积、荧光强度推断、配准和置信区间估计的同步求解。

Result: 在2D+t模拟数据集和两周内小鼠3D+t活体荧光突触显微数据集上验证了该框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 提出的贝叶斯模板框架能够有效应对活体显微成像中的多重挑战，为大规模突触动态研究提供了一种鲁棒的计算方法。

Abstract: Synapses are densely packed submicron structures that dynamically reorganize during learning and memory formation. Longitudinal \textit{in vivo} imaging of fluorescently tagged synaptic receptors offers a promising opportunity to study large-scale synaptic dynamics and how these processes are disrupted in neurological disease. However, in vivo imaging with 2-photon microscopy uses low laser power and therefore suffers from low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and high shot noise, nonlinear tissue motion between days, nonstationary fluctuations in synaptic fluorescence, and significant blur induced by the microscope point spread function (PSF). Together, these factors make it challenging to detect and track synapses, especially in regions with high synaptic density. This paper presents a novel template-based framework for modeling synapses as varying luminance point sources that move under a nonlinear tissue deformation. Taking a unified Bayesian approach, we apply this model to microscopy data by deriving a posterior that incorporates a diffeomorphic mapping for domain warping, a Gaussian point spread function for the imaging process, and a Poisson observation model for raw photon counts. The Bayesian solution simultaneously: (1) Constructs a probabilistic template of synapse locations, (2) denoises and deconvolves the image data, (3) infers fluorescence intensities, (4) performs diffeomorphic image registration to correct for tissue motion, and (5) provides confidence regions for these parameter estimates. We demonstrate the framework on both a 2D+t simulated dataset and a 3D+t longitudinal \textit{in vivo} microscopy dataset of fluorescent synapses imaged in a mouse over two weeks.

</details>


### [204] [MiVE: Multiscale Vision-language features for reference-guided video Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14664)
*Tong Wang,Meng Zou,Chengjing Wu,Xiaochao Qu,Luoqi Liu,Xiaolin Hu,Ting Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MiVE利用VLM的多尺度分层特征（浅层空间细节+深层语义指令）统一注入扩散Transformer，实现参考引导视频编辑的SOTA性能，优于现有方法和商业系统。


<details>
