  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有参考引导视频编辑方法存在两类局限：解耦编码器处理指令与视觉内容时存在模态间隙；统一视觉-语言编码器仅依赖最终层表示，丢失细粒度空间细节。作者观察到VLM层编码互补信息——浅层捕获局部空间细节，深层编码全局语义。

Method: 提出MiVE框架，将Qwen3-VL作为多尺度特征提取器，提取层次化特征并统一注入到自注意力扩散Transformer中，消除交叉注意力设计固有的模态不匹配问题。

Result: MiVE在人类偏好评估中排名最高，优于学术方法和商业系统，达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 利用VLM层次化多尺度特征能够有效解决参考引导视频编辑中的模态间隙与空间细节丢失问题，验证了该设计的有效性。

Abstract: Reference-guided video editing takes a source video, a text instruction, and a reference image as inputs, requiring the model to faithfully apply the instructed edits while preserving original motion and unedited content. Existing methods fall into two paradigms, each with inherent limitations: decoupled encoders suffer from modality gaps when processing instructions and visual content independently, while unified vision-language encoders lose fine-grained spatial details by relying solely on final-layer representations. We observe that VLM layers encode complementary information hierarchically -- early layers capture localized spatial details essential for precise editing, while deeper layers encode global semantics for instruction comprehension. Building on this insight, we present MiVE (Multiscale Vision-language features for reference-guided video Editing), a framework that repurposes VLMs as multiscale feature extractors. MiVE extracts hierarchical features from Qwen3-VL and integrates them into a unified self-attention Diffusion Transformer, eliminating the modality mismatch inherent in cross-attention designs. Experiments demonstrate that MiVE achieves state-of-the-art performance by ranking highest in human preference, outperforming both academic methods and commercial systems.

</details>


### [205] [Can Visual Mamba Improve AI-Generated Image Detection? An In-Depth Investigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14799)
*Mamadou Keita,Wassim Hamidouche,Hessen Bougueffa Eutamene,Abdelmalik Taleb-Ahmed,Xianxun Zhu,Abdenour Hadid*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了Vision Mamba模型在AI生成图像检测中的表现，将其与CNN、ViT、VLM等主流方法进行对比，分析了其在准确性、效率和泛化能力方面的优势与局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机视觉的快速发展使得图像生成技术日益逼真，引发了 misinformation、身份盗窃、隐私安全等担忧。尽管Mamba架构在多项图像分析任务中表现优异，但其在AI生成图像检测领域的潜力尚未被充分探索。

Method: 对多种Vision Mamba变体进行系统评估，并与代表性CNN、ViT、VLM检测器在多个数据集和合成图像来源上进行对比分析，重点关注准确性、效率和跨生成模型的泛化能力。

Result: Vision Mamba在AI生成图像检测中展现出一定潜力，但同时也存在当前局限性；研究揭示了其相较于已有方法在适用性、准确性和效率方面的优劣。

Conclusion: Vision Mamba有望成为区分真实与AI生成视觉内容的系统组件，但在该领域仍需进一步发展以应对真实与AI内容难以区分的重大挑战。

Abstract: In recent years, computer vision has witnessed remarkable progress, fueled by the development of innovative architectures such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), diffusion-based architectures, Vision Transformers (ViTs), and, more recently, Vision-Language Models (VLMs). This progress has undeniably contributed to creating increasingly realistic and diverse visual content. However, such advancements in image generation also raise concerns about potential misuse in areas such as misinformation, identity theft, and threats to privacy and security. In parallel, Mamba-based architectures have emerged as versatile tools for a range of image analysis tasks, including classification, segmentation, medical imaging, object detection, and image restoration, in this rapidly evolving field. However, their potential for identifying AI-generated images remains relatively unexplored compared to established techniques. This study provides a systematic evaluation and comparative analysis of Vision Mamba models for AI-generated image detection. We benchmark multiple Vision Mamba variants against representative CNNs, ViTs, and VLM-based detectors across diverse datasets and synthetic image sources, focusing on key metrics such as accuracy, efficiency, and generalizability across diverse image types and generative models. Through this comprehensive analysis, we aim to elucidate Vision Mamba's strengths and limitations relative to established methodologies in terms of applicability, accuracy, and efficiency in detecting AI-generated images. Overall, our findings highlight both the promise and current limitations of Vision Mamba as a component in systems designed to distinguish authentic from AI-generated visual content. This research is crucial for enhancing detection in an age where distinguishing between real and AI-generated content is a major challenge.

</details>


### [206] [EgoExo-WM: Unlocking Exo Video for Ego World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15477)
*Danny Tran,Roberto Martín-Martín,Kristen Grauman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出通过从外视角视频中提取结构化身体姿态并转换为自我中心视角视频的方法，弥合外视角数据丰富性与自我中心数据稀缺性之间的差距，显著提升了自我中心世界模型的预测质量和下游规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我中心世界模型受限于自我中心训练数据的稀缺性以及其对人类物理动作的固有部分可观测性，而外视角视频虽然丰富且能清晰展现身体姿态，但缺乏与智能体动作空间的直接对齐。

Method: 从外视角视频中提取结构化身体姿态作为动作表示，并利用人体运动学先验将外视角视频转换为自我中心视角视频，从而将野外外视角数据整合到自我中心世界模型训练中。

Result: 使用转换后的数据训练全身动作条件化的自我中心世界模型，显著提升了预测质量和下游规划性能，能够推断实现视觉目标状态所需的身体姿态序列。

Conclusion: 该方法为利用任意野外视频构建强大自我中心世界模型铺平了道路，进一步推动机器人规划和增强现实引导等应用的发展。

Abstract: Egocentric world models present a promising direction for enabling agents to predict and plan, but their performance is constrained by the limited availability of egocentric training data and its inherent partial observability of humans' physical actions. In contrast, exocentric video is abundant and reveals body poses well, but lacks direct alignment with an agent's action space -- and is not egocentric. We propose a method to bridge this gap by extracting structured body pose from exocentric video as a representation of action and transforming the exocentric video to egocentric video, informed by a human kinematics prior. This process unlocks the integration of in-the-wild exocentric data for egocentric world model training. We show that training whole-body action-conditioned egocentric world models with our converted data significantly improves both prediction quality and downstream planning performance, where we infer the sequence of body poses needed to achieve a visual goal state. Our approach paves the way to enlist arbitrary in-the-wild videos for building powerful egocentric world models, furthering applications in robot planning and augmented-reality guidance.

</details>


### [207] [Xiaomi Auto World Model: A Joint World Model Integrating Reconstruction and Generation for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18137)
*Lijun Zhou,Hongcheng Luo,Zhenxin Zhu,Cheng Chi,Mingfei Tu,Kaixin Xiong,Lei Gong,Zhanqian Wu,Zehan Zhang,Fangzhen Li,Hao Li,Yingying Shen,Jiale He,Haohui Zhu,Shan Zhao,Kai Wang,Zhiwei Zhan,Yuechuan Pu,Kaiyuan Tan,Ruiling Yang,Xianqi Wang,Tianyi Yan,Jiawei Zhou,Lei Zhang,Jingyang Zhao,Xi Zhou,Chitian Sun,Chenming Wu,Jiong Deng,Hongwei Xie,Ming Lu,Kun Ma,Long Chen,Guang Chen,Hangjun Ye,Bing Wang,Haiyang Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的技术系统，包含世界表示模块WorldRec（基于稀疏场景查询的前馈重建架构）和世界生成模块WorldGen（两阶段训练框架，通过三个渐进阶段实现仅需4步去噪的高质量因果视频生成），并进一步将两者深度融合为JWM，为自动驾驶的闭环仿真、数据合成和端到端训练提供坚实基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶需要同时具备世界表示和世界生成两大核心能力，现有方法通常将二者分离处理，缺乏统一的技术框架来协同优化。

Method: WorldRec采用3D空间中的结构化查询来聚合跨视角、跨时间特征，构建紧凑且高保真的3D高斯场景表示；WorldGen采用双向预训练+因果微调的两阶段框架，通过Teacher Forcing、ODE蒸馏和DMD三个渐进阶段实现仅需4步去噪的高质量因果视频生成；JWM深度融合两个模块以实现协同增益。

Result: JWM在生成稳定性、跨帧一致性和视觉保真度方面实现协同增益，显著优于独立使用WorldRec或WorldGen的效果。

Conclusion: 该统一系统为自动驾驶的闭环仿真、数据合成和端到端训练提供了坚实的基础。

Abstract: This report presents a unified technical system addressing the two core capabilities of world models for autonomous driving: world representation and world generation. For world representation, we propose WorldRec, a feed-forward reconstruction architecture driven by sparse scene queries. WorldRec initializes structured queries in 3D space, leveraging them to aggregate cross-view, cross-temporal features, thereby naturally enforcing spatial consistency across frames and yielding compact yet high-fidelity 3D Gaussian scene representations. For world generation, we propose WorldGen, a two-stage training framework of bidirectional pretraining followed by causal fine-tuning through three progressive stages (Teacher Forcing, ODE distillation, and DMD), enabling high-quality online causal video generation in as few as 4 denoising steps. Building on both modules, we further introduce the JWM, which deeply integrates WorldRec and WorldGen to achieve synergistic gains in generation stability, cross-frame consistency, and visual fidelity, providing a solid foundation for closed-loop simulation, data synthesis, and end-to-end training in autonomous driving.

</details>


### [208] [RAVE: Re-Allocating Visual Attention in Large Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18359)
*Xi Leng,Xinhong Ma,Ziqiang Dong,Feng Zhang,Xiaoying Tang,Yang Yang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RAVE是一种轻量级成对门控机制，通过添加可学习的查询-键偏置来重新分配视觉注意力，无需修改骨干架构即可提升多模态模型在感知密集型任务上的表现，平均提升3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言多模态模型（LMMs）继承了预训练语言骨干的自注意力机制，但标准注意力存在次优分配问题，包括文本与视觉证据之间的跨模态错配以及视觉token内部的视觉不平衡。

Method: 提出RAVE（Re-Allocating Visual Attention），一种轻量级成对门控机制，在softmax前的注意力分数上添加针对视觉键的可学习查询-键偏置，该偏置来源于RoPE之前的查询和键特征。无需对骨干网络进行架构修改，可与模型其余部分端到端训练。

Result: 在多模态基准测试中，RAVE相比标准注意力平均提升3个百分点，在感知密集型任务（多语言OCR、图表理解、文档VQA、场景文本VQA）上提升最为显著。

Conclusion: RAVE通过轻量级的注意力重分配机制有效缓解了LMMs中的跨模态错配和视觉token不平衡问题，尤其对需要精确视觉定位的感知密集型任务效果突出。

Abstract: Large multimodal models (LMMs) inherit the self-attention mechanism of pretrained language backbones, yet standard attention can exhibit suboptimal allocation, including cross-modal misallocation between textual and visual evidence and intra-visual imbalance among visual tokens. We propose RAVE (Re-Allocating Visual Attention), a lightweight pair-gating mechanism that adds a learned query-key bias to pre-softmax attention scores over visual keys, derived from pre-RoPE query and key features. RAVE requires no architectural modification to the backbone and can be trained end-to-end with the rest of the model. Across a suite of multimodal benchmarks, RAVE improves over standard attention by an average of 3 points, with the largest gains on perception-intensive tasks -- including multilingual OCR, chart understanding, document VQA, and scene text VQA -- where accurate visual grounding is critical.

</details>


### [209] [Mind Your Margin and Boundary: Are Your Distilled Datasets Truly Robust?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20606)
*Muquan Li,Yingyi Ma,Yihong Huang,Hang Gou,Ke Qin,Ming Li,Yuan-Fang Li,Tao He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: C²R是一种结合攻击感知课程学习与对比鲁棒性目标的数据集蒸馏框架，通过鲁棒边际视角推导扰动分数实现课程学习，并采用类别平衡对比鲁棒性损失增强决策边界分离，在多个数据集和攻击下平均鲁棒准确率提升2.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有鲁棒数据集蒸馏方法存在两个问题：(i) 对所有对抗扰动样本一视同仁，忽略了鲁棒风险主要由近零鲁棒边际的样本主导；(ii) 没有显式增加攻击集中区域（决策边界）的类间分离性，导致准确率-鲁棒性权衡不佳。

Method: C²R框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 从鲁棒边际角度推导出近似每个样本鲁棒铰链损失的扰动分数，据此构建优先处理最小边际样本的攻击感知课程学习；(2) 类别平衡的对比鲁棒性损失，在强制对抗不变性的同时显式拓宽类间决策边界。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、Tiny-ImageNet及多个ImageNet-1K子集上，针对六种攻击方法的实验表明，C²R实现了最佳鲁棒准确率，平均比先前的鲁棒DD方法高出2.8%。

Conclusion: C²R通过攻击感知课程学习与对比鲁棒性目标的有效结合，显著改善了鲁棒数据集蒸馏的准确率-鲁棒性权衡。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) compresses a large training set into a small synthetic set for efficient training, but most DD methods optimize only clean accuracy and leave robustness uncontrolled. Recent robust DD methods improve robustness, yet they often suffer from a poor accuracy-robustness trade-off because they (i) treat all adversarially perturbed examples uniformly, despite robust risk being dominated by near-zero robust margins, and (ii) do not explicitly increase inter-class separation in the decision boundary where attacks concentrate. We present Contrastive Curriculum for Robust Dataset Distillation (C$^2$R), a framework that couples an attack-aware curriculum with a contrastive robustness objective. From a robust-margin perspective, we derive a perturbation score that approximates each sample's robust hinge, enabling a curriculum that prioritizes the smallest-margin adversaries that most directly drive robust error. In parallel, a class-balanced contrastive robustness loss enforces adversarial invariance while explicitly widening boundary separation across classes. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100, Tiny-ImageNet, and multiple ImageNet-1K subsets under six attacks show that C$^2$R achieves the best robust accuracy, outperforming prior robust DD by $2.8$% on average.

</details>


### [210] [RISE: Reliable Improvement in Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20914)
*Chaoran Xu,Yingmao Miao,Pengfei Zhang,Hao Dou,Lei Sun,Xiangxiang Chu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RISE框架，一种面向视觉语言模型的可信自演进学习框架，通过细粒度角色交替、质量监督器和技能感知动态平衡三个互补设计，解决现有自演进方法中角色交替粗粒度、生成问题质量下降和问题类型坍缩三大挑战，在无标注图像上实现模型的可靠自我提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的后训练严重依赖大规模人工标注数据，成本高昂，尤其是推理密集型多模态任务需要精心设计问题、答案和反馈信号。自演进学习虽能通过模型自我提问与求解的双角色闭环实现自我提升，但现有方法存在三个关键问题：角色交替粗粒度导致问题生成与求解器适应之间的交互延迟；生成问题质量逐代退化；问题类型坍缩至狭窄分布，限制了自演进的效率和可靠性。

Method: RISE框架包含三个互补设计：(1) 细粒度角色交替，缩短提问者与求解器之间的反馈循环，提升效率；(2) 质量监督器，提高生成问题的有效性和伪标签的可靠性；(3) 技能感知动态平衡，缓解模式坍缩，在演进过程中保持广泛的技能覆盖。

Result: 在两个VLM骨干网络上，跨七个基准测试的实验结果表明，RISE能够持续提升基础模型性能，取得广泛且持续的性能增益。

Conclusion: RISE通过细粒度角色交替、质量监督和技能感知动态平衡三个互补设计，实现了更可靠、更有效的视觉语言模型自演进学习，在无标注图像上即可完成模型自我提升。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, but further improving them still relies heavily on large-scale human-constructed supervision for post-training. Such supervision is costly to obtain, especially for reasoning-intensive multimodal tasks where questions, answers, and feedback signals must be carefully designed. This motivates self-evolving learning, where a model improves itself through a dual-role closed loop: a questioner autonomously poses questions and a solver learns to solve them. However, we observe that current VLM self-evolving methods still face three major challenges: coarse-grained role alternation delays the interaction between question generation and solver adaptation; generated questions can progressively degrade in quality; and question types may collapse toward a narrow distribution. These issues limit the efficiency and reliability of self-evolution. Thus, we propose \textbf{RISE}, a reliable self-evolving framework for vision-language models. RISE is built on three complementary designs: fine-grained role alternation, which shortens the feedback loop between the questioner and the solver to improve efficiency; a quality supervisor, which improves question validity and pseudo-label reliability; and skill-aware dynamic balancing, which mitigates mode collapse and maintains broad skill coverage during evolution. Together, these components enable more reliable and effective self-evolution from unlabeled images. Experiments on two VLM backbones across seven benchmarks show that RISE consistently improves the base models, yielding broad and sustained gains. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/RISE.

</details>


### [211] [Broken Memories: Detecting and Mitigating Memorization in Diffusion Models with Degraded Generations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22050)
*Yuanmin Huang,Mi Zhang,Chen Chen,Feifei Li,Geng Hong,Xiaoyu You,Min Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次发现扩散模型中的记忆化会导致内部数值不稳定（表现为“破碎”伪影），并基于潜变量更新范数提出经验稳定性区域来量化稳定行为，进而设计了一种即时的逐步骤检测与自适应缓解框架，在不改变提示词或引导的情况下有效抑制记忆化，在Stable Diffusion 1.4上实现了AUC>0.999的检测性能和0.0%的记忆化率，且开销极低（每张图约0.01秒）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在生成高质量图像时存在记忆化训练数据的风险，带来严重的隐私和版权问题；现有方法缺乏对记忆化内在机理的理解和高效的在线检测/缓解手段。

Method: 通过数值稳定性分析发现记忆化会导致内部数值不稳定（“破碎”伪影）；引入基于潜变量更新范数的经验稳定性区域定量刻画生成过程的稳定行为；在此基础上构建逐步骤的检测与自适应缓解框架，不依赖提示词或引导修改。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion 1.4上，检测AUC>0.999，缓解后记忆化率降至0.0%，额外开销仅约每张图0.01秒。

Conclusion: 所提方法能高效、准确地检测并抑制扩散模型的记忆化行为，同时保持语义保真度和图像质量，为隐私和版权保护提供了可行方案。

Abstract: While diffusion models excel at generating high-quality images, their tendency to memorize training data poses significant privacy and copyright risks. In this work, we for the first time identify that memorization induces internal numerical instability, often manifesting as visually ``broken'' artifacts. Inspired by stability analysis in numerical methods, we introduce empirical stability regions based on latent update norms to quantitatively characterize stable behavior during generation. Leveraging this, we propose a principled, on-the-fly framework for step-wise detection and adaptive mitigation. Our approach suppresses memorization without altering prompts or guidance, thereby preserving semantic fidelity and image quality. Extensive experiments on Stable Diffusion 1.4 demonstrate that our method achieves an AUC $>0.999$ detection performance and a $0.0\%$ memorization rate after mitigation with negligible overhead ($\approx0.01$s per image).

</details>


### [212] [The Neglected Baseline in Model Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22417)
*Yongjin Cui,Xiaohui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出现有模型解释方法普遍忽略基线（baseline），导致解释不精确甚至错误。通过重新定义模型解释任务和解释原则，统一了梯度法、积分梯度法和泰勒展开，明确了各方法的基线。分析了IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map等方法中的缺陷，提出用归因误差来评估解释质量。最终改进IG，提出了一种基于清晰合理基线的模型解释方法，支持任意层的特征解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型解释方法普遍忽略基线的重要性，导致归因结果不精确甚至错误。作者希望通过重新审视基线的作用，统一相关方法并揭示其内在联系，从而改进模型解释的准确性和合理性。

Method: 1. 重新定义模型解释任务和解释原则，阐明基线的重要性。2. 统一梯度法、积分梯度法（IG）和泰勒展开，厘清各方法的联系并明确其基线。3. 分析IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map等方法的缺陷和误差。4. 提出用归因误差（归因结果与归因目标之间的误差）来评估解释质量，替代基于边际效应或完美模型假设的评价方法。5. 改进IG方法，开发具有清晰合理基线的模型解释方法，支持基于任意层特征的解释。

Result: 提出的改进方法在基线定义上更加清晰合理，归因结果更准确。支持基于任意层特征的解释，且不同层特征的解释结果均合理，反映了不同特征提取阶段的程度差异。

Conclusion: 基线在模型解释中至关重要，忽视基线会导致不精确的解释。通过统一和厘清相关方法，改进IG后可以获得更优的解释结果。不同层的解释结果各有其合理性，对应不同特征提取阶段。

Abstract: We observe that existing model interpretation methods generally ignore the baseline, and such neglect often results in imprecise or even incorrect interpretation. In this paper, we reformulate the task of model interpretation and the interpretation principles for model interpretation results to demonstrate the importance of the baseline. We further unify gradient-based methods, Integrated Gradients (IG) methods, and Taylor expansion, clarifying the connections among them and explicitly identifying the baseline for each method. On this basis, we analyze the flaws and errors in related model interpretation methods (IG, LayerCAM, ODAM, Difference Map). We advocate evaluating the quality of model interpretation results precisely through the attribution error between the attribution result and the attribution target, rather than adopting flawed evaluation methods, such as those based on marginal-effect or the assumption of perfect model performance. We revise IG and develope a model interpretation method with a clear and reasonable baseline, achieving better results. Our method supports model interpretation based on features from any layer. Interpretation based on features from different layers are all reasonable, and the differences among these results reflect varying degrees of feature extraction at different feature extraction stages.

</details>


### [213] [Suicide Risk Assessment from AI-powered Video Surveillance: An Interpretable Framework for Prevention in Metro Stations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22904)
*Safwen Naimi,Wassim Bouachir,Guillaume-Alexandre Bilodeau,Brian Mishara*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次形式化定义了地铁站自杀风险评估（SRA）任务，提出一个可解释的框架，通过整合行人跟踪、活动识别、站台语义分割和轨迹驱动风险热图建模，在真实监控数据上实现83.2% ROC-AUC，为可解释AI社会应用开辟新方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地铁站中理解与监控人类行为对支持自杀预防至关重要，早期识别高风险情境可实现及时干预。现有方法要么聚焦孤立子任务，要么试图直接推断意图，缺乏从累积证据中综合评估自杀风险的可解释框架。

Method: 提出一个可解释的SRA框架，集成四个关键模块：行人跟踪（感知人体运动）、活动识别（理解行为语义）、站台语义分割（理解空间几何结构）以及轨迹驱动风险热图建模（聚合异构行为线索的时间动态）。通过联合推理每位乘客的行为、空间上下文和时间动态来评估自杀风险。

Result: 在真实监控数据上实现83.2%的ROC-AUC，验证了完整操作管道的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作突出了自杀风险评估的复杂性，通过将其形式化为一个独立任务并建立基准，为面向社会公益的可解释AI系统研究开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Understanding and monitoring human behavior in metro stations play an important role in supporting suicide prevention efforts, where early identification of high-risk situations can enable timely intervention. This requires assessing suicide risk from a surveillance video by jointly reasoning about the behavior of each passenger, his/her spatial context, and temporal dynamics. However, this assessment using videos captured by surveillance cameras is challenging, as it demands accurate perception of human motion, understanding of platform geometry, and aggregation of heterogeneous behavioral cues over time. In this work, we formalize the task of Suicide Risk Assessment (SRA) in metro stations and introduce the first interpretable framework that addresses this challenge. Unlike approaches that focus on isolated subtasks or attempt to infer intent directly, our formulation assesses suicide risk from accumulated evidence by incorporating person tracking, activity recognition, semantic segmentation of the platform, and trajectory-driven risk heatmap modeling. By formalizing SRA as a distinct task and benchmarking a complete operational pipeline achieving 83.2% ROC-AUC on real surveillance data, this work highlights the complexity of suicide risk assessment and opens new directions for research on interpretable AI systems for social good.

</details>


### [214] [GFSR: Geometric Fidelity and Spatial Refinement for Reliable Lane Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23327)
*Tiancheng Wang,Zhaolu Ding,Richeng Xu,Tianhui Zheng,Hui Liu,Hanyu Xuan,Zhiliang Wu,Guanghui Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GFSR框架（包含LCC和AGLR两个模块），通过LaneIoU引导的置信度校准和自适应门控位置细化，解决了车道检测中分类置信度与几何质量不匹配、采样点间相关性弱导致复杂场景欠拟合的问题，在CULane和CurveLanes上实现了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有车道检测方法在复杂场景下性能下降，原因有二：一是分类置信度仅表征车道先验的类别存在性，与几何质量弱相关，导致基于置信度的阈值过滤和NMS会保留高置信度但几何质量差的先验，而丢弃低置信度但几何质量好的先验；二是回归模块削弱了采样点间的相关性，阻碍了对远端、高曲率和复杂拓扑车道的细粒度优化，导致欠拟合。

Method: 提出GFSR框架，包含两个核心模块：1) LaneIoU引导的置信度校准（LCC），采用LaneIoU作为软监督显式估计车道先验的几何保真度，并与分类置信度融合构建协作可靠性指标（CRI），用于指导车道先验过滤；2) 自适应门控位置细化（AGLR），在每个细化阶段与回归头协作，预测采样点横向偏移，采用门控机制自适应调节修正幅度，增强点间相关性。

Result: 在CULane上，F1_50为81.46%，F1_75为65.01%；在CurveLanes上，F1_50为87.35%。在CULane上达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: GFSR通过几何保真度感知的置信度校准和自适应空间细化，有效解决了现有方法的两个主要局限，显著提升了复杂场景下的车道检测性能。

Abstract: Lane detection stands as a crucial perception task in autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. However, existing methods still degrade in complex real scenarios due to two major limitations. First, classification confidence only characterizes the categorical existence of lane priors and has no strong correlation with geometric quality. If threshold filtering and NMS are conducted merely based on this confidence, the model tends to retain lane priors with high confidence while eliminating those with lower confidence but superior geometric representation. Secondly, the regression modules in existing methods weaken correlations among sampling points, hindering fine-grained optimization of distant, high-curvature and complex-topology lanes and causing underfitting. To address these issues, we propose Geometric Fidelity and Spatial Refinement (GFSR), a framework consisting of LaneIoU-guided Confidence Calibration (LCC) and Adaptive Gated Location Refinement (AGLR). Specifically, LCC adopts LaneIoU as soft supervision to explicitly estimate the geometric fidelity of lane priors, which is further fused with classification confidence to construct the Collaborative Reliability Index (CRI). This index guides lane prior filtering, effectively retaining those with high classification confidence and favorable geometric quality. Meanwhile, cooperating with regression heads in each refinement stage, AGLR predicts sampling point lateral offsets and adopts a gating mechanism to adaptively regulate correction magnitude, strengthen inter-point correlations and boost model adaptability as well as robustness toward complex lane scenarios. Extensive experiments on CULane and CurveLanes demonstrate that our GFSR achieves state-of-the-art performance on CULane, with F1_50 and F1_75 scores of 81.46% and 65.01%, and reaches 87.35% F1_50 on CurveLanes.

</details>


### [215] [Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward: Towards Principled One-step Generator RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24001)
*Junyi Wu,Weijian Luo,Haoyang Zheng,Ruizhe Zhang,Guang Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DIDR框架，通过扩散奖励传播实现单步文生图模型的轨迹级对齐，在不牺牲图像保真度的前提下提升偏好对齐效果，在SDXL和6B DiT骨干上均优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法将图像空间奖励优化与扩散噪声空间分布匹配结合，导致终端奖励优化与生成动力学不匹配，优化倾向于利用随机自由度，提升奖励却牺牲图像保真度。

Method: 提出DIDR框架：基于积分KL最小化推导的数据无关轨迹级对齐方法；将RLHF最优的奖励倾斜干净图像分布沿扩散轨迹传播至所有噪声水平；引入扩散奖励分数(DRS)作为参考分数函数的奖励驱动修正；提出基于可微短步去噪的扩散奖励代理(DRP)高效估计DRS。

Result: 在SDXL上一致帕累托主导现有单步基线；迁移至6B DiT骨干(Z-Image)时，单步生成超越50步教师模型的偏好对齐效果。

Conclusion: DIDR有效解决了单步生成中奖励优化与图像保真度的权衡问题，实现了高效的单步偏好对齐。

Abstract: Recent advances in one-step text-to-image generation have enabled real-time synthesis with remarkable efficiency and quality. Previous reinforcement learning methods for one-step generators combine image-space reward optimization with diffusion noisy-space distribution matching. This paradigm brings challenges due to a mismatch between terminal reward optimization and the underlying generative dynamics. As a result, optimization tends to exploit stochastic degrees of freedom, often improving reward at the expense of image fidelity. To address this issue, we propose Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR), a data-free trajectory-level alignment framework derived from Integral KL minimization. DIDR propagates the RLHF-optimal reward-tilted clean-image distribution across all noise levels along the diffusion trajectory. We show that this objective admits the same minimizer as clean-image RLHF, while naturally inducing the Diffused Reward Score (DRS), which acts as a reward-driven correction to the reference score function. To make this practical, we further introduce the Diffused Reward Proxy (DRP), an efficient estimator of DRS based on differentiable short-step denoising. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DIDR consistently Pareto-dominates existing one-step SDXL baselines. Moreover, when transferred to a 6B DiT backbone (Z-Image), DIDR surpasses its 50-step teacher in preference alignment while requiring only a single generation step.

</details>


### [216] [EgoProx: Evaluating MLLMs on Egocentric 3D Proximity Reasoning Across a Cognitive Hierarchy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24456)
*Jinzhao Li,Yinuo Chen,Dongxu Piao,Panwang Pan,Yifan Yu,Dong Wang,Honglei Yan,Liang Yue,Shaofei Wang,Yixin Chen,Siyuan Huang,Miao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了EgoProx基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在自我中心3D邻近推理方面的能力。通过设计认知链任务和基于智能体的数据引擎，研究发现现有MLLMs虽然具备一定的空间知识，但在空间推理VQA方面仍存在困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类在日常生活中不断进行3D邻近关系推理（身体与周围物体的空间关系），但目前不清楚多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）是否具备这种具身3D推理能力，因此需要建立一个专门的评估基准来检验。

Method: 1) 构建EgoProx基准，沿认知链组织任务（意图、探索、利用、行动链推理）；2) 设计基于智能体的数据引擎，自动生成多样化且一致的QA对；3) 在EgoProx上对主流MLLMs进行基准测试，并进行数据集特定和任务特定的指令微调分析。

Result: 观察到显著的跨域增益，表明当前MLLMs包含一定的空间知识；但模型在有效利用这些知识进行空间推理VQA方面仍存在困难。

Conclusion: 现有MLLMs具备部分空间知识，但在自我中心3D邻近推理这一具身认知任务上表现不足，仍需进一步提升空间推理能力。

Abstract: Humans constantly reason about 3D proximity, the relations between their body and surrounding objects, to guide perception and action in daily life. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perform such embodied 3D reasoning remains unclear. To this end, we introduce EgoProx, a benchmark for egocentric 3D proximity reasoning. We organize our tasks along a cognitive chain, covering intention, exploration, exploitation, and chain-of-actions reasoning. We also design an agent based data engine that produces diverse and consistent QA pairs at scale. We benchmark prevailing MLLMs on EgoProx and conduct additional analyses with dataset specific and task specific instruction tuning. We observe large cross-domain gains, indicating that current MLLMs contain some spatial knowledge; however, they still struggle to effectively leverage it for spatial reasoning VQA.

</details>


### [217] [Resolving Ambiguity in Composed Image Retrieval via Calibrated Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24634)
*Amsisan Tran,Baogh Le,Tuan Kiet Pham,Sui Yang Guang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出组合图像检索（CIR）中单个查询映射到多个可能目标的内在歧义性问题，提出将CIR重构为不确定性下的校准意图解析，通过共形预测层返回有覆盖率保证的候选集，并在候选集较大时通过预期信息增益策略提出最有效的澄清问题，在多个基准上实现了与单轮SOTA相当的性能，同时以更少的交互轮次达到目标，并首次报告了有效的覆盖率和校准结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CIR方法普遍假设一个查询对应单一目标，但实际中如"make it more formal"等模糊查询本质上是欠定的，导致假阴性问题普遍存在，模型无法区分精确查询与模糊查询。

Method: 将CIR重构为不确定性下的校准意图解析：在检索器外包裹共形预测层，返回有覆盖率保证的候选集，候选集大小作为歧义性的原则性度量；当候选集较大时，通过预期信息增益策略从可解释的歧义轴中挑选最有帮助的澄清问题，使候选集收缩。

Result: 在开放域和时尚基准上，该方法在精确查询上与单轮SOTA性能持平；在模糊查询上以远少于朴素对话基线的交互轮次达到目标；首次报告了任务中有效的覆盖率和校准结果。

Conclusion: 校准解析在精确查询上无性能代价，同时能高效处理模糊查询，为CIR任务提供了更具鲁棒性和可解释性的解决方案。

Abstract: Composed image retrieval (CIR) searches a corpus with a reference image and a text describing how to modify it. Despite rapid progress from triplet-trained compositors to zero-shot and generative methods, essentially all systems share one assumption: that a query maps to a single target, scored by Recall@K against one annotation. We argue this is fundamentally at odds with the task. A query such as make it more formal does not name an image but a region of the corpus, and which member the user intends is genuinely underdetermined. This underspecification is the root of the well-known false-negative problem and leaves current models unable to tell a precise query from an ambiguous one. We reframe CIR as calibrated intent resolution under uncertainty: a retriever is wrapped in a conformal prediction layer that returns a candidate set with a coverage guarantee and whose size is a principled measure of ambiguity; when the set is large, an expected-information-gain policy asks the single most useful clarifying question, drawn from interpretable ambiguity axes, and the set contracts. We introduce AmbiCIR, a benchmark and human-validated user simulator that revive the dormant auxiliary and dialogue annotations of CIRR and extend the multiple-positive setting of CIRCO. Across open-domain and fashion benchmarks our method matches single-turn state of the art, confirming calibrated resolution is cost-free on precise queries, while reaching the intended target in a fraction of the interaction budget required by naive conversational baselines, and it is the first to report valid coverage and calibration for the task.

</details>


### [218] [Where Detectors Fail: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24906)
*Zijie Cao,Weijie Tu,Yao Xiao,Weijian Deng,Liang Lin,Pengxu Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PROBE框架，通过主动探索生成过程中的困难区域来生成难以分类的AIGI样本，从而提升检测器对未知生成器的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AIGI检测器在生成设置变化时性能下降，仅靠扩大数据规模不足以解决泛化问题，因为训练时生成变体的覆盖范围有限。

Method: PROBE利用检测器作为批评者，引导生成器通过流形层面的修改产生难以分类的真实样本，主动探索生成过程中的困难区域，暴露标准采样下罕见的失败案例，并用这些样本优化检测器。

Result: 在多个基准测试上，PROBE增强了对未见生成器的泛化能力，提升了AIGI检测的整体性能。

Conclusion: 主动探索生成过程中的困难区域比单纯扩大数据规模更能有效提升AIGI检测器的泛化性。

Abstract: Detecting AI-generated images (AIGI) remains challenging because detectors often fail to generalize to unseen generators. Although existing methods are trained on large datasets, their performance still degrades when generation settings change, indicating that data scale alone is insufficient and that limited coverage of generative variations during training is a key factor. Studies on generative model editing show that small changes in internal representations can produce diverse and meaningful image variations, many of which are not explored under standard sampling. Leveraging this insight, we propose PROBE (Probing Robustness via Boundary Exploration), a framework that improves detector generalization by actively exploring challenging regions of the generative process. Instead of treating the generator as a fixed data source, PROBE uses the detector as a critic to steer the generator through manifold-level modifications, producing realistic samples that are difficult to classify. These samples expose failure cases that are uncommon under standard data sampling strategies and are used to refine the detector. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks indicate that PROBE enhances generalization to unseen generators, resulting in more generalizable AIGI detection performance. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Amamiya-C/PROBE-AIGI-Detection

</details>


### [219] [Tetris: Tile-level Sampling for Efficient and High-Fidelity Video Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25538)
*Chanwut Kittivorawong,Alena Chao,Charlie Si,Alvin Cheung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Tetris是一个面向静态视频的磁贴提取系统，通过基于多联骨牌的细粒度时空剪枝技术，在保证5%跟踪精度损失范围内实现最高68.8倍的吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨道物化系统在从原始视频中高效提取可复用对象磁贴时成本高昂，虽通过时间帧采样降低开销，但会抹除帧间运动信息，无法满足细粒度跟踪需求。静态视频中大部分帧区域不含感兴趣对象，不同区域可容忍不同采样率，但现有系统未能充分利用这一特性进行精细化剪枝。

Method: 提出基于瓦片的多联骨牌（polyomino）数据模型，将视频分解为时空块，并设计三个上游算子：分类器识别相关瓦片并分组为多联骨牌；整数线性规划（ILP）在用户指定精度约束下剪枝冗余多联骨牌；打包器将幸存多联骨牌组装成画布以最小化检测器调用次数。

Result: 在7个静态视频数据集上，Tetris在5%跟踪精度损失范围内，比全帧全时参考管道吞吐量提升最高68.8倍，比现有系统提升最高17.4倍。现有系统在7个数据集中有3个超出了5%精度损失边界。

Conclusion: Tetris通过细粒度时空剪枝策略，在静态视频场景下实现了检测调用次数与跟踪保真度的最优平衡，显著超越现有系统性能。

Abstract: Track materialization converts raw video into reusable object tracks that downstream queries can run against without rerunning tracking, but extracting those tracks efficiently and with high fidelity remains expensive. Prior systems reduce cost through temporal frame sampling, erasing the inter-frame motion that fine-grained tracking requires. In stationary video, however, large portions of each frame contain no objects of interest, and the remaining regions tolerate different sampling rates. We present Tetris, a track-extraction system that decomposes videos into a tile-based polyomino data model, enabling fine-grained spatiotemporal pruning that reduces detector calls with minimal fidelity loss. Tetris runs three operators upstream of the user-provided detector: a classifier identifies relevant tiles and groups them into polyominoes, an integer linear program (ILP) prunes redundant polyominoes under a user-specified accuracy constraint, and a packer assembles the survivors into canvases that minimize detector calls. Across 7 stationary-video datasets, Tetris stays within a 5% tracking accuracy loss of a full-frame, every-frame reference pipeline, whereas prior systems exceed this bound on 3 of the 7 datasets. At this 5% bound, Tetris achieves up to 17.4x higher throughput than prior systems and up to 68.8x higher than the reference pipeline. The project page is at https://tetris-db.github.io .

</details>


### [220] [ControlLight: Towards Controllable, Consistent, and Generalizable Low-Light Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25569)
*Yufeng Yang,Jianzhuang Liu,Jisheng Chu,Yuqi Peng,Xianfang Zeng,Jiancheng Huang,Shifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ControlLight 提出了一个可控、一致且泛化的低光增强框架，通过构建大规模连续照度强度监督的真实退化数据集，并结合错位感知加权流匹配损失，实现了用户在保持视觉一致性和真实性的前提下灵活控制增强强度，在多个基准上达到了最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习的低光增强方法通常在有限数据集上训练，且只有单一增强目标，导致其在真实场景中的泛化能力和可控性受限。

Method: 1) 构建了大规模真实世界退化图像数据集，包含连续照度强度监督；2) 提出错位感知加权流匹配损失（misalignment-aware weighted flow matching loss），确保不同控制强度下输出的一致性；3) 框架支持用户灵活控制增强强度，同时保持视觉一致性和真实性。

Result: 在多个基准上，ControlLight 在现有低光增强方法中达到了最先进的性能，同时展现出强大的连续可控性和对真实场景的泛化能力。

Conclusion: ControlLight 通过可控、一致且泛化的框架有效解决了现有低光增强方法的泛化性和可控性局限，为实际应用提供了灵活的增强方案。

Abstract: Existing deep learning-based low-light enhancement methods are typically trained on limited datasets with single enhancement targets, which restricts their generalization ability and controllability in real-world applications. To overcome these limitations, we propose ControlLight, a controllable, consistent, and generalizable framework for low-light enhancement. We first construct a large-scale dataset of real-world degraded images with continuous illumination-strength supervision. To further ensure consistent outputs under different control strengths, we introduce a misalignment-aware weighted flow matching loss that preserves image structure across continuous enhancement strengths. ControlLight allows users to edit real-world degraded low-light images toward satisfactory enhancement results by flexibly controlling the strength while preserving visual consistency and realism. Extensive experiments show that ControlLight achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing low-light enhancement approaches while demonstrating strong continuous controllability and generalization to real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [221] [From Contrast to Consistency: Rethinking Event-based Continuous-Time Optical Flow Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25570)
*Rui Hu,Song Wu,Wen Yang,Jinjian Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对事件相机连续光流估计中标注稀缺和对比度最大化框架忽视时间连续性与结构一致性的问题，提出基于时空结构一致性的混合监督框架，结合双向互补多尺度架构和课程式混合训练策略，在多个基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具有微秒级延迟和高动态范围，能异步捕捉亮度变化，为以精细时间精度建模运动提供独特机会。但现有方法面临两大挑战：1) 时间密集的真实标注稀缺，限制了监督学习的有效性；2) 对比度最大化框架聚焦于事件翘曲图像锐化，忽视了时间连续性和结构一致性，导致复杂运动下轨迹扭曲。

Method: 提出混合监督的连续时光流估计框架，核心原则为时空结构一致性（STSC），同时强制局部结构稳定性和轨迹连续性。具体包括：1) 双向互补多尺度架构增强表示与鲁棒性；2) 课程式混合训练策略，实现从监督点约束到自监督流形正则化的平滑过渡。

Result: 在多个基准上的综合实验表明，该方法在连续时间和标准光流估计任务中均达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 提出的混合监督学习范式有效解决了事件相机光流估计中的标注稀缺与结构一致性缺失问题，验证了时空结构一致性原则在学习物理连贯运动中的有效性。

Abstract: Estimating continuous optical flow is a fundamental yet challenging problem in dynamic visual perception. Event-based cameras, with microsecond latency and high dynamic range, capture brightness changes asynchronously, offering a unique opportunity to model motion with fine temporal precision. However, the scarcity of temporally dense ground-truth annotations limits the effectiveness of supervised learning, while contrast maximization (CM) frameworks, focused on sharpening the Image of Warped Events (IWE), often neglect temporal continuity and structural coherence, leading to distorted trajectories under complex motion. To overcome these challenges, we propose a hybrid-supervised framework for continuous-time optical flow estimation, grounded in the principle of Spatio-temporal Structural Consistency (STSC). This paradigm jointly enforces local structural stability and trajectory continuity, ensuring physically coherent motion across time. To further enhance representation and robustness, we design a bidirectionally complementary multi-scale architecture and employ a curriculum-guided hybrid training strategy, enabling a smooth transition from supervised point constraints to self-supervised manifold regularization. Comprehensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both continuous-time and standard optical flow estimation, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed learning paradigm.

</details>


### [222] [AI-T2I: Aggregating-and-Isolating Cross-Attention to Diffusion Models for Text-to-Image Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25763)
*Shipeng Cao,Biao Qian,Haipeng Liu,Yang Wang,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AI-T2I方法，通过聚合损失解决同一主体内token激活分散问题，并引入隔离损失分离不同主体间token激活，从而实现扩散模型中的精确文本-图像对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本-图像合成方法主要关注不同主体token之间的交叉注意力分数重叠问题，忽略了对同一主体内部token激活分散的问题，导致文本-图像对齐不精确。

Method: 提出聚合与隔离交叉注意力机制（AI-T2I）：1）聚合损失：识别并整合分散的同一主体内token激活，间接缓解潜在的重叠问题；2）隔离损失：进一步推远不同主体间token激活，实现精确的文本-图像对齐。

Result: 在多个基准测试上超越了现有最先进方法，并在可控布局生成和个性化生成等其他任务上展现出优秀的泛化能力。

Conclusion: AI-T2I通过同时解决跨注意力中的主体内激活分散和主体间激活重叠问题，有效提升了文本-图像对齐精度，且具有良好的跨任务泛化能力。

Abstract: Text-to-image synthesis has made significant progress, benefiting from the strong generative capabilities of diffusion models. However, these models struggle to achieve precise text-to-image alignment within cross-attention maps during the denoising process. Existing works primarily focus on inter-subject-token activations (i.e., cross-attention scores) overlap for different subjects, overlooking the intra-subject-token activations scattering issue for identical subjects. In this paper, we propose an Aggregating-and-Isolating cross-attention approach to diffusion models for Text-to-Image synthesis, dubbed AI-T2I. Technically, to address the scattering issue, we devise an aggregation loss to identify and consolidate the scattered intra-token activations, which implicitly helps mitigate the potential overlap issue. Upon that, an isolation loss is further introduced to push the inter-token activations apart, thus fulfilling precise text-to-image alignment. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of AI-T2I over the state-of-the-art works for text-to-image synthesis. Furthermore, our AI-T2I exhibits excellent generalization across other tasks, e.g., controllable layout generation and personalized generation.

</details>


### [223] [MuNet: A Mutualistic Network for Joint 3D Human Mesh Recovery and 3D Clothed Human Reconstruction from Single Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25861)
*Yunqi Gao,Leyuan Liu,Yuhan Li,Changxin Gao,Jingying Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MuNet是一个统一框架，通过互惠机制联合优化3D人体网格恢复和3D clothed人体重建，在六个基准数据集上均达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D人体网格恢复和3D clothed人体重建本质相关但长期被孤立研究，忽视了联合优化的潜在收益。

Method: 采用2-流形图作为统一表示；设计端到端图卷积网络逐步变形初始图为3D人体网格并细化至 clothed 人体模型；提出互惠机制实现两任务间的交互指导。

Result: 在Human3.6M、3DPW、MPI-INF-3DHP、THuman2.0、CAPE、RenderPeople六个数据集上均达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 联合优化框架能有效利用两任务间的互惠关系，同时提升两者性能。

Abstract: 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction are inherently related, yet they have long been studied in isolation, thereby overlooking the potential gains of joint optimization. To overcome this limitation, we propose to address these two tasks within a unified framework, which allows their mutual dependencies to be effectively exploited. Building on this idea, we propose MuNet, a mutualistic network for joint 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction from single images. First, we adopt 2-manifold graphs as a unified representation for all 3D models, enabling consistent modeling across 3D human mesh recovery and clothed human reconstruction. Second, we design an end-to-end graph convolutional network that progressively deforms an initial graph into a 3D human mesh and refines it into a detailed 3D clothed human model. Third, we introduce a mutualistic mechanism that allows reciprocal interaction between the two tasks {during training}, where 3D human mesh recovery provides guidance for 3D clothed human reconstruction, and reconstruction feedback refines the 3D human mesh recovery. We extensively evaluate MuNet on six benchmark datasets for 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction, including Human3.6M, 3DPW, MPI-INF-3DHP, THuman2.0, CAPE, and RenderPeople. Experimental results demonstrate that MuNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks across all datasets. The code of MuNet is released for research purposes at https://github.com/starVisionTeam/MuNet.

</details>


### [224] [Global Structure-from-Motion Meets Feedforward Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26103)
*Linfei Pan,Johannes Schönberger,Marc Pollefeys*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合经典SfM方法与前馈式3D重建方法优势的新型SfM流水线（GluMap），在多种场景下实现了最先进的性能，并作为开源系统发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典SfM方法在低纹理、有限重叠和对称性等困难场景下存在失效问题，而前馈式方法虽在这些挑战性条件下表现优异，但在标准重建场景中在可扩展性、精度或鲁棒性方面存在局限。作者旨在结合两类方法的各自优势，构建一个更全面的SfM系统。

Method: 系统分析经典与前馈方法的局限性，设计一种新的SfM流水线，有机融合两者的优势——利用前馈方法处理困难场景，同时保留经典方法在标准场景下的可扩展性和精度。

Result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，所提出的方法在多种场景下均取得了最先进的结果。

Conclusion: 结合经典与前馈方法各自优势的混合策略是提升SfM系统综合性能的有效途径，相关工作已以开源形式发布。

Abstract: Structure-from-Motion -- the process of simultaneously estimating camera poses and 3D scene structure from a collection of images -- remains a central challenge in computer vision, with many open problems yet to be solved. Recent advances in feedforward 3D reconstruction have made significant strides in overcoming persistent failure cases of classical SfM methods, particularly in scenarios characterized by low texture, limited overlap, and symmetries. However, while feedforward approaches excel in these challenging conditions, they often face limitations regarding scalability, accuracy, or robustness, and typically fall short of classical methods in standard reconstruction settings. In this work, we systematically analyze these limitations and propose a new Structure-from-Motion pipeline by combining the respective strengths of classical and feedforward methods. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets show the benefits of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art results across a wide range of scenarios. We share our system as an open-source implementation at https://github.com/colmap/gluemap.

</details>


### [225] [Efficient All-Pairs Correlation Volume Sampling for Optical Flow Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.16942)
*Karlis Martins Briedis,Markus Gross,Christopher Schroers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种内存和计算高效的全局代价体采样算法，在保持与RAFT数学算子一致的前提下，相比按需采样速度提升92%，相比默认实现内存降低99%，并在高分辨率（含8K）光流估计任务上取得SOTA精度与速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有光流估计方法使用密集全对关联代价体采样，计算和内存复杂度呈像素数量的二次方。虽然存在按需计算的省内存方案，但实际速度慢，导致许多方法在降采样分辨率上处理，丢失细节信息。

Method: 提出一种内存与计算高效的全局关联代价体采样算法，精确匹配RAFT定义的数学算子，在保持低内存占用的同时实现快速采样。

Result: 相比按需采样，速度提升高达92%，内存占用同样低；相比默认实现，内存降低高达99%；端到端模型推理在高分辨率输入上可节省高达63%的时间；在8K超高清数据集和SEA-RAFT方法的推理扩展上取得高分辨率下的SOTA结果。

Conclusion: 所提算法同时解决了密集代价体采样的内存瓶颈和低效问题，使得高分辨率光流估计在精度和速度上均达到最优。

Abstract: Recent optical flow estimation methods often employ local cost sampling from a dense all-pairs correlation volume. This results in quadratic computational and memory complexity in the number of pixels. Although an alternative memory-efficient implementation with on-demand cost computation exists, this is significantly slower in practice and therefore many prior methods process images at downsampled resolutions, missing fine-grained details. To address this, we propose an algorithm for both memory and compute-efficient implementation of the all-pairs correlation volume sampling, still matching the exact mathematical operator as defined by RAFT. Our approach outperforms on-demand sampling by up to 92% while maintaining equally low memory usage, and performs at least on par with the default implementation with up to 99% lower memory usage. As cost sampling makes up a significant portion of the overall runtime, this can translate to up to 63% savings for the total end-to-end model inference on high-resolution inputs. Our evaluation of existing methods includes an 8K ultra-high-resolution dataset and an inference-time extension of the SEA-RAFT method. With this, we achieve state-of-the-art results at high resolutions both in accuracy and runtime.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [226] [When Does Adaptive Guidance Help? Belief-Aware Privileged Distillation for Autonomous Driving Under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26155)
*Mehmet Haklidir*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BA-GSAC通过集成不确定性动态调节蒸馏系数λ，但实验发现严重遮挡下自适应系数会坍塌；相比之下，线性衰减调度表现最佳，表明调度机制而非集成驱动了稳定性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GSAC使用固定蒸馏系数，未考虑智能体的不确定性，限制了其在部分可观测自动驾驶任务中的适应性。

Method: 提出BA-GSAC，利用集成分歧（ensemble disagreement）动态调节蒸馏系数λ；在Highway-Env上对比五种策略（固定λ∈{0.01,0.1}、自适应、线性衰减、原版SAC），覆盖三种POMDP难度级别。

Result: 严重遮挡下自适应系数约3K步后坍缩至λ_min；线性衰减调度取得最佳性能（均值116.5，CV=8.9%），恒λ=0.01的CV为29.8%，而自适应方法CV=13.3%。

Conclusion: 调度效应而非集成是稳定性的主因；集成预测目标的选择是关键设计因素；提出了在引导策略的privileged access上训练集成的架构修复方案但尚未验证。

Abstract: Guided Soft Actor-Critic (GSAC) distills knowledge from a privileged full-state teacher to a partial-observation student for autonomous driving, but uses a fixed distillation coefficient lambda regardless of the agent's uncertainty. We present Belief-Aware GSAC (BA-GSAC), which modulates lambda via ensemble disagreement, and use it as a testbed for a systematic empirical study asking: when does adaptive guidance actually help? Evaluating five strategies (fixed lambda in {0.01, 0.1}, adaptive, linear decay, and vanilla SAC) across three POMDP difficulty levels on Highway-Env, we find that preliminary single-seed runs suggest benefits under mild and moderate partial observability, but under severe occlusion (evaluated with 3 seeds for all methods) the adaptive coefficient collapses to lambda_min within about 3K steps. We trace this to an observability blindness phenomenon: because the ensemble predicts partial observations, it achieves low disagreement even under heavy occlusion, modeling what is visible but unable to detect what is missing. We diagnose the root cause and propose an architectural fix (training the ensemble on full-state predictions using the guiding actor's privileged access); while not validated here, we show that even with current limitations, the warmup phase provides measurable stabilization (CV=13.3% vs. 29.8% for constant lambda=0.01). In fact, a simple deterministic linear decay schedule achieves the best severe-POMDP performance across all metrics (mean 116.5, CV=8.9%), suggesting that the scheduling effect, not the ensemble, drives the stability benefit. These findings provide practical guidance for designing uncertainty-aware teacher-student frameworks and highlight ensemble prediction targets as an important design choice.

</details>


### [227] [PhyPush: One Push is All You Need for Sensorless Physical Property Estimation with Physics-Guided Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26284)
*Koyo Fujii,Luis Figueredo,Praminda Caleb-Solly,Ivan Boschi,Edoardo Ida',Marco Carricato,Aly Magassouba*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PhyPush是一个基于物理引导的Transformer框架，仅通过单次推动和运动学数据（机械臂末端速度）即可估计物体的质量和摩擦系数，无需力传感器等专用硬件。该方法结合牛顿第二定律和库仑摩擦模型作为物理引导损失，在仿真和真实实验中均优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物体质量与摩擦估计方法依赖专用硬件（力/力矩传感器、触觉阵列、多相机运动捕捉系统），限制了可扩展性和实际部署。本文旨在仅利用标准机械臂可获取的运动学数据实现物理属性估计。

Method: 提出PhyPush框架，基于Transformer架构，输入为单次推动中机械臂末端执行器的运动学速度数据。通过物理引导损失函数引入牛顿第二定律和库仑摩擦模型作为约束，增强模型的物理一致性和泛化能力。

Result: 在仿真中，相比可获取完整力信息的基线方法，误差降低超过10%；在真实实验中，优于纯数据驱动损失方法。在跨领域（未知物体和表面）条件下仍保持高精度。

Conclusion: 物理引导学习能够实现低成本、传感器高效的物理属性估计，仅需单次推动和现成的运动学数据即可完成，展示了在机器人操作中的实际应用潜力。

Abstract: Accurately estimating object mass and friction is fundamental to achieving reliable and adaptive robotic manipulation. Although interactive perception provides a powerful mechanism for inferring such properties, most existing approaches depend on specialized hardware such as force/torque sensors, tactile arrays, or multi-camera motion-capture systems, limiting scalability and deployment. This paper presents PhyPush, a physics-guided Transformer framework that estimates an object's mass and friction coefficient using only kinematically derived end-effector velocity from a single push. This typically requires data available on standard robotic arms. The model incorporates constraints from Newton's second law and the Coulomb friction model through a physics-guided loss, improving physical consistency and generalization to unseen objects and surfaces. Across diverse simulation and real-world setups, PhyPush consistently achieves more accurate mass and friction estimation in challenging out-of-domain conditions. In simulation, it reduces error by over 10% compared with a baseline that has privileged access to full force information, while in real-world experiments, it outperforms a data-driven loss approach. Overall, the results demonstrate that physics-guided learning can enable low-cost, sensor-efficient estimation of physical properties, relying solely on a single push and readily available kinematic data.

</details>


### [228] [Collaborative Navigation and Exploration with $β$-Sparse Gaussian Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26304)
*Evangelos Psomiadis,Dipankar Maity,Panagiotis Tsiotras*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种异构机器人协作导航框架，通过β-稀疏高斯过程模型实现带宽受限下的在线地图点选择与导航动作决策，在火星和地球地图仿真中路径成本降低18%、信息传输量减少76%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决未知环境中异构机器人在感知、通信和计算受限条件下的协作导航难题，特别是带宽约束下如何有效传输环境信息以辅助领航机器人导航。

Method: 提出β-稀疏高斯过程（β-Sparse Gaussian Processes）变分稀疏GP模型用于任务感知的诱导点选择；开发平衡任务相关性与探索的动作选择策略；使移动传感器机器人（如无人机）在线联合选择传输地图点与导航动作，同时预测未探索区域。

Result: 在火星和地球地图上的仿真中，相比无通信情况路径成本降低18%，相比原始数据传输基线减少76%的传输信息量。

Conclusion: 所提框架能在严重带宽约束下有效降低导航路径成本，大幅减少所需传输的数据量，为异构机器人在未知环境中的协作导航提供可行方案。

Abstract: Collaborative navigation of heterogeneous robots in unknown environments poses significant challenges due to sensing, communication, and computational limitations. In this work, a lead robot navigates toward a target while a mobile sensor robot (e.g., a drone) assists by transmitting information about its locally observed environment under bandwidth constraints. We propose a framework that enables the sensor to jointly select its transmitted map points and navigation actions online, while also predicting unexplored regions of the environment. To this end, we present $β$-Sparse Gaussian Processes, a novel and robust variational sparse Gaussian Process model for task-aware inducing point selection. Furthermore, we develop an action-selection strategy that balances task relevance with exploration. Simulations on Mars and Earth maps show that the framework can reduce path cost by 18% relative to no communication and decrease transmitted information by 76% compared to raw-data transmission baselines.

</details>


### [229] [NightSight: Passive Computation for Navigation in Dark Using Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26330)
*Deepak Singh,Brijan Vaghasiya,Shreyas Khobragade,Nitin Sanket*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种轻量级感知方法，结合单目事件相机、编码孔径镜头和红外点阵投影器，使小型空中机器人在完全黑暗环境中实现自主导航。通过投影图案经编码孔径成像产生深度依赖的模糊特征，利用仅基于简单平面墙合成数据训练的CNN解码为密集深度图，实现了零样本泛化到复杂真实场景，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上以20Hz实时运行，精度达7.0cm（2.80%误差）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型空中机器人在完全黑暗环境中的自主导航面临重大挑战，因为这类平台无法承载需要大量载荷、功耗或计算资源的传统感知系统，亟需一种轻量级、低功耗的感知方案。

Method: 结合单目事件相机、编码孔径镜头和红外点阵投影器；投影图案经编码孔径成像产生深度依赖的模糊特征；使用仅基于简单平面墙合成数据训练的卷积神经网络解码为密集深度图。

Result: 系统在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上以20Hz实时运行；零样本泛化到复杂真实场景；深度估计精度达7.0cm（l1误差），在2.5m范围内误差率为2.80%。

Conclusion: 证明了结合结构化照明、编码光学和事件感知在完全黑暗环境中实现鲁棒感知与导航的潜力，为资源受限平台上的黑暗环境自主导航提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Small aerial robots are particularly well-suited for search and rescue in confined and hazardous environments due to their agility, low cost, and ability to traverse through cluttered spaces that are inaccessible to larger platforms. However, enabling autonomous navigation in complete darkness remains a significant challenge, because small aerial robots cannot easily accommodate perception systems that demand substantial payload, power, or computation. In this work, we present a lightweight perception approach that combines a monocular event camera, a coded aperture lens, and an infrared dot projector to enable navigation in such conditions. The projected pattern, when imaged through the coded aperture, produces depth dependent blur signatures that implicitly encode scene geometry. We train a convolutional neural network to decode these signatures into dense depth maps using only synthetic data generated from a simple planar wall setup. Despite this minimal training regime, the model generalizes zero-shot to complex real-world scenes. Our system operates in real time at 20 Hz on a NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, demonstrating suitability for resource-constrained platforms. We further analyze the impact of different coded aperture designs on depth estimation performance. Our approach gives high accuracy (l1 error 7.0cm) upto 2.5m range (2.80% error). These results highlight the potential of combining structured illumination, coded optics, and event-based sensing for enabling robust perception and navigation in complete darkness.

</details>


### [230] [RCSP: Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning for Safe Dynamic Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26348)
*Zhengye Han,Quanyan Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出风险敏感推测性场景规划（RCSP），一种预测性规划层，通过评估候选命令对短期障碍物未来的影响来解决移动机器人预测性近失问题，在MuJoCo和ROS2/Gazebo仿真中提高了动态瓶颈场景下的安全性和路径质量，但严格基准成功率低于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人在动态环境中面临"预测性近失承诺问题"：当前安全的速度可能使机器人陷入即将被移动障碍物关闭的通道，现有方法缺乏对此类风险的前瞻性评估。

Method: RCSP维护一个轻量级的局部运动假设信念，通过对未来交互进行采样并惩罚高风险尾部分布来评估候选命令，最后通过局部安全检查执行。

Result: 在MuJoCo瓶颈任务中，RCSP无碰撞到达目标，安全性和路径质量优于非自适应预测器但延迟更高；在ROS2/Gazebo中，向Nav2堆栈添加RCSP减少了动态近失故障；在DynaBARN/Jackal迁移中，DWA和TEB在严格基准成功率上仍更强。

Conclusion: RCSP可作为预测性风险模块，补充现有导航堆栈在动态瓶颈场景中的不足，但存在性能边界。

Abstract: Mobile robots can fail before they collide: a velocity that is safe now may commit the robot to a passage that moving obstacles will soon close. We study this predictive near-miss commitment problem and propose Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning (RCSP), a planning layer that evaluates candidate commands against plausible short-horizon obstacle futures. RCSP maintains a lightweight belief over local motion conjectures, samples future interactions, penalizes high-risk tails, and executes through a local safety check. In controlled MuJoCo bottleneck tasks, the RCSP planner reaches the goal without collisions and yields higher secondary safety and path-quality point estimates than a non-adaptive predictor, with additional latency. In ROS2/Gazebo, adding the local safety layer to a standard Nav2 stack reduces dynamic near-miss failures. On official DynaBARN/Jackal transfer, tuned DWA and TEB remain stronger on strict benchmark success, revealing the boundary of the approach. These simulation results position RCSP as a predictive-risk module that complements existing navigation stacks in dynamic bottleneck regimes.

</details>


### [231] [Closing the Loop in Teleoperation: Episode-Level Data Quality Assessment and Feedback for High-Quality Demonstration Collection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26349)
*Gokul Narayanan,Yash Shahapurkar,Melih Erdogan,Brian Zhu,Eugen Solowjow*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一个数据质量评估与反馈框架（DQAF），通过即时后验反馈帮助操作员提升遥操作演示数据的质量。实验表明，接收该框架反馈的操作员比未接收者更快地生成高质量演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业自动化正从刚性系统向灵活自适应系统转型，物理AI的发展需要大规模真实机器人演示数据。然而新手操作员产生的遥操作演示虽任务成功但常因运动低效、重复修正或接近关节极限而质量不佳，亟需一种能提供非二元质量反馈的机制来提升数据质量。

Method: 构建DQAF框架：从遥操作数据中提取子任务进度、运动平滑度、停顿和运动学极限等质量相关信号，将其转化为结构化质量评估和可操作的自然语言反馈，为操作员提供即时后验反馈。

Result: 在验证研究中，该系统与人类评审员在数据集策展中的拒绝原因和改进建议上表现一致；在包含三名新手操作员和两项操作任务的试点研究中，接收系统即时反馈的操作员比未接收者更快地提高演示质量。

Conclusion: 提出的DQAF框架能够有效识别遥操作演示中的质量缺陷并提供可操作反馈，帮助操作员更快提升演示质量，优于传统的二元成功/失败反馈方式。

Abstract: Industrial automation is at a pivotal moment, as Physical AI is driving a transition from rigid, hand-engineered automation systems toward more flexible and adaptive systems. This shift has created a growing demand for large-scale, real-world robot demonstration data, making teleoperation an increasingly important mechanism for data collection. However, high-quality teleoperated demonstrations remain difficult to obtain in practice, as novice operators often produce episodes that are task-successful but suboptimal for downstream use due to inefficient motion, repeated corrections, or operation near robot joint limits. We present a Data Quality Assessment and Feedback (DQAF) framework that closes the loop in teleoperation by providing immediate post-episode feedback grounded in semantic task progress and robot telemetry. The framework extracts quality relevant signals such as sub-task progress, motion smoothness, stalls, kinematic limits and converts them into structured quality assessments and actionable natural-language feedback. Unlike binary success or failure feedback, the proposed system explains why an episode is suboptimal and highlights specific behaviors to correct in the next trial. We evaluate the framework through a diagnostic validation study and a pilot user study. In the validation study, the system is compared with a human reviewer during dataset curation, producing rejection reasons and actionable feedback for improvement. In the pilot study with three novice operators across two manipulation tasks, the operator who received the systems immediate, automated post-episode feedback improved faster than those who did not, producing higher-quality demonstrations sooner.

</details>


### [232] [Multi-Robot Box Transport over Different Surfaces with Decentralized Role-based Proportional Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26430)
*Aditya Bhatt,Himavarshini Yarragangu,Urvish Shah,Venkata Sai Yaswanth Mohan Thota,Souma Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为R2P2的异步去中心化任务与运动规划方法，用于多机器人协作推送物体。该方法通过角色分配（推、支撑、阻止）和规则/比例控制，实现了在不同倾斜角度和摩擦系数的地面上搬运不同质量箱子的任务。在六机器人仿真和四机器人实物实验中，R2P2展现了优于标准虚拟领航-跟随方法的成功率和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人协作搬运在建筑、仓储和灾后清理等场景有广泛应用，但在地面倾斜度和摩擦系数不同的复杂地形上实现协作搬运存在独特挑战。现有方法对通信、同步和共识要求高，存在单点故障问题。

Method: 提出R2P2方法：1) 基于规则的角色分配（推、支撑、阻止），根据搬运模式（旋转vs平移）确定；2) 角色执行时采用规则控制或比例速度控制；3) 每个机器人仅需观测自身和箱子的位置及朝向信息；4) 异步去中心化架构，降低通信和同步需求。

Result: 在基于NVIDIA IsaacSim构建的六机器人仿真环境中，R2P2在不同地面摩擦/倾斜和箱子质量场景下展现出良好的泛化能力，成功率优于标准虚拟领航-跟随方法；并在四台Turtlebot协作搬运1.2kg箱子的实物实验中成功验证。

Conclusion: R2P2是一种有效的去中心化多机器人协作搬运方法，能够应对不同地形和负载条件，减轻通信和同步负担，且具备良好的可扩展性和实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Collaborative transport of objects via pushing by multiple robots has many applications, ranging from construction and warehouse environments to post disaster debris clean-up. Achieving collaborative transport over surfaces with different inclination and friction properties however poses unique challenges. To address these challenges, this paper presents an asynchronous decentralized task and motion planning approach for transporting rectangular boxes of varying mass over flat, uphill and downhill terrain. Such a decentralized approach alleviates communication, synchronization and consensus needs and mitigates single point of failure issues. Our approach, called R2P2 or Roles with Rules and Proportional-control Primitive, assigns roles (e.g., push, support and prevent) to robots based on rules cognizant of the mode of manipulation needed (box rotation vs translation); this is followed by either rule-based control or proportional control of robot velocity based on the roles. Each robot is assumed to observe the location and heading of self and the box in executing the role and controls. R2P2 is evaluated with a six-robot team deployed in a simulator built using NVIDIA IsaacSim -- demonstrating generalizability across different surface friction/inclination and box mass scenarios, and better success rate compared to a standard virtual-leader-follower method. R2P2 is also successfully validated with a physical experiment, where it is executed onboard four turtlebots tasked with moving a 1.2 kg box.

</details>


### [233] [Robust Koopman Control Barrier Filters for Safe Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26452)
*Dhruv S. Kushwaha,Zoleikha A. Biron*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种鲁棒Koopman-CBF SAC框架，通过数据驱动的Koopman预测器学习提升空间中的仿射CBF约束，并利用投影残差裕度鲁棒化处理近似误差，在安全控制基准上实现零约束违反，同时揭示了线性EDMD模型与一阶速度屏障在高维任务中的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 控制屏障函数（CBF）在无模型强化学习中的应用受限于对精确动力学模型和手工设计的屏障证书的需求，亟需一种数据驱动且鲁棒的CBF约束构建方法。

Method: 1) 从数据中学习有限维Koopman预测器，在提升空间中构建仿射CBF约束；2) 通过二次规划安全层实施CBF滤波；3) 利用投影残差裕度（从保留的 rollout 数据估计）收紧CBF条件以应对近似误差；4) 评论家在执行的安行动上训练，行动者正则化朝向Koopman-CBF可行集。

Result: 在CartPole稳定和跟踪任务上实现零约束违反，回报匹配或超过无约束SAC；在高维Safety Gymnasium任务中部分场景降低违反，但暴露了线性EDMD模型和一阶速度屏障的局限性。

Conclusion: 鲁棒Koopman-CBF滤波器是连接无模型RL与可验证安全性的有前景桥梁，但其有效性依赖于结构条件（如高维、非线性场景需高阶和多步Koopman-CBF扩展）。

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) for robotic systems requires policies that improve task performance while satisfying state and input constraints during both training and deployment. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a principled mechanism for enforcing forward invariance through minimally invasive safety filters, but their use in model-free RL is limited by the need for accurate dynamics and hand-designed barrier certificates. We propose Robust Koopman-CBF SAC, a safety-filtered actor--critic framework that learns a finite-dimensional Koopman predictor from data, constructs affine CBF constraints in the lifted space, and enforces them through a quadratic-program safety layer. To account for finite-dimensional Koopman approximation error, the CBF condition is tightened using a projected residual margin estimated from held-out rollout data. The critic is trained on the executed safe action, while the actor is regularized toward the Koopman-CBF feasible set, reducing dependence on the filter over training. Across safe-control benchmarks, the method achieves zero constraint violations on CartPole stabilization and tracking while matching or exceeding unconstrained SAC returns. On high-dimensional Safety Gymnasium locomotion tasks, the method reduces violations in some settings but also exposes important limitations of first-order velocity barriers and linear EDMD models, motivating high-order and multi-step Koopman-CBF extensions. These results suggest that robust Koopman-CBF filters are a promising bridge between model-free RL and certifiable safety, while clarifying the structural conditions under which such filters remain effective. All code is available at \href{https://github.com/DhruvKushwaha/Koopman-CBF-Soft-Actor-Critic}{Github Repository}.

</details>


### [234] [Heterogeneous AAV Logistics Task Allocation: A Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Overlapping Coalition Formation Game Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26471)
*Yuze Zhou,Jingliang Sun,Junzhi Li,Jianxin Zhong,Zihan Wang,Teng Long*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对异构AAV物流任务分配中随机涌现的时间敏感任务带来的最优性挑战，提出了一种强化学习增强的重叠联盟形成博弈方法。该方法利用Transformer-based SAC网络编码变长物流状态并捕获任务时空依赖，指导联盟更新，证明了算法构成精确势博弈并收敛到纳什稳定均衡。仿真显示在32架AAV和80个任务场景下，相比启发式OCF基线成本降低39.76%，室内飞行实验验证了实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态城市物流中，随机涌现的时间敏感任务对异构AAV物流任务分配的最优性构成显著挑战，现有方法难以应对时变任务集和异构资源约束下的全局最优分配。

Method: 提出强化学习增强的重叠联盟形成博弈方法。建立动态任务分配模型，以耦合服务质量与资源消耗的广义物流成本量化全局最优性；设计Transformer-based SAC网络，利用多头自注意力编码变长物流状态并捕获任务时空依赖；学习策略自适应指导联盟更新，替代重叠联盟形成博弈中的启发式规则；证明联盟形成过程构成精确势博弈，有限迭代内收敛到纳什稳定均衡。

Result: 在32架AAV和80个任务场景下，相比启发式OCF基线成本降低39.76%；室内飞行实验验证了实用性。

Conclusion: 所提算法在广义物流成本准则下有效提升了动态任务分配的最优性，兼具理论收敛保证与实际部署可行性。

Abstract: In dynamic urban logistics, the stochastic emergence of time-sensitive tasks poses a significant optimality challenge for heterogeneous AAVs logistics task allocation. To address this problem, a reinforcement learning enhanced overlapping coalition formation game approach is proposed. A dynamic task allocation model is established, where global optimality is mathematically quantified by a generalized logistics cost coupling service quality and resource consumption. To deal with the time-varying task sets induced by stochastic order arrivals, a transformer-based soft actor-critic network is designed. By leveraging multi-head self-attention to encode variable-length logistics states and capture task-wise spatiotemporal dependencies, the learned policy adaptively guides coalition updates, replacing heuristic rules in the overlapping coalition formation game. On this basis, heterogeneous AAVs can form more efficient overlapping coalitions for dynamic logistics tasks. The resulting coalition formation process is proven to constitute an exact potential game, which guarantees convergence to a Nash-stable equilibrium within a finite number of iterations. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm effectively improves the optimality of task allocation under the generalized logistics cost criterion. In a scenario with 32 AAVs and 80 tasks, our algorithm achieves a 39.76% cost reduction compared with the heuristic OCF baseline. Indoor flight experiments further validate its practicality.

</details>


### [235] [Efficient On-policy Visual-RL via Stochastic Decoupled Policy Gradient](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26478)
*Haoxiang You,Yilang Liu,Davis Zong,Qian Wang,Teeratham Vitchutripop,Qi Wang,Daniel Rakita,Ian Abraham*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出随机解耦策略梯度（SDPG）方法，通过轨迹滚动的随机扰动估计策略梯度，显著降低计算和内存开销，在单张RTX 4080 GPU上数小时内完成视觉强化学习训练，在视觉MuJoCo基准测试中优于基线方法，并展示了从仿真到真实机器人的有效迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉强化学习方法需要大量批渲染环境，计算和内存开销巨大，训练时间长，难以在单GPU上高效端到端训练多样化视觉运动控制策略。

Method: 提出SDPG方法，通过轨迹滚动的随机扰动来估计策略梯度，无需大量批渲染环境，大幅减少计算和内存开销。

Result: 在视觉MuJoCo基准测试中，SDPG在训练时间、内存使用和奖励方面均优于基线方法；在灵巧操作、具有挑战性的运动等真实感视觉机器人基准测试中表现有效，并成功实现从仿真到真实硬件上的迁移。

Conclusion: SDPG是一种轻量级、高效的视觉强化学习方法，可在单GPU上快速训练，并支持从仿真到真实的迁移，为未来视觉机器人研究提供了新的基准。

Abstract: We present the stochastic decoupled policy gradient (SDPG), a lightweight visual reinforcement learning (RL) method that trains diverse visuomotor control policies end-to-end within a few hours on a single NVIDIA RTX 4080 GPU. SDPG estimates policy gradients via random perturbations of trajectory rollouts, requiring orders of magnitude fewer batch-rendered environments and substantially reducing compute and memory overhead. On visual MuJoCo benchmarks, SDPG consistently outperforms baseline methods in training time, memory usage, and rewards. Finally, to support future research, we introduce a suite of realistic visual robotics benchmarks spanning dexterous manipulation, challenging locomotion, and demonstrate effective sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware.

</details>


### [236] [Provably Safe Motion Planning Under Unknown Disturbances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26625)
*Ibon Gracia,Qi Heng Ho,Luca Laurenti,Morteza Lahijanian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种在未知分布随机扰动下可证明安全的采样式运动规划算法，通过学习Wasserstein模糊管并结合概率完备的树生长策略与高效验证器，在满足机会约束的同时优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有采样式运动规划算法在处理系统受未知分布随机扰动影响时，缺乏可证明的安全保证；而传统鲁棒方法往往过于保守或难以扩展到高维状态空间。

Method: 利用系统轨迹数据学习Wasserstein模糊管（一组模糊集序列），以高置信度包含状态分布轨迹；将该模糊管融入概率完备的采样式运动规划树生长算法中；通过学习多个低维模糊管替代单一高维模糊管来降低保守性并提升可扩展性；设计基于Bandit的高效有效性验证器提升经验性能。

Result: 在杂乱环境中，算法能够在严格安全阈值下找到有效规划路径，性能优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 所提方法在未知分布随机扰动下实现了可证明安全的运动规划，兼顾了理论保证与经验性能。

Abstract: We present a provably safe sampling-based motion planning algorithm for robotic systems affected by random disturbances of unknown distribution. We consider systems with linear or linearizable dynamics evolving in workspace with arbitrary-shaped obstacles subject to state and control constraints. Safety requirements are formulated as chance-constraints. Our approach leverages data from trajectories of the system to learn a Wasserstein ambiguity tube, i.e., a sequence of ambiguity sets, which contains the trajectory of the system's state distribution with high confidence. This ambiguity tube is then used in a probabilistically complete algorithm to grow a sampling-based motion planning tree that respects the constraints of the problem. We show that learning several lower-dimensional ambiguity tubes instead of a single high-dimensional one effectively reduces the conservatism and boosts scalability. Additionally, we design an efficient bandit-based validity checker that remarkably increases the empirical performance of our approach without sacrificing probabilistic completeness. Case studies show our algorithm finds valid plans in cluttered environments under strict safety thresholds, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [237] [Enabling Extensible Embodied Capabilities with Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26637)
*Xueyang Zhou,Zijia Wang,Qianjiang Li,Yibo Hu,Guiyao Tie,Li Wan,Yidan Liu,Pan Zhou,Lichao Sun,Yongchao Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出能力外化方法Embodied Tool Protocol (ETP)，通过将具身智能中的异构能力解耦为独立工具并在推理时动态调用，显著提升性能（EB-ALFRED提升31%，EB-Navigation提升36%），但认知和感知类能力提升大，执行类能力提升有限，且模型在何时、选择、如何调用工具方面仍存在挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能方法将感知、推理、规划、控制统一在参数化策略中，但这些能力本质上是分层且异构的，难以在单一模型中可靠学习和模块化。

Method: 提出能力外化方法，将异构能力解耦为独立优化工具，推理时动态调用。设计ETP标准化协议（工具注册、发现、调用、执行），构建100+验证工具的工具库，并搭建EmbodiedToolBench评估框架。

Result: 仿真和真实平台实验表明能力外化持续提升性能（EB-ALFRED平均提升31%，EB-Navigation平均提升36%），但增益主要集中于认知和感知类能力，执行类能力提升有限。

Conclusion: 能力外化有效提升具身智能性能，但何时、选择、如何调用工具仍是所有模型的持续挑战，具身工具能力是未来研究的关键方向。

Abstract: Most existing embodied intelligence methods formulate perception, reasoning, planning, and control within a unified parameterized policy. Yet these capabilities are inherently hierarchical and heterogeneous, making them difficult to reliably learn and modularize within a single model. We propose a capability externalization approach that decouples heterogeneous capabilities into independently optimized tools, dynamically invoked at inference time. To this end, we introduce Embodied Tool Protocol (ETP), a standardized protocol for embodied tool registration, discovery, invocation, and execution, and curate 100+ validated tools spanning perception, cognition, reasoning, and execution as the tool base. Building on this, we construct EmbodiedToolBench to evaluate both whether tool augmentation improves embodied performance and how well current models use tools across tool-necessity recognition, tool selection, tool execution, and tool-chain composition. Experiments across simulation and real-world platforms confirm that capability externalization consistently improves embodied performance (avg. gain 31% on EB-ALFRED and 36% on EB-Navigation), yet reveal a clear boundary: gains are substantial for cognition and perception but are limited for execution-type capabilities. Moreover, our analysis reveals that knowing when, which, and how to invoke tools remains a persistent challenge across all models, thereby highlighting embodied tool competence as a critical direction for future research.

</details>


### [238] [HyperSim: A Holistic Sim-To-Real Framework For Robust Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26638)
*Junyi Dong,Haotian Luo,Ziwei Xu,Shengwei Bian,Heng Zhang,Sitong Mao,Jingyi Guo,Yang Xu,Wenhao Chen,Qiuyu Feng,Yao Mu,Ping Luo,Shunbo Zhou,Xiaodong Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HyperSim是一个从合成数据生成到策略训练再到真实世界部署的全流程框架，通过高保真环境合成、对抗轨迹生成和仿真-真实联合训练三大支柱系统性地缩小仿真到现实的差距。在400次真实世界任务执行中，ACT和π₀模型的sim-to-real成功率分别达到80%和95%，且对抗轨迹训练的策略在物理扰动下完成率提升35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展数据规模与多样性对于泛化具身智能至关重要，但物理数据采集成本高昂，而合成数据生成虽可扩展，但仿真到现实的域差距问题仍未解决。

Method: HyperSim提出三大核心模块：(1) 高保真环境合成——提升视觉逼真度；(2) 对抗轨迹生成——扩展数据覆盖范围；(3) 仿真-真实联合训练——强制学习域不变表征，三者协同缩小域差异。

Result: 在400次真实世界任务执行中，完整pipeline在ACT和π₀模型上分别达到80%和95%的sim-to-real成功率；对抗轨迹训练的策略在物理扰动下任务完成率提升35%。

Conclusion: HyperSim通过系统性地融合高保真合成、对抗数据生成和联合训练策略，有效弥合了仿真到现实的域差距，显著提升了机械臂操作策略在真实世界中的鲁棒性和成功率。

Abstract: Scaling data volume and diversity is critical for generalizing embodied intelligence. While synthetic data generation offers a scalable alternative to expensive physical data acquisition, transferring robotic manipulation policies from simulation to the real world (sim-to-real) remains a formidable challenge due to the domain gap. This paper presents HyperSim, a holistic framework spanning from synthetic data generation to policy training and seamless real-world deployment. To systematically bridge the sim-to-real gap, HyperSim is realized through three core pillars: high-fidelity environment synthesis, adversarial trajectory generation, and sim-and-real co-training. Collectively, these modules address domain discrepancies by enhancing visual fidelity, expanding data coverage, and enforcing domain-invariant representations. We rigorously validate HyperSim through a large-scale empirical study involving 400 real-world task executions across two representative manipulation models. Assessed across three fine-grained metrics, our complete pipeline achieves remarkable sim-to-real success rates of 80% and 95% with ACT and π_{0}, respectively. Furthermore, policies trained on our adversarial trajectories exhibit significantly enhanced robustness against dynamic uncertainties, achieving a 35% higher completion rate under physical perturbations.

</details>


### [239] [L-Learning : A Lyapunov-Based Approach Leveraging Lagrangian Mechanics for Efficient and Stable Robot Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26648)
*Quan Quan,Hao Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出L-Learning，一种融合李雅普诺夫稳定性理论与拉格朗日力学的数据驱动控制框架，通过学习系统能量函数实现机器人轨迹跟踪的高精度控制，同时保证闭环稳定性与样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统控制方法在动态不确定环境中性能退化，而数据驱动方法虽适应性更强，但存在样本复杂度高、缺乏严格稳定性保证的问题。L-Learning旨在弥合两者差距。

Method: 将李雅普诺夫稳定性理论与拉格朗日力学融入数据驱动框架，显式地从数据中学习系统的能量函数，从而在优化轨迹跟踪性能的同时内在地保证闭环稳定性。

Result: L-Learning具有优越的控制精度、理论稳定性保证和高样本效率。

Conclusion: L-Learning是解决实际机器人应用中性能与稳定性兼顾问题的有前景的方案。

Abstract: This paper presents L-Learning, a novel data-driven control framework for robotics that integrates Lyapunov stability theory with Lagrangian mechanics to enhance trajectory tracking performance. While traditional control methods often suffer from performance degradation in dynamic and uncertain environments, data-driven approaches, while more adaptable, are frequently limited by high sample complexity and a lack of rigorous stability guarantees. L-Learning mitigates these challenges by explicitly learning the system's energy function from data, thereby optimizing performance while ensuring closed-loop stability intrinsically. Characterized by superior control accuracy, theoretical stability guarantees, and high sample efficiency, L-Learning represents a promising solution for practical robotic applications.

</details>


### [240] [On the Generalization Capabilities, Design Choices and Limitations of Keypoint Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26649)
*Thomas Lips,Marco Moletta,Michael C. Welle,Danica Kragic,Francis wyffels*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于视觉基础模型的关键点模仿学习（KIL）在机器人操作中的泛化能力，通过2000多次真实世界实验，KIL在五项任务中达到75%的成功率，显著优于RGB基线（47%），与S2-diffusion（73%）相当，但未能超越替代表示方法，且继承了基础模型的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGB-based模仿学习需要大量 demonstrations 才能泛化到未见过的物体或场景，因此需要研究中间表示来提高机器人操作的泛化能力。

Method: 结合先前关键点模仿学习（KIL）工作的多种方法，研究多种设计选择以提供实践指南，利用视觉基础模型进行一次性关键点提取，并通过2000多次真实世界 rollout 评估泛化能力。

Result: KIL在五项任务中达到75%整体成功率，显著优于RGB基线（47%），与S2-diffusion（73%）表现相当。

Conclusion: KIL是一种数据高效的机器人学习方法，但未能超越替代表示方法，且继承了用于关键点提取的视觉基础模型的局限性。

Abstract: RGB-based imitation learning requires many demonstrations to generalize to unseen objects or scenes, motivating research into intermediate representations to improve generalization for robotic manipulation. Visual foundation models enable one-shot extraction of keypoints to provide such representation. However, it remains unclear how to integrate them into imitation learning optimally and when they outperform alternative representations. We combine approaches from previous works on keypoint imitation learning (KIL) and investigate several design choices to provide practical guidelines. Using over 2000 real-world rollouts, we also assess the generalization capabilities of KIL to unseen objects and scene variations. KIL achieves a 75% overall success rate across five tasks, significantly outperforming the RGB baseline (47%) and performing on par with S2-diffusion (73%). Finally, we explore the limitations of the foundation models used for keypoint extraction and extend KIL to tasks with multiple object instances. Our results confirm KIL as a data-efficient approach for robot learning, though it does not outperform alternative representations and inherits limitations of the foundation models used for keypoint extraction. All rollout videos, demonstrations, and results are available at https://kil-manipulation.github.io/.

</details>


### [241] [SteelDS: A High-Resolution Video Dataset of E40 Steel Scrap for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26682)
*Melanie Neubauer,Christian Rauch,Gerald Koinig,Alexia Tischberger-Aldrian,Roland Pomberger,Elmar Rueckert*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一个包含24,297帧标注的高分辨率视频数据集，用于钢和铜废料的自动分拣，涵盖396个钢和101个铜物体，支持分类、检测和分割任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业磁选后阶段需要人工干预去除铜杂质，缺乏标准化的基准数据集来开发自动化分拣算法。

Method: 在受控实验室环境中模拟工业传送带场景，收集E40级钢和铜废料的高分辨率视频，提供像素级分割掩码和材料类别标注，包含不同间距和密度变化。

Result: 构建了包含24,297个标注帧、5个子集、396个钢和101个铜物体的数据集，物体按尺寸分类。

Conclusion: 该数据集可作为评估从复杂异质废钢流中识别铜杂质的自动化分拣算法的基准。

Abstract: This dataset provides high-resolution, annotated video sequences of shredded E40-grade steel and copper scrap on a conveyor belt.
