Across three model families and three math benchmarks, it yields consistent gains with no net-negative cases; for example, on Llama-3.1-8B MMLU-HS-Math, it improves accuracy from the mid-78% range to the mid-82% range, recovering about 22% of the available oracle headroom, indicating that this headroom can be partially recovered from the sample pool itself.

</details>


### [277] [InfoQuant: Shaping Activation Distributions for Low-Bit LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26175)
*Ke Li,Dong An,Xiaoling Zang,Can Ye,Liang Xie,Qibo Qiu,Chen Shen,Xiaofei He,Wenxiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出InfoQuant，一种无需训练的低比特激活量化方法，通过峰抑制正交变换（PSOT）将激活分布塑造成更易于量化的形态，在W4A4KV4设置下平均保持97%的浮点精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特激活量化是高效大模型部署的主要瓶颈，现有方法虽抑制峰值、平衡通道或最小化重构误差，但未明确什么样的激活分布才易于离散化，导致激活看似平滑却仍存在大量化误差。

Method: 从信息论角度分析量化误差，提出量化友好的激活应同时具有较小的数值范围和充分的分散度。基于此设计InfoQuant，采用峰抑制正交变换（PSOT）重塑激活分布，并引入自适应异常令牌选择提升PSOT优化的鲁棒性。

Result: 在多个LLM家族上，InfoQuant一致优于先前PTQ和端到端训练基线。在W4A4KV4设定下平均保持97%浮点精度，将LLaMA-2 13B的性能差距相比之前最优结果缩小42%。

Conclusion: 通过将激活转换重新定义为面向量化器的分布设计，并给出量化友好的分布准则，InfoQuant实现了无需训练的高效低比特量化，显著提升大模型部署效率。

Abstract: Low-bit activation quantization remains a major bottleneck in efficient large language model (LLM) deployment. The difficulty is not only that activations contain outliers, but that their distributions are often poorly matched to a low-bit uniform quantizer. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suppress peaks, balance channels, or minimize reconstruction error, yet they rarely specify what activation distribution is actually easy to discretize. As a result, activations may appear numerically smoother while still incurring large quantization error because the quantization range remains wide or most values collapse into a few levels near the mean. We recast activation transformation as quantizer-facing distribution design and analyze quantization error from an information-theoretic perspective. Our analysis shows that quantization-friendly activations should jointly have a smaller numerical range and sufficient dispersion within that range. Guided by this analysis, we propose InfoQuant, a train-free method that employs Peak Suppression Orthogonal Transformation (PSOT) to shape activations into more quantization-friendly distributions. We further introduce adaptive outlier-token selection to improve the robustness of PSOT during optimization. Across multiple LLM families, InfoQuant consistently outperforms prior PTQ and end-to-end training baselines. Under W4A4KV4, it preserves 97% of floating-point accuracy on average and reduces the LLaMA-2 13B performance gap by 42% over the previous state of the art. Code is available at [https://github.com/LLIKKE/InfoQuant](https://github.com/LLIKKE/InfoQuant)

</details>


### [278] [GAC: Noise-Aware Adaptive Mixing for Hybrid SFT-RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26184)
*Yuelin Hu,Zhenbo Yu,Zhengxue Cheng,Wei Liu,Li Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GAC，一种噪声感知的自适应混合训练权重控制器，通过在线估计梯度方差和信号不一致性动态调整监督微调与强化学习的混合比例，在数学、代码、科学和逻辑基准上持续优于固定和规则基线，且训练开销低于1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合后训练中固定的混合调度无法适应监督微调和强化学习两种信号相对噪声随时间变化的问题。

Method: GAC从在线估计的梯度方差和两种训练信号之间的不一致性推导出自适应混合权重，并加入了平滑、先验指导和有界更新，同时重用现有训练张量。

Result: 在数学、代码、科学和逻辑基准上，GAC一致优于强固定基线和基于规则的基线，模型规模越大增益越明显，训练开销低于1%。

Conclusion: 噪声感知的自适应混合方法能有效提升混合后训练性能，且计算开销极小。

Abstract: Hybrid post-training usually combines supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, but fixed mixing schedules cannot adapt when the relative noise of the two signals changes over time. We propose GAC, a noise-aware controller that derives an adaptive mixing weight from online estimates of gradient variance and disagreement between the two training signals. The method adds smoothing, prior guidance, and bounded updates while reusing existing training tensors. Experiments on math, code, science, and logic benchmarks show that GAC consistently improves hybrid post-training over strong fixed and rule-based baselines, with larger gains at larger model scales and less than 1% training overhead.

</details>


### [279] [Max-Window Scale Estimation for Near-Lossless HiF8 W8A8 Quantization-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26189)
*Yingying Cheng,Jinquan Shi,Li Zhou,Zhiyang He,Zhaoyi Sun,Fan Zhang,Jie Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了HiF8 W8A8量化感知训练（QAT）中两种正交的失效模式：amax饱和（由延迟缩放估计引起的前向裁剪导致知识表征损坏）和灾难性遗忘（激进学习率覆盖预训练常识知识）。通过保守的64步历史窗口最大算法策略解决amax饱和，通过500步BF16预热+lr=1e-5的QAT缓解遗忘，最终在MMLU、HellaSwag和ARC-Challenge上仅分别下降0.43%、0.58%和0.22%，训练损失APE仅0.11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特浮点格式的QAT在部署LLM时引入了标准训练指标无法检测的微妙失效模式，需要系统研究并解决这些隐藏问题。

Method: 通过8组对照实验识别出两种正交失效模式：amax饱和（延迟张量缩放导致的裁剪问题）和灾难性遗忘（学习率过大导致）。分别采用64步历史窗口保守最大算法和500步BF16预热+lr=1e-5策略进行修复。

Result: 最终配置在MMLU、HellaSwag和ARC-Challenge上相对BF16基线仅下降0.43%、0.58%和0.22%，训练损失APE为0.11%。

Conclusion: 两种修复策略是必要且充分的，能够有效解决HiF8 QAT中的失效模式，实现高效低比特LLM部署。

Abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) with low-bit floating-point formats enables efficient LLM deployment, yet introduces subtle failure modes invisible to standard training metrics. We present a systematic study of HiF8 W8A8 QAT for OpenPangu-Embedded-1B through the lens of Delayed Tensor Scaling (DTS). Across eight controlled experiments, we identify and disentangle two orthogonal failure modes: (i)amax saturation, where delayed scale estimates silently corrupt knowledge-sensitive representations via forward-pass clipping, and (ii)catastrophic forgetting, where an aggressive learning rate overwrites pretrained commonsense knowledge independently of quantization. Neither is detectable from training loss alone. We address amax saturation with a conservative max-algorithm DTS strategy over a 64-step history window, and mitigate forgetting via a 500-step BF16 warmup followed by QAT at lr=10^{-5}. Both fixes are necessary and sufficient: our final configuration achieves 0.43% MMLU drop, 0.58% HellaSwag drop, and 0.22% ARC-Challenge drop versus a matched BF16 baseline, with a training loss APE of only 0.11% over 10,000 steps.

</details>


### [280] [HRVConformer: Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Classification from the Heart Rate signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26190)
*Shuwen Yu,William P Marnane,Geraldine B. Boylan,Gordon Lightbody*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HRVConformer，一种基于卷积-Transformer混合架构的深度学习模型，用于直接利用原始心率信号对缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）进行端到端分类。模型在包含1,573小时心电数据的大规模数据集上训练，在测试集上达到83.23%的AUC和74.56%的准确率，优于Transformer、ResNet50和全卷积网络等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的HIE分类方法依赖人工设计的特征，无法充分挖掘心率信号中的深层表征。本文旨在设计一种端到端的深度学习架构，能够同时捕获心率信号中的局部和长程依赖关系，从而提高HIE分类的准确性和自动化程度。

Method: 提出HRVConformer混合架构：卷积层用于局部特征提取，Transformer注意力机制用于全局上下文建模；采用改进的Pan-Tompkins算法从心电图中提取心率信号；使用包含1,573小时数据（含专家标注和弱标注）进行监督学习训练。

Result: 在独立测试集上AUC达83.23%，准确率74.56%，性能优于Transformer、ResNet50和全卷积网络等基线模型。

Conclusion: 卷积-Transformer混合架构能有效提升基于心率信号的HIE分类性能，为HIE的自动化评估提供了一种有前景的新方法。

Abstract: This paper presents the HRVConformer, a novel deep learning architecture for the classification of hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) using the instantaneous heart rate (HR) signal. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on handcrafted features, HRVConformer directly processes raw HR signals in an end-to-end manner, capturing both local and long-range dependencies through a hybrid Convolution-Transformer framework. By integrating convolutional layers for local feature extraction and Transformer-based attention mechanisms for global context modelling, the architecture effectively enhances signal representation and classification performance. The model was trained using supervised learning on a large HR dataset consisting of 1,573 one-hour epochs, including 259 one-hour expert-annotated epochs and a substantial set of weakly labelled data. A 314-hour validation set provided a robust performance estimation, while an independent 215-hour dataset with expert annotations was reserved for final testing. HR signals were extracted from electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings using an improved Pan-Tompkins algorithm, which significantly enhanced both signal quality and data availability. Experimental results demonstrate that the HRVConformer achieves an AUC of 83.23\% and accuracy of 74.56\% on the test set. These results surpass the performance of the Transformer, ResNet50 and fully convolutional networks baselines, highlighting the advantages of integrating convolutional and Transformer-based components for HR-based HIE classification. The proposed method provides a promising step toward a more accurate and automated assessment of HIE using HR signals. The code is available at: https://github.com/syu-kylin/HRVConformer.

</details>


### [281] [Modeling Dynamic Mixtures of Time-Delay Systems from Streaming Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26191)
*Ren Fujiwara,Yasuko Matsubara,Yasushi Sakurai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DelayMix框架，将流式时间序列视为动态混合的时滞系统，通过固定长度的马尔可夫参数张量总结过往状态，实现快速自适应建模，在真实数据集上表现出更优的预测精度和时滞适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列数据流中存在由环境因素或输入时滞变化引起的系统快速变化（体制迁移），导致模型性能下降；且在使用多个小模型适配不同时间序列模式时，面临准确性、鲁棒性和内存使用之间的权衡问题。

Method: 将流式时间序列建模为动态混合的时滞系统；利用系统的马尔可夫参数序列构建固定长度的摘要系统张量，同时捕捉动态行为和时滞特征；必要时通过张量分解算法从张量中提取相关历史模型，选择最适合当前体制的系统。

Result: 在真实数据集上，DelayMix在预测准确性和时滞适应速度上持续优于其他对比方法，尤其在高非平稳数据上表现突出。

Conclusion: DelayMix能够快速适应环境变化、计算高效，并通过固定长度表示在保持模型跟踪鲁棒性的同时降低内存使用，有效解决了自适应时间序列建模中的关键挑战。

Abstract: This research addresses the problem of adaptive modeling in time-series data streams with clear input-output relationships. This problem is challenging because rapid system changes (regime shifts) caused by environmental factors or input delay changes degrade model performance, and the trade-off among accuracy, robustness, and memory usage arises when using multiple small models for each time-series pattern. To address these issues, this paper presents an online framework/method that treats streaming time series as dynamic mixtures of time-delay systems. This framework maintains robustness of model tracking and reduces memory usage by summarizing past regimes using a fixed-length representation that captures both the system dynamics and input-output delays. Concretely, this approach constructs a summary system tensor using the system's Markov parameter series, capturing both dynamic behavior and delay characteristics. If necessary, a tensor decomposition algorithm extracts relevant past models from the tensor and helps select the system that best fits the current regime. This method enables rapid adaptation to environmental changes and is computationally efficient. Tests on real datasets show that DelayMix consistently outperforms other methods, achieving superior forecast accuracy and faster adaptation to delays, especially for highly non-stationary data.

</details>


### [282] [Co-folding model guided by structural proteomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26192)
*Alon Shtrikman,Nitzan Simchi,Michal Ran Shchory,Sagie Brodsky,Eran Seger,Kirill Pevzner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AIMS-Fold是一个推理时引导扩散框架，通过整合XL-MS空间约束和HDX-MS溶剂可及性分布等结构蛋白质组学数据，在蛋白质结构生成模型中有效捕捉构象状态，特别是针对诱导接近靶点（如抗体和PROTACs），显著优于未引导的SOTA模型Boltz-2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质结构生成模型能预测静态结构，但无法正确捕捉蛋白质复合物的构象状态，而结构蛋白质组学技术（XL-MS、HDX-MS）虽能提供空间和动态信息，但如何将这些稀疏、异质的测量数据整合到模型中仍是一个开放挑战。

Method: 提出AIMS-Fold推理时引导扩散框架，利用来自XL-MS空间约束和HDX-MS溶剂可及性分布的可微物理势能，主动引导生成采样轨迹。

Result: XL-MS和HDX-MS单独使用均能提升预测精度，且两者协同使用效果更优；在具有挑战性的诱导接近靶点上，AIMS-Fold的准确性超过纯计算无引导的SOTA模型Boltz-2。

Conclusion: 该框架建立了一种用于诱导接近药物（如PROTACs）基于结构的药物设计的强大整合计算方法。

Abstract: Protein structure generative models excel at predicting single protein static structures from sequence, but routinely fail to capture the correct conformational state of protein complexes, critical for protein design and induced proximity modalities such as antibodies and PROTACs. While structural proteomics techniques like Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (XL-MS) and Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange (HDX-MS) offer valuable spatial and dynamic insights, integrating these sparse, heterogeneous measurements into these models remains an open challenge. Here, we bridge this gap by combining structural proteomics data with the rich biophysical priors learned by pretrained diffusion models. We introduce AIMS-Fold, an inference-time guided-diffusion framework that actively steers the generative sampling trajectory using differentiable physical potentials derived from XL-MS spatial restraints and HDX-MS solvent accessibility profiles. We demonstrate that these structural methods individually enhance predictive accuracy, and their integration yields synergistic improvement. Crucially, by leveraging these experimental restraints, AIMS-Fold achieves higher accuracy on challenging induced proximity targets than purely computational, unguided state-of-the-art models like Boltz-2. This establishes our framework as a powerful, integrative computational approach for the structure based drug design of induced proximity drugs. Evaluation code will be made publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [283] [Bridging Classification and Reconstruction: Cooperative Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26193)
*Qideng Tang,Dai Chaofan,Wubin Ma,Yahui Wu,Haohao Zhou,Tao Zhang,Huan Li,Dalin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoAD框架，通过统一分类（Outlier Exposure）与重构（Masked Autoencoder）两种范式，利用分类模块生成概率引导软掩码帮助重构模块，同时重构模块缓解分类模块的泛化问题，实现对细微和复杂时序异常的有效检测，在多个基准数据集上显著超越现有方法，且模型轻量、速度快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSAD方法中，Outlier Exposure方法泛化能力差，Masked Autoencoder方法存在掩码对齐问题，且现有深度学习模型对细微和长期异常检测效果不佳。

Method: 提出CoAD框架，将分类范式与重构范式统一：分类模块生成概率引导的软掩码指导重构模块，重构模块缓解分类模块的泛化问题；同时分类模块针对分类粒度不当和频率信息缺失问题进行了专门设计。

Result: 在高品质基准数据集上按严格评估协议进行实验，CoAD显著优于现有深度学习和传统数据挖掘方法；模型轻量且推理速度远快于现有方法，适用于大规模实时应用。

Conclusion: CoAD验证了深度学习在时序异常检测中的潜力，通过协同设计有效解决了两种范式的各自局限，实现了对细微复杂异常的高效检测。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has long been a hot research topic in data mining due to its various applications. Recent studies challenge the effectiveness of popular deep learning methods for TSAD, suggesting their failure in detecting subtle and prolonged anomalies. Outlier Exposure (OE) and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) emerge as two promising paradigms (classification and reconstruction) for solving the above problems. However, OE-based methods are constrained by poor generalization, while MAE-based methods are limited by masking misalignment issues. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel framework, CoAD, which unifies the two paradigms to leverage their complementary strengths while mitigating their respective weaknesses. In this framework, the classification module generates probability-informed soft masks for the reconstruction module, which in turn alleviates the generalization problem of the classification module. This cooperative design enables CoAD to effectively detect subtle and complex anomalies that are often overlooked by existing methods. Additionally, the classification module is carefully designed to resolve issues related to improper classification granularity and the neglect of frequency information. Extensive experiments on high-quality benchmark datasets, conducted under rigorous evaluation protocols, demonstrate that CoAD significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art deep learning and traditional data mining methods, highlighting the potential of deep learning in TSAD. Moreover, CoAD is lightweight and substantially faster than existing SOTA methods, demonstrating its practical value for large-scale, real-time applications.

</details>


### [284] [On the Role of Inductive Bias in Time-Series Pretraining: A Case Study in Learning Generalizable Representations for Clinical Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26194)
*Sharmita Dey,Diego Paez-Granados*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PathoFM框架，通过在病理步态分析中结合局部补全、时间连续性和无监督上下文动态三种预训练目标，研究时间序列基础模型的不同归纳偏好对分类和回归迁移任务的影响，发现动态中心的目标组合能产生最均衡的跨任务、跨主体泛化表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床时间序列学习受限于小规模异质队列和协议漂移，且下游任务涵盖分类和回归两类。预训练范式的归纳偏好选择对表征迁移能力至关重要，但何种预训练目标组合能同时支持两种任务类型的迁移尚不明确。

Method: PathoFM以编码器为中心的Transformer架构，在脊髓损伤步态数据上预训练，联合三种互补目标：1)局部补全（掩码重建局部结构）；2)时间连续性（预测掩码中间延续以保持平滑性和因果一致性）；3)无监督上下文动态（基于支持样本注意力进行查询重建）。对比了三类目标家族（分组/对比、动态、生成重建）的迁移效果。

Result: 动态中心的目标组合产生最均衡的迁移效果：分组目标有利于判别边界但降低连续目标的幅度保真度，纯重建目标保留波形结构但分类性能不足。结合局部重建与时间连续性，并在可获取样本时加入上下文条件化，得到鲁棒的跨主体泛化表征。

Conclusion: 时间序列预训练中，动态中心的目标混合策略（局部重建+时间连续性+上下文条件化）能在分类和回归任务之间取得最佳平衡，为临床小样本场景下的基础模型设计提供了指导原则。

Abstract: Clinical time-series learning is routinely constrained by small, heterogeneous cohorts and protocol drift, while its downstream use spans both classification (e.g., pathology diagnosis) and regression (e.g., temporal forecasting). These constraints make foundation-model pretraining appealing, but raises an important question of which inductive biases should the pretraining objective impose so that representations transfer across task types and subjects. We study this question in pathological gait analysis for spinal cord injury (SCI) via PathoFM, an encoder-centric transformer pretrained on multivariate gait windows with three complementary objectives: Local Completion (reconstruct contiguous masked spans to enforce local structure), Temporal Continuity (predict a masked mid-horizon continuation from an observed prefix to enforce smoothness and causal consistency), and Unsupervised In-Context Dynamics (support-query reconstruction conditioned on subject exemplar windows via attention). Empirically comparing objective families (grouping/contrastive, dynamics-based, and generative reconstruction), we find that dynamics-centric mixtures produce the most balanced transfer: grouping objectives favor discriminative margins but can degrade magnitude fidelity needed for continuous targets, whereas reconstruction-only objectives preserve waveform structure but may underperform on classification. Overall, combining local reconstruction with temporal continuity, and adding in-context conditioning when exemplar access is realistic, yields robust subject-generalizing representations.

</details>


### [285] [From Privacy to Generalization: Linear Max-Information Bounds for DP-SGD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26222)
*Christoph H. Lampert,Hossein Zakerinia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明DP-SGD的近似最大信息量具有与数据集大小呈线性关系的有限样本界，并由此导出PAC-Bayes泛化界以及DP-SGD训练模型自身的显式泛化界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解泛化与隐私之间的关系是机器学习理论的核心挑战，尤其对于使用差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）训练的深度网络而言，这一问题尚未解决。

Method: 通过证明DP-SGD的近似最大信息量（approximate max-information）的有限样本界，该界具有与(Dwork等人, 2015)中ε-差分隐私算法经典结果相当的缩放性质（即至多与数据集大小呈线性关系），并利用该结果导出PAC-Bayes泛化界。

Result: 获得了DP-SGD的近似最大信息量的有限样本界，其缩放性质与经典ε-DP结果可比；得到了一个通用PAC-Bayes泛化界（其中先验分布可由DP-SGD学习），以及一个DP-SGD训练模型自身的泛化界（复杂度项完全显式且由优化超参数控制）。

Conclusion: 该工作为DP-SGD的泛化性提供了理论保证，揭示了隐私保护与泛化能力之间的可量化关系。

Abstract: Understanding the relationship between generalization and privacy remains a central challenge in modern machine learning theory, particularly for deep networks trained by variants of differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD). In this work we make progress on this persistent open problem by proving a finite-sample bound on the approximate max-information of DP-SGD that exhibits scaling properties comparable with (Dwork et al, 2015)'s classic result for $ε$-differentially private algorithms, namely at most linear in the dataset size. From our result we obtain a general-purpose PAC-Bayes generalization bound in which the necessary prior distribution can be learned by DP-SGD, as well as a generalization bound for DP-SGD-trained models themselves, with a complexity term that is fully explicit and controlled by the optimization hyperparameters.

</details>


### [286] [Provably Communication-Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Federated Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26243)
*Zhishuai Guo,Wenhan Wu,Chen Chen,Lei Zhang,Olivera Kotevska,Ravi K Madduri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CE-FedGNN，一种通信高效且隐私保护的联邦图神经网络框架，通过低频交换聚合节点表示、移动平均估计器处理跨客户端依赖和过时问题，并采用度量差分隐私（metric-DP）提供形式化隐私保证，在合成反洗钱基准和引文网络上实现强性能、低通信开销和隐私鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界中的图数据常分布在不同组织间，因隐私和政策约束无法共享原始数据。现有联邦GNN方法要么忽略跨客户端链接导致精度下降，要么频繁交换嵌入向量带来高昂通信和隐私成本。

Method: 1）低频交换聚合节点表示而非原始数据或每轮嵌入；2）移动平均估计器持续追踪节点表示，实现跨轮稳定重用并缓解过时问题；3）采用度量差分隐私（metric-DP）框架，基于嵌入空间距离而非最坏情况输入扰动度量隐私，在噪声水平较低时提供有意义的保证；4）建立收敛到驻点的O(1/√T)速率和O(T^{3/4})通信复杂度；5）通过Rényi DP组合在公共-群体威胁模型下推导(ε,δ)-metric-DP保证。

Result: 在合成反洗钱基准和引文网络上的实验表明，CE-FedGNN在显著降低通信开销的同时保持强性能，并在隐私噪声下具有鲁棒性。理论分析证明了O(1/√T)收敛速率和O(T^{3/4})通信复杂度。

Conclusion: CE-FedGNN有效解决了跨客户端耦合图上的联邦学习挑战，在通信效率、模型性能和隐私保护之间取得了良好平衡，度量DP为图嵌入提供了一种比标准DP更合适的隐私保护框架。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) achieve strong performance on relational data, but real-world graphs are often distributed across organizations that cannot share raw data due to privacy and policy constraints. Existing federated GNN methods either ignore cross-client links, leading to degraded accuracy, or require frequent embedding exchanges, incurring substantial communication and privacy costs. We propose CE-FedGNN, a communication-efficient and privacy-preserving federated GNN framework for learning over such coupled graphs. Our approach avoids sharing raw data or per-round embeddings by infrequently exchanging aggregated node representations. To handle cross-client dependency and staleness, we introduce a moving-average estimator that continuously tracks node representations and enables their stable reuse across rounds. To provide formal privacy guarantees for the released representations, we adopt the metric differential privacy (metric-DP) framework, which measures privacy with respect to distances in the learned embedding space rather than worst-case input perturbations. This yields meaningful guarantees at noise levels where standard differential privacy becomes overly conservative. We establish convergence to a stationary point at a rate of $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ with $O(T^{3/4})$ communication complexity. In addition, we derive $(\varepsilon,δ)$-metric-DP guarantees via Rényi differential privacy composition under a public-cohort threat model. Experiments on synthetic interbank anti-money laundering benchmarks and citation networks demonstrate that CE-FedGNN achieves strong performance while significantly reducing communication and maintaining robustness under privacy-preserving noise.

</details>


### [287] [The Bridge-Garden Dilemma in LLM Distillation: Why Mixing Hard and Soft Labels Works](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26246)
*Guanghui Wang,Kaiwen Lv Kacuila,Zhiyong Yang,Zitai Wang,Jin-Wen Wu,Longtao Huang,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Bridge-Garden 分解理论，将生成步骤分为需精确匹配的 Bridges 和可灵活选择的 Gardens。通过混合硬标签（教师采样 token）和软标签（完整分布），在知识蒸馏中减少曝光偏差，在推理和编码任务上以 9.7 倍训练成本降低超越了基于散度和 on-policy 的 KD 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管软标签理论上更丰富，但混合硬标签和软标签在知识蒸馏中表现更好。作者发现增益并非来自更精确的教师匹配，而是来自减少曝光偏差（训练与推理分布不匹配）。

Method: 提出 Bridge-Garden 分解理论：Bridges 是需要精确匹配的步骤（硬标签优势），Gardens 是可灵活选择的步骤（软标签优势）。基于此设计 Bridge-Garden 混合监督方法，自适应平衡硬标签和软标签。

Result: 在 Qwen、Llama、Gemma、DeepSeek 等七组师生对上的推理和编码基准测试中，超越基于散度和 on-policy 的 KD 基线，同时训练成本降低 9.7 倍。

Conclusion: 混合硬软标签能有效减少曝光偏差，Bridge-Garden 理论为自适应混合策略提供了理论依据，实现了高效模型压缩。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student. In language modeling, the student is trained either on tokens sampled from the teacher (hard labels) or the teacher's full next-token distribution (soft labels). Despite soft labels appear strictly richer, we find that mixing hard and soft labels consistently yields better results. Crucially, we show that this gain cannot be explained by closer teacher matching during training. Instead, it comes from reduced exposure bias, the mismatch between training and inference distributions. To explain this phenomenon, we introduce the Bridge-Garden Decomposition theory, which categorizes generation steps into two types: Bridges, where the next token must be exact, and Gardens, where it can be flexible. We show that hard-only KD excels in Bridges by avoiding risky deviations, while soft-only KD preserves diversity in Gardens. A hybrid strategy handles both cases and, as a result, reduces exposure bias across the sequence. Guided by this theory, we develop a family of Bridge-Garden hybrid supervision methods that adaptively balance hard and soft labels. Across a primary suite of seven teacher-student pairs (including Qwen, Llama, Gemma, and DeepSeek) and benchmarks in reasoning and coding, our approach outperforms divergence-based and on-policy KD baselines while reducing training cost by 9.7x, enabling efficient model compression. Code is available at https://github.com/ghwang-s/bridge_garden_hybrid_kd_release.

</details>


### [288] [Unified Neural Scaling Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26248)
*Ethan Caballero,Priyank Jaini,David Krueger,Irina Rish*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种统一神经缩放定律（UNSL），能够同时建模和预测深度神经网络在多维度（参数、数据、训练步数、推理步数、计算量、超参数等）同时变化时的缩放行为，在视觉、语言、数学和强化学习等多种任务上均优于现有缩放定律形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的神经缩放定律通常只考虑单一维度的缩放（如仅模型参数或仅数据量），缺乏能够同时建模多个维度（参数、数据、训练步数、推理步数、计算量、超参数等）联合变化的统一函数形式，导致跨维度联合缩放时的预测不准确。

Method: 提出了一种名为统一神经缩放定律（UNSL）的函数形式，该形式能够同时拟合和预测多维度（模型参数、训练数据集大小、训练步数、推理步数、计算量以及多种超参数）同时变化时评估指标的行为，并在大规模视觉、语言、数学和强化学习等多样化的上游和下游任务上进行了验证。

Result: 与现有的其他神经缩放定律函数形式相比，UNSL在多种架构和多样化任务集上对缩放行为的外推预测显著更准确。

Conclusion: UNSL为多维度联合缩放提供了更精确的建模和预测能力，有助于指导大规模深度学习模型在多个资源维度上的最优分配策略。

Abstract: We present a functional form (that we refer to as a Unified Neural Scaling Law (UNSL)) that accurately models and extrapolates the scaling behaviors of deep neural networks as multiple dimensions all vary simultaneously (i.e. how the evaluation metric of interest varies as one simultaneously varies the number of model parameters, training dataset size, number of training steps, number of inference steps, amount of compute, and various hyperparameters) for various architectures and for each of various tasks within a varied set of upstream and downstream tasks. This set includes large-scale vision, language, math, and reinforcement learning. When compared to other functional forms for neural scaling, this functional form yields extrapolations of scaling behavior that are considerably more accurate on this set.

</details>


### [289] [Quantized Keys Steal Attention: Bias Correction for KV-Cache Compression in Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26266)
*Tuna Tuncer,Felix Becker,Thomas Pfeil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现量化KV缓存导致视频质量下降的关键原因——softmax的凸性导致量化噪声产生Jensen偏差，使量化key从当前未量化块中窃取注意力权重。作者提出了一种基于量化步长和查询范数的逐注意力分数在线校正方法，在INT2量化下恢复接近BF16的视频质量，比INT4节省50%内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频生成中，逐块自回归视频扩散模型的KV缓存迅速成为内存瓶颈。量化KV缓存到低位宽可减少内存压力，但会显著降低视频质量，需要理解并解决这一退化根源。

Method: 1) 理论分析发现softmax的凸性导致量化噪声产生Jensen偏差，使量化key的注意力权重被系统性夸大；2) 推导出基于量化步长和查询范数的逐注意力分数校正项，在期望上消除该偏差；3) 使用二阶泰勒近似保证计算开销可忽略，无需额外内存。

Result: 在MAGI-1、SkyReels-V2和HY-WorldPlay三个模型上，INT2量化结合校正方法恢复了大部分因激进量化损失的质量，达到接近BF16的视频质量，优于INT4量化且内存减少50%。

Conclusion: 量化KV缓存的注意力偏差可以通过理论指导的轻量级校正有效消除，这为长视频生成中的高效内存管理提供了可行方案，在不牺牲质量的前提下大幅降低内存需求。

Abstract: Chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion models rely on a KV cache of previously generated chunks to avoid redundant computation, but this cache quickly becomes a memory bottleneck as videos grow longer. Methods that quantize the KV cache to low bitwidths reduce memory pressure but degrade video quality. We show that a key driver of this degradation is a systematic bias in attention weights: due to the convexity of the exponential in softmax attention, quantization noise inflates the contribution of cached keys, a phenomenon we call the Jensen bias. This effect causes quantized keys to steal attention mass from the unquantized current chunk. We derive a per-attention-score correction that removes this bias in expectation, computed on the fly from the quantization step sizes of the cached keys and the query norm. Using a second-order Taylor approximation, the additional computational overhead is negligible, and no additional memory is needed alongside the cache. Evaluated on MAGI-1, SkyReels-V2, and HY-WorldPlay at INT2 quantization, our correction recovers most of the quality lost to aggressive quantization, reaching near-BF16 video quality, and can outperform INT4 quantization while using 50% less memory.

</details>


### [290] [Scaling World-Model Reinforcement Learning Through Diffusion Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26282)
*Xiaoyuan Cheng,Wenxuan Yuan,Zhancun Mu,Yuanzhao Zhang,Yiming Yang,Hai Wang,Zhuo Sun,Che Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MBDPO，一种在世界模型中通过扩散策略表示统一搜索与策略优化的方法，解决了现有方法中搜索与价值学习之间的结构错位问题，在离线预训练、在线学习和微调场景中均表现优异，并展现出随模型容量增加而持续提升的扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模型的强化学习在扩展时面临根本性限制，现有研究主要关注模型偏差和误差累积问题，但本文识别出更关键且未被充分探索的瓶颈：搜索与价值学习之间的结构错位——策略改进依赖于非搜索策略诱导的价值函数，导致训练不一致和次优学习。

Method: 提出MBDPO框架，将策略优化重新表述为在潜在世界模型中对搜索轨迹的扩散过程，通过扩散策略表示统一搜索与策略优化；从收集的数据集中提取隐式能量函数来锚定策略，从而精炼分数场以实现策略优化并缓解错位。

Result: 在多任务离线预训练、在线学习和离线到在线微调等多种设置下进行评估；在离线场景中，通过在大规模数据集上进行预训练来研究扩展行为，观察到随着模型容量增加，性能持续且单调提升。

Conclusion: MBDPO通过扩散策略表示有效解决了搜索与价值学习的结构错位问题，释放了世界模型在可扩展策略学习中的潜力，并展现出良好的扩展性。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (RL) can be effectively supported at scale through the use of world models. However, in practice, scaling such approaches remains fundamentally limited. A commonly recognized challenge is model bias and error compounding, which degrade long-horizon predictions. Beyond these issues, we identify a more critical yet underexplored bottleneck: a structural misalignment between search and value learning in existing world model approaches. In particular, policy improvement often relies on value functions induced by a separate, non-search policy, resulting in training inconsistency and ultimately suboptimal learning. To address this limitation, we propose Model-Based Diffusion Policy Optimization (MBDPO) in world models, a framework that unifies search and policy optimization through diffusion policy representations, thereby unlocking the potential of world models for scalable policy learning. Instead of constructing an explicit planner over a learned world model, we reformulate policy optimization as a diffusion process over searched trajectories in latent world models. In this view, we extract an implicit energy function from the collected dataset that anchors the policy, enabling MBDPO to refine the score field for policy optimization while mitigating misalignment. We evaluate MBDPO across a wide range of settings, including multi-task offline pretraining, online learning, and offline-to-online fine-tuning. In the offline regime, we further investigate its scaling behavior by pretraining on large-scale datasets, observing consistent and monotonic performance gains with increasing model capacity.

</details>


### [291] [Two-Parameter Flows for Learning Population Dynamics of Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26285)
*Paul Schwerdtner,Tobias Blickhan,Benjamin Peherstorfer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需轨迹数据、仅利用未标注样本学习高维概率密度随时间演化动力学的方法，通过双参数流将采样时间传输与物理时间速度解耦，并证明所得动力学具有唯一性和正则性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常需要轨迹信息或最优传输耦合，难以扩展到高维或处理旋转/循环等非梯度动力学。本文旨在开发一种可扩展、无需轨迹数据且能建模非梯度物理现象的高维概率密度动力学学习方法。

Method: 引入双参数流：首先学习从基分布到每个边际分布的采样时间传输（基于条件流匹配技术），然后通过回归合成耦合轨迹提取物理时间速度场。

Result: 证明所得物理时间动力学具有唯一性，并从采样时间传输继承正则性；方法可扩展至高维，无需每步最优传输耦合，同时允许非梯度动力学以解释旋转或循环物理现象。

Conclusion: 该方法利用成熟的条件流匹配技术实现高维可扩展性，在无需轨迹数据和最优传输耦合的前提下，有效建模包括非梯度动力学在内的复杂物理现象。

Abstract: This work addresses the problem of learning the dynamics of high-dimensional probability densities over time using unlabeled samples, without assuming access to trajectory information. We introduce two-parameter flows that learn only sampling-time transports from a base distribution to each marginal and then extract a physics-time velocity by regressing on coupled synthetic trajectories. We prove that the resulting physics-time dynamics are unique and inherit regularity from the sampling-time transports. Because we can build on standard, well-developed conditional flow matching techniques for learning the base-to-marginal transports, our approach scales to high dimensions and avoids per-step optimal-transport couplings, while allowing admissible non-gradient dynamics that can naturally explain rotational or circulating physics phenomena.

</details>


### [292] [Stateful Inference for Low-Latency Multi-Agent Tool Calling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26289)
*Victor Norgren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种有状态推理架构，通过持久化KV缓存和前缀缓存将多智能体工具调用的每轮成本从O(n_t)降至O(Δ_t)，在6轮工作流中每轮加速2.1倍，35轮工作流中中位轮次加速4.2倍，端到端时间减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推理框架将每次工具调用视为独立请求，重复处理整个对话历史（其中85-95%的提示词与前一轮相同），导致计算效率低下。

Method: 提出有状态推理架构：(1) 持久化KV缓存跨轮次存活，仅摄入新令牌；(2) 基数前缀缓存扩展至交织的多智能体流量；(3) 提示查询推测解码加速结构化输出。

Result: 相比vLLM和SGLang，在6轮智能体工作流中每轮加速2.1倍，在35轮工作流中中位轮次加速4.2倍，端到端墙钟时间减半。

Conclusion: 优势来源于状态复用和推测解码，而非传统缓存机制。

Abstract: Multi-agent tool calling is becoming the dominant interaction pattern for LLM-based systems, yet existing inference frameworks treat each tool call as an independent request, re-processing the entire conversation from scratch even though 85-95% of the prompt is unchanged from the previous turn.
  We present a stateful inference architecture that converts the $O(n_t)$ per-turn cost of conventional serving into an $O(Δ_t)$ delta-only cost: a persistent KV cache lives across turns and advances by ingesting only the new tokens, while a radix prefix cache extends this across interleaved multi-agent traffic and a prompt-lookup speculative decoder accelerates structured output. Against vLLM and SGLang on novel, fully-generated workloads, the reference implementation is $2.1\times$ faster per turn on a 6-turn agentic workflow and $4.2\times$ on the median turn of a 35-turn one, halving end-to-end wall time. The advantage comes from stateful reuse and speculation, not caching.

</details>


### [293] [Dynamic Link Prediction with Temporally Enhanced Signed Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26290)
*Derek Regier,Andrew Polyak,Aresh Dadlani,Khosro Salmani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种模块化时序增强框架，通过历史上下文集成模块（HCIM）将时序意识融入有符号图神经网络，在多个真实世界与合成时序有符号网络上的链接预测任务中取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序有符号网络（TSNs）中符号关系、结构演化与平衡理论约束的交互使得有效学习具有挑战性，现有GNN方法多针对静态或无符号图设计，缺乏对时序有符号动态的专门处理。

Method: 提出HCIM模块，包含可学习的近因感知时序加权、LSTM嵌入轨迹建模和多头时序注意力机制，以全局或节点自适应方式将历史信息与当前节点表示融合，并实例化于SE-SGformer架构上。

Result: 在Bitcoin OTC、Bitcoin Alpha、Reddit及小世界网络模型等真实与合成数据集上，相较静态基线方法取得一致且统计显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: 所提框架具有架构无关性，能有效增强静态有符号GNN的时序感知能力，在保留可解释性的同时提升时序有符号网络上的学习性能。

Abstract: Temporal signed networks (TSNs) model the time evolution of cooperative and adversarial relationships that arise in applications such as social media analysis, trust and reputation systems, and financial transaction networks. While graph neural networks (GNNs) perform well for static or unsigned link prediction, effective learning in temporal signed graphs remains challenging due to the interaction of signed relations, evolving structure, and balance-theoretic constraints. To address this gap, we propose a \emph{modular} temporal enhancement framework for signed GNNs that integrates historical context into otherwise static architectures. The framework introduces a Historical Context Integration Module (HCIM) that combines learnable recency-aware temporal weighting, LSTM-based embedding trajectory modeling, and multi-head temporal attention to capture both short- and long-term signed interaction dynamics. Historical information is fused with current node representations using either global or node-adaptive weighting, allowing the architecture-agnostic framework to accommodate heterogeneous temporal behaviors. We instantiate the approach on the Self-Explainable Signed Graph Transformer (SE-SGformer), preserving interpretability while extending it with temporal awareness. Experiments on real-world and synthetic TSNs, including Bitcoin OTC, Bitcoin Alpha, Reddit, and small-world network models, demonstrate consistent and statistically significant improvements over the static baseline.

</details>


### [294] [Classification and detection of multiple UAVs using rational Gaussian wavelet neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26310)
*Ungvári Gergő,Ferenc Braun,Attila Ámon,Péter Kackstädter,János Volk,Péter Kovács,Tamás Dózsa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于声音信号和自适应有理高斯小波变换的无人机检测系统，将可解释特征提取器嵌入小型神经网络中联合训练，能够有效检测和分类单个无人机及无人机群，在室内外环境中均优于传统机器学习方法，且保持高度可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保护民用和军用基础设施需要有效的无人机检测手段，现有方法存在成本高或可解释性差的问题，因此需要一种成本效益高且可解释的无人机检测方案。

Method: 使用麦克风采集声音信号，通过信号处理流水线采用可解释的自适应特征提取器（有理高斯小波），将这些自适应小波变换嵌入到小型神经网络中联合训练，实现无人机的检测与分类。

Result: 在室内录音室和嘈杂室外环境的数据集上，该方法在检测和分类单个无人机及无人机群方面均优于传统机器学习方法。

Conclusion: 提出的方法在保持高度可解释性的同时，有效实现了对单无人机和无人机群的检测与分类，且代码已公开以供复现。

Abstract: The detection of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is important for the protection of civilian and military infrastructure. In this paper we propose a cost effective UAV detection system using sound signals obtained from microphones. The recorded signals are passed through a signal processing pipeline which employs interpretable adaptive feature extractors using so-called rational Gaussian wavelets. These adaptive wavelet transformations are embedded into and trained together with an underlying small neural network which detects and classifies UAVs based on the obtained features. This leads to a physically interpretable machine learning algorithm that in addition to classifying UAVs is also capable of detecting UAV swarms. We demonstrate our results using data collected in indoor studio and noisy outdoor environments. We conclude that the proposed method outperforms traditional machine learning approaches for detecting and classifying single UAVs as well as drone swarms, while retaining a high degree of interpretability. Our implementation of the proposed methods is made publicly available for reproducibility.

</details>


### [295] [Curriculum Learning for Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26315)
*Sandeep Kumar,Virginia Smith,Chhavi Yadav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Staged-Competence框架，通过课程学习将偏好数据按难度组织、基于能力采样、渐进更新参考模型，提升DPO安全对齐的鲁棒性和OOD泛化能力，分别降低16%有害响应率和20%越狱攻击成功率，且仅需75%训练数据即可达到基线安全水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO在安全对齐中表现脆弱，OOD泛化能力差，现有方法缺乏对训练数据组织方式的系统性改进。

Method: Staged-Competence框架：按难度组织偏好数据、采用基于能力的采样策略、在训练过程中渐进式更新参考模型。

Result: 跨三个模型家族平均降低OOD有害响应率16%，越狱攻击成功率20%，保持通用能力且几乎无过度拒绝；仅用75%训练数据即可匹配基线安全性能；产生更好的安全/非安全响应分离。

Conclusion: 课程学习能有效提升DPO安全对齐的鲁棒性，该框架与策略优化损失无关，可扩展至其他DPO变体和对齐领域。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) is widely used for safety alignment in large language models. However, prior work shows it is brittle and exhibits poor out-of-distribution (OOD) generalisation. In this paper, we investigate whether Curriculum Learning can improve the robustness of DPO-based safety alignment. We propose Staged-Competence, a curriculum-based framework that organises preference data by difficulty, employs competence-based sampling, and progressively updates the reference model during training. Averaged across three model families, Staged-Competence reduces OOD harmful response rates by 16% and jailbreak attack success rates by 20%, while preserving general capabilities with near-zero over-refusal. We further show that Staged-Competence (1) matches baseline safety with only 75% of the training data and (2) yields better separation between safe and unsafe responses. Staged-Competence is agnostic to the policy optimisation loss and can extend to other DPO variants and alignment domains. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Sandeep5500/curriculum-learning-for-safety.

</details>


### [296] [Trust Region Q Adjoint Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27079)
*Yonghoon Dong,Kyungmin Lee,Changyeon Kim,Jaehyuk Kim,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TRQAM，一种稳定的离线策略强化学习微调算法，通过投影对偶下降自适应控制预训练流策略的路径空间KL散度，在50个OGBench任务上离线RL成功率达68%，远超最强基线46%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离策略强化学习预训练流策略因多步采样过程导致优化不稳定。QAM虽通过重构为无记忆随机最优控制问题缓解此问题，但继承了评论家引导改进的根本脆弱性：评论家误差在条件不良时被放大，常导致模型崩溃。

Method: 提出Trust Region Q-Adjoint Matching (TRQAM)，通过投影对偶下降自适应控制与预训练流策略的路径空间KL散度。优化SOC动力学中的信任域参数λ，并理论证明路径空间KL可由λ的闭式函数表示，从而精确控制与预训练流策略的偏差。

Result: 在50个OGBench任务上，TRQAM在离线RL和离线到在线RL中均持续优于先前方法。离线RL任务中总体成功率达68%，显著提升最强基线46%的成绩。

Conclusion: TRQAM通过自适应信任域机制有效解决了评论家引导微调中的不稳定性问题，实现了对预训练流策略偏差的精确控制，在多个任务上取得了显著性能提升。

Abstract: Off-policy reinforcement learning of pretrained flow policies remains challenging due to the instability of optimization arising from the multi-step sampling process. Recently, Q-learning with Adjoint Matching (QAM) addressed this issue by reformulating into a memoryless stochastic optimal control (SOC) problem with a learned critic. However, QAM inherits a fundamental fragility of critic-guided improvement: small critic errors are amplified when critics are ill-conditioned, often leading to model collapse. This paper introduces Trust Region Q-Adjoint Matching (TRQAM), a stable off-policy fine-tuning algorithm that adaptively controls the path-space KL with pretrained flow policies through projected dual descent. Specifically, we optimize the trust-region parameter $λ$ in SOC dynamics, and theoretically show that the path-space KL can be represented by a closed-form function of $λ$. As a result, our method can precisely control the exact deviation from pretrained flow policies, achieving stable off-policy RL. Through experiments on 50 OGBench tasks, TRQAM consistently outperforms prior arts in both offline RL and offline-to-online RL. In particular, TRQAM achieves an overall success rate of 68% in offline RL, substantially improves the strongest baseline at 46%.

</details>


### [297] [MULTISEISMO: A Multimodal Seismic Dataset and Model for Cross-Modal Seismic Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26320)
*Sai Munikoti,Ian Stewart,Chengping Chai,Lisa Linville,Scott Vasquez,Sameera Horawalavithana,Karl Pazdernik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MultiSeismo，一个大规模结构化多模态地震数据集，包含16K+地震事件（2010-2023年），整合了波形数据、地理图像和文本描述；同时构建了MISCE多模态指令集，并基于Unified IO 2微调得到首个地震领域专用多模态模型SeisModal，在跨模态推理任务上显著优于通用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态模型（GMMs）在专业科学领域的应用受限于缺乏整合多种数据模态（尤其是时间序列波形数据）的领域专用数据集；现有地震数据集缺乏波形、地理图像和元数据的多模态融合。

Method: 1) 构建MultiSeismo数据集：收集16K+地震事件，整合全球台网波形记录、烈度图、人口暴露可视化图像及结构化文本描述；2) 开发MISCE指令集：涵盖从基础信息检索到复杂跨模态分析的多级推理任务；3) 基于Unified IO 2微调，引入专用时间序列编码器，得到SeisModal模型。

Result: SeisModal在地震多模态推理任务上表现优异；现有通用多模态模型在MultiSeismo上表现不佳，尤其在时间序列数据处理方面存在显著挑战；MultiSeismo可作为地震学多模态研究的严格基准。

Conclusion: MultiSeismo填补了地震学领域多模态数据集的空白，为未来研究提供了基准；领域专用的架构适配（时间序列编码器）对提升多模态模型在科学领域的性能至关重要。

Abstract: The application of generalist multimodal models (GMMs) to specialized scientific domains remains limited due to the scarcity of comprehensive domain-specific datasets that integrate multiple data modalities beyond text and images. In seismology, understanding earthquake phenomena requires the synthesis of timeseries waveform data, geographical imagery, and contextual metadata, a multimodal integration absent in existing seismic datasets. We present MultiSeismo, a large scale structured multimodal seismic dataset, comprising over 16K seismic events spanning 13 years (2010 to 2023) across diverse geographical regions. Each event data integrates waveform recordings from global station networks, intensity maps, population exposure visualizations, and a comprehensive textual description within a standardized JSON format. We additionally develop MISCE, a multimodal instruction set on top of raw data to enable supervised training and evaluation of GMMs on seismic reasoning tasks ranging from basic information retrieval to complex cross modal analysis. We leverage MISCE to finetune an existing multimodal model (Unified IO 2) enhanced with a specialized timeseries encoder, which yields SeisModal, the first domain specific multimodal model for comprehensive seismic analysis. Evaluation of state of the art multimodal models on MultiSeismo reveals significant challenges, particularly with time-series data processing for general purpose models, while demonstrating SeisModal's superior performance on seismic multimodal reasoning tasks. These results prove that MultiSeismo provides a rigorous benchmark for future multimodal research in seismology and validate the success of our domain specific architectural adaptations.

</details>


### [298] [Semigroup Consistency as a Diagnostic for Learned Physics Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26324)
*Lennon J. Shikhman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出归一化半群误差（Normalized Semigroup Error）作为评估学习型物理模拟器长时间滚动预测质量的诊断指标，该指标通过比较直接演化与组合演化的预测一致性来检测时间组合失败。在1D热力学和Burgers动力学实验中，该指标与轨迹级滚动退化呈显著正相关（Spearman ρ=0.635），且作为训练目标时效果不一，更适合作为评估诊断工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习型物理模拟器常基于单步或短时预测误差进行评估，但这些指标无法捕捉时间组合和长时间滚动中的失败模式。因此需要一种能够检测时间一致性和长期预测退化的诊断方法。

Method: 提出归一化半群误差，利用自治、状态完备系统的半群性质——直接演化s+t步应与先演化s步再演化t步的结果一致——作为一致性度量。在1D热力学和Burgers动力学上，使用时间条件ConvNet和FNO基线进行实验验证。

Result: 半群误差与滚动退化呈正相关，轨迹级Spearman相关系数ρ=0.635，95%置信区间[0.621, 0.649]。此外，半群正则化作为训练目标时效果不一，表明其主要价值在于诊断而非训练。

Conclusion: 归一化半群误差是一种有效的、模型无关的后验诊断工具，用于评估学习型物理模拟器的时间组合性能；但作为训练目标时并非普遍有益。

Abstract: Learned physics simulators are often evaluated by one-step or short-horizon prediction error, but these metrics can miss failures in temporal composition and long-horizon rollout. For autonomous, state-complete systems, exact solution maps satisfy a semigroup law: direct evolution over $s+t$ should agree with evolution over $s$ followed by $t$. We propose normalized semigroup error as a post hoc, model-agnostic diagnostic comparing these direct and composed learned predictions. On one-dimensional heat and Burgers dynamics with time-conditioned ConvNet and FNO baselines, semigroup error is positively associated with rollout degradation, with trajectory-level Spearman correlation $ρ= 0.635$ and $95%$ CI $[0.621, 0.649]$. Semigroup regularization has mixed effects, supporting semigroup consistency primarily as an evaluation diagnostic rather than a universally beneficial training objective.

</details>


### [299] [Reparametrizing Shampoo and SOAP for Subspace Basis Updates and BFloat16 Storage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26327)
*Alan Milligan,Zikun Xu,Simon Lacoste-Julien,Felix Dangel,Wu Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种重参数化预处理矩阵的方法，支持BFP16存储并通过子空间部分QR分解更新基向量，从而在降低Shampoo类方法计算开销的同时缓解低精度存储带来的性能下降，使KL-SOAP在BFP16下达到或超越KL-Shampoo的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Shampoo类方法（如KL-Shampoo、SOAP）依赖QR分解，但QR分解需要FP32精度且计算昂贵，导致大预处理矩阵时时间和内存开销大；使用BFP16存储虽可减少内存但会降低性能。

Method: 提出预处理矩阵的重参数化方法，支持BFP16存储；通过将更新后的基向量与未变化的基向量组合形成完整基，仅在子空间中对部分基进行QR分解来降低计算开销，同时缓解BFP16存储带来的性能下降。

Result: 该方法广泛适用于使用QR分解的Shampoo类方法（KL-Shampoo、SOAP、KL-SOAP），尤其改善了SOAP和KL-SOAP在BFP16存储下的性能，使KL-SOAP能够匹配或超越KL-Shampoo。

Conclusion: 所提方法使得Shampoo类方法在内存和时间效率上更优。

Abstract: Shampoo-based methods, such as KL-Shampoo and SOAP, have demonstrated strong performance in training neural networks and rely on QR decomposition. Because existing QR implementations require single-precision (FP32) arithmetic and remain computationally expensive, these methods become time- and memory-intensive when their preconditioning matrices are large. Moreover, using BFloat16 (BFP16) storage to reduce memory usage can degrade the performance of Shampoo-based methods. We propose a reparametrization of the preconditioner that supports BFP16 storage and forms a complete basis by combining updated basis vectors with unchanged ones. By updating only part of the basis through QR decomposition in a subspace, our approach reduces computational overhead while mitigating the performance degradation caused by BFP16 storage. Our approach applies broadly to Shampoo-based methods that employ QR decomposition, including KL-Shampoo, SOAP, and KL-SOAP. In particular, it improves the performance of SOAP and KL-SOAP under BFP16 storage, enabling KL-SOAP to match or exceed KL-Shampoo. Overall, our approach makes Shampoo-based methods more memory- and time-efficient.

</details>


### [300] [QAM-W: Joint 2D Codebook Quantization for LLM Weights via Hadamard Rotation and Activation-Aware Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26339)
*Preetam Sharma,Kacper Dobek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QAM-W是一种新型权重量化编解码器，通过L2归一化、块哈达玛旋转、2D坐标配对和基于单位圆高斯分布的Lloyd-Max码本量化，恢复权重行内的成对坐标结构。在五种LLM上，约5.5 bpw的激活感知变体在WikiText-2困惑度上保持在BF16的±0.4%以内，以少32%的权重比特匹配SmoothQuant W8A8质量。2D联合编码优于极坐标编码，且配对KL与ΔPPL%的Spearman ρ=0.99。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量后训练量化器丢弃了权重行内的成对坐标结构，作者希望恢复这种结构以提升量化效率。

Method: 对每行权重进行L2归一化、块哈达玛旋转、将坐标配对为2D点，然后使用在单位圆高斯分布上训练的单个Lloyd-Max码本进行量化，并采用激活感知的逐通道缩放。

Result: 在五种LLM（1.1B-13B参数）上，约5.5 bpw的激活感知变体困惑度在BF16的±0.4%以内，比SmoothQuant W8A8少32%权重比特。2D联合编码比极坐标编码提升2-15 pp ΔPPL。配对KL与ΔPPL%的Spearman ρ=0.99。

Conclusion: QAM-W在5-6 bpw的质量保持波段有贡献，严格4 bpw下QTIP更优，3.5 bpw变体在量化容忍架构上有竞争力。

Abstract: Scalar post-training quantizers discard pairwise coordinate structure within weight rows. We introduce QAM-W (Quadrature Amplitude Modulation for Weights), a codec that recovers this structure: each row is L2-normalized, block-Hadamard rotated, paired into 2D coordinates, and quantized against a single Lloyd-Max codebook trained on the unit circular Gaussian, with activation-aware per-channel scaling. In a cross-model study spanning five LLMs from four families (1.1B--13B parameters) and eight quantized configurations, the activation-aware variant at $\approx 5.5$ bpw stays within $\pm 0.4\%$ of BF16 WikiText-2 perplexity on every model, matching the SmoothQuant W8A8 quality envelope at $32\%$ fewer weight bits. Joint 2D coding outperforms polar (amplitude $\times$ phase) coding by 2--15~pp $Δ$PPL at equal bitrate, and paired KL against BF16 tracks $Δ$PPL\% at Spearman $ρ= 0.99$ across 37 (method, model) rows, consistent with a monotone composite bound from codec distortion to KL divergence. A 3.5~bpw variant is competitive on quantization-tolerant architectures. At strict 4~bpw, the rotated-codebook frontier method QTIP outperforms QAM-W; the contribution is the quality-preserving 5--6~bpw band.

</details>


### [301] [A PAC-Bayesian View of Generalisation for Physics-Informed Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26341)
*Thien V. Nguyen,Amaury Habrard,Benjamin Guedj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个PAC-Bayesian框架，用于分析物理信息机器学习（PIML）在无界损失下的泛化性能，推导了与输入梯度范数相关的非空洞泛化界，并设计了可优化这些界的自边界感知学习算法，在标准PDE基准上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管PIML在经验上表现优异，但其统计泛化性质（尤其是在无界损失的回问题中）仍缺乏深入理解。现有分析依赖近似或稳定性论证，未能充分揭示物理结构如何从有限数据中影响泛化。

Method: 采用多任务PAC-Bayesian视角，联合处理数据保真度、PDE残差、初始和边界条件，避免标准并集界方法的松散性；利用物理信息目标的结构，推导出复杂度与损失输入梯度范数相关的泛化界；在Sobolev和Poincaré型假设下实例化框架，得到两类权衡统计复杂度和平滑性的界；提出自边界感知学习算法，优化导出界的可计算替代量，并设计估计相关常数的实用流程。

Result: 在标准PDE基准上的实验表明，所推导的泛化界是非空洞的，显著优于并集界基线，并且在训练过程中可以有效最小化。

Conclusion: 本文为物理信息模型的泛化提供了原则性的统计基础，揭示了物理规律与泛化之间的直接联系。

Abstract: Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) integrates mechanistic knowledge, typically in the form of partial differential equations (PDE), into data-driven models. Despite strong empirical performance, its statistical generalisation properties remain poorly understood, particularly in the regression setting with unbounded losses. Existing analyses rely on approximation or stability arguments and do not fully capture how physical structure influences generalisation from finite data. In this work, we develop a PAC-Bayesian framework for PIML that provides high-probability generalisation guarantees in the presence of unbounded losses. We adopt a multi-task perspective that jointly treats data fidelity, PDE residuals, initial and boundary conditions, avoiding the looseness induced by standard union-bound approaches. Our analysis leverages the structure of physics-informed objectives to derive novel bounds where the complexity scales with input-gradient norms of the losses, revealing a direct link between physical regularity and generalisation. We instantiate this framework under Sobolev and Poincaré-type assumptions, yielding two classes of bounds that trade off statistical complexity and smoothness in different regimes. Building on these results, we propose a self-bounding-aware learning algorithm that directly optimises tractable surrogates of the derived bounds, along with a practical procedure to estimate the associated constants in realistic settings. Empirical evaluations on standard PDE benchmarks demonstrate that our bounds are non-vacuous, significantly tighter than union-bound baselines, and can be effectively minimised during training. Overall, our results provide a principled statistical foundation for the generalisation of physics-informed models.

</details>


### [302] [MechRL: Reinforcement Learning Agents Perform Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26343)
*Barsat Khadka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将电路发现重新定义为强化学习问题，使用PPO在GPT-2 small的144个注意力头上训练一个智能体，通过零消融和对比奖励来识别因果关键的头。该智能体在两个训练任务（induction和IOI）上达到oracle水平，并在未见的docstring任务上通过best-of-five规划恢复96%的oracle性能，其识别出的头部与已有文献的因果非冗余头高度一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的机械可解释性电路发现需要针对每个新任务构建定制化的分析流程，缺乏通用性和可迁移性，因此需要一种更通用的电路发现方法。

Method: 将电路发现视为强化学习问题，智能体在GPT-2 small的144个注意力头上进行离散动作选择，每个动作触发零消融并计算对比奖励（目标任务损伤减通用预测损伤），使用PPO在多任务向量化环境中训练。

Result: 单个PPO策略在两个训练任务上均达到每集oracle水平；在未见过的docstring任务上，best-of-five规划恢复96%的oracle上限；智能体偏好的头与文献中因果非冗余头精确匹配，而冗余类别被正确降权。

Conclusion: 强化学习通过因果干预识别机制电路的单头瓶颈是可行的、可迁移的方法，与现有路径修补方法互补。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has identified small sets of attention heads that implement specific behaviours in transformer language models, but recovering these circuits typically requires a bespoke analytical pipeline for each new task. We recast circuit discovery as a reinforcement-learning problem. An agent operates over the 144 attention heads of GPT-2 small as a discrete action space; each action triggers a zero-ablation and a contrastive reward that subtracts the ablation's damage to general next-token prediction from its damage to the target task. A single PPO policy, trained on two tasks (induction and IOI) in a vectorised multi-task environment, attains the per-episode oracle on both training tasks and on a held-out third task (docstring completion). Its preferred heads coincide with the canonical heads of established literature on precisely the axes those papers identify as causally non-redundant under single-head ablation; the categories they identify as redundant are correctly de-prioritised by the agent. On the held-out task, best-of-five planning recovers 96\% of the oracle ceiling with no task signal supplied at evaluation. These results indicate that reinforcement learning over causal interventions is a viable, transferable substrate for identifying the single-head bottlenecks of mechanistic circuits, complementary to existing path-patching approaches.

</details>


### [303] [When Correct Demonstrations Hurt: Rethinking the Role of Exemplars in In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26350)
*Chenghao Qiu,Chunli Peng,Yufeng Yang,Kuan-Hao Huang,Yi Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ICL中，正确性不等于样例有效性；任务保持扰动可降低ICL性能，揭示了正确性-效用差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICL通常被认为提供正确输入-输出示例有助于模型学习，但本文发现某些正确示例反而会降低ICL准确率，存在正确性-效用差距，因而需要系统研究这一现象。

Method: 提出任务保持扰动框架，仅改变样例输入但保持其为同一任务的正确实例，包括标签更新扰动和目标保持扰动；通过上下文证据偏移形式化该失效模式。

Result: 在情感分类、逻辑推理和数学应用题上，任务保持扰动显著降低ICL性能，尤其对小模型、困难任务和高扰动比例更明显。

Conclusion: ICL鲁棒性不仅需要评估示例的正确性，还需评估其对上下文推理的影响方式。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) is often motivated by the intuition that demonstrations help because they provide correct input-output examples. However, we reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: correctness does not guarantee exemplar utility, and some correct demonstrations can even reduce ICL accuracy. To study this correctness-utility gap, we introduce task-preserving perturbations, where only the exemplar input is changed, while the example remains a correct instance of the same task. Concretely, each perturbed exemplar is assigned the target induced by the task mapping. This framework covers both label-updating perturbations, where task-relevant semantics change and targets are recomputed, and stricter target-preserving perturbations, where the original target remains valid. We formalize the resulting failure mode as contextual evidence shift: task-preserving perturbations can change the effective mixture of evidence used by the model for contextual inference, thereby separating exemplar correctness from exemplar utility. Across sentiment classification, logical reasoning, and math word problems, we find that task-preserving perturbed demonstrations can substantially degrade ICL performance, especially for smaller models, harder tasks, and higher perturbation ratios. Our results show that robust ICL requires evaluating not only whether demonstrations are correct, but also how they influence contextual inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Chenghao-Qiu/Task-Preserving-ICL.

</details>


### [304] [Energy-Gated Attention and Wavelet Positional Encoding: Complementary Inductive Biases for Transformer Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26355)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出能量门控注意力（EGA）和莫雷特位置编码（MoPE），分别补充标准注意力所缺乏的**能量显著性**（哪些token包含更多信息能量）和**尺度选择性局部性**（不同频率下注意力作用范围应不同）。两者组合产生超加性效果（0.119验证损失提升，超过单独之和），表明显著性与局部性是互补的归纳偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer注意力对所有token等权处理，且位置编码缺乏频率自适应的局部性，忽略了输入的信息结构差异。作者旨在补充这两种缺失的归纳偏差。

Method: 1）**EGA**：通过一个线性投影学习key token嵌入的能量估计，以此门控值聚合，选择性地关注重要token。2）**MoPE**：用可学习的高斯加窗小波（Morlet小波）替代固定正弦位置编码，自适应联合位置-频率定位。

Result: 在TinyShakespeare上：EGA单独提升+0.092，MoPE单独低于基线-0.032，但两者组合提升+0.119（超加性）。消融实验表明结构化谱先验（固定小波门控、尺度初始化头、固定正弦PE）始终不如无约束的可学习对应物。

Conclusion: 能量显著性和尺度选择性局部性是互补的归纳偏差，各自解决对方无法单独填补的注意力缺陷。实验限于小规模（≤6M参数），未来应在更大规模多种子设定下验证。

Abstract: Standard transformer attention computes pairwise token similarity but treats all tokens as equally salient and all positions as equally local, regardless of the informational structure of the input. We identify two complementary inductive biases that standard attention lacks: energy salience (which tokens concentrate informational energy, learned end-to-end without explicit frequency decomposition) and scale-selective locality (how far positional influence extends at each frequency, implemented via Morlet wavelet encoding). We address both with two simple components. Energy-Gated Attention (EGA) gates value aggregation by a learned energy estimate of key token embeddings, computed via a single linear projection; it selects what to attend to. Morlet Positional Encoding (MoPE) replaces fixed sinusoidal encodings with learned Gaussian-windowed wavelets that adapt the joint position-frequency localization to the corpus; it specifies where attention operates at each scale. On TinyShakespeare, EGA alone achieves +0.092 validation loss improvement over standard attention (+0.103 over Phase 1-3 baseline); MoPE alone is -0.032 (below baseline as a standalone encoding); but their combination achieves +0.119 -- more than the sum of parts. This superadditivity, observed across two independent training runs, is the central empirical finding: salience and locality are complementary inductive biases, each addressing a gap the other cannot fill alone. Ablations confirm that structured spectral priors (Morlet wavelet gates, scale-initialized heads, fixed sinusoidal PE) consistently underperform their unconstrained learned counterparts, while complementary learned components interact superadditively. All experiments are at small scale (<=6M parameters, character-level benchmarks, single seed); larger-scale multi-seed validation is the most important direction for future work.

</details>


### [305] [Balancing Plasticity and Stability with Fast and Slow Successor Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26357)
*Raymond Chua,Doina Precup,Blake Richards*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了深度强化学习在持续渐变环境中的稳定性与可塑性权衡，发现稳定性（如突触巩固）优于可塑性（如参数重置），并将后继特征作为多时间尺度巩固目标取得了最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通过突变引入非平稳性，但真实环境往往通过持续渐变演化，二者对稳定性-可塑性困境的影响不同，需要专门研究渐变环境下的RL适应机制。

Method: 改造Miniworld和MuJoCo环境引入连续渐变非平稳性，比较稳定性方法（突触巩固）与可塑性方法（参数重置）的表现，并将后继特征（SFs）作为巩固目标，探索多时间尺度巩固策略。

Result: 稳定性方法优于可塑性方法；后继特征作为巩固目标优于Q值；多时间尺度的突触巩固在持续渐变环境中效果最佳。

Conclusion: 在持续渐变环境中稳定性比可塑性更关键，多时间尺度巩固预测性表征是一种有效的应对策略。

Abstract: A hallmark of intelligence is the ability to adapt in non-stationary environments, yet deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents often struggle in such settings. Prior studies introduce non-stationarity through abrupt shifts in features or dynamics, whereas real-world environments often evolve gradually through continual drift. This distinction has important implications for the "stability-plasticity dilemma" in RL, as abrupt task changes may demand more plasticity than naturalistic settings. To address this, we modify existing 3D Miniworld and MuJoCo environments to incorporate naturalistic, continual non-stationarity, and use them to examine how stability and adaptation affect performance under continuous environmental change. We find that methods favoring stability, such as synaptic consolidation, outperform approaches focused on plasticity, such as parameters resetting. Motivated by this result, and prior evidence that Successor Features (SFs) reduce interference, we investigate whether SFs are better consolidation targets than Q-values. Across both environments, applying neuro-inspired synaptic consolidation to SFs yields superior performance on continually changing settings. Moreover, consolidation is most effective when SFs are stabilized across multiple timescales, which capture complementary aspects of gradual environmental change. Together, these results suggest that stability is more critical in continual learning when changes are gradual, and that multi-timescale consolidation of predictive representations is an effective approach.

</details>


### [306] [Online Learning on Hidden-Convex Losses via Algorithmic Equivalence: Optimal Regret, Geometric Barrier, and Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26373)
*Anas Barakat,Andreas Kontogiannis,Vasilis Pollatos,Ioannis Panageas,Antonios Varvitsiotis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明在隐藏凸损失（经非线性重参数化后变为凸的非凸损失）的在线学习中，在线梯度下降（OGD）能够达到最优的 $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾界，匹配在线凸优化的最优最坏情况界，解决了 Ghai, Lu 和 Hazan (2022) 提出的开放问题。此外，本文用 Hessian 相容性条件替代了原有的对角雅可比条件，扩展了可容许重参数化类别；证明了该条件对于 OGD 的必要性（不满足时 OGD 遭受 $\Omega(T)$ 遗憾）；并将分析扩展至单点赌博反馈，给出 $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ 的期望遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ghai, Lu 和 Hazan (2022) 证明了在隐藏凸损失下 OGD 可近似模拟 OMD 并得到 $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ 遗憾，但能否恢复在线凸优化中最优的 $\Theta(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾是一个开放问题。本文致力于回答此问题，并澄清算法等价性所需的几何条件。

Method: 使用更精细的离散时间算法等价性论证，证明 OGD 在相同假设下达到 $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾；用 Hessian 相容性条件（必要且充分）替代对角雅可比充分条件；通过构造反例证明该条件不可或缺；对单点赌博反馈使用球形平滑技术。

Result: OGD 在隐藏凸损失下达到 $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾（匹配最优界）；Hessian 相容性是必要且充分的几何条件；不满足时 OGD 遭受 $\Omega(T)$ 遗憾；赌博 OGD 达到 $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ 期望遗憾。

Conclusion: 证明了隐藏凸在线学习可以达到与在线凸优化相同的 $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 最优遗憾界，并阐明了算法等价性所需的精确几何条件，为处理非凸在线学习问题提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We study adversarial online learning with hidden-convex losses, i.e., nonconvex losses that become convex after a nonlinear reparameterization. Ghai, Lu and Hazan (2022) proved that, under geometric and smoothness assumptions, online gradient descent (OGD) on such nonconvex losses approximately simulates online mirror descent (OMD) on the underlying convex losses with a suitable regularizer, yielding $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret. They left open whether the optimal $Θ(\sqrt{T})$ regret from online convex optimization can be recovered in this hidden-convex setting. We answer this question affirmatively. More specifically, via a sharper discrete-time algorithmic equivalence argument, we prove that OGD achieves $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret under the same assumptions, matching the optimal worst-case rate for adversarial online convex optimization. We also address another open question of Ghai, Lu and Hazan (2022) by clarifying the geometry required for this algorithmic equivalence. We replace the diagonal-Jacobian sufficient condition with a necessary-and-sufficient Hessian compatibility condition, thereby expanding the class of admissible reparameterizations. We complement our tight regret bound with a lower bound showing that the Hessian compatibility assumption is essential for OGD; when it fails, we construct a smooth reparameterization and an adversarial sequence of hidden-convex losses for which OGD suffers $Ω(T)$ regret. Finally, we extend our analysis to one-point bandit feedback and prove a $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ expected regret bound for bandit OGD with spherical smoothing, matching its classical rate on convex losses.

</details>


### [307] [Function-Valued Causal Influence in Nonlinear Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26408)
*Valentina V. Kuskova,Dmitry Zaytsev,Michael Coppedge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 传统时序因果发现使用非线性机器学习模型却用标量边分数总结关系，本文指出这种做法掩盖了状态依赖的非线性因果函数。作者形式化了函数值因果影响，提出基于个体条件期望的因果响应函数估计框架，实验证明标量分数无法区分单调、阈值、饱和及符号变化等不同功能行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非线性时序因果发现方法虽使用复杂模型，但最终用标量边分数总结因果强度，这严重丢失了模型学习到的状态依赖函数信息，无法区分不同机制下的因果行为差异。

Method: 以神经加性向量自回归为代表架构，形式化函数值因果影响，引入个体条件期望（ICE）框架直接从训练模型中估计因果响应函数。

Result: 标量分数相同的边可呈现单调、阈值、饱和、符号变化等完全不同的函数行为；民主发展案例表明函数值分析能发现被标量方法忽视的体制特异和非对称因果结构。

Conclusion: 标量因果分数是严重的信息瓶颈，混淆了状态间变化与残差噪声；函数值因果分析能揭示更丰富的因果结构，应替代或补充传统标量评价方式。

Abstract: Causal discovery in time series is increasingly performed using nonlinear machine-learning models, yet the resulting causal relationships are almost always summarized by scalar edge scores. We argue that this practice obscures the true object learned by nonlinear autoregressive models: a state-dependent function whose effect varies across regimes, magnitudes, and contexts. We formalize function-valued causal influence for additive, contribution-decomposable architectures and show that scalar causal scores constitute a severe information bottleneck, conflating between-state variation with within-state residual noise. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a representative architecture, we introduce a practical framework based on Individual Conditional Expectation for estimating causal response functions directly from trained models. Through controlled synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that edges with indistinguishable scalar scores can exhibit qualitatively different functional behaviors, including monotonic, thresholded, saturating, and sign-changing effects. An applied case study on democratic development further shows that function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structure systematically missed by score-centric approaches.

</details>


### [308] [When Does Deep RL Beat Calibrated Baselines? A Benchmark Study on Adaptive Resource Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26418)
*Guilin Zhang,Chuanyi Sun,Kai Zhao,Shahryar Sarkani,John Fossaceca*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过RLScale-Bench基准测试发现，经过良好校准的基于规则的自动缩放器在所有六种工作负载上的成本都优于六种主流深度强化学习（DRL）算法；DRL仅在突发流量场景下略有优势，且离散动作算法优于连续动作算法；RL资源控制的瓶颈在于基线校准、奖励工程和评估协议，而非算法选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究深度强化学习在自适应资源控制任务中是否真的优于传统的基于规则的自动缩放器，以及何时DRL能带来实际帮助。

Method: 构建RLScale-Bench可重现基准测试和评估协议，对比六种DRL算法（PPO、DQN、A2C、SAC、TD3、DDPG）与经过校准的基于规则的基线，在六种工作负载模式、匹配架构和训练预算下进行240次实验，并在Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaling上实例化。

Result: (i) 校准后的规则控制器在所有六种工作负载上成本最低，但在突发和闪流流量上落后于最优RL智能体；(ii) 离散动作算法在约束违反方面比连续动作算法好一到两个数量级；(iii) 没有单一算法在所有工作负载上占优，排名变化可达四个位置。

Conclusion: DRL在资源控制中的瓶颈不是算法选择，而是基线校准、奖励工程和现实的评估协议。

Abstract: A properly calibrated rule-based autoscaler can beat every one of six mainstream deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms on cost across every workload we test - so when, if ever, does DRL actually help? We study this in RLScale-Bench, a reproducible benchmark and evaluation protocol for DRL on adaptive resource control, where an agent allocates compute to a dynamic workload under cost and service-level constraints. We evaluate PPO, DQN, A2C, SAC, TD3, and DDPG under matched architectures, training budgets, and reward functions against a calibrated rule-based baseline across six workload patterns and five seeds (240 runs), instantiate the benchmark on Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaling, and probe distribution-shift generalization. Three findings challenge common assumptions: (i) the calibrated controller achieves the lowest cost on all six workloads, though it trails the best RL agents on bursty and flash traffic; (ii) discrete-action algorithms outperform continuous-action ones by one to two orders of magnitude in constraint violations due to action-space mismatch; and (iii) no single algorithm dominates across workloads, with rankings shifting by up to four positions. The bottleneck in RL-based resource control is not algorithm selection but baseline calibration, reward engineering, and realistic evaluation protocols.

</details>


### [309] [Amortized Factor Inference Networks for Posterior Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26419)
*Joohwan Ko,Justin Domke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs)，一种能够跨不同先验、似然和维度泛化的单一推理网络，无需重新训练或微调，在推理速度上比NUTS和传统VI方法快2-4个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的摊销推理方法只能服务于固定模型，扩展到未见过的模型通常需要重新训练或昂贵的测试时微调，缺乏跨模型泛化的能力。

Method: AFINs采用"编码-合并-解码"架构，由维度无关的模块组成，将模型规范（先验、似然）及其观测数据映射为变分后验参数。

Result: 单个训练的AFIN在多个不同模型上达到了与NUTS和多种变分推断方法相当的后验精度，测试时计算量减少了2到4个数量级。

Conclusion: 可以构建一个单一推理网络，在不重新训练或微调的情况下，泛化到不同的先验、似然和维度问题，实现高效的贝叶斯推断。

Abstract: Amortized inference promises fast test-time Bayesian inference, but existing methods are inherently tied to fixed models. Extending amortization to unseen models typically requires retraining or costly test-time finetuning. In this paper, we ask: is it possible to build a single inference network capable of generalizing across varying priors, likelihoods, and dimensionality? We introduce Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs), a family of encode-merge-decode inference networks built on dimension-independent modules that map a model specification and its observations to the parameters of a variational posterior. Experimentally, a single trained AFIN achieves posterior accuracy comparable to NUTS and several variational inference methods, while requiring 2 to 4 orders of magnitude less test-time compute. Code is available at https://github.com/joohwanko/AFINs.

</details>


### [310] [FM-fMRI: Event Conditioned Flow Matching for Rest-to-Task fMRI Time-Series Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26423)
*Peiyu Duan,Jiyao Wang,Nicha C. Dvornek,Junlin Yang,Ziqi Gao,Lawrence H. Staib,James S. Duncan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FM-fMRI，一种基于事件条件流匹配的模型，能够从静息态fMRI和任务事件信息生成任务态fMRI的ROI时间序列，在HCP和自闭症队列上优于扩散模型、GAN和VAE基线，并在自闭症分类任务中验证了其实用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务态fMRI能直接反映任务诱发的神经动态，但获取成本高、难以大规模采集。为缓解这一问题，利用广泛可得的静息态fMRI合成任务态fMRI响应，实现静息态到任务态的跨模态生成。

Method: 提出FM-fMRI，一个事件条件流匹配模型。通过学习连续时间条件向量场，从受试者的静息态fMRI和任务事件信息生成任务态ROI时间序列。采用快速ODE采样，支持异构事件调度的灵活条件控制。评估指标不局限于逐点重构，而是涵盖时域/频域结构、个体及群体水平连接矩阵一致性以及分布对齐。

Result: 在HCP公共数据集和内部BioPoint自闭症队列上，FM-fMRI在频谱一致性、连接矩阵一致性和分布匹配方面均优于条件扩散模型、GAN和VAE基线。通过生成任务态fMRI扩充BioPoint队列，显著提升了自闭症分类性能。

Conclusion: FM-fMRI有效实现了静息态到任务态fMRI的生成，在数据有限的临床场景中具有实际应用价值，代码将开源。

Abstract: Task-based fMRI provides a direct readout of task-evoked neural dynamics, but it is expensive and difficult to acquire at scale, motivating rest-to-task synthesis from widely available resting-state fMRI (rsfMRI). We propose FM-fMRI, an event-conditioned flow-matching model that learns a continuous-time conditional vector field to generate task ROI time series from a subject's rsfMRI and the task event information. The formulation enables fast ODE-based sampling and flexible conditioning over heterogeneous event schedules. Rather than optimizing for pointwise reconstruction, we evaluated generated signals using complementary criteria that probe temporal and spectral structure, subject and group-level connectome consistency, and distributional alignment. On the public Human Connectome Project and internal BioPoint autism cohort, FM-fMRI achieves the strongest spectral and connectivity agreement and improved distribution-level matching over conditional diffusion, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and variational autoencoders (VAEs) baselines. Furthermore, we augment the BioPoint cohort by synthesizing task-fMRI ROI time series with our method, improving downstream autism classification and demonstrating practical utility in data-limited clinical settings. The code will be available on GitHub.

</details>


### [311] [Continual Model-Based Reinforcement Learning with Hypernetworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2009.11997)
*Yizhou Huang,Kevin Xie,Homanga Bharadhwaj,Florian Shkurti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HyperCRL，一种使用任务条件超网络在序列任务中持续学习动力学模型的方法，避免了传统MBRL中模型从头重新训练导致的训练时间随经验线性增长问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MBRL和MPC方法假设动力学模型是平稳的，并定期从头重新训练，导致训练时间随收集经验规模线性增长，无法满足机器人终身学习的需求。

Method: 使用固定容量的任务条件超网络（hypernetworks）来表征非平稳且任务感知的动力学模型；动力学学习会话不回溯先前任务训练数据，仅存储最近固定大小的状态转移经验。

Result: 在机器人 locomotion 和 manipulation 场景（如推物和开门任务）中，HyperCRL优于依赖固定容量网络的现有持续学习方法，与依赖不断增长核心集基线的性能相当。

Conclusion: HyperCRL能够在不增长数据存储和训练时间的前提下实现持续动力学学习，为终身机器人学习提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Effective planning in model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) and model-predictive control (MPC) relies on the accuracy of the learned dynamics model. In many instances of MBRL and MPC, this model is assumed to be stationary and is periodically re-trained from scratch on state transition experience collected from the beginning of environment interactions. This implies that the time required to train the dynamics model - and the pause required between plan executions - grows linearly with the size of the collected experience. We argue that this is too slow for lifelong robot learning and propose HyperCRL, a method that continually learns the encountered dynamics in a sequence of tasks using task-conditional hypernetworks. Our method has three main attributes: first, it includes dynamics learning sessions that do not revisit training data from previous tasks, so it only needs to store the most recent fixed-size portion of the state transition experience; second, it uses fixed-capacity hypernetworks to represent non-stationary and task-aware dynamics; third, it outperforms existing continual learning alternatives that rely on fixed-capacity networks, and does competitively with baselines that remember an ever increasing coreset of past experience. We show that HyperCRL is effective in continual model-based reinforcement learning in robot locomotion and manipulation scenarios, such as tasks involving pushing and door opening. Our project website with videos is at this link https://rvl.cs.toronto.edu/blog/hypercrl

</details>


### [312] [Aperiodic and Low-Frequency Spectral Bias in Reconstruction based EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26434)
*Aditya Kommineni,Emily Zhou,Kleanthis Avramidis,Simon Bock Segaard,Jeppe Roden Münster,Andreas Peter Juhl Hansen,Takfarinas Medani,Tiantian Feng,Richard Leahy,Shrikanth Narayanan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EEG基础模型在低资源场景下性能不如小型监督模型，原因是基于重构的预训练任务偏向于捕捉EEG信号中的非周期性成分（高功率低频），而低估了振荡成分（低功率高频），且嵌入编码中主体身份信息强于任务相关信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究EEG基础模型在低资源场景下性能不如小型监督模型的原因，揭示基于重构的预训练范式在EEG信号上的根本性缺陷。

Method: 通过控制合成EEG输入进行机制分析，结合线性探针评估真实BCI数据集，对比基础模型嵌入中非周期成分与振荡成分的表征差异，以及主体身份与任务信息的编码强度。

Result: EEG基础模型嵌入偏向捕捉非周期成分（尤其低频），低估高频振荡成分；嵌入中主体身份信息强于任务相关信息，强化了低频和非周期成分的偏差。

Conclusion: 基于重构的EEG基础模型存在固有失败模式，未来需引入显式针对高频振荡结构的辅助损失函数以提升表征能力和泛化性。

Abstract: EEG foundation models, pre-trained on large-scale unlabelled EEG data, have emerged as a promising direction towards learning generalizable EEG representations. Despite showing positive results in data-rich regimes, they often fail to outperform significantly smaller supervised models in low-resource settings compared to fully supervised models. We provide a mechanistic account of this shortcoming, attributing it to a fundamental mismatch between reconstruction-based pretext tasks and the idiosyncratic spectral structure of EEG signals, which decompose into distinct high-power aperiodic and low-power oscillatory components. Using controlled, synthetically-generated EEG inputs, we demonstrate that EEG foundation model embeddings are biased to capture the aperiodic components of the EEG signal while under-representing oscillatory components, particularly at higher frequencies. Additionally, linear probe evaluations on real-world BCI datasets further reveal that embeddings encode subject identity more strongly than task-relevant information, thereby reinforcing the low-frequency and aperiodic component bias in foundation model embeddings trained primarily on reconstruction based objectives. Together, these findings elucidate a failure mode in reconstruction based EEG foundation models and motivate future work to incorporate auxiliary losses explicitly targeting high-frequency oscillatory structure as a path toward more capable and generalizable EEG representations.

</details>


### [313] [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Safe Autonomous Driving Under Pedestrian Behavioral Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20255)
*Prakash Aryan,Kaushik Raghupathruni,Timo Kehrer,Sebastiano Panichella*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出使用多智能体强化学习（MARL）联合训练自动驾驶汽车（SDC）和行人，以生成更真实的交互场景。实验表明，联合训练相比固定策略基线显著降低了碰撞率（14% vs 33%），但发现乱穿马路行人导致了62%的碰撞，SDC在近距离时对乱穿马路者的速度差异达2.65 m/s，表明其无法有效预测乱穿马路行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于脚本化行人模型的仿真测试无法捕捉真实过街行为的异质性和不确定性，特别是乱穿马路行为受车辆不可观测的潜在人格特质影响，导致安全性评估缺乏真实性。

Method: 使用MAPPO算法联合训练1个SDC和12个行人，行人底层运动采用脚本化Dijkstra寻路，RL策略控制高层"走/等"决策，乱穿马路概率由每个行人每轮随机采样的隐藏特质决定。

Result: 联合训练的SDC在500轮评估中达到78%目标完成率和14%碰撞率（最优规则基线为35%/33%）；SDC在近距离（0-3m）处对乱穿马路者的速度比使用人行横道的行人快2.65 m/s；乱穿马路占过街事件13%但占碰撞的62%；联合训练相比单智能体RL减少30%碰撞。

Conclusion: 联合训练可生成更真实的交互场景并提升安全性，但SDC仍无法有效预测乱穿马路行为，乱穿马路是主要安全隐患来源。

Abstract: Simulation-based testing of self-driving cars (SDCs) typically relies on scripted pedestrian models that do not capture the heterogeneity and uncertainty of real crossing behavior, limiting the realism of safety assessments, especially for jaywalking, which is governed by latent personality traits the vehicle cannot observe. We hypothesize that jointly training pedestrians and the SDC with multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) yields more realistic interaction scenarios than training against fixed pedestrian policies, and that the behavior gap between predictable and unpredictable crossings can be measured directly from trajectories. We co-train an SDC and 12 pedestrians using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO): pedestrian locomotion follows scripted Dijkstra pathfinding while an RL policy controls high-level go/wait decisions, and jaywalking probability depends on a per-pedestrian trait sampled at episode start and hidden from the SDC. In 500-episode evaluations, the co-trained SDC reached 78% of goals with a 14% collision rate, versus 35%/33% for the best rule-based baseline. A speed differential metric shows the SDC traveled 2.65 m/s faster near jaywalkers than near crosswalk users at close range (0-3 m), indicating jaywalking encounters were not anticipated. Jaywalking was 13% of crossing events but 62% of collisions, and co-training reduced collisions by 30% relative to single-agent RL as pedestrians learned to wait when the SDC approached at speed.

</details>


### [314] [DDGAD: Trajectory Dynamics for Diffusion-Based Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26446)
*Yuxin Yang,Limei Hu,Feng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DDGAD，一种基于扩散过程的图异常检测框架，通过轨迹动力学区分正常节点与异常节点，并引入分布式可靠性感知共识机制及三种互补异常信号来缓解污染传播问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
