Extending the Digital Red Queen framework with DEI, nodes share local optimal solutions at the end of each round to seed the next round's population. This creates cross-model adversarial pressure that drives robustness beyond intra-model self-play. Evaluated on the Core War domain, a competitive programming benchmark in which Redcode warrior programs battle inside a simulated machine, a four-node heterogeneous ensemble (GPT-5.4-mini, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.2, and Claude Haiku 4.5) achieves 124 percent higher merged-archive QD-Score (45.90 vs. 20.46) and 28 percent higher coverage (80.6 percent vs. 63.0 percent of cells) than a single-node baseline at equal total LLM-call budget. The heterogeneous ensemble also outperforms an equally-budgeted homogeneous ensemble on QD-Score, coverage, and held-out solution generality across all four model families. These results provide the first empirical evidence that model diversity, not merely parallelism, is the key driver of gain in distributed LLM-based QD search.

</details>


### [388] [Deep-layer limit and stability analysis of the basic forward-backward-splitting induced network (II): learning problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27133)
*Xuan Lin,Chunlin Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了由前向-后向分裂算法展开得到的基本深度展开网络的学习问题收敛性，建立了网络训练问题到深层极限系统学习问题的Γ-收敛性，并分析了扰动稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度展开神经网络在数据科学中受到广泛关注，但由基本FBS算法展开得到的网络（通过直接参数松弛构建）的理论学习性质尚未充分研究。本文旨在建立此类网络的训练收敛性及其与深层极限系统学习问题之间的联系。

Method: 基于前期工作中的差/微分包含形式，对FBS诱导网络的学习问题进行分析。在温和假设下，建立训练问题的Γ-收敛性，证明最优学习参数的聚点是深层极限系统学习问题的解；同时进行扰动稳定性的定性分析，并通过数值实验验证主要结论。

Result: 建立了基本FBS诱导网络训练问题到深层极限系统学习问题的Γ-收敛性；给出了学习问题扰动稳定性的定性分析结果；数值实验验证了理论收敛性。

Conclusion: 该研究为FBS展开网络的学习理论提供了严格的收敛性基础，证明了深层极限系统下学习问题与原始网络训练问题之间的内在联系，为深度展开网络的设计与分析提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Deep unfolding neural networks derived from iterative optimization schemes and numerical ordinary/partial differential equations (ODEs/PDEs) have attracted much attention in data science over the last decade. Therein, numerous important network architectures were constructed from the basic forward-backward-splitting (FBS) algorithm. In this paper, we continue our research on the most basic FBS-induced network, an architecture unrolled from the original FBS algorithm by incorporating direct parameter relaxations. Following the difference/differential inclusion formulations in our previous forward system analyses, we here consider some theoretical aspects of corresponding learning problems. Under some mild assumptions, we establish a general convergence property of the training problem of the basic FBS-induced network to the learning problem of the deep-layer limit system, implying a $Γ$-convergence argument showing that any cluster point of the optimal learning parameters for the network is a solution to the learning problem of the deep-layer limit system. A qualitative analysis of perturbation stabilities of these learning problems is also presented. A simple numerical experiment is conducted to validate our main general convergence result.

</details>


### [389] [The Role of Causal Features in Strategic Classification for Robustness and Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27163)
*Antonio Gois,Sophia Gunluk,Nir Rosenfeld,Nidhi Hegde,Simon Lacoste-Julien,Dhanya Sridhar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了因果模型与策略分类之间的联系，证明了因果分类在大规模用户适应后能实现最优分类误差，分析了OOD交叉熵风险的分解，并发现因果特征有助于对齐机构与用户的长期激励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在策略分类中，用户为提升自身效用而改变特征会导致分布偏移，传统方法难以应对。作者转向因果模型，旨在利用其对最坏情况OOD风险的边界能力，建立因果模型与策略分类之间的理论联系。

Method: 首先证明在噪声有界条件下，因果分类在用户充分适应后达到最优分类误差；其次分解OOD交叉熵风险为OOD偏置项和未使用全部可观测特征导致的项；最后分析因果特征在长期激励对齐中的作用，并通过合成数据实验验证理论。

Result: 因果分类在噪声有界时具有最优性；OOD风险分解揭示了因果分类器的优势来源；因果特征能够促进机构与用户长期激励的一致性，区别于以往研究中强调的社会成本。

Conclusion: 因果模型为策略分类中的分布偏移问题提供了理论保障，并在特定条件下同时实现分类最优性和激励对齐，对实践具有指导意义。

Abstract: In strategic classification, an institution (e.g., a bank) anticipates adaptation from users who change their features to increase utility in a classification task (e.g., loan repayment). Since a key challenge is the distribution shift induced by users, we turn to causal models, which have been shown to bound the worst-case out-of-distribution (OOD) risk, and establish several new results that link causality and strategic classification. First, we show that causal classification leads to optimal classification error after any sufficiently large adaptation, when the noise is bounded in a certain way. Second, when these assumptions do not hold, we show OOD cross-entropy risk of optimal classifiers decomposes into an OOD bias term and a term arising from not using all observable features, allowing us to understand when causal classifiers have an advantage. Finally, we show that the use of causal features can allow alignment of long-term incentives between institutions and users, contrasting with previous work that highlights social costs of such approaches. We validate our theory empirically on synthetic data, finding that our results predict behavior in practice.

</details>


### [390] [Nonlinear Data Integration via Kernel Methods for Data Collaboration Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27219)
*Yamato Suetake,Yuta Kawakami,Shunnosuke Ikeda,Yuichi Takano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出非线性核集成方法（NKI），通过核化线性核集成（LKI）并引入图正则化和中心化约束，在非线性降维场景下实现隐私保护的分布式数据协作分析，在图像分类任务上优于现有线性集成方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据协作（DC）分析方法多依赖线性变换进行数据混淆与集成，存在重构风险；而非线性降维虽能降低风险，但传统线性集成方法无法准确对齐非线性变换产生的中间表示；此外，现有集成方法主要最小化各方间的差异，未显式纳入对下游分析有用的几何或目标变量信息。

Method: 首先将线性核集成（LKI）形式化，再通过核技巧将其扩展为非线性核集成（NKI）；NKI通过核岭回归和特征值问题获得全局最优解；引入图正则化和中心化约束，使目标表示能够捕获几何结构和目标变量信息。

Result: 在图像分类任务上，NKI在非线性降维条件下优于现有线性集成方法；引入目标变量感知的图正则化和中心化后进一步提升了分类准确率；降维选择显著影响分类准确率和重构风险。

Conclusion: NKI有效克服了线性集成在非线性降维场景下的局限，通过核化实现非线性对齐，并利用图正则化和中心化约束融入下游任务信息，在隐私保护与数据分析效用之间取得了更好的平衡。

Abstract: Collaborative analysis of decentralized confidential datasets is important, but direct sharing of original datasets is often restricted by privacy and institutional constraints. Data collaboration (DC) analysis transforms each dataset into privacy-preserving intermediate representations via party-specific obfuscation functions and integrates them into common collaboration representations using an anchor dataset. However, many existing DC analysis methods rely on linear transformations for data obfuscation and integration, which may increase reconstruction risk. Although nonlinear dimensionality reduction can mitigate this risk, conventional linear integration methods cannot accurately align intermediate representations produced by nonlinear transformations. Moreover, existing integration methods mainly minimize discrepancies among parties and do not explicitly incorporate geometric or target-variable information useful for downstream analysis. To overcome these limitations, we first formulate linear kernel integration (LKI) as a linear integration method and then kernelize it to obtain nonlinear kernel integration (NKI). NKI admits a globally optimal solution via kernel ridge regression and an eigenvalue problem. We also introduce graph regularization and a centering constraint so that the target representation can capture geometric and target-variable information useful for downstream analysis. Experiments on image classification tasks demonstrate that NKI improves classification accuracy over existing linear integration methods under nonlinear dimensionality reduction, with further gains from target-variable-aware graph regularization and centering. The results also show that dimensionality reduction choices substantially affect both classification accuracy and reconstruction risk.

</details>


### [391] [Explainable Comparison of Feature-Based and Deep Learning Models for TROPOMI Methane Plume Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27236)
*Solomiia Kurchaba,Joannes D. Maasakkers,Berend J. Schuit,Ilse Aben*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究比较了基于特征的传统机器学习模型（SVC、随机森林、XGBoost）和基于图像的深度学习模型（ResNet-18、ResNet-34）在TROPOMI甲烷羽流-伪影分类任务上的性能，并利用SHAP进行可解释性分析，为CAMS甲烷热点探测器等运营工作流中的模型选择提供实践指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星观测中检测到的甲烷羽流特征有相当一部分是反演伪影而非真实排放，现有基于支持向量机的分类方法依赖于领域专家设计的统计聚合特征，限制了信息利用、破坏了空间关系。因此需要探索更有效的分类方法。

Method: 对比两类模型：(1) 基于特征的传统模型（SVC、随机森林、XGBoost）；(2) 基于图像的深度学习模型（ResNet-18、ResNet-34）。在平衡和不平衡评估设置下进行实验，并使用SHAP对两类模型进行可解释性分析。

Result: 给出了两类模型在平衡和不平衡设置下的性能比较结果，并通过SHAP分析揭示了不同模型家族的决策依据差异。

Conclusion: 为运营甲烷筛检工作流（如CAMS甲烷热点探测器）中的模型选择提供了实践指导依据。

Abstract: Continuous and global detection of large methane emissions is a crucial step for global warming mitigation. Satellite observations, such as from S5P/TROPOMI, combined with plume detection algorithms, can play a key role in this effort. However, not all TROPOMI plume detections that look like methane emission plumes are the result of actual emissions. A significant part of the plume-like features in the data are retrieval artifacts. Such artifacts could be the result of variations in elevation or albedo gradients, high concentrations of aerosols, coastal lines, water bodies, etc. Previous work approached the problem of plume-artifact classification by means of a Support Vector Machine Classifier (SVC), trained on an extensive set of observation-based scalar features designed by domain experts. However, such an approach limits the information scope received by the algorithm to what is deemed to be important by the experts, breaks the spatial relationship between pixels, and loses information during the process of statistical aggregation. In this study, we compare feature-based (SVC, Random Forest, XGBoost) and image-based (ResNet-18, ResNet-34) models for methane plume-artifact classification under balanced and imbalanced evaluation settings. To interpret the results, we apply SHAP-based explainability to both model families. Our findings provide practical guidance for model selection in operational methane-screening workflows such as the CAMS Methane Hotspot Explorer.

</details>


### [392] [Symbolic Regression via Latent Iterative Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27245)
*Xieting Chu,Sriram Vishwanath,Vijay Ganesh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LEE框架，通过迭代摊销推理和功能引导的潜在空间，在保持高精度的同时生成比现有方法简单2-10倍的符号表达式，显著推进了精度-复杂度帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经符号回归方法（编码器直接一步映射到表达式）存在摊销间隙（amortization gap），即单次预测与真实后验之间存在偏差，导致表达式质量受限。

Method: 构建共享潜在空间Z，包含三个组件：编码器f_θ（联合嵌入符号token和数值观测）、表达式解码器g_expr（从z重建公式）、评估解码器g_eval（从z预测函数值）；推理时通过迭代重编码进行精炼，并利用g_eval在z上的可微性交替进行连续梯度下降和离散重编码。

Result: 在SRBench三个噪声水平下对比19个基线，生成的表达式复杂度8-11（基线为20-90），比最强精度导向基线（Operon, GP-GOMEA, TPSR, RAG-SR, GenSR等）简单2-10倍，且随噪声增加性能退化平缓。

Conclusion: LEE通过迭代摊销推理有效缩小了摊销间隙，在精度-复杂度帕累托前沿的低复杂度区域取得显著进展，为符号回归提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks closed-form mathematical expressions that fit observed data. Neural SR methods amortize the search by training an encoder to map observations directly to expressions in a single pass, but this amortized inference leaves a residual amortization gap between its one-shot prediction and the true posterior. We propose Latent Equation Embedding (LEE), a framework that closes this gap through iterative amortized inference in a functionally grounded latent space. LEE learns a shared latent space Z equipped with three components: an encoder f_theta that jointly embeds symbolic tokens and numerical observations into a single latent vector z; an expression decoder g_expr that reconstructs formulas from z; and an evaluation decoder g_eval that predicts function values from z, explicitly grounding the latent space in functional behavior. At inference, LEE performs iterative refinement by re-encoding decoded expressions jointly with observations, progressively improving the latent estimate. LEE uses the encoder itself as a learned inference optimizer: each re-encoding step implicitly computes the mismatch between the candidate and the data. Because g_eval is differentiable in z, we additionally interleave continuous gradient descent with discrete re-encoding, yielding a hybrid iterative and gradient refinement procedure. On SRBench across three noise levels, against 19 baselines spanning genetic programming, symbolic-neural hybrids, and pre-trained Transformers, LEE produces expressions 2--10x simpler than the strongest accuracy-oriented baselines, including Operon, GP-GOMEA, TPSR, RAG-SR, and GenSR, with complexity 8--11 versus 20--90. These results advance the low-complexity region of the accuracy-complexity Pareto frontier and show graceful degradation as noise increases.

</details>


### [393] [LUCoS: Latent Unsupervised Context Selection for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27254)
*Oroel Ipas,Guillermo Gomez-Trenado,Rocío Romero-Zaliz,Isaac Triguero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对表格基础模型（如TabPFN）在低标签场景下的冷启动上下文选择问题，本文提出LUCoS方法，利用无监督先验拟合网络（PFN）的潜在嵌入几何代替原始特征空间，选择代表性medoid作为上下文。在67个OpenML-CC18数据集上的实验表明，LUCoS在AUC、ACC和F1指标上均排名第一，且收益分解显示：小预算时覆盖性起主要作用，预算增大时表征空间几何成为决定因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）中，上下文选择直接影响预测性能，但冷启动场景（标签可用前选择实例）在TFM文献中关注不足。原始表格空间缺乏自然度量，异构类型、混合尺度和非线性交互导致原始空间距离不可靠，甚至在大预算下多数数据集上随机选择表现更差。

Method: 提出LUCoS（Latent Unsupervised Context Selection）：用无监督Prior-Fitted Network（PFN）的嵌入替换原始特征空间，在潜在几何中选择代表性medoid作为上下文，实现覆盖性约束下的冷启动上下文选择。

Result: 在67个OpenML-CC18数据集、6种低标签预算下评估，LUCoS在平均AUC、ACC和F1上均排名第一，结论在指标和数据集层面稳健。收益分解揭示：最小预算时主要受益来自覆盖性约束；预算增大时，决定性因素变为衡量覆盖性所用的表征空间。

Conclusion: LUCoS有效缓解了原始特征空间选择的失败，表明可靠的无监督上下文选择的关键不在于选择器的复杂度，而在于在有意义的表征几何中定义代表性。

Abstract: Selecting which instances to label is a key challenge in low-label tabular learning. For recent Tabular Foundation Models such as TabPFN, context selection directly determines predictive performance. Supervised oracle experiments show that carefully chosen labeled context sets can strongly outperform random selection under the same labeling budget. However, the cold-start setting, where instances must be selected before any labels are available, has received little attention in the TFM literature. This problem is fundamentally geometric. In vision and language, foundation models induce embedding spaces where simple geometric selection methods are effective. In contrast, tabular instance selection has so far been performed predominantly in the original tabular space, which lacks a natural metric; heterogeneous types, mixed scales, and nonlinear interactions make raw-space distances unreliable for context construction, and original-space selection falls below random on the majority of datasets as the budget grows. We propose LUCoS (Latent Unsupervised Context Selection), which replaces raw-feature geometry with the latent geometry induced by embeddings from an unsupervised Prior-Fitted Network (PFN) and selects representative medoids as context. Evaluated on 67 OpenML-CC18 datasets across six low-label budgets, LUCoS ranks first under mean AUC, ACC, and F1, with conclusions stable across metrics and dataset-level robustness checks. A gain decomposition reveals a simple mechanism: at the smallest budgets, the main benefit comes from enforcing coverage; as the budget increases, the decisive factor becomes the representation space in which coverage is measured. LUCoS mitigates failures of original feature space selection, showing that reliable unsupervised context selection depends less on selector sophistication than on defining representativeness in a meaningful representation geometry.

</details>


### [394] [Kan Extension Transformers: A Categorical Unification of Attention, Diffusion, and Predict-Detach Self-Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27259)
*Sridhar Mahadevan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Kan Extension Transformers (KETs)作为统一各类Transformer实现的范畴论框架，证明Transformer层可视为加权结构化扩展算子，并引入predict-detach机制在非因果设置中暴露结构而不泄露未来信息。在12种实现上的实验表明，predict-detach机制带来的收益大于改变邻域族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer实现种类繁多（标准注意力、几何Transformer、高阶复形等），缺乏统一的数学框架来理解它们之间的关系和差异，也缺少对非因果信息利用方式的系统研究。

Method: 将Transformer层形式化为加权结构化扩展算子（Kan扩展），涵盖不同邻域结构（单例、稀疏边、高阶复形）；提出predict-detach机制，将扩展算子作用于分离的预测载体而非教师强制隐藏状态，实现无泄漏的自条件化。

Result: 在严格因果设置下，二次KET在WikiText-2和WikiText-103上是最强模型。但所有数据集上，predict-detach机制带来的收益显著大于改变邻域族。

Conclusion: KET提供了统一的Transformer理论视角，但实际性能提升更多来自predict-detach训练策略而非高阶结构扩展，为Transformer改进提供了新方向。

Abstract: We propose Kan Extension Transformers (KETs) as a unifying categorical framework for a diverse group of Transformer implementations. The core claim is that a Transformer layer can be viewed as a weighted structured extension operator: standard attention is the singleton-neighborhood case, Geometric Transformer style incidence mixing is a sparse edge-restricted case, and KET is the higher-order simplicial case. This lens also clarifies a bridge to diffusion-style completion. When the extension operator acts on detached predictive carriers instead of teacher-forced hidden states, it becomes a valid self-conditioning mechanism that exposes noncausal structure without leaking gold future tokens. We include a comprehensive experimental validation of 12 different Transformer implementations varying across strict-causal and predict-detach regimes on Penn Treebank, WikiText-2, and WikiText-103. In the strict-causal setting, quadratic KET is the strongest model among the compared causal architectures on WikiText-2 and WikiText-103. Across all datasets, however, the largest gains come from the predict-detach regime rather than from changing the neighborhood family alone.

</details>


### [395] [Transfer Learning using 66 Diseases for Disease Forecasting Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27269)
*Lauren J Beesley,Alexander C Murph,Dave Osthus,Lauren A Castro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了跨66种传染病、多数据流的机器学习预测模型，发现融合其他数据流在84.9%的情况下能提升预测性能，但数据质量至关重要，低质量数据可能降低预测效果，并构建了公开数据库供社区使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统疾病预测模型通常依赖单一数据流，当历史数据短或有噪声时模型脆弱；近期研究通过多数据流融合和跨疾病迁移学习提升了性能。本文旨在大幅扩展这些方法，系统评估多数据流融合在广泛传染病预测中的价值。

Method: 训练覆盖66种传染病及多个数据流的机器学习模型，对20种不同疾病数据流进行预测，比较融合不同数据流与单一数据流的预测效果，并分析数据质量的影响。

Result: 融合数据流在84.9%的时间序列和模型结构中提升了预测性能；但若添加的数据与目标数据流差异过大，可能会降低预测效果。

Conclusion: 多数据流融合能显著提升传染病预测性能，但数据质量是关键因素；同时构建了公开数据库，为传染病预测社区提供了重要资源。

Abstract: Disease forecasting models typically rely on a single data stream, making models brittle when histories are short or noisy. Recent top-performing models have shown that synthesizing multiple reporting systems for the same disease improves performance. Other recent work takes this idea a step further, using transfer learning to train a forecasting model for one disease using data from a different disease. We expand upon each of these approaches greatly, training machine learning models on data that span 66 infectious diseases and several data streams. We investigate the value of incorporating different data streams for forecasting 20 different disease data streams. We find that incorporating other data streams improves forecasting in the vast majority (84.9%) of time series and model structures considered. However, our work highlights that the quality of the added data matters, where adding data extremely different from the target data stream can sometimes degrade forecast performance. A major contribution of this work is in compiling a publicly-available database of data for use by the infectious disease forecasting community.

</details>


### [396] [Causal Risk Minimization for High-Dimensional Treatments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27281)
*Nikita Dhawan,Arnav Paruthi,Andrew Kim,Lovedeep Gondara,Jekaterina Novikova,Chris J. Maddison*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在高维处理空间（如文本）中估计因果效应的方法，通过将因果推断转化为学习问题，利用高阶矩平衡误差优化，并引入投影机制将高维处理映射到低维属性上，从而无需针对每个属性单独训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统因果估计方法假设所有可能的干预都是可观测的，这在处理空间极高维（如所有文本字符串）时不可行。本文旨在解决高维处理空间下的因果效应估计问题。

Method: 将因果推断重新表述为学习问题，证明因果误差可分解为一系列递增阶数的矩平衡误差；设计直接改善因果估计的目标函数；提出将高维处理投影到低维处理属性的方法，使单一模型可回答多个因果问题而无需额外训练。

Result: 在高维连续、离散和文本处理设置下进行了实验评估（文本处理使用了Amazon Reviews的半合成数据集）。实验表明高阶平衡误差优化具有优势，且投影因果估计在性能上与特定属性估计器相当。

Conclusion: 该方法有效处理了高维处理空间的因果估计问题，高阶矩平衡优化和投影机制是提升性能的关键技术。

Abstract: Predicting the effect of interventions with many possible variations, e.g., therapeutic content that affects mental health outcomes or an earnings call transcript that drives movement in share price, is useful across several domains. However, classical causal estimators tend to assume that all possible interventions are observed, which is infeasible when interventions vary widely, for instance, in the space of all text strings. We adapt a well-known approach of recasting causal inference as a learning problem, to address high-dimensional treatment spaces. Specifically, under standard assumptions like no unobserved confounding, we show that causal error decomposes into a series of moment-balancing errors of increasing order, and design objectives that directly improve causal estimation. We also show how to project the effect of a high-dimensional treatment onto lower-dimensional treatment attributes, which allows a single model to answer several causal questions without additional attribute-specific training. We empirically evaluate our estimators in settings with high-dimensional continuous, discrete, and text treatments, the last of which used a semi-synthetic dataset of Amazon Reviews. Our experiments demonstrate the benefit of higher-order balance error optimization and competitive performance of projected causal estimates with attribute-specific estimators.

</details>


### [397] [Falcon-X: A Time Series Foundation Model for Heterogeneous Multivariate Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27286)
*Yiding Liu,Yifan Hu,Hongjie Xia,Peiyuan Liu,Hongzhou Chen,Xilin Dai,Zewei Dong,Jiang-Ming Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Falcon-X 提出了一种将时间序列变量从原始空间解耦到统一原型潜在空间的方法，通过正负语义亲和显式对齐异构变量，并利用潜在实体注意力实现跨变量交互，在多个基准上达到了最先进的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型多为单变量模型，而支持多变量建模的方法仍直接在原始变量空间中操作，存在语义对齐困难和关系表达力不足的问题——原始空间的变量混合缺乏对齐异构物理量的机制，且标准非负注意力无法捕捉真实系统中普遍存在的协同与拮抗交互关系。

Method: Falcon-X 将变量从原始空间解耦并映射到统一的潜在原型空间；(1) 统一原型差异注意力（Unified Prototype Diff-Attention）显式评估正/负语义亲和度以对齐异构变量；(2) 潜在实体注意力（Latent Entity Attention）在共享空间内高效执行跨变量交互，自然支持零样本结构迁移；(3) 变量重组装路由器（Variate Reassembly Router）通过请求-分发机制鲁棒地重构各变量的轨迹。

Result: 在 GIFT-Eval 和 fev-bench 基准上的广泛评估表明，Falcon-X 达到了最先进的预测性能。

Conclusion: Falcon-X 为复杂的多变量时间序列预测提供了一种有原则且可扩展的新范式，已公开发布以支持未来研究。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are transforming the forecasting paradigm through large-scale cross-domain pretraining. However, most existing TSFMs remain univariate, and recent efforts to enable cross-variate modeling still operate directly within the raw variate space. This design introduces fundamental limitations in semantic alignment and relational expressivity. Specifically, raw-space group mixing lacks a dedicated mechanism to align heterogeneous physical quantities, while standard non-negative attention fails to capture the complex synergistic and antagonistic interactions ubiquitous in real-world systems. To address these challenges, we propose Falcon-X, decouples variates from the raw space and maps them into a unified latent prototype space. Falcon-X employs a Unified Prototype Diff-Attention mechanism that explicitly evaluates both positive and negative semantic affinities to explicitly align heterogeneous variates. Cross-variate interactions are then efficiently performed within this shared space via Latent Entity Attention, naturally facilitating zero-shot structural transfer. Finally, a Variate Reassembly Router robustly reconstructs variate-specific trajectories via a request-and-dispatch mechanism. Extensive evaluations on the GIFT-Eval and fev-bench benchmarks demonstrate that Falcon-X achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance, offering a principled and scalable paradigm for complex multivariate environments. Falcon-X is publicly released to support future research.

</details>


### [398] [Detectability in Diversity: Improved Canary Crafting for Privacy Auditing in One Run](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27292)
*Mathieu Dagréou,Aurélien Bellet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合影响函数贪心初始化和双层优化的金丝雀数据构造方法，用于单次运行隐私审计，通过最大化可区分性和嵌入空间多样性，在更低计算成本下获得更强的隐私泄露估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单次运行审计方法中，多个"金丝雀"数据点之间的相互干扰导致隐私泄露估计弱于多次运行方法，亟需一种高效构造既高可检测又低干扰的金丝雀的方法。

Method: 1) 基于影响函数的贪心初始化选择金丝雀；2) 双层优化过程最大化可区分性同时促进嵌入空间多样性；3) 采用计算高效的双层优化算法。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在更低计算成本下实现了比现有金丝雀构造方法更强的隐私泄露估计。

Conclusion: 通过优化金丝雀的可检测性和低干扰性，可以有效提升单次运行隐私审计的实用性和效率。

Abstract: Privacy auditing aims to empirically assess privacy leakage in machine learning models using membership inference attacks (MIAs), and to derive lower bounds on differential privacy (DP) parameters. Recent one-run auditing methods address the high cost of standard approaches by relying on a single training run with multiple "canary" points whose inclusion or exclusion must be detected by the auditor. In this work, we study the problem of efficiently crafting canaries for one-run privacy auditing. Motivated by recent theoretical insights suggesting that interference between canaries contributes to weaker leakage estimates compared to multi-run methods, we propose to optimize canaries to be both highly detectable and minimally interfering. Our approach combines a greedy initialization based on influence functions with a bilevel optimization procedure that maximizes distinguishability while promoting diversity in embedding space, enabling the use of computationally efficient bilevel algorithms. Experiments show that our method achieves stronger privacy leakage estimates at a lower computational cost than existing canary crafting approaches.

</details>


### [399] [BASIS: Batchwise Advantage Estimation from Single-Rollout Information Sharing for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27293)
*Shijin Gong,Erhan Xu,Kai Ye,Francesco Quinzan,Giulia Livieri,Chengchun Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BASIS是一种免评论家的在线后训练算法，通过跨提示利用批量信息改进价值函数估计，仅需每提示单次采样即可实现接近多rollout方法的性能，并将价值估计MSE降低69%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习算法在价值估计和策略学习中面临计算效率与样本效率的权衡，亟需一种能同时兼顾两者的方法。

Method: BASIS在每个在线训练步中每提示仅采样一次rollout，但利用整个批次中跨提示的丰富信息来改进价值函数估计，实现免评论家的训练。

Result: 相比REINFORCE++，价值函数估计MSE降低69%；单rollout的MSE低于组均值估计器使用8个rollout的结果；训练时间显著减少，性能接近多rollout的GRPO类基线，且常优于单rollout的REINFORCE类基线。

Conclusion: BASIS有效解决了计算效率与样本效率的权衡，通过跨提示信息共享实现高效的价值估计和策略优化。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a standard recipe for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. Existing algorithms face a tradeoff between computational efficiency and sample efficiency in value estimation and policy learning. We introduce BASIS, a critic-free post-training algorithm designed to address this tradeoff. At each online training step, BASIS samples only one rollout per prompt, but leverages rich information across prompts in the entire batch to improve value function estimation. Our experiments demonstrate that BASIS reduces MSE in value function estimation by 69% compared to REINFORCE++, a representative single-rollout baseline, and achieves lower MSE with one rollout than group mean estimators with 8 rollouts. This improvement in value estimation translates to better policy optimization: using substantially less training time, BASIS achieves performance close to multi-rollout GRPO-type baselines and often outperforms single-rollout REINFORCE-type baselines.

</details>


### [400] [Normal Guidance is what Attention Needs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27306)
*Ethan Harvey,Dennis Johan Loevlie,Michael C. Hughes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对3D医学图像弱监督学习（仅有一个整体标签）中的切片级分类问题，本文发现简单中心聚焦基线优于现有MIL方法，并提出Normal Guidance正则化技术，使注意力分布遵循钟形曲线，在三个数据集（超400万切片）上显著提升了注意力型MIL的切片级定位性能，同时保持整体扫描分类竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有弱监督3D医学图像分类方法中，注意力MIL和Transformer MIL在切片级定位任务上表现不佳，甚至被简单的中心聚焦基线超越，需要一种能有效利用注意力机制同时保持强定位能力的方法。

Method: 提出Normal Guidance正则化技术，通过鼓励注意力分布遵循钟形（高斯）曲线来约束注意力学习过程，可应用于注意力MIL和Transformer MIL框架。

Result: 在三个医学影像数据集（脑部、胸部、腹部CT，总计超400万2D切片）上，Normal Guidance使注意力MIL和Transformer MIL的切片级定位显著优于现有最先进方法，同时整体扫描分类性能保持竞争力。

Conclusion: Normal Guidance是一种简单有效的正则化方法，能够弥补弱监督3D医学图像分类中注意力MIL方法在切片级定位上的不足，为该领域的注意力机制应用提供了新的改进方向。

Abstract: We consider training classifiers for 3D medical images using only one binary label for the entire volume rather than a label for each 2D slice. In such weakly supervised settings, can we learn accurate classifiers for slice-level predictions? Attention-based multiple instance learning (MIL) can produce an attention score for every slice. Yet recent work demonstrates that a simple center-focused baseline that ignores image content can outperform attention-based and transformer-based MIL at slice-level classification of 3D brain scans. We show this baseline also outperforms existing MIL at slice-level classification of thoracic and abdominal CT scans. Motivated by this baseline, we propose Normal Guidance, a regularization technique that encourages the learned attention distribution to follow a bell-shaped curve. Across three medical imaging datasets totaling over 4 million 2D slices, we show our Normal Guidance enables attention-based and transformer-based MIL methods to deliver significantly better slice-level localization than the state-of-the-art while remaining competitive at whole-scan classification.

</details>


### [401] [Greening AI Inference with Accuracy and Latency-aware User Incentives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27309)
*Vasilios A. Siris,Adamantia Stamou,George D. Stamoulis,Konstantinos Varsos,Ramin Khalili*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于用户对推理质量、延迟和环境意识的AI推理激励机制框架，通过两 tier 服务订阅（标准/折扣）来平衡碳排放与用户体验质量（QoE）之间的权衡，在高碳强度期间允许降低服务质量以换取减排。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI服务的广泛使用引发了对其环境可持续性的担忧，而现有研究已识别出AI推理的碳排放是主要贡献者，需要设计激励机制来平衡用户体验与碳排放。

Method: 基于用户对推理质量和延迟的估值以及环境意识，考虑碳排放与两个QoE参数之间的权衡，设计了一个两 tier 服务订阅机制（标准服务与折扣服务），其中折扣服务允许AI提供商在高碳强度期间以较低质量和较高延迟服务部分推理请求。

Result: 该方法能够适应不同AI模型规模和复杂度以及资源分配情况下的多种权衡关系，通过两 tier 订阅模式为用户提供折扣以换取减少碳排放。

Conclusion: 提出的框架可为AI服务提供商设计实用的激励方案，在满足用户偏好的同时降低AI推理的环境足迹。

Abstract: The widespread use of AI services has raised concerns for its environmental sustainability, towards which recent studies have identified carbon emissions of AI inference as the major contributor. This paper introduces a framework for designing AI inference incentives based on the users' valuation for inference quality and latency, together with their environmental consciousness, while accounting for the tradeoff between carbon emissions and the two QoE parameters. Our approach can accommodate different tradeoffs, that depend on the size and complexity of the AI models and the allocation of resources to serve inference requests. The incentives can be offered through a practical two-tier service subscription that offers users a discount in exchange for reduced carbon emissions. The discounted service option gives the AI provider the flexibility to serve some percentage of inference requests at a lower quality and higher latency during periods of high carbon intensity.

</details>


### [402] [Probabilistic Smoothing with Ratio-Monotone Transforms for Global Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27316)
*Kukyoung Jang,Taehyun Cho,Junrui Zhang,Ping Xu,Kyungjae Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种通用的概率平滑框架，使用灵活对称单峰核与单调比率变换，在无需递减平滑调度下保证全局最优解保持性，并在高维优化和黑盒对抗攻击中展现更优鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于高斯核的概率平滑方法高度依赖超参数且鲁棒性有限，亟需一种更通用、更鲁棒的全局优化平滑框架。

Method: 结合灵活对称单峰核与单调比率变换构建通用平滑框架；在温和条件下证明平滑目标保持全局最大化点且驻点集中于真最优解附近；为随机梯度上升提供显式复杂度界；提出留一法基线用于方差缩减。

Result: 在高维基准测试和黑盒对抗攻击实验中，该方法展现出更优的鲁棒性和具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 提出的通用平滑框架有效克服了传统高斯核方法的超参数敏感性和鲁棒性不足问题，为全局优化提供了理论保证更充分、实践性能更稳定的新方案。

Abstract: Probabilistic smoothing is a standard tool for global optimization, but existing methods rely on Gaussian kernels and specific transforms, often resulting in strong hyperparameter sensitivity and limited robustness. We propose a general smoothing framework that combines flexible symmetric unimodal kernels with monotonic ratio-based transformations. Under mild conditions, we show that the smoothed objective preserves the global maximizer and that all stationary points concentrate near the true optimum for sufficiently large amplification, without requiring a decreasing smoothing schedule. We further provide explicit complexity bounds for stochastic gradient ascent and show that a leave-one-out baseline provably reduces variance. Experiments on high-dimensional benchmarks and black-box adversarial attacks demonstrate improved robustness and competitive performance.

</details>


### [403] [From Scores to Gibbs Correctors: Accelerating Uniform-Rate Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27352)
*Yuchen Liang,Ness Shroff,Yingbin Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于吉布斯采样的离散扩散模型加速方法GADD，无需额外训练即可实现O(polylog(ε^{-1}))的采样复杂度，在文本和音乐生成任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型（特别是均匀速率模型）需要大量步骤才能生成单个样本，现有加速方法要么依赖额外训练量，要么存在慢混合问题。

Method: 提出GADD（Gibbs-Accelerated Discrete Diffusion），利用具体得分函数（concrete score function）的结构直接构建吉布斯后验似然，无需标准得分估计之外的额外训练。在理论分析上，提出基于归纳论证的预测-校正方法分析框架，跟踪预测迭代中的误差传播并考虑校正器更新的不准确性。

Result: 实现了O(polylog(ε^{-1}))的整体采样复杂度，这是均匀速率离散扩散模型扩散基采样器首次达到该速率。实验上，在合成数据、零样本文本采样和零样本条件音乐生成中，GADD在样本质量和墙钟效率上持续优于标准基线（包括欧拉方法和CTMC校正器）。

Conclusion: GADD是一种高效、无需额外训练的离散扩散模型加速方法，具有理论保证和实证优势，同时提出的理论分析框架可能具有独立研究价值。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models have achieved strong empirical performance in text and other symbolic domains, but, especially for uniform-rate models, they often require many steps to generate a single sample. Existing acceleration methods either rely on training additional quantities or suffer from slow mixing. In this work, we propose a novel Gibbs-based corrector for discrete diffusion models, termed Gibbs-Accelerated Discrete Diffusion (GADD). GADD leverages the structure of the concrete score function to construct Gibbs posterior likelihoods directly, without requiring any additional training beyond standard score estimation. We show that GADD achieves an overall sampling complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{polylog} (\varepsilon^{-1}))$, yielding the first such rate for diffusion-based samplers for uniform-rate discrete diffusion models. We also conduct numerical experiments demonstrating the practical advantages of GADD across synthetic data, zero-shot text sampling, and zero-shot conditional music generation. These results corroborate the theory and show that GADD consistently improves sample quality and wall-clock efficiency over standard baselines, including vanilla Euler methods and CTMC correctors. Beyond this, our theoretical analysis introduces a novel framework for analyzing predictor-corrector methods in discrete diffusion models, which may be of independent interest. Unlike existing approaches that rely on the Girsanov change-of-measure technique, our method is based on an induction argument that tracks error propagation across predictor iterations while accounting for inaccuracies in the corrector updates.

</details>


### [404] [Guiding LLM Post-training Data Engineering with Model Internals from Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27354)
*Yi Jing,Zao Dai,Jinwu Hu,Zijun Yao,Lei Hou,Juanzi Li,Xiaozhi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAERL利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取模型内部信号，对多样性、难度和质量三种内在数据属性进行建模，以指导强化学习中的数据工程操作（批次混合、课程排序、数据过滤），在GRPO等算法上提升3%准确率并减少20%训练步数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM后训练数据工程主要依赖外部信号，忽视了模型内部丰富的内在信号（即模型如何处理训练数据的内部表征）。

Method: 使用SAE提取模型内部表征，构建三种数据属性：1) SAE空间聚类+适度批次混合控制多样性；2) 难度代理实现从易到难的课程排序；3) 质量探针进行数据过滤。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B上，相比vanilla GRPO平均准确率提升3.00%，达到目标准确率所需训练步数减少20%，且在不同模型规模和RL算法上表现一致。

Conclusion: 模型内部信号是后训练数据工程的强大且实用的信号源，SAE可作为轻量级可复用的数据工程工具跨模型族和规模有效迁移。

Abstract: Model internals encode rich information about how a large language model (LLM) processes its training data; however, post-training data engineering largely relies on external signals and ignores rich intrinsic signals lying in model internals. We propose SAERL, a data engineering framework for LLM reinforcement learning (RL). It models three intrinsic data properties: diversity, difficulty, and quality, using model internals extracted with Sparse Autoencoder (SAE), an advanced mechanistic interpretability tool. Each property grounds a concrete data engineering operation: SAE-space clustering with moderate batch mixing for batch diversity control, a difficulty proxy for easy-to-hard curriculum ordering, and a quality probe for data filtering. SAERL improves average accuracy by 3.00% over vanilla GRPO and reaches target accuracy with 20% fewer training steps on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, with consistent gains across model scales and RL algorithms. Experiments show that SAE transfers effectively across model families and scales, serving as a lightweight and reusable data engineering tool. These results demonstrate that model internals are a powerful and practical source of signals for post-training data engineering.

</details>


### [405] [MobileMoE: Scaling On-Device Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27358)
*Yanbei Chen,Hanxian Huang,Ernie Chang,Jacob Szwejbka,Digant Desai,Zechun Liu,Vikas Chandra,Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MobileMoE，首个面向移动设备部署的亚十亿参数量MoE语言模型系列（0.3-0.9B激活/1.3-5.3B总参数量），通过推导设备端MoE缩放定律找到最优架构（适度稀疏+细粒度+共享专家），采用四阶段训练流程，在14个基准上匹配或超越领先的密集模型（2-4倍更少FLOPs）和SOTA MoE模型（最多60%更少参数），并在商用智能手机上实现首个高效MoE推理，相比密集基线MobileLLM-Pro实现1.8-3.8倍prefill加速和2.2-3.4倍decode加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构已在千亿参数大语言模型中成为事实标准，但其在十亿参数以下移动端部署场景中的优势尚未被充分探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，研究MoE在亚十亿规模下能否为设备端LLM建立新的帕累托前沿。

Method: 1) 推导设备端MoE缩放定律，在移动内存和计算约束下联合优化MoE架构，识别出"适度稀疏+细粒度专家+共享专家"的最优配置；2) 采用四阶段训练流程（预训练、中期训练、指令微调、量化感知训练），全部使用开源数据集；3) 在商用智能手机上实现首个高效MoE推理引擎并进行全面性能分析。

Result: MobileMoE在14个基准上匹配或超越领先的密集设备端LLM，同时推理FLOPs减少2-4倍；匹配或超越SOTA MoE模型OLMoE-1B-7B，参数减少最多60%。在INT4权重量化下，MobileMoE-S相比密集基线MobileLLM-Pro实现1.8-3.8倍prefill加速和2.2-3.4倍decode加速。

Conclusion: MoE架构在亚十亿参数规模下同样能建立新的设备端LLM帕累托前沿，通过合理的架构设计和训练流程，可以在移动设备上实现更高效的推理性能。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become the de facto architecture for hundred-billion-parameter language models, yet its advantages at sub-billion scales for on-device deployment remain largely unexplored. To close this gap, we present MobileMoE, a family of on-device MoE language models with sub-billion active parameters (0.3-0.9B active and 1.3-5.3B total) that establish a new Pareto frontier for on-device LLMs. We first formulate an on-device MoE scaling law that jointly optimizes MoE architecture under mobile memory and compute constraints, identifying an on-device sweet spot - moderate sparsity with fine-grained and shared experts - that is simultaneously memory and compute-optimal. Building on the derived architectures, we train MobileMoE with a four-stage recipe covering pre-training, mid-training, instruction fine-tuning, and quantization-aware training, all on open-source datasets. Across 14 benchmarks, MobileMoE matches or exceeds leading on-device dense LLMs with 2-4$\times$ fewer inference FLOPs, and matches or surpasses the state-of-the-art MoE OLMoE-1B-7B with up to 60% fewer parameters. To bridge the last mile to mobile deployment, we provide the first efficient MoE inference on commodity smartphones with comprehensive on-device profiling. At comparable INT4 weight memory, MobileMoE-S delivers $1.8$-$3.8\times$ faster prefill and $2.2$-$3.4\times$ faster decode than the dense baseline MobileLLM-Pro.

</details>


### [406] [Reformulation of RBM to Unify Linear and Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.08210)
*Jiangsheng You,Chun-Yen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过最大后验估计和EM算法，证明了无MCMC的对比散度算法在条件似然目标函数下的收敛性，并将受限玻尔兹曼机重新表述为确定性模型，使其适用于标量和向量变量的线性和非线性降维，在CIFAR-10和多元序列数据上展示了优于PCA的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RBM依赖概率解释和MCMC采样，CD算法虽高效但缺乏收敛性数学证明，且RBM难以自然处理向量值节点（如彩色图像和多元序列数据）。本文旨在从理论上证明CD算法的收敛性，并扩展RBM的适用性。

Method: 利用MAP估计和EM算法框架，证明无MCMC的CD算法对条件似然目标函数的收敛性；将RBM重新表述为确定性模型，移除概率解释和MCMC依赖，使CD算法等同于梯度下降法，并允许灵活选择激活函数处理标量和向量节点。

Result: 数值实验表明，该确定性RBM在線性和非线性降维任务上均有效，通过选择适当的激活函数可在非线性降维中超越PCA；成功应用于CIFAR-10彩色图像和多元序列数据的向量值节点处理，这是传统RBM难以自然实现的。

Conclusion: 该工作为传统RBM提供了理论见解，统一了标量和向量变量的线性和非线性降维框架，拓展了RBM的应用范围。

Abstract: A restricted Boltzmann machine (RBM) is a two-layer neural network with shared weights and has been extensively studied for dimensionality reduction, data representation and recommendation systems in the literature. The traditional RBM requires a probabilistic interpretation of the values on both layers and a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) procedure to generate samples during the training. The contrastive divergence (CD) is efficient to train the RBM but its convergence has not been proved mathematically. In this paper, using a maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate and the expectation maximization (EM) algorithm, we show that the CD algorithm without MCMC is convergent for the conditional likelihood object function. Another key contribution in this paper is the reformulation of the RBM into a deterministic model. Within the reformulated RBM, the CD algorithm without MCMC approximates the gradient descent (GD) method. This reformulated RBM can take the continuous scalar and vector variables on the nodes with flexibility in choosing the activation functions. Numerical experiments show its capability in both linear and nonlinear dimensionality reduction, and, for the nonlinear dimensionality reduction, the reformulated RBM can outperform principal component analysis (PCA) by choosing the proper activation functions. Finally, we demonstrate its application to vector-valued nodes for the CIFAR-10 dataset (color images) and the multivariate sequence data, which cannot be configured naturally with the traditional RBM. This work not only provides theoretical insights regarding the traditional RBM but also unifies the linear and nonlinear dimensionality reduction for scalar and vector variables.

</details>


### [407] [Efficient Learning of Mesh-Based Physical Simulation with BSMS-GNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.02573)
*Yadi Cao,Menglei Chai,Minchen Li,Chenfanfu Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BSMS-GNN框架，通过双跨度池化策略（bi-stride）在多尺度图神经网络中实现高效物理模拟，避免了手工粗网格绘制和空间邻近导致的跨边界错误边问题，显著提升精度和计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于多尺度GNN的物理模拟方法依赖人工绘制粗网格或基于空间邻近构建粗层级，这既耗时又可能引入跨几何边界的错误边；同时，大规模网格上的平坦GNN存在节点数量扩展复杂性和过平滑问题。

Method: 受二分图判定启发，提出bi-stride池化策略：在广度优先搜索（BFS）的每隔一个前沿层对节点进行池化，无需手工绘制粗网格，避免空间邻近导致的错误边；每层仅需一次消息传递，并通过插值实现非参数化的池化与逆池化，形成类似U-Net的结构。

Result: 在代表性物理模拟任务上，BSMS-GNN在精度和计算效率方面均显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: Bi-stride池化策略有效解决了多尺度GNN物理模拟中的手工标注和边界错误边问题，同时大幅降低计算成本，为大规模物理模拟提供了高效且准确的解决方案。

Abstract: Learning the physical simulation on large-scale meshes with flat Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and stacking Message Passings (MPs) is challenging due to the scaling complexity w.r.t. the number of nodes and over-smoothing. There has been growing interest in the community to introduce \textit{multi-scale} structures to GNNs for physical simulation. However, current state-of-the-art methods are limited by their reliance on the labor-intensive drawing of coarser meshes or building coarser levels based on spatial proximity, which can introduce wrong edges across geometry boundaries. Inspired by the bipartite graph determination, we propose a novel pooling strategy, \textit{bi-stride} to tackle the aforementioned limitations. Bi-stride pools nodes on every other frontier of the breadth-first search (BFS), without the need for the manual drawing of coarser meshes and avoiding the wrong edges by spatial proximity. Additionally, it enables a one-MP scheme per level and non-parametrized pooling and unpooling by interpolations, resembling U-Nets, which significantly reduces computational costs. Experiments show that the proposed framework, \textit{BSMS-GNN}, significantly outperforms existing methods in terms of both accuracy and computational efficiency in representative physical simulations.

</details>


### [408] [Towards Interpretable Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.13473)
*Anran Li,Rui Liu,Ming Hu,Yuanyuan Chen,Shipeng Wang,Lizhen Cui,Han Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统综述了可解释联邦学习（IFL）领域的研究，提出了独特的IFL分类体系，涵盖模型预测解释、调试支持及数据贡献归因等关键方向，并分析了代表性方法、评估指标与未来展望。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习在金融、医疗等关键任务应用中需要平衡性能、隐私保护与可解释性，但IFL的跨学科特性给新研究者带来入门困难，目前缺乏系统的综述文献来梳理该领域。

Method: 提出首个IFL分类体系，从模型预测解释、模型调试支持、数据贡献归因三个维度对现有工作进行系统分类与综合分析，并梳理评估指标与未来方向。

Result: 建立了IFL领域首个系统性分类框架，覆盖了主流IFL方法，明确了各类方法在可解释性、隐私保护与性能之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: IFL是联邦学习领域的重要新兴方向，本文提供的分类体系与综述为后续研究奠定了基础，未来需发展更通用的IFL技术以平衡多目标需求。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple data owners to build machine learning models collaboratively without exposing their private local data. In order for FL to achieve widespread adoption, it is important to balance the need for performance, privacy-preservation and interpretability, especially in mission critical applications such as finance and healthcare. Thus, interpretable federated learning (IFL) has become an emerging topic of research attracting significant interest from the academia and the industry alike. Its interdisciplinary nature can be challenging for new researchers to pick up. In this paper, we bridge this gap by providing (to the best of our knowledge) the first survey on IFL. We propose a unique IFL taxonomy which covers relevant works enabling FL models to explain the prediction results, support model debugging, and provide insights into the contributions made by individual data owners or data samples, which in turn, is crucial for allocating rewards fairly to motivate active and reliable participation in FL. We conduct comprehensive analysis of the representative IFL approaches, the commonly adopted performance evaluation metrics, and promising directions towards building versatile IFL techniques.

</details>


### [409] [Incremental Gauss-Newton Descent for Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.05560)
*Mikalai Korbit,Mario Zanon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出增量高斯-牛顿下降法（IGND），在标量输出逐样本损失场景下，利用广义高斯-牛顿矩阵秩为1的特性，将阻尼高斯-牛顿方向简化为随机梯度的闭式标量归一化，无需存储或分解曲率矩阵。实验表明IGND对灵敏度缩放具有鲁棒性，可与常见随机优化器竞争或互补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机梯度更新的有效步长严重依赖特征缩放和局部模型灵敏度，而标准高斯-牛顿方法虽能通过曲率信息处理缩放效应，但在小批量形式下需要矩阵-向量乘积、线性求解或结构化近似，计算成本高。本文旨在利用逐样本标量输出损失的特殊结构，推导出无需曲率矩阵存储或分解的闭式更新规则。

Method: 针对标量输出损失逐样本评估的场景，观察到广义高斯-牛顿矩阵秩最多为1，其唯一可能的非零曲率方向与随机梯度对齐。据此将阻尼高斯-牛顿方向简化为随机梯度的闭式标量归一化，得到IGND更新。推导了更新形式，刻画其行为，并与归一化梯度下降、自适应一阶方法、随机Polyak步长及小批量高斯-牛顿更新建立联系。在显式光滑性、对齐性和随机逼近假设下证明IGND的驻点收敛结果。

Result: 在监督学习、尺度鲁棒性控制测试和线性二次型控制案例研究中，IGND相比常见随机优化器展现出对灵敏度缩放更强的鲁棒性，性能具有竞争力或互补性。

Conclusion: IGND作为一种简单增量更新的优化器，在无需曲率矩阵存储和分解的前提下，有效提升了对于灵敏度缩放的鲁棒性，为随机优化提供了一种兼具高斯-牛顿方法优势和计算效率的新选择。

Abstract: Stochastic gradient updates are widely used for their efficiency and scalability, but their effective step sizes can depend strongly on feature scaling and local model sensitivity. Gauss-Newton methods address such scale effects through curvature information, but in their standard mini-batch form they require matrix-vector products, linear solves, or structured approximations. This paper studies the special case of scalar-output losses evaluated one sample at a time. In this setting, the generalized Gauss-Newton matrix has rank at most one, and its only possible nonzero curvature direction is aligned with the stochastic gradient. As a result, the damped Gauss-Newton direction reduces to a closed-form scalar normalization of the sample gradient. The resulting update, Incremental Gauss-Newton Descent (IGND), requires no curvature matrix storage, factorization, or iterative linear solve. We derive the update, characterize its behavior, and relate it to normalized gradient descent, adaptive first-order methods, stochastic Polyak step sizes, and mini-batch Gauss-Newton updates. Under explicit smoothness, alignment, and stochastic approximation assumptions, we prove a stationarity result for the IGND update. Experiments on supervised learning, a controlled test of scale robustness, and a linear-quadratic control case study show that IGND improves robustness to sensitivity scaling and can be competitive with, or complementary to, common stochastic optimizers while retaining a simple incremental update.

</details>


### [410] [Neural Scaling Laws of Deep ReLU and Deep Operator Network: A Theoretical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.00357)
*Hao Liu,Zecheng Zhang,Wenjing Liao,Hayden Schaeffer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个理论框架来量化深度算子网络（如DeepONet）的神经缩放定律，通过分析网络模型大小和训练数据大小与逼近误差和泛化误差之间的关系，为算子学习中的缩放定律提供了部分解释和理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经缩放定律在深度神经网络中广泛存在且对性能至关重要，但完整的理论框架尚未建立，本文旨在填补这一空白，特别是针对深度算子网络这一重要但理论薄弱的领域。

Method: 建立了一个理论框架，通过分析Chen和Chen风格架构（包括DeepONet）的逼近误差和泛化误差，量化了网络模型大小和训练数据大小与这些误差之间的关系，并考虑了输入函数具有低维结构的情况以推导更紧的误差界。

Result: 阐明了深度算子网络的逼近误差和泛化误差与网络模型大小、训练数据大小等关键因素之间的关系；针对低维结构输入函数导出了更紧的误差界；结果同样适用于深度ReLU网络及其他类似结构。

Conclusion: 为算子学习中的神经缩放定律提供了部分理论解释，并为其应用奠定了理论基础。

Abstract: Neural scaling laws play a pivotal role in the performance of deep neural networks and have been observed in a wide range of tasks. However, a complete theoretical framework for understanding these scaling laws remains underdeveloped. In this paper, we explore the neural scaling laws for deep operator networks, which involve learning mappings between function spaces, with a focus on the Chen and Chen style architecture. These approaches, which include the popular Deep Operator Network (DeepONet), approximate the output functions using a linear combination of learnable basis functions and coefficients that depend on the input functions. We establish a theoretical framework to quantify the neural scaling laws by analyzing its approximation and generalization errors. We articulate the relationship between the approximation and generalization errors of deep operator networks and key factors such as network model size and training data size. Moreover, we address cases where input functions exhibit low-dimensional structures, allowing us to derive tighter error bounds. These results also hold for deep ReLU networks and other similar structures. Our results offer a partial explanation of the neural scaling laws in operator learning and provide a theoretical foundation for their applications.

</details>


### [411] [CktGen: Automated Analog Circuit Design with Generative Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.00995)
*Yuxuan Hou,Hehe Fan,Jianrong Zhang,Yue Zhang,Hua Chen,Min Zhou,Faxin Yu,Roger Zimmermann,Yi Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CktGen，一种基于条件变分自编码器的模拟电路自动生成方法，通过解耦编码、对比训练和分类器引导，实现根据目标规格生成多样化有效电路，在公开基准上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模拟电路自动综合方法多采用单目标优化，忽略了同一电路类型在不同应用场景下设计规格的广泛差异。本文旨在利用已有的高质量电路设计，提升模拟电路设计的自动化水平。

Method: 提出CktGen，一种规格条件变分自编码器：(1) 将离散化的规格和电路映射到联合潜在空间；(2) 解耦电路和规格的编码，对齐潜在空间；(3) 采用带过滤掩码的对比训练最大化编码差异；(4) 使用分类器引导和潜在特征对齐促进同规格电路聚类，避免模型退化为简单的一对一映射。

Result: 在公开电路基准上进行综合实验，引入跨模型一致性评估指标，CktGen在多项指标上显著优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过对潜在空间进行规格规范化，可以搜索到满足目标规格的最优电路。本文提出的解耦编码与对比学习方法有效解决了一对多映射问题，为模拟电路自动生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: The automatic synthesis of analog circuits presents significant challenges. Most existing approaches formulate the problem as a single-objective optimization task, overlooking that design specifications for a given circuit type vary widely across applications. To address this, we introduce specification-conditioned analog circuit generation, a task that directly generates analog circuits based on target specifications. The motivation is to leverage existing well-designed circuits to improve automation in analog circuit design. Specifically, we propose CktGen, a simple yet effective variational autoencoder that maps discretized specifications and circuits into a joint latent space and reconstructs the circuit from that latent vector. Notably, as a single specification may correspond to multiple valid circuits, naively fusing specification information into the generative model does not capture these one-to-many relationships. To address this, we decouple the encoding of circuits and specifications and align their mapped latent space. Then, we employ contrastive training with a filter mask to maximize differences between encoded circuits and specifications. Furthermore, classifier guidance along with latent feature alignment promotes the clustering of circuits sharing the same specification, avoiding model collapse into trivial one-to-one mappings. By canonicalizing the latent space with respect to specifications, we can search for an optimal circuit that meets valid target specifications. We conduct comprehensive experiments on the open circuit benchmark and introduce metrics to evaluate cross-model consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that CktGen achieves substantial improvements over state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [412] [CHESTNUT: A QoS Dataset for Mobile Edge Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.19248)
*Guobing Zou,Fei Zhao,Shengxiang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有QoS数据集（如WS-Dream）主要关注静态指标，忽略了时间和地理位置等动态属性。为此，本文提出一个新的数据集，在采集过程中精确记录了QoS的时间与地理位置信息，以支持移动边缘环境下的QoS预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有QoS数据集（如WS-Dream）主要关注静态指标，忽略了时间和地理位置等动态属性，而这些属性对于理解和预测网络服务的实际性能至关重要。

Method: 提出一个新的数据集，在采集过程中精确记录服务质量的时间戳和地理位置信息。

Result: 构建了一个包含时间与地理位置动态属性的新型QoS数据集。

Conclusion: 该数据集能为移动边缘环境下的QoS预测提供更准确可靠的数据支持。

Abstract: Quality of Service (QoS) is an important metric to measure the performance of network services. Nowadays, it is widely used in mobile edge environments to evaluate the quality of service when mobile devices request services from edge servers. QoS usually involves multiple dimensions, such as bandwidth, latency, jitter, and data packet loss rate. However, most existing QoS datasets, such as the common WS-Dream dataset, focus mainly on static QoS metrics of network services and ignore dynamic attributes such as time and geographic location. This means they should have detailed the mobile device's location at the time of the service request or the chronological order in which the request was made. However, these dynamic attributes are crucial for understanding and predicting the actual performance of network services, as QoS performance typically fluctuates with time and geographic location. To this end, we propose a novel dataset that accurately records temporal and geographic location information on quality of service during the collection process, aiming to provide more accurate and reliable data to support future QoS prediction in mobile edge environments.

</details>


### [413] ["Give Me BF16 or Give Me Death"? Accuracy-Performance Trade-Offs in LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.02355)
*Eldar Kurtic,Alexandre Marques,Shubhra Pandit,Mark Kurtz,Dan Alistarh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过对Llama-3.1全系列模型进行50万次以上评估，系统比较了FP8、INT8和INT4量化格式在学术基准和实际任务中的精度与性能权衡，提供了面向不同部署场景的量化格式选择指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化是加速大模型推理的有效手段，但不同量化格式（FP8、INT8、INT4）在精度与性能之间的权衡关系尚不明确，缺乏系统性的实证研究来指导实际部署选择。

Method: 在Llama-3.1全模型家族上，通过50万次以上的评估，系统比较FP8、INT8和INT4量化格式在学术基准和实际任务中的表现，并利用vLLM框架分析不同部署场景（同步、异步连续批处理、混合工作负载）下的推理性能。

Result: (1) FP8(W8A8-FP)在所有模型规模上接近无损；(2) 调优后的INT8(W8A8-INT)精度损失仅1-3%；(3) INT4权重量化(W4A16-INT)竞争力超出预期，可与8-bit量化媲美。W4A16在同步场景下成本效益最优，W8A8在异步连续批处理中占优，混合工作负载的选择取决于具体用例。

Conclusion: 研究为大规模部署量化LLM提供了基于数据的实用指南，帮助在实际应用中实现速度、效率和精度的最佳平衡。

Abstract: Quantization is a powerful tool for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference, but the accuracy-performance trade-offs across different formats remain unclear. In this paper, we conduct the most comprehensive empirical study to date, evaluating FP8, INT8, and INT4 quantization across academic benchmarks and real-world tasks on the entire Llama-3.1 model family. Through over 500,000 evaluations, our investigation yields several key findings: (1) FP8 (W8A8-FP) is effectively lossless across all model scales, (2) well-tuned INT8 (W8A8-INT) achieves surprisingly low (1-3\%) accuracy degradation, and (3) INT4 weight-only (W4A16-INT) is more competitive than expected, rivaling 8-bit quantization. Further, we investigate the optimal quantization format for different deployments by analyzing inference performance through the popular vLLM framework. Our analysis provides clear deployment recommendations: W4A16 is the most cost-efficient for synchronous setups, while W8A8 dominates in asynchronous continuous batching. For mixed workloads, the optimal choice depends on the specific use case. Our findings offer practical, data-driven guidelines for deploying quantized LLMs at scale -- ensuring the best balance between speed, efficiency, and accuracy.

</details>


### [414] [Evaluating Sample Utility for Efficient Data Selection by Mimicking Model Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06708)
*Tzu-Heng Huang,Manjot Bilkhu,John Cooper,Frederic Sala,Javier Movellan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Mimic Score指标和Grad-Mimic框架，基于几何方法衡量数据质量，通过梯度对齐度评估样本效用，避免依赖人工启发式、下游数据集或昂贵计算，在六个图像数据集上提升数据效率和收敛速度，使CLIP模型训练步骤减少20.7%、样本减少470万。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模网络爬取数据存在噪声、偏差和无关信息，需要数据选择技术。现有方法依赖手工启发式规则、下游数据集或昂贵的基于影响力的计算，这些都限制了可扩展性并引入了不必要的数据依赖。

Method: 提出Mimic Score，一种基于几何的数据质量指标，通过计算样本梯度与预训练参考模型诱导的目标方向之间的对齐程度来评估效用。在此基础上构建Grad-Mimic两阶段框架：在线阶段对样本重新加权以加速训练，离线阶段聚合样本效用以构建有效的数据过滤器。

Result: 在六个图像数据集上，Mimic Score引导的训练提升了数据效率、加速收敛并取得一致性能提升；CLIP模型训练步骤减少20.7%；基于Mimic Score的过滤器可增强现有过滤技术，用减少470万样本训练出更优的CLIP模型。

Conclusion: Mimic Score和Grad-Mimic框架是一种简单、可扩展且有效的数据质量评估与选择方法，能够在不依赖人工启发式或下游数据集的情况下，显著提升模型训练效率和性能。

Abstract: Large-scale web-crawled datasets contain noise, bias, and irrelevant information, necessitating data selection techniques. Existing methods depend on hand-crafted heuristics, downstream datasets, or require expensive influence-based computations -- all of which limit scalability and introduce unwanted data dependencies. To address this, we introduce the Mimic Score, a simple and geometry-based data-quality metric that evaluates utility by measuring alignment between a sample's gradients and a target direction induced by a pre-trained reference model. This leverages readily available model weights, avoids needing validation datasets, and incurs minimal computational overheads. Building on this metric, we propose Grad-Mimic, a two-stage framework that re-weights samples online to accelerate training and aggregates sample utilities offline to construct effective data filters. Empirically, we show that using mimic scores to guide training improves data efficiency, accelerates convergence, yields consistent performance gains across six image datasets, and enhances CLIP models with 20.7% fewer training steps. Additionally, mimic score-based filters augment existing filtering techniques, enabling improved CLIP models trained with 4.7 million fewer samples.

</details>


### [415] [CleanSurvival: Automated data preprocessing for time-to-event models using reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.03946)
*Yousef Koka,David Selby,Gerrit Großmann,Kathan Pandya,Sebastian Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CleanSurvival，一个基于强化学习（Q-learning）的数据预处理优化框架，专门针对生存分析（时间-事件模型）中的缺失值插补、异常值检测和特征提取等预处理步骤进行自动化优化，实验表明其能提升模型预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AutoML流水线已开始整合数据预处理，但针对生存分析（删失数据的时间-事件模型）缺乏专门的自动化预处理解决方案，而生存分析面临的数据预处理挑战既具有一般性又缺乏定制化工具。

Method: 基于Learn2Clean的Q-learning强化学习框架，自动选择数据插补、异常值检测和特征提取技术的最优组合，适用于Cox回归、随机森林、神经网络或用户自定义的时间-事件模型，可处理连续和分类变量。

Result: 在真实数据集上，Q-learning驱动的数据预处理相比简单基线方法能提升预测性能；运行时行为取决于条件；模拟实验表明在不同类型和水平的缺失与噪声下均有效。

Conclusion: CleanSurvival填补了生存分析领域自动化预处理的空白，能够使生存研究更简便、快速且结果更稳健；推广AutoML流水线到包括生存分析在内的多样化模型具有重要意义。

Abstract: Data preprocessing is often paid little attention in machine learning, despite its potentially significant impact on model performance. While automated machine learning pipelines are starting to recognize and integrate data preprocessing into their solutions for classification and regression tasks, this integration is lacking for more specialized tasks like time-to-event models for censored data. As a result, survival analysis not only faces the general challenges of data preprocessing but also suffers from the lack of tailored, automated solutions in this area. To address this gap, this paper presents CleanSurvival, a reinforcement-learning-based solution for optimizing preprocessing pipelines, extended specifically for survival analysis. The framework can handle continuous and categorical variables. It builds upon Learn2Clean's Q-learning to select which combination of data imputation, outlier detection and feature extraction techniques achieves optimal performance for a Cox, random forest, neural network or user-supplied time-to-event model. The Python package is available on GitHub: https://github.com/datasciapps/CleanSurvival. Experimental benchmarks on real-world datasets show that the Q-learning-based data preprocessing can improve predictive performance relative to simple baselines, while runtime behavior is condition-dependent and most clearly interpretable in the best-covered benchmark cells. Furthermore, a simulation study demonstrates effectiveness across different types and levels of missingness and noise. With an increase in the use of machine learning, it becomes important to generalise AutoML pipelines to a variety of models now present, including survival analysis. Tools like CleanSurvival, which integrate preprocessing for survival analysis, can make survival studies easier and quicker to perform, as well as make the results more robust.

</details>


### [416] [Intelligent Offloading in Vehicular Edge Computing: A Comprehensive Review of Deep Reinforcement Learning Approaches and Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06963)
*Ashab Uddin,Ahmed Hamdi Sakr,Ning Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述了基于深度强化学习（DRL）的车辆边缘计算（VEC）计算卸载策略，从学习范式、系统架构和优化目标三个维度对现有工作进行分类比较，并分析了MDP建模、奖励设计、协调机制和可扩展性等关键问题，最后指出了开放挑战和未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能交通系统（ITS）日益复杂，计算卸载到边缘服务器、车辆节点和无人机等外部基础设施的需求显著增加。传统卸载策略难以适应动态异构环境，而强化学习和深度强化学习提供了自适应决策框架，因此需要对该领域的研究进展进行系统综述。

Method: 采用综述研究方法，对基于DRL的VEC卸载工作进行分类：按学习范式（单智能体、多智能体）、系统架构（集中式、分布式、分层式）和优化目标（延迟、能耗、公平性）进行对比分析；同时分析MDP建模方式、奖励设计、协调机制和可扩展性等关键方面。

Result: 系统梳理了DRL在VEC卸载中的应用现状，建立了多维度分类框架，总结了不同范式、架构和目标下的方法优劣，并揭示了当前在奖励设计、协调机制和可扩展性方面的技术趋势。

Conclusion: DRL为VEC中的计算卸载提供了有效的自适应决策方案，但仍面临开放性挑战，未来需进一步研究鲁棒、智能的卸载策略以推动下一代ITS的发展。

Abstract: The increasing complexity of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) has led to significant interest in computational offloading to external infrastructures such as edge servers, vehicular nodes, and UAVs. These dynamic and heterogeneous environments pose challenges for traditional offloading strategies, prompting the exploration of Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) as adaptive decision-making frameworks. This survey presents a comprehensive review of recent advances in DRL-based offloading for vehicular edge computing (VEC). We classify and compare existing works based on learning paradigms (e.g., single-agent, multi-agent), system architectures (e.g., centralized, distributed, hierarchical), and optimization objectives (e.g., latency, energy, fairness). Furthermore, we analyze how Markov Decision Process (MDP) formulations are applied and highlight emerging trends in reward design, coordination mechanisms, and scalability. Finally, we identify open challenges and outline future research directions to guide the development of robust and intelligent offloading strategies for next-generation ITS.

</details>


### [417] [Yes, Q-learning Helps Offline In-Context RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.17666)
*Denis Tarasov,Alexander Nikulin,Ilya Zisman,Albina Klepach,Andrei Polubarov,Nikita Lyubaykin,Alexander Derevyagin,Igor Kiselev,Vladislav Kurenkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在离线上下文强化学习（ICRL）中引入RL目标（而非仅用监督学习），在150+数据集上平均比AD提升约30%性能，且在XLand-MiniGrid中性能翻倍，同时发现价值学习中添加保守性约束能带来额外收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线ICRL方法主要依赖监督训练目标，但在离线RL场景中存在局限性，亟需探索更符合RL奖励最大化目标的训练方式。

Method: 在离线ICRL框架中整合RL目标（而非仅用监督学习），并在价值学习中引入保守性约束，在GridWorld和MuJoCo衍生的150+数据集上进行实验验证。

Result: 优化RL目标相比AD平均提升约30%性能；在XLand-MiniGrid中性能翻倍；添加保守性约束在几乎所有测试场景中带来额外提升。

Conclusion: ICRL的学习目标应与RL的奖励最大化目标对齐，离线RL是推进ICRL发展的有前景方向。

Abstract: Existing offline in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) methods have predominantly relied on supervised training objectives, which are known to have limitations in offline RL settings. In this study, we explore the integration of RL objectives within an offline ICRL framework. Through experiments on more than 150 GridWorld and MuJoCo environment-derived datasets, we demonstrate that optimizing RL objectives directly improves performance by approximately 30% on average compared to widely adopted Algorithm Distillation (AD), across various dataset coverages, structures, expertise levels, and environmental complexities. Furthermore, in the challenging XLand-MiniGrid environment, RL objectives doubled the performance of AD. Our results also reveal that the addition of conservatism during value learning brings additional improvements in almost all settings tested. Our findings emphasize the importance of aligning ICRL learning objectives with the RL reward-maximization goal, and demonstrate that offline RL is a promising direction for advancing ICRL.

</details>


### [418] [An uncertainty-aware Bayesian framework for machine learning classification models: A case study in land cover classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.21510)
*Samuel Bilson,Miles McCrory,Anna Pustogvar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯二次判别分析（BQDA）框架，将输入测量不确定性纳入生成式ML分类模型，并在真实和合成数据集上验证了其相比随机森林和神经网络更具可解释性、计算效率更高且预测性能相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前不确定性量化研究主要关注ML模型的认知不确定性，而很少考虑输入测量不确定性。在计量学中，输入测量不确定性的可追溯性至关重要，因此需要一种能够同时建模输入测量不确定性的分类框架。

Method: 提出贝叶斯框架用于生成式ML分类模型，具体采用贝叶斯二次判别分析（BQDA）模型，将输入测量不确定性纳入建模过程，并在Copernicus Sentinel-2土地覆盖数据集及合成分类数据上进行验证。

Result: 在真实和合成数据上，BQDA模型比随机森林和神经网络更具可解释性，能显式建模输入测量不确定性，在不同领域和规模的数据集上保持类别概率输出的预测性能，且计算效率更高。

Conclusion: BQDA模型在兼顾预测性能的同时，显著提升了模型的可信度（可解释性、不确定性建模能力）和计算效率，是一种更值得信赖的ML分类方法。

Abstract: Ensuring that predictions of machine learning (ML) classification models are accompanied by uncertainty estimates is one of the main pillars of trustworthy AI. Current research in uncertainty quantification focuses mainly on epistemic uncertainty of the ML model, but rarely takes account of input measurement uncertainty, which is vital for traceability in metrology. In this work we propose a Bayesian framework for generative ML classification models that takes account of input measurement uncertainty. We take the specific case of a Bayesian quadratic discriminant analysis (BQDA) model, and apply it to metrological land cover datasets from Copernicus Sentinel-2 from 2020 and 2021. We benchmark the performance of the model against more popular classification models used in land cover maps such as random forests and neural networks. To validate and assess the generalisability of such a model, we also run simulations over synthetic classification data, varying distribution type and strength of the input measurement noise. We find for both real and synthetic data, the BQDA model presented is more trustworthy, in the sense that it is more interpretable, explicitly models the input measurement uncertainty, and maintains predictive performance of class probability outputs across datasets over different domains and sizes, whilst also being more computationally efficient.

</details>


### [419] [Generating realistic global precipitation fields from modelled atmospheric circulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.00307)
*Michael Aich,Sebastian Bathiany,Philipp Hess,Yu Huang,Niklas Boers*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于条件扩散模型与UNet架构的生成式机器学习方法，从少量全球大气变量中生成高分辨率（0.25°）全球日降水场，作为地球系统模型中传统参数化方案的替代，能够高效生成集合预报并减少降水偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球系统模型（ESMs）中降水参数化方案分辨率低、计算昂贵、忽略空间相互作用，且存在显著偏差，亟需一种高效、高精度且能捕捉不确定性的替代方法。

Method: 采用条件扩散模型结合UNet架构，以ERA5再分析数据训练，从少量全球预报大气变量生成0.25°全球日降水场；提出一种方法将模型应用于未见过的ESM数据，实现概率预报和气候情景的快速生成。

Result: 模型能生成高分辨率降水场，有效缓解ESM降水偏差，同时保持与大尺度年际趋势的一致性；可高效生成集合预报，捕捉降水不确定性。

Conclusion: 复杂降水模式可直接从大尺度大气变量中学习，该方法为ESM提供了一种计算高效的降水参数化替代方案，无需以高分辨率运行动力模型即可获得高分辨率降水。

Abstract: Improving the representation of precipitation in Earth system models (ESMs) is critical for assessing the impacts of climate change and especially of extreme events like floods and droughts. In existing ESMs, precipitation is not resolved explicitly, but represented by parameterizations. These typically rely on resolving approximated but computationally expensive column-based physics, not accounting for interactions between locations. They struggle to capture fine-scale precipitation processes and introduce significant biases. We present a novel approach, based on generative machine learning, which integrates a conditional diffusion model with a UNet architecture to generate accurate, high-resolution (0.25°) global daily precipitation fields from a small set of prognostic atmospheric variables. Unlike traditional parameterizations, our framework efficiently produces ensemble predictions, capturing uncertainties in precipitation, and does not require fine-tuning by hand. We train our model on the ERA5 reanalysis and present a method that allows us to apply it to unseen ESM data, enabling fast generation of probabilistic forecasts and climate scenarios. By leveraging interactions between global prognostic variables, our approach provides an alternative parameterization scheme that mitigates biases present in the ESM precipitation while maintaining consistency with its large-scale (annual) trends. This work demonstrates that complex precipitation patterns can be learned directly from large-scale atmospheric variables, offering a computationally efficient method to obtain high-resolution precipitation without the cost of running the dynamical model at such high resolution.

</details>


### [420] [PLAID: A Unified Data Model for Machine Learning on Heterogeneous Physics Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.02974)
*Fabien Casenave,Xavier Roynard,Brian Staber,Alexandre Devaux-Rivière,William Piat,Michele Alessandro Bucci,Nissrine Akkari,Abbas Kabalan,Xuan Minh Vuong Nguyen,Luca Saverio,Raphaël Carpintero Perez,Anthony Kalaydjian,Samy Fouché,Thierry Gonon,Ghassan Najjar,Thomas Daniel,Emmanuel Menier,Matthieu Nastorg,Giovanni Catalani,Christian Rey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PLAID是一个统一可扩展的物理仿真数据模型，包含标准化数据集和工具库，旨在解决机器学习代理模型在物理仿真领域缺乏大规模、异构标准化数据集的瓶颈问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准数据集多聚焦狭窄领域或使用简化数据模型，无法捕捉真实场景中几何、网格和拓扑的异构性，限制了机器学习代理模型在物理仿真中的泛化能力评估和实际应用。

Method: 提出PLAID统一数据层，保留仿真数据完整复杂性的同时支持高效ML工作流；配套开源数据集构建与操作库；发布6个覆盖结构力学和计算流体力学的数据集；集成Hugging Face提供可复现评估协议和社区驱动基准测试。

Result: 开发了PLAID数据模型与开源库(github.com/PLAID-lib/plaid)，发布了6个面向工业场景的标准化数据集，并建立了基于Hugging Face的开放社区基准测试平台(huggingface.co/PLAIDcompetitions)。

Conclusion: PLAID通过统一数据层和标准化基准，有效弥补了物理仿真ML数据集在异构性和规模上的不足，为评估和推动机器学习代理模型的真实场景泛化能力提供了基础设施。

Abstract: Machine learning-based surrogate models have emerged as a powerful tool to accelerate simulation-driven scientific workflows, but their adoption is limited by the lack of large-scale, diverse, and standardized datasets for physics-based simulations. Existing benchmarks often focus on narrow domains or rely on simplified data models, and fail to capture the heterogeneity arising from variable geometries, meshes, and topologies, which is critical for assessing generalization in realistic settings. We introduce PLAID (Physics-Learning AI Data model), a unified and extensible data layer for heterogeneous physics simulations. It preserves the full complexity of simulation data while enabling efficient and scalable machine learning workflows, together with a library for dataset construction and manipulation~(\href{https://github.com/PLAID-lib/plaid}{github.com/PLAID-lib/plaid}). We release six datasets covering structural mechanics and computational fluid dynamics, designed to reflect realistic industrial scenarios and provide standardized benchmarks. The framework includes reproducible evaluation protocols and is integrated with Hugging Face to enable open, community-driven benchmarking with active user participation (\href{https://huggingface.co/PLAIDcompetitions}{huggingface.co/PLAIDcompetitions}).

</details>


### [421] [Beyond Semantics: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Reasonless Intermediate Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13775)
*Karthik Valmeekam,Vardhan Palod,Kaya Stechly,Atharva Gundawar,Subbarao Kambhampati*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验发现，Transformer模型在形式化可验证推理任务上，即使使用完全正确的推理轨迹训练，仍可能产生无效推理；使用随机破坏的推理轨迹训练与使用正确轨迹效果相当，甚至泛化更好；GRPO强化学习后处理虽提升答案正确性但不改善轨迹有效性；推理轨迹长度与问题计算复杂度无关。这些结果质疑了Chain of Thought（CoT）中间token反映或诱导可预测推理行为的假设，警告不要对模型输出进行拟人化或过度解读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究对CoT推理轨迹的作用存在分歧：一方面有工作赋予其语义解释，另一方面有研究警告其不能作为模型内部计算过程的透明忠实代理。作者旨在通过受控实验系统探究推理轨迹的端用户语义对模型性能的实际影响。

Method: 从零开始训练Transformer模型，使用形式化可验证推理轨迹及对应解决方案；设置多种训练条件：仅解决方案、完全正确轨迹、随机破坏轨迹（中间步骤与问题无关）；并采用GRPO强化学习进行后训练，分析轨迹有效性。

Result: (1) 正确轨迹训练优于仅解决方案基线，但模型仍可能产生无效推理轨迹；(2) 使用随机破坏轨迹训练与正确轨迹训练性能相似，且在分布外任务上泛化更好；(3) GRPO后训练提升答案准确率但不改善轨迹有效性；(4) 推理轨迹长度与问题计算复杂度无关。

Conclusion: 研究结果挑战了CoT中间token反映或诱导可预测推理行为的假设，警示不要对语言模型的输出进行拟人化或过度解读，即使它们表面上看起来合理。

Abstract: Recent impressive results from large reasoning models have been interpreted as a triumph of Chain of Thought (CoT), and especially of the process of training on CoTs sampled from base LLMs in order to help find new reasoning patterns. While these traces certainly seem to help model performance, it is not clear how they influence it, with some works ascribing semantics to them and others cautioning against relying on them as transparent and faithful proxies of the model's internal computational process. To systematically investigate the role of end-user semantics of derivational traces, we set up a controlled study where we train transformer models from scratch on formally verifiable reasoning traces and the solutions they lead to. We notice that, despite gains over the solution-only baseline, models trained on entirely correct traces can still produce invalid reasoning traces even when arriving at correct solutions. More interestingly, our experiments also show that models trained on corrupted traces, whose intermediate reasoning steps bear no relation to the problem they accompany, perform similarly to those trained on correct ones, and even generalize better on out-of-distribution tasks. We also study the effect of GRPO-based RL post-training on trace validity, noting that while solution accuracy increases, this is not accompanied by improvements in trace validity. Finally, we examine whether reasoning-trace length reflects inference-time scaling and find that trace length is largely agnostic to the underlying computational complexity of the problem being solved. These results challenge the assumption that intermediate tokens or ``Chains of Thought'' reflect or induce predictable reasoning behaviors and caution against anthropomorphizing such outputs or over-interpreting them (despite their mostly seemingly forms) as evidence of human-like or algorithmic behaviors in language models.

</details>


### [422] [OCR-Reasoning Benchmark: Unveiling the True Capabilities of MLLMs in Complex Text-Rich Image Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17163)
*Mingxin Huang,Yongxin Shi,Dezhi Peng,Songxuan Lai,Zecheng Xie,Lianwen Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了OCR-Reasoning基准，一个专门评估多模态大模型在文本丰富图像中推理能力的系统化基准，包含1,069个人工标注样本、6种核心推理能力和18项推理任务，并额外提供逐步推理过程作为标注。评估表明最先进的MLLM在该基准上准确率均低于50%，揭示了文本丰富图像推理任务的巨大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态慢思考系统在视觉推理任务中表现优异，但在文本丰富图像推理任务上的能力缺乏专门的系统性基准来评估。

Method: 构建OCR-Reasoning基准，包含1,069个人工标注样本，覆盖6种核心推理能力和18项实际推理任务；不仅提供最终答案，还额外标注了逐步推理过程，支持对模型答案和推理过程的全方位评估。

Result: 最先进的MLLMs在该基准上准确率均低于50%，表明文本丰富图像推理任务仍面临巨大挑战。

Conclusion: 文本丰富图像推理是一个亟待解决的紧迫问题，现有MLLMs在该任务上表现远未令人满意。

Abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal slow-thinking systems have demonstrated remarkable performance across various visual reasoning tasks. However, their capabilities in text-rich image reasoning tasks remain understudied due to the absence of a dedicated and systematic benchmark. To address this gap, we propose OCR-Reasoning, a novel benchmark designed to systematically assess Multimodal Large Language Models on text-rich image reasoning tasks. Specifically, OCR-Reasoning comprises 1,069 human-annotated examples spanning 6 core reasoning abilities and 18 practical reasoning tasks in text-rich visual scenarios. Unlike existing text-rich image understanding benchmarks that only provide a final answer, this benchmark additionally provides a detailed step-by-step reasoning process. This dual annotation enables the evaluation of both the models' final answers and their reasoning processes, thereby offering a holistic assessment of text-rich reasoning capabilities. By leveraging this benchmark, we conducted a comprehensive evaluation of the latest MLLMs. Our results demonstrate that even the most advanced MLLMs exhibit substantial difficulties in text-rich image reasoning tasks, with none achieving an accuracy above 50\% on our benchmark, indicating that the challenges of text-rich image reasoning are an urgent issue to be addressed. The benchmark and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/OCR-Reasoning.

</details>


### [423] [Message-Passing State-Space Models: Improving Graph Learning with Modern Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18728)
*Andrea Ceni,Alessio Gravina,Claudio Gallicchio,Davide Bacciu,Carola-Bibiane Schonlieb,Moshe Eliasof*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MP-SSM，将状态空间模型的计算原理嵌入消息传递神经网络框架中，统一处理静态和时态图，实现高效、置换等变的长程信息传播，并具备精确的敏感性分析能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图状态空间模型（GSSM）通过在图上提取序列后应用SSM模块，这往往损害置换等变性、消息传递兼容性和计算效率，因此需要一种更统一且保留图结构特性的方法。

Method: 将现代SSM计算的核心原则直接嵌入消息传递神经网络框架中，提出MP-SSM。该方法在保持消息传递架构简洁性的同时，实现了高效、置换等变和长程信息传播，并支持精确的敏感性分析来表征信息流和评估深层问题（如梯度消失和过挤压）。

Result: 在节点分类、图属性预测、长程基准和时空预测等广泛任务上验证了MP-SSM的通用性和强实证性能。

Conclusion: MP-SSM成功统一了静态图和时态图的处理方法，在保留置换等变性和消息传递兼容性的同时，实现了高效的长程信息传播和精确的理论分析能力。

Abstract: The recent success of State-Space Models (SSMs) in sequence modeling has motivated their adaptation to graph learning, giving rise to Graph State-Space Models (GSSMs). However, existing GSSMs operate by applying SSM modules to sequences extracted from graphs, often compromising core properties such as permutation equivariance, message-passing compatibility, and computational efficiency. In this paper, we introduce a new perspective by embedding the key principles of modern SSM computation directly into the Message-Passing Neural Network framework, resulting in a unified methodology for both static and temporal graphs. Our approach, MP-SSM, enables efficient, permutation-equivariant, and long-range information propagation while preserving the architectural simplicity of message passing. Crucially, MP-SSM enables an exact sensitivity analysis, which we use to theoretically characterize information flow and evaluate issues like vanishing gradients and over-squashing in the deep regime. Furthermore, our design choices allow for a highly optimized parallel implementation akin to modern SSMs. We validate MP-SSM across a wide range of tasks, including node classification, graph property prediction, long-range benchmarks, and spatiotemporal forecasting, demonstrating both its versatility and strong empirical performance.

</details>


### [424] [Learnable Kernel Density Estimation for Graphs and Its Application to Graph-Level Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.21285)
*Xudong Wang,Ziheng Sun,Chris Ding,Jicong Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LGKDE框架，利用图神经网络和最大均值差异学习图核密度估计，通过最大化密度与扰动图密度之比来训练，在理论保证和异常检测任务上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图密度估计的关键挑战在于同时捕捉结构模式和语义变化并保持理论保证。现有的图核与KDE结合方法因使用手工特征而性能不佳。

Method: LGKDE使用图神经网络将每个图表示为离散分布，利用最大均值差异学习多尺度KDE的图度量；通过对节点特征和图谱进行扰动，最大化密度与扰动图密度之比来学习所有参数。
