Result: 在合成图分布上有效恢复潜在密度，在图异常检测基准数据集上优于最先进基线方法。

Conclusion: LGKDE具有理论上的均方积分误差界、鲁棒性和泛化保证，实证上在多数数据集上表现最优。

Abstract: This work proposes a framework LGKDE that learns kernel density estimation for graphs. The key challenge in graph density estimation lies in effectively capturing both structural patterns and semantic variations while maintaining theoretical guarantees. Combining graph kernels and kernel density estimation (KDE) is a standard approach to graph density estimation, but has unsatisfactory performance due to the handcrafted and fixed features of kernels. Our method LGKDE leverages graph neural networks to represent each graph as a discrete distribution and utilizes maximum mean discrepancy to learn the graph metric for multi-scale KDE, where all parameters are learned by maximizing the density of graphs relative to the density of their well-designed perturbed counterparts. The perturbations are conducted on both node features and graph spectra, which helps better characterize the boundary of normal density regions. Theoretically, we establish consistency and convergence guarantees for LGKDE, including bounds on the mean integrated squared error, robustness, and generalization. We validate LGKDE by demonstrating its effectiveness in recovering the underlying density of synthetic graph distributions and applying it to graph anomaly detection across diverse benchmark datasets. Extensive empirical evaluation shows that LGKDE demonstrates superior performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines on most benchmark datasets.

</details>


### [425] [Muddit: Liberating Generation Beyond Text-to-Image with a Unified Discrete Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23606)
*Qingyu Shi,Jinbin Bai,Zhuoran Zhao,Wenhao Chai,Kaidong Yu,Jianzong Wu,Yunhai Tong,Xiangtai Li,Xuelong Li,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Muddit 是第二代 Meissonic，一种统一离散扩散 Transformer，通过整合预训练文本到图像骨干网络和轻量文本解码器，实现跨文本和图像模态的快速并行生成，在质量和效率上媲美或超越更大的自回归模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一生成模型旨在单一架构中处理多种模态任务，但自回归模型推理速度慢（顺序解码），非自回归模型因缺乏预训练骨干而泛化能力弱。现有统一扩散模型通常从零训练，效率低下。

Method: 提出 Muddit（第二代 Meissonic），一种统一离散扩散 Transformer。利用预训练文本到图像模型的强视觉先验，结合轻量文本解码器，在统一架构下实现灵活多模态生成。

Result: 在质量和效率方面，Muddit 达到了与更大规模自回归模型竞争或更优的性能。

Conclusion: 纯离散扩散模型在配备强视觉先验时，可作为统一生成的可扩展且有效的骨干架构，具有潜力。

Abstract: Unified generation models aim to handle diverse tasks across modalities -- such as text generation, image generation, and vision-language reasoning -- within a single architecture and decoding paradigm. Autoregressive unified models suffer from slow inference due to sequential decoding, and non-autoregressive unified models suffer from weak generalization due to limited pretrained backbones. We introduce the second-generation Meissonic: Muddit, a unified discrete diffusion transformer that enables fast and parallel generation across both text and image modalities. Unlike prior unified diffusion models trained from scratch, Muddit integrates strong visual priors from a pretrained text-to-image backbone with a lightweight text decoder, enabling flexible and high-quality multimodal generation under a unified architecture. Empirical results show that Muddit achieves competitive or superior performance compared to significantly larger autoregressive models in both quality and efficiency. The work highlights the potential of purely discrete diffusion, when equipped with strong visual priors, as a scalable and effective backbone for unified generation.

</details>


### [426] [Efficient Prediction of SO(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Matrices via SO(2) Local Frames](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09398)
*Haiyang Yu,Yuchao Lin,Xuan Zhang,Xiaofeng Qian,Shuiwang Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出QHNetV2，通过SO(2)局部框架和SO(2)等变操作实现全局SO(3)等变的哈密顿矩阵预测，避免了昂贵的SO(3) Clebsch-Gordan张量积，在QH9和MD17数据集上取得优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加速电子结构计算中哈密顿矩阵的预测，避免传统SO(3)等变网络中使用Clebsch-Gordan张量积带来的高计算成本，同时保持全局对称性。

Method: 利用哈密顿矩阵非对角块与SO(2)局部框架的内在关系，设计SO(2)等变操作，在SO(2)局部框架内完成所有非对角特征更新和消息传递，并在每个节点执行连续SO(2)张量积来融合节点特征。

Result: 在QH9和MD17大型数据集上，模型在多种分子结构和轨迹上均表现出优越性能，泛化能力强。

Conclusion: SO(2)局部框架上的SO(2)等变操作为可扩展且对称感知的电子结构学习提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: We consider the task of predicting Hamiltonian matrices to accelerate electronic structure calculations, which plays an important role in physics, chemistry, and materials science. Motivated by the inherent relationship between the off-diagonal blocks of the Hamiltonian matrix and the SO(2) local frame, we propose a novel and efficient network, called QHNetV2, that achieves global SO(3) equivariance without the costly SO(3) Clebsch-Gordan tensor products. This is achieved by introducing a set of new efficient and powerful SO(2)-equivariant operations and performing all off-diagonal feature updates and message passing within SO(2) local frames, thereby eliminating the need of SO(3) tensor products. Moreover, a continuous SO(2) tensor product is performed within the SO(2) local frame at each node to fuse node features, mimicking the symmetric contraction operation. Extensive experiments on the large QH9 and MD17 datasets demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance across a wide range of molecular structures and trajectories, highlighting its strong generalization capability. The proposed SO(2) operations on SO(2) local frames offer a promising direction for scalable and symmetry-aware learning of electronic structures. Our code will be released as part of the AIRS library https://github.com/divelab/AIRS.

</details>


### [427] [Athena: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning with Data-efficient Process Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09532)
*Shuai Wang,Zhenhua Liu,Jiaheng Wei,Xuanwu Yin,Dong Li,Emad Barsoum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Athena-PRM 是一种多模态过程奖励模型，通过利用弱完成器和强完成器之间的预测一致性来高效生成高质量的过程标注数据，仅需5000个样本即可在多种场景下实现卓越性能，并在多个基准测试上取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发高性能PRM通常需要大量时间和资金投入，因为需要步骤级的人工标注；而传统自动标注方法如蒙特卡洛估计会产生噪声标签且计算成本高。本文旨在高效生成高质量过程标注数据以降低PRM开发成本。

Method: 提出利用弱完成器和强完成器之间的预测一致性作为识别可靠过程标签的标准；同时开发了ORM初始化和负样本上采样两种有效策略来提升PRM性能。

Result: Athena-PRM仅用5000样本即在多个基准上表现优异：在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，测试时缩放提升WeMath 10.2点、MathVista 7.1点；在VisualProcessBench上以3.9 F1-score超越先前SoTA。

Conclusion: Athena-PRM在验证测试时缩放、直接评估推理步骤正确性和奖励排名微调三种场景下均取得一致优越性能，验证了所提方法的高效性和有效性。

Abstract: We present Athena-PRM, a multimodal process reward model (PRM) designed to evaluate the reward score for each step in solving complex reasoning problems. Developing high-performance PRMs typically demands significant time and financial investment, primarily due to the necessity for step-level annotations of reasoning steps. Conventional automated labeling methods, such as Monte Carlo estimation, often produce noisy labels and incur substantial computational costs. To efficiently generate high-quality process-labeled data, we propose leveraging prediction consistency between weak and strong completers as a criterion for identifying reliable process labels. Remarkably, Athena-PRM demonstrates outstanding effectiveness across various scenarios and benchmarks with just 5,000 samples. Furthermore, we also develop two effective strategies to improve the performance of PRMs: ORM initialization and up-sampling for negative data. We validate our approach in three specific scenarios: verification for test time scaling, direct evaluation of reasoning step correctness, and reward ranked fine-tuning. Our Athena-PRM consistently achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks and scenarios. Notably, when using Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the policy model, Athena-PRM enhances performance by 10.2 points on WeMath and 7.1 points on MathVista for test time scaling. Furthermore, Athena-PRM sets the state-of-the-art (SoTA) results in VisualProcessBench and outperforms the previous SoTA by 3.9 F1-score, showcasing its robust capability to accurately assess the correctness of the reasoning step. Additionally, utilizing Athena-PRM as the reward model, we develop Athena-7B with reward ranked fine-tuning and outperforms baseline with a significant margin on five benchmarks.

</details>


### [428] [Interpretability and Generalization Bounds for Learning Spatial Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.15199)
*Alejandro Francisco Queiruga,Theo Gutman-Solo,Shuai Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过数值分析技术严格量化机器学习模型在线性微分方程参数发现和求解中的精度、收敛率和泛化边界，发现数据函数空间对模型泛化至关重要，不同模型可能表现出相反的泛化行为，并基于理论分析引入了一种从黑箱模型权重中提取格林函数表示的新机械可解释性视角，同时提出了一种用于物理系统泛化测量的交叉验证方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管机器学习在科学问题中有许多看似有前景的应用，但可视化结果可能具有欺骗性，需要严格量化ML模型在科学问题中的准确性、收敛性和泛化能力。

Method: 采用数值分析技术严格量化ML模型在线性微分方程中的精度、收敛率和泛化边界；通过实验验证数据函数空间对泛化的关键作用；基于理论分析从黑箱模型权重中提取格林函数表示。

Result: 数据函数空间而非仅仅是数据量和离散方式对模型泛化至关重要；不同类别模型可能表现出相反的泛化行为；常用模型（包括物理专用技术）存在类似的泛化不足问题；可以从黑箱模型权重中提取格林函数表示。

Conclusion: 研究提出了一种用于物理系统泛化测量的新交叉验证技术，可作为基准方法，同时引入了基于格林函数表示的机械可解释性新视角。

Abstract: While there are many applications of ML to scientific problems that look promising, visuals can be deceiving. Using numerical analysis techniques, we rigorously quantify the accuracy, convergence rates, and generalization bounds of certain ML models applied to linear differential equations for parameter discovery or solution finding. Beyond the quantity and discretization of data, we identify that the function space of the data is critical to the generalization of the model. A similar lack of generalization is empirically demonstrated for commonly used models, including physics-specific techniques. Counterintuitively, we find that different classes of models can exhibit opposing generalization behaviors. Based on our theoretical analysis, we also introduce a new mechanistic interpretability lens on scientific models whereby Green's function representations can be extracted from the weights of black-box models. Our results inform a new cross-validation technique for measuring generalization in physical systems, which can serve as a benchmark.

</details>


### [429] [Real-Time Progress Prediction in Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23274)
*Hans Peter Lyngsøe Raaschou-Jensen,Constanza Fierro,Anders Søgaard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了推理语言模型在长链思维过程中的实时进度预测问题。通过离散化推理轨迹训练线性探针分类进度状态，并微调模型生成0-100%的进度估计。最强模型在数学推理轨迹上达到0.161 MAE，优于位置基线。同时量化了进度标签的内在歧义性，发现Qwen3-4B的延续生成产生的展开离散度最小，表明大模型可通过减少剩余解长度变化来稳定进度标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理语言模型在复杂智能体任务中表现优异，但随着推理时间变长，其内部进展对用户不透明，导致用户难以进行期望管理和实时监督。因此需要实时进度预测方法。

Method: 1) 离散化推理轨迹并训练线性探针分类推理状态；2) 微调模型在思维链推理过程中生成0-100%的进度估计；3) 通过测量部分展开带来的进度值变化来量化进度标签的内在歧义性。

Result: 最强进度报告检查点在数学推理轨迹上达到0.161 MAE，优于位置基线。Qwen3-4B的进度标签歧义性最低，其延续生成产生的展开离散度最小。

Conclusion: 较大模型通过减少剩余解长度的变化可以使进度标签更加稳定，从而实现更可靠的实时进度预测。

Abstract: Recent reasoning language models, particularly those that employ long latent chains of thought, achieve strong performance on complex agentic tasks. However, as these models operate over increasingly long time horizons, their internal progress becomes opaque to users, making expectation management and real-time oversight difficult. In this work, we investigate whether real-time progress prediction is feasible for such models. We first test whether hidden states encode progress information by discretizing reasoning trajectories and training a linear probe to classify reasoning states. We then fine-tune models to generate progress estimates from 0--100\% during chain-of-thought reasoning. Our strongest progress-reporting checkpoint reaches 0.161 MAE on mathematical reasoning traces and outperforms position baselines in this setting. Finally, we quantify the intrinsic ambiguity of progress labels by measuring how much the implied progress value varies from the same partial rollout. This ambiguity is lowest for Qwen3-4B, whose continuations produce the smallest rollout dispersion, suggesting that larger models can make progress labels more stable by reducing variation in remaining solution length.

</details>


### [430] [Exploring the robustness of TractOracle methods in RL-based tractography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.11486)
*Jeremi Levesque,Antoine Théberge,Maxime Descoteaux,Pierre-Marc Jodoin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在TractOracle-RL框架基础上集成了四种强化学习扩展方法，并提出了一种名为IRT的新型训练方案（受RLHF启发，利用束过滤方法迭代优化oracle指导）。实验表明，结合oracle反馈的RL方法在五个扩散MRI数据集上显著优于传统纤维追踪技术，在准确性和解剖有效性方面均有提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的纤维追踪方法（如TractOracle-RL）已显示出优于传统方法的潜力，但仍存在改进空间。作者希望整合RL领域的最新进展，并探索更有效的训练范式，以进一步提升纤维追踪的准确性和解剖有效性。

Method: 1) 在TractOracle-RL基础上集成了四种RL扩展方法；2) 提出Iterative Reward Training (IRT)方法，借鉴RLHF思想，利用束过滤方法而非人工反馈来迭代优化oracle指导；3) 在五个不同扩散MRI数据集上进行系统评估。

Result: 结合oracle的RL方法在所有数据集上均显著优于传统纤维追踪技术；IRT训练方案有效提升了模型的性能；oracle反馈机制的引入使得RL方法在准确性和解剖有效性方面表现稳健且可靠。

Conclusion: 将oracle机制与强化学习框架结合是提高纤维追踪质量的通用有效策略，IRT作为一种无需人工标注的迭代优化训练方法，为RL在医学影像分析中的应用提供了新思路。

Abstract: Tractography algorithms leverage diffusion MRI to reconstruct the fibrous architecture of the brain's white matter. Among machine learning approaches, reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising framework for tractography, outperforming traditional methods in several key aspects. TractOracle-RL, a recent RL-based approach, reduces false positives by incorporating anatomical priors into the training process via a reward-based mechanism. In this paper, we investigate four extensions of the original TractOracle-RL framework by integrating recent advances in RL, and we evaluate their performance across five diverse diffusion MRI datasets. Results demonstrate that combining an oracle with the RL framework consistently leads to robust and reliable tractography, regardless of the specific method or dataset used. We also introduce a novel RL training scheme called Iterative Reward Training (IRT), inspired by the Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) paradigm. Instead of relying on human input, IRT leverages bundle filtering methods to iteratively refine the oracle's guidance throughout training. Experimental results show that RL methods trained with oracle feedback significantly outperform widely used tractography techniques in terms of accuracy and anatomical validity.

</details>


### [431] [MolPIF: A Parameter Interpolation Flow Model for Molecule Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.13762)
*Yaowei Jin,Junjie Wang,Yufan Tang,Wenkai Xiang,Duanhua Cao,Dan Teng,Zhehuan Fan,Jiacheng Xiong,Xia Sheng,Chuanlong Zeng,Duo An,Mingyue Zheng,Shuangjia Zheng,Qian Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MolPIF提出参数插值流机制统一分子连续坐标与离散原子类型生成，通过参数空间而非样本空间的流插值恢复Wasserstein-2最优传输与Fisher-Rao测地线，结合几何增强学习在CrossDocked2020上超越基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度生成模型（如扩散模型、流匹配模型）在处理基于结构的药物设计时，难以统一连续原子坐标与离散原子类型这两种异质模态，往往采用分离策略或对离散变量使用不适配的欧几里得度量，缺乏统一的框架来捕捉蛋白质-配体复合物的几何与化学结构。

Method: 提出MolPIF参数插值流机制：在参数空间而非样本空间进行分布间插值，理论上为连续坐标恢复Wasserstein-2最优传输，为离散原子类型建立Fisher-Rao测地线；同时引入几何增强学习策略以改善原子上下文捕获能力。

Result: 在CrossDocked2020数据集上的广泛评估表明，MolPIF在结合亲和力、化学有效性、几何保真度和化学空间覆盖率方面均优于基线方法；此外在先导优化方面表现出多功能性，支持灵活的先验分布选择（如Laplace分布）。

Conclusion: MolPIF建立了基于结构的药物设计的鲁棒范式，通过参数插值流统一了连续与离散分子变量的生成，代码已开源。

Abstract: Motivation: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) has advanced with deep generative models, but bridging the gap between continuous atomic coordinates and discrete atom types remains a challenge. Current approaches, such as diffusion and flow matching models, often fail to unify these heterogeneous modalities, relying on separate strategies or ill-fitting Euclidean metrics for discrete variables. This lack of a consistent framework limits generative models' ability to capture the geometric and chemical structure of protein-ligand complexes. Results: We present MolPIF, a parameter interpolation flow mechanism designed to unify the generation of continuous and discrete molecular variables. Unlike traditional flow models that operate in sample space, MolPIF interpolates between distributions in the parameter space, theoretically recovering Wasserstein-2 optimal transport for continuous coordinates and establishing Fisher-Rao geodesics for discrete atom types. We further incorporate a geometry-enhanced learning strategy to improve the capture of atomic contexts. Extensive evaluations on the CrossDocked2020 dataset demonstrate that MolPIF outperforms baselines in binding affinity, chemical validity, geometric fidelity and chemical space coverage. Additionally, MolPIF exhibits versatility in lead optimization and offers flexible prior distribution selection (such as Laplace), establishing a robust paradigm for SBDD. Availability: Source code is freely available at https://github.com/BLEACH366/MolPIF. Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics.

</details>


### [432] [A Physics-Informed Hierarchical Neural Network for Microwave Scattering Analysis of 3D PEC Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.03774)
*Rui Zhu,Yuexing Peng,George C. Alexandropoulos,Wenbo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种U型物理信息人工神经网络（U-PINet），用于三维PEC目标的微波散射分析。该网络受MLFMA近远场分解启发，结合近场图编码器和八叉树分层多尺度融合模块，通过电场积分方程残差训练，无需参考电流标签。实验表明U-PINet在双站RCS重建上优于典型物理信息基线，并在重复查询场景下相比MLFMA大幅节省计算时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典数值方法（矩量法、MLFMA）在重复查询（多种入射角或频率）场景下计算成本高昂，而纯数据驱动代理模型在复杂几何目标上精度不足。因此需要一种兼具物理保真度和计算效率的替代方法。

Method: 提出U-PINet，其核心结构包括：(1) 近场图编码器，使用可学习单变量基函数参数化；(2) 基于八叉树组织的分层多尺度融合模块，模拟MLFMA的近远场分解思想。网络训练采用电场积分方程在表面配点处的离散残差作为损失函数，无需真实电流标签。

Result: 在多种频率和极化配置下，对典型和几何复杂三维PEC目标进行双站RCS重建实验，U-PINet在精度上优于代表性的物理信息基线方法，并且在重复查询场景下相比经典MLFMA求解器实现了显著的计算时间节省。

Conclusion: U-PINet成功将物理信息融入神经网络架构，在保持较高物理保真度的同时大幅降低了重复查询场景的计算开销，为三维微波散射分析提供了一种高效且准确的替代方案。

Abstract: Accurate modeling of scattering from three-dimensional (3D) perfectly electrically conducting (PEC) targets at microwave frequencies constitutes a fundamental objective in computational electromagnetics, particularly for radar cross section (RCS) prediction and microwave scattering analysis. Classical solvers, such as the method of moments and the Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm (MLFMA), although provide high physical fidelity, they become costly under scenarios of repeated queries involving many incidence configurations or frequencies, whereas purely data-driven surrogates often lack accuracy on geometrically complex targets. This paper proposes a U-shaped physics-informed artificial neural network (U-PINet) for 3D microwave scattering analysis. Inspired by the near-far field decomposition of MLFMA, U-PINet combines a near-field graph encoder, parameterized by learnable univariate basis functions, with a hierarchical multi-scale fusion module organized on an octree partition. The proposed network is trained against a discretized residual of the electric-field integral equation at surface collocation points, without requiring reference current labels. Experiments on canonical and geometrically complex 3D PEC targets, conducted under multiple frequency and polarization configurations and assessed through bistatic RCS reconstruction, showcase that U-PINet outperforms representative physics-informed baselines, and yields substantial runtime savings over the classical MLFMA solver under repeated-query scenarios.

</details>


### [433] [A Unified Framework for Diffusion Model Unlearning with f-Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21167)
*Nicola Novello,Federico Fontana,Luigi Cinque,Deniz Gunduz,Andrea M. Tonello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将文本到图像扩散模型中的概念遗忘从KL散度（MSE损失）推广到任意f-散度，其中α-散度族可得到与MSE同样高效的闭式训练目标，其余散度则通过变分形式的极小极大目标实现。理论分析和实验表明，不同f-散度影响梯度大小和收敛性质，其中Hellinger散度在多个场景下持续优于MSE，该框架为平衡遗忘效果与生成保真度提供了灵活选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念遗忘方法仅使用MSE损失（等价于KL散度），缺乏对散度选择的深入理解与灵活调控，无法针对不同应用场景优化遗忘效果与生成质量之间的权衡。

Method: 1) 将遗忘目标从KL散度推广到一般f-散度；2) 对α-散度族推导高斯闭式解，得到与MSE同样高效的目标；3) 对其他f-散度基于变分形式提出极小极大训练目标；4) 理论分析不同散度对梯度大小和收敛性的影响。

Result: Hellinger闭式解在多个场景下持续优于MSE；不同f-散度对梯度规模和收敛性质产生显著影响，从而影响遗忘质量。

Conclusion: 提出的统一框架允许根据应用需求灵活选择最优散度，实现对遗忘效果与生成保真度更精细的控制。

Abstract: Most existing methods for concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models minimize a mean squared error (MSE) loss between the denoiser outputs conditioned on a target and an anchor concept, which is implicitly the KL divergence between two Gaussians. We generalize this objective to any $f$-divergence, recovering MSE as the KL instance, and identify a family of $α$-divergences whose Gaussian closed-form yields cheap, MSE-like training objectives. For the remaining $f$-divergences, we provide a min-max objective based on the variational formulation of the $f$-divergence. We theoretically analyze and numerically validate how different $f$-divergences impact the gradient magnitude and the convergence properties of the algorithm, affecting the quality of unlearning. For instance, we observe that the Hellinger closed-form instance consistently dominates MSE across multiple scenarios. More generally, the proposed unified framework offers a flexible paradigm for selecting the optimal divergence based on the application and user goal, allowing for finer control over the trade-off between unlearning efficacy and generative fidelity.

</details>


### [434] [Position: The Hidden Costs and Measurement Gaps of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21882)
*Fang Wu,Aaron Tu,Weihao Xuan,Heli Qi,Xu Huang,Qingcheng Zeng,Shayan Talaei,Yijia Xiao,Peng Xia,Xiangru Tang,Yuchen Zhuang,Yinxi Li,Bing Hu,Hanqun Cao,Wenqi Shi,Rui Yang,Nan Liu,Huaxiu Yao,Ge Liu,Li Erran Li,Amin Saberi,Naoto Yokoya,Jure Leskovec,Yejin Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出，当前RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）的许多显著收益并未得到充分验证，因为报告常将策略改进与预算不匹配、尝试膨胀/校准漂移和数据污染三种混淆因素混为一谈。通过预算匹配复现和部分提示污染探测，作者发现多个被广泛引用的差距在控制变量后大幅缩小或消失。为此，作者提出了一套包含预算匹配饱和曲线、法官鲁棒性测试和污染筛查的最小标准，确保RLVR在可验证领域保持有效和可部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前RLVR的显著收益缺乏充分验证，报告常混淆策略改进与其他因素，导致对模型能力的过高估计。

Method: 采用预算匹配的复现实验和部分提示污染探测方法，系统评估RLVR相对于基线方法的真实收益，并识别三种主要混淆因素。

Result: 多个被广泛引用的RLVR与基线之间的能力差距在匹配预算、提示和数据集版本后显著缩小或消失；部分表现提升源于记忆而非推理。

Conclusion: RLVR在可验证领域仍然有效，但当前测量方式普遍高估能力提升并掩盖可靠性成本，需要建立标准化的评估框架以确保结果可信。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a practical, scalable way to improve large language models on math, code, and other structured tasks. However, we argue that many headline RLVR gains are not yet well validated because reports often conflate policy improvement with three confounds: (i) budget mismatch between RLVR and baseline evaluations, (ii) attempt inflation and calibration drift that convert abstentions into confident answers, and (iii) benchmark data contamination. Using budget-matched reproductions and partial-prompt contamination probes, we find that several widely cited gaps shrink substantially or disappear once budgets, prompts, and dataset versions are matched and contaminated sets are treated as memorization probes rather than evidence of reasoning. This does not mean that RLVR is ineffective, but it implies that current measurements often overstate capability gains and obscure reliability costs. We therefore propose a compact, tax-aware minimum standard for RLVR training and evaluation: budget-matched saturation curves with variance, calibration, and abstention tracking, a judge-robustness stress test when LLM judges are used, and an explicit contamination screen. With these controls, RLVR remains effective and deployable in verifiable domains, but reasoning gains should be treated as provisional without them.

</details>


### [435] [DiVeQ: Differentiable Vector Quantization Using the Reparameterization Trick](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.26469)
*Mohammad Hassan Vali,Tom Bäckström,Arno Solin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DiVeQ和SF-DiVeQ两种量化方法，通过将量化视为添加模拟失真误差向量，实现硬前向传播与梯度流动，无需辅助损失或温度调度，在图像压缩、图像生成和语音编码任务中优于传统量化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决深度模型中向量量化的硬赋值导致梯度阻断、阻碍端到端训练的问题。

Method: DiVeQ将量化视为添加模拟量化失真的误差向量，保持前向硬量化同时允许梯度流动；SF-DiVeQ将输入分配到码字间连线构成的曲线上，减少量化误差并充分利用码本。

Result: 在VQ-VAE图像压缩、VQGAN图像生成、DAC语音编码任务中，DiVeQ和SF-DiVeQ在重建质量和样本质量上均优于其他量化方法。

Conclusion: 提出的方法无需辅助损失或温度调度即可实现端到端训练，且性能优于现有量化方法。

Abstract: Vector quantization is common in deep models, yet its hard assignments block gradients and hinder end-to-end training. We propose DiVeQ, which treats quantization as adding an error vector that mimics the quantization distortion, keeping the forward pass hard while letting gradients flow. We also present a space-filling variant (SF-DiVeQ) that assigns input to a curve constructed by the lines connecting codewords, resulting in less quantization error and full codebook usage. Both methods train end-to-end without requiring auxiliary losses or temperature schedules. In VQ-VAE image compression, VQGAN image generation, and DAC speech coding tasks across various data sets, our proposed methods improve reconstruction and sample quality over alternative quantization approaches.

</details>


### [436] [Monte Carlo Permutation Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06381)
*Tristan Cazenave*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出蒙特卡洛排列搜索(MCPS)，一种改进GRAVE算法的通用蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，在无法使用深度强化学习或算力有限时表现出色，通过将路径上所有节点的统计数据纳入探索项，在多种游戏中几乎始终优于GRAVE，并提供了权重公式的数学推导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MCTS算法（如GRAVE）在深度强化学习不可用或计算资源受限的场景下性能不足，需要一种更高效的通用搜索算法。

Method: 在MCTS的探索项中纳入从根节点到当前节点路径上所有走法的全部仿真统计数据；数学推导出三种统计来源的加权公式，消除了GRAVE中的偏置超参数。

Result: 在Hex、Go、AtariGo、NoGo和Wargame等多种游戏中，MCPS几乎始终优于GRAVE算法。

Conclusion: MCPS是一种更优的通用MCTS算法，其数学推导的权重公式是对GRAVE的改进，消除了对偏置超参数的依赖。

Abstract: We propose Monte Carlo Permutation Search (MCPS), a general-purpose Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) algorithm that improves upon the GRAVE algorithm. MCPS is relevant when deep reinforcement learning is not an option or when the computing power available before play is not substantial, such as in General Game Playing. The principle of MCPS is to include in the exploration term of a node the statistics on all the playouts that contain all the moves on the path from the root to the node. We test MCPS on a variety of games: Hex, Go, AtariGo, NoGo and a Wargame. MCPS almost always outperforms GRAVE. We also provide a mathematical derivation of the formulas used for weighting the three sources of statistics. These formulas are an improvement on the GRAVE formula since they no longer use the bias hyperparameter of GRAVE.

</details>


### [437] [MATT-CTR: Unleashing a Model-Agnostic Test-Time Paradigm for CTR Prediction with Confidence-Guided Inference Paths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08932)
*Moyu Zhang,Yun Chen,Yujun Jin,Jinxin Hu,Yu Zhang,Xiaoyi Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MATT（模型无关的测试时范式），通过层次化概率哈希估计特征组合置信度，并以此引导多推理路径生成与聚合，从而优化CTR模型在推理阶段的预测性能，尤其针对低频特征组合导致的不稳定预测问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CTR模型研究多集中于训练阶段的架构优化或目标函数改进，忽视了推理阶段的优化潜力。低频特征组合会导致预测性能下降、输出不可靠或低置信度。

Method: 1) 提出层次化概率哈希方法估计不同阶特征组合的出现频率作为置信度得分；2) 以置信度得分为采样概率，通过迭代采样生成多个实例特定的推理路径；3) 聚合多个路径的预测分数进行鲁棒预测。

Result: 大量离线实验和在线A/B测试验证了MATT与现有CTR模型的兼容性和有效性。

Conclusion: MATT是一种模型无关的测试时优化范式，通过置信度引导的多路径推理有效提升了CTR模型对低频特征组合的预测鲁棒性和性能。

Abstract: Recently, a growing body of research has focused on either optimizing CTR model architectures to better model feature interactions or refining training objectives to aid parameter learning, thereby achieving better predictive performance. However, previous efforts have primarily focused on the training phase, largely neglecting opportunities for optimization during the inference phase. Infrequently occurring feature combinations, in particular, can degrade prediction performance, leading to unreliable or low-confidence outputs. To unlock the predictive potential of trained CTR models, we propose a Model-Agnostic Test-Time paradigm (MATT), which leverages the confidence scores of feature combinations to guide the generation of multiple inference paths, thereby mitigating the influence of low-confidence features on the final prediction. Specifically, to quantify the confidence of feature combinations, we introduce a hierarchical probabilistic hashing method to estimate the occurrence frequencies of feature combinations at various orders, which serve as their corresponding confidence scores. Then, using the confidence scores as sampling probabilities, we generate multiple instance-specific inference paths through iterative sampling and subsequently aggregate the prediction scores from multiple paths to conduct robust predictions. Finally, extensive offline experiments and online A/B tests strongly validate the compatibility and effectiveness of MATT across existing CTR models.

</details>


### [438] [Cross-Receiver Generalization for RF Fingerprint Identification via Feature Disentanglement and Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09405)
*Yuhao Pan,Xiucheng Wang,Fushuo Huo,Nan Cheng,Wenchao Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对RFFI中接收机更换导致性能下降的问题，提出一种跨接收机鲁棒框架，通过对抗域对齐、接收机感知正则化和特征分离约束，解耦发射机与接收机特征，在跨接收机WiFi数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际部署中更换接收机会导致RFFI模型性能严重下降，因为RF信号天然耦合了发射机特有特征和接收机依赖的失真，模型容易学到接收机相关模式。

Method: 提出跨接收机鲁棒RFFI框架，包含三个核心模块：(1)对抗域对齐，抑制发射机特征中的残留接收机信息；(2)接收机感知正则化，增强接收机特有表征的类内一致性；(3)特征分离约束，在隐空间中解耦发射机和接收机两个表征分量。

Result: 在多接收机WiFi数据集上的跨接收机评估中，所提方法一致优于现有最先进基线，显著提升了接收机更换的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过显式解耦发射机特有和接收机特有的表征，有效解决了接收机变化带来的域偏移问题，为RFFI在实际部署中的鲁棒性提供了一种可行方案。

Abstract: Radio frequency fingerprint identification (RFFI) is a key technique for wireless network security, leveraging intrinsic hardware imperfections to enable transmitter identification. Although deep neural networks are effective at extracting discriminative RF features, their performance is significantly affected by receiver-induced variability in practical deployments. In real-world scenarios, RF signals inherently entangle transmitter-specific characteristics with receiver-dependent distortions, leading models to capture receiver-related patterns when training and evaluation are conducted on the same device. Consequently, replacing the receiver during deployment often results in notable performance degradation. To address this issue, we propose a cross-receiver robust RFFI framework that explicitly disentangles transmitter-specific and receiver-specific representations. The proposed method integrates adversarial domain alignment with receiver-aware regularization to suppress residual receiver information in transmitter features while enforcing intra-receiver consistency in receiver-specific representations. A feature separation constraint is further introduced to decouple the two components in the latent space. Extensive experiments on multi-receiver WiFi datasets demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under cross-receiver evaluation and significantly improves robustness to receiver replacement.

</details>


### [439] [Prototyping an End-to-End Multi-Modal Tiny-CNN for Cardiovascular Sensor Patches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.18668)
*Mustafa Fuad Rifet Ibrahim,Tunc Alkanat,Felix Manthey,Maurice Meijer,Alexander Schlaefer,Peer Stelldinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在资源受限的医疗边缘设备上，利用早期融合的卷积神经网络对同步心电图和心音图记录进行分类的可行性。该方法在保持竞争性精度的同时，将内存占用和计算成本降低了约三个数量级，并通过微控制器和BLE能耗测量验证了设备端推理比连续数据流更节能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数心血管疾病可通过早期体征和风险因素检测来预防，而可穿戴传感器设备（如传感器贴片）能在不影响患者自由和舒适度的情况下进行监测。然而，传感器数据分析必须健壮、可靠、高效且高精度，深度学习方法可自动化数据解释以减少临床医生工作负担。

Method: 提出一种早期融合数据的卷积神经网络，解决二分类问题。模型在Physionet Challenge 2016数据集的同步ECG和PCG记录上进行训练和验证。通过在配备神经处理单元（NPU）的微控制器上测量能耗，并在BLE评估套件上对不同载荷大小的BLE通信能耗进行基准测试，评估模型在医疗边缘设备上的适用性。

Result: 与最先进方法相比，该方法将内存占用和计算成本降低了约三个数量级，同时保持了竞争性精度。设备端推理比连续数据流更节能。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了在资源受限的医疗边缘设备上部署深度学习模型进行心电和心音信号分类的可行性，且设备端推理在能效方面优于持续数据传输方案。

Abstract: The vast majority of cardiovascular diseases may be preventable if early signs and risk factors are detected. Cardiovascular monitoring with body-worn sensor devices like sensor patches allows for the detection of such signs while preserving the freedom and comfort of patients. However, the analysis of the sensor data must be robust, reliable, efficient, and highly accurate. Deep learning methods can automate data interpretation, reducing the workload of clinicians. In this work, we analyze the feasibility of applying deep learning models to the classification of synchronized electrocardiogram (ECG) and phonocardiogram (PCG) recordings on resource-constrained medical edge devices. We propose a convolutional neural network with early fusion of data to solve a binary classification problem. The model is trained and validated on the synchronized ECG and PCG recordings from the Physionet Challenge 2016 dataset. Our approach reduces memory footprint and compute cost by approximately three orders of magnitude compared with the state-of-the-art while maintaining competitive accuracy. We further demonstrate the applicability of the proposed model on medical edge devices by measuring its energy consumption on a microcontroller equipped with a neural processing unit (NPU) and benchmarking the energy of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) communication on a representative BLE evaluation kit across a range of payload sizes. The comparison confirms that on-device inference can be more energy efficient than continuous data streaming.

</details>


### [440] [Learning to Reason Efficiently with Discounted Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23486)
*Alex Ayoub,Kavosh Asadi,Dale Schuurmans,Csaba Szepesvári,Karim Bouyarmane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出通过折扣强化学习惩罚推理token数量，在保持准确性的同时缩短思维链长度，并将此问题建模为随机最短路径问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型常常消耗过多token，增加计算成本和延迟。作者质疑"更长响应提升准确性"这一假设，希望实现既简洁又准确的推理。

Method: 采用折扣强化学习设置，通过惩罚推理token（可解释为小token成本），在受限策略类中分析Blackwell最优性，将问题类比为随机最短路径问题中偏好更短的成功轨迹。

Result: 实验证实理论结果：该方法能够在保持准确性的同时缩短思维链长度。

Conclusion: 通过适当的token惩罚机制，可以在不牺牲推理质量的前提下显著减少推理开销，为构建更高效的推理模型提供了理论依据和实用方法。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often consume excessive tokens, inflating computational cost and latency. More broadly, in goal reaching sequential decision problems we often want to reach the goal quickly, and LRM reasoning can be viewed through this lens. We challenge the assumption that longer responses improve accuracy. By penalizing reasoning tokens using a discounted reinforcement learning setup (interpretable as a small token cost) and analyzing Blackwell optimality in restricted policy classes, we encourage concise yet accurate reasoning, analogous to preferring shorter successful trajectories in a stochastic shortest path problem. Experiments confirm our theoretical results that this approach shortens chains of thought while preserving accuracy.

</details>


### [441] [An End-to-End Learning Approach for Solving Capacitated Location-Routing Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02525)
*Changhao Miao,Yuntian Zhang,Tongyu Wu,Fang Deng,Chen Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次提出基于深度强化学习（DRL）的端到端方法DRLHQ，用于求解容量受限的选址-路径问题（CLRP）及其开放变体（OCLRP），通过异构查询注意力机制有效处理选址与路径决策间的依赖关系，在合成与基准数据集上优于传统方法和现有DRL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLRP是组合优化中的经典问题，同时涉及选址与路径决策，复杂约束及多种决策间的相互依赖使其求解困难。尽管DRL已广泛应用于车辆路径问题，但针对CLRP的研究仍不足。

Method: 提出DRLHQ方法，采用编码器-解码器结构，将CLRP重新建模为适用于多类决策的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并引入异构查询注意力机制，动态适应不同决策阶段的交互需求。

Result: 在合成数据集和基准数据集上的实验结果表明，DRLHQ在求解CLRP和OCLRP时，在解质量和泛化性能上均优于代表性传统方法和DRL基线。

Conclusion: DRLHQ是首个针对CLRP的端到端学习方法，其异构查询注意力机制有效处理了选址与路径决策间的相互依赖，为未来DRL解决复杂组合优化问题提供了新框架。

Abstract: The capacitated location-routing problems (CLRPs) are classical problems in combinatorial optimization, which require simultaneously making location and routing decisions. In CLRPs, the complex constraints and the intricate relationships between various decisions make the problem challenging to solve. With the emergence of deep reinforcement learning (DRL), it has been extensively applied to address the vehicle routing problem and its variants, while the research related to CLRPs still needs to be explored. In this paper, we propose the DRL with heterogeneous query (DRLHQ) to solve CLRP and open CLRP (OCLRP), respectively. We are the first to propose an end-to-end learning approach for CLRPs, following the encoder-decoder structure. In particular, we reformulate the CLRPs as a markov decision process tailored to various decisions, a general modeling framework that can be adapted to other DRL-based methods. To better handle the interdependency across location and routing decisions, we also introduce a novel heterogeneous querying attention mechanism designed to adapt dynamically to various decision-making stages. Experimental results on both synthetic and benchmark datasets demonstrate superior solution quality and better generalization performance of our proposed approach over representative traditional and DRL-based baselines in solving both CLRP and OCLRP.

</details>


### [442] [CFG-OEC: Classifier Free Guidance with Orthogonal Error Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.14075)
*Nakgyu Yang,Yechan Lee,SooJean Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出CFG-OEC方法，通过正交误差校正减少分类器自由引导中条件与无条件预测误差的交互，从而提升扩散模型条件采样质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准CFG的采样规则与训练目标不一致，导致条件预测和无条件预测误差之间的交互产生结构性采样误差。

Method: 首先将采样误差分解为基项和由两种误差对齐程度决定的交叉项；据此提出正交误差校正（CFG-OEC）来减少交互项；对无法观测真实噪声的实际场景，引入基于模型预测的代理和跨时间步的动态稳定方法。

Result: 在受控环境中验证了理论误差分解和代理构造的有效性；在Stable Diffusion v1.5和XL上，CFG-OEC在多种采样器和引导强度下均优于CFG和CFG++，提升了FID和CLIP分数。

Conclusion: 理论分析和实验证明，通过修正条件与无条件预测误差间的结构性问题，可以有效提升扩散模型条件生成的质量。

Abstract: Classifier free guidance is a standard method for conditional sampling in diffusion models, but its sampling rule is not aligned with the objective used in training. This mismatch induces a structural sampling error through the interaction of conditional and unconditional prediction errors. We analyze this issue by decomposing the sampling error into a base term and a cross term determined by the alignment of the two errors. Based on this analysis we propose CFG with orthogonal error correction (CFG-OEC), a structural modification that reduces the interaction term. For practical settings where ground truth noise is not observable, we introduce a proxy computed from model predictions and a dynamic method that stabilizes correction across diffusion timesteps. Experiments in a controlled environment validate our theoretical error decomposition and proxy construction. Image generation on Stable Diffusion v1.5 and Stable Diffusion XL show that CFG-OEC improves FID and CLIP scores over CFG and CFG++ across multiple samplers and guidance regimes.

</details>


### [443] [Transformers with RL or SFT Provably Learn Sparse Boolean Functions, But Differently](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.17852)
*Bochen Lyu,Yiyang Jia,Xiaohao Cai,Zhanxing Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文统一分析了强化学习（过程奖励）和监督微调（SFT）在训练一層Transformer学习k-稀疏布尔函数（如k-PARITY、k-AND、k-OR）时的学习动态，发现RL同时学习整个CoT链，而SFT逐步学习，揭示了两种方法触发CoT能力的不同机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究强化学习（过程奖励）和监督微调在训练Transformer获得思维链推理能力时的内在学习机制差异，从理论角度理解两种方法如何触发CoT能力。

Method: 以可递归分解为固定2-稀疏布尔函数的k-稀疏布尔函数为研究对象，使用单层Transformer，统一分析RL（过程奖励）和SFT的学习动态，推导出Transformer可证明学习这些函数的充分条件，并在k-PARITY、k-AND、k-OR三个基本例子上验证。

Result: RL和SFT都能使Transformer学习k-稀疏布尔函数；RL同时学习整个CoT链，SFT则逐步学习；两者的比较需考虑奖励设计和Teacher Forcing的使用。

Conclusion: RL和SFT在触发Transformer CoT能力时表现出截然不同的学习行为，揭示了Teacher Forcing和奖励设计在其中的关键作用，为理解两种微调范式的差异提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Transformers can acquire Chain-of-Thought (CoT) capabilities to solve complex reasoning tasks through fine-tuning. Reinforcement learning (RL) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) are two primary approaches to this end. In this work, we specifically examine RL with process rewards and SFT for learning $k$-sparse Boolean functions with a one-layer transformer through intermediate reasoning steps akin to CoT. In particular, we consider $k$-sparse Boolean functions that can be recursively decomposed into fixed 2-sparse Boolean functions. We first analyze the learning dynamics of RL fine-tuning with process reward and SFT in a unified way. This allows us to identify sufficient conditions under which the transformer provably learns these sparse Boolean functions. We then verify that these conditions hold for three basic examples, including $k$-PARITY, $k$-AND, and $k$-OR, thus demonstrating their learnability via both RL and SFT. Notably, we reveal that RL and SFT exhibit distinct learning behaviors: RL learns the whole CoT chain simultaneously, whereas SFT naturally learns the CoT chain step by step. Overall, our findings provide insights on the mechanisms underlying RL and SFT and how they differ in triggering the CoT capabilities of transformers, and suggest that the comparison between RL and SFT may need to consider the reward design and the use of teacher forcing.

</details>


### [444] [Normalizing Flows on Quotient Manifolds via Boundary Quotients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22882)
*William Ghanem,Benjamin Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了边界商框架，用于在由简单域边界商产生的流形上进行密度学习，并展示了如何利用该框架在离散群作用下的商流形上构建归一化流，特别在亏格-g曲面和透镜空间上进行了实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在处理具有非平凡拓扑结构的流形（如商流形）上的密度估计时面临挑战，尤其是当流形由离散群作用生成时。作者希望提供一种通用的框架，能够将简单域上的密度学习迁移到其边界商流形上。

Method: 提出边界商（boundary quotients）概念，将目标流形视为更简单域的边界在群作用下的商空间。利用这一构造，将归一化流（如RealNVP）先在简单域上训练，再通过商映射投影到目标流形上。具体实例化了亏格-g曲面（Σ_g）和透镜空间（cyclic quotients of 3-sphere）的构造。

Result: 在透镜空间上的实验表明，简单的预商RealNVP模型能够取得强结果，同时计算成本显著降低。

Conclusion: 边界商框架为在具有复杂拓扑的商流形上进行概率密度学习提供了一种有效且计算高效的方案，尤其适用于对称性感知学习场景。

Abstract: We introduce boundary quotients and present a framework for learning densities on manifolds that arise as boundary quotients of simpler domains. We show that this framework can be used to construct normalizing flows on quotient manifolds $N/G$, where a discrete group $G$ acts on $N$. We instantiate this construction for genus-$g$ surfaces $Σ_g$. When $G$ is finite, we show applicability to symmetry aware learning; we demonstrate this on cyclic quotients of the 3-sphere. Experiments on lens spaces show that simple pre-quotient RealNVP models can achieve strong results while being substantially cheaper to evaluate.

</details>


### [445] [Reconstructing Multi-Scale Physical Fields from Extremely Sparse Measurements with an Autoencoder-Diffusion Cascade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01572)
*Letian Yi,Tingpeng Zhang,Mingyuan Zhou,Guannan Wang,Quanke Su,Zhilu Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Cascaded Sensing（Cas-Sensing）框架，通过层级化重构后验推断：先由确定性粗尺度估计器解决全局结构模糊性，再由条件扩散模型学习残差分布，从而在极端稀疏传感条件下实现稳定的全场重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极端传感器稀疏条件下，全场重建是严重不适定问题，后验分布严重欠约束且本质多峰，确定性映射会坍塌不确定性，直接条件学习无法覆盖所有解空间，似然引导采样对噪声和传感器配置高度敏感，导致后验估计不稳定，亟需结构性不确定性建模方法。

Method: 提出Cascaded Sensing层级框架：1）粗尺度阶段：基于神经算子的功能自编码器，以掩码稀疏观测输入，学习粗尺度结构场（类似MAP估计），固定后验主自由度；2）精尺度阶段：条件扩散模型学习残差分布（粗估计与全场的差异），将采样限制在稳定邻域内；3）掩码级联训练：暴露于多样稀疏观测模式；4）推理时流形约束引导，将观测一致性作为精炼机制而非全局模式选择。

Result: 该方法将不适定的全场后验推断分解为条件数更好的粗尺度估计+残差推断，抑制了观测一致模式间的竞争，提升了对噪声和传感器配置的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: Cas-Sensing通过层级化结构将极端稀疏传感下的全场重建从全局模式选择转化为局部精炼问题，有望实现更稳定、鲁棒的后验估计。

Abstract: Extreme sensor sparsity makes full-field reconstruction a fundamentally ill-posed problem in scientific sensing,where the goal is to infer physical fields from sparse measurements.In this regime,the posterior is severely underconstrained and inherently multimodal,making its approximation highly ill-conditioned.Specifically,deterministic mappings collapse uncertainty,direct conditional learning cannot cover the space of possible observation-conditioned solutions,and likelihood-guided sampling becomes highly sensitive to noise and sensor configurations.These limitations result in unstable posterior estimates and highlight the need for modeling uncertainty in a structural manner.To this end,we propose Cascaded Sensing,a hierarchical framework that restructures posterior inference across scales.Rather than modeling the full-field posterior directly,Cas-Sensing first resolves global structural ambiguity through a deterministic coarse-stage estimator.A neural-operator-based functional autoencoder,trained with masked inputs,maps sparse observations to a coarse-scale structural field,acting analogously to a maximum a posteriori estimator that selects the dominant global configuration.This structural anchor fixes the principal degrees of freedom of the posterior and transforms the problem into a better-conditioned residual inference task.A conditional diffusion model then learns only the refined-scale residual distribution,confining sampling to a stable neighborhood of plausible solutions and suppressing competition among observation-consistent modes.To enhance robustness under varying sensing conditions,we introduce mask-cascade training,which exposes the model to diverse sparse observation patterns through intermediate coarse reconstructions.During inference,manifold-constrained guidance enforces observation consistency as a refinement mechanism rather than a global mode-selection process.

</details>


### [446] [Morphling: Fast, Fused, and Flexible GNN Training at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01678)
*Anubhab,Rupesh Nasre*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Morphling是一个针对图神经网络的领域专用代码合成器，通过生成后端专用实现和运行时稀疏感知执行引擎，在CPU、GPU和分布式平台上分别实现平均20倍、19倍和6倍的训练吞吐量提升，峰值可达66倍，同时内存消耗降低最高15倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN框架（如PyG和DGL）虽注重高层可用性，但未能解决GNN中不规则、内存受限的图遍历与规则、计算密集的稠密矩阵操作之间的根本性硬件挑战，导致通用核存在缓存局部性差、内存移动过多和大量中间分配等问题。

Method: Morphling将高层GNN规范编译为面向OpenMP、CUDA和MPI的可移植后端专用实现，通过实例化针对不同执行环境优化的架构感知原语库，并配备运行时稀疏感知执行引擎，利用输入特征统计信息动态选择稠密或稀疏执行路径以减少零值计算。

Result: 在11个真实数据集上，相比PyG和DGL，Morphling在CPU上平均提升20倍、GPU上19倍、分布式环境下6倍的每轮训练吞吐量，峰值达66倍；内存高效布局将峰值内存消耗降低最高15倍。

Conclusion: 专用、架构感知的代码合成为跨多样并行和分布式平台的高性能GNN执行提供了有效且可扩展的路径。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) present a fundamental hardware challenge by fusing irregular, memory-bound graph traversals with regular, compute-intensive dense matrix operations. While frameworks such as PyTorch Geometric (PyG) and Deep Graph Library (DGL) prioritize high-level usability, they fail to address these divergent execution characteristics. As a result, they rely on generic kernels that suffer from poor cache locality, excessive memory movement, and substantial intermediate allocations. To address these limitations, we present Morphling, a domain-specific code synthesizer designed to bridge this gap. Morphling compiles high-level GNN specifications into portable, backend-specialized implementations targeting OpenMP, CUDA, and MPI. It achieves this by instantiating a library of optimized, architecture-aware primitives tailored to each execution environment. Morphling also incorporates a runtime sparsity-aware execution engine that dynamically selects dense or sparse execution paths using input feature statistics, reducing unnecessary computation on zero-valued entries. We evaluate Morphling on eleven real-world datasets spanning diverse graph structures, feature dimensionalities, and sparsity regimes. Morphling improves per-epoch training throughput by an average of 20X on CPUs, 19X on GPUs, and 6X in distributed settings over PyG and DGL, with peak speedups reaching 66X. Morphling's memory-efficient layouts further reduce peak memory consumption by up to 15X, enabling large-scale GNN training on commodity hardware. These findings demonstrate that specialized, architecture-aware code synthesis provides an effective and scalable path toward high-performance GNN execution across diverse parallel and distributed platforms.

</details>


### [447] [Mechanistic Interpretability of Antibody Language Models Using SAEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05794)
*Rebonto Haque,Oliver M. Turnbull,Anisha Parsan,Nithin Parsan,John J. Yang,Anna L. Beukenhorst,Charlotte M. Deane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对比了TopK和Ordered稀疏自编码器在抗体语言模型中的可解释性与生成控制能力，发现TopK SAEs能揭示生物语义特征但因果控制力弱，Ordered SAEs虽激活模式复杂但更适合精确生成引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究SAEs在领域特异性蛋白质语言模型（抗体语言模型）中的可解释性表现，并评估其对生成过程进行因果控制的能力，为机械可解释性在蛋白质工程中的应用提供指导。

Method: 在抗体自回归语言模型上分别应用TopK SAEs和Ordered SAEs，提取潜在特征；通过相关性分析和因果干预（生成引导实验）比较两类SAEs在特征-概念映射和生成控制方面的差异。

Result: TopK SAEs能够发现生物学上有意义的潜在特征，但高特征-概念相关性并不能保证对生成的因果控制；Ordered SAEs通过层级结构可靠地识别可引导特征，但激活模式更复杂且可解释性降低。

Conclusion: 特征映射任务首选TopK SAEs，精确生成引导任务首选Ordered SAEs；两类SAEs在可解释性与因果控制力之间存在根本权衡。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a mechanistic interpretability technique that have been used to provide insight into learned concepts within large protein language models. Here, we employ TopK and Ordered SAEs to investigate autoregressive antibody language models, and steer their generation. We show that TopK SAEs can reveal biologically meaningful latent features, but high feature-concept correlation does not guarantee causal control over generation. In contrast, Ordered SAEs impose a hierarchical structure that reliably identifies steerable features, but at the expense of more complex and less interpretable activation patterns. These findings advance the mechanistic interpretability of domain-specific protein language models and suggest that, while TopK SAEs suffice for mapping latent features to concepts, Ordered SAEs are preferable when precise generative steering is required.

</details>


### [448] [Training-Free Vector Quantization via Gaussian VAEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.06609)
*Tongda Xu,Wendi Zheng,Jiajun He,Jose Miguel Hernandez-Lobato,Yan Wang,Ya-Qin Zhang,Jie Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Gaussian Quant (GQ)方法，通过先训练带约束的高斯VAE，再将其无损转换为VQ-VAE（无需额外训练），在图像压缩和生成任务上超越了现有离散VAE方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VQ-VAE因离散化过程导致训练困难，现有方法训练复杂且不稳定。

Method: 先训练带目标散度约束（TDC）的高斯VAE，然后通过随机生成高斯噪声作为码本，将后验均值映射到最近邻噪声向量，实现无需额外训练的离散化转换。理论证明当码本大小的对数超过高斯VAE的bits-back编码率时，可保证小量化误差。

Result: 在UNet和ViT架构上均优于VQGAN、FSQ、LFQ、BSQ等先前VQ-VAE方法；TDC也可改进TokenBridge等高斯VAE离散化方法。

Conclusion: GQ提供了一种简单高效的VQ-VAE训练范式，克服了离散化训练困难，且具有理论保证。

Abstract: Vector-quantized variational autoencoders (VQ-VAEs) are discrete autoencoders that compress images into discrete tokens. However, they are difficult to train due to discretization. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective technique dubbed Gaussian Quant (GQ), which first trains a Gaussian VAE under certain constraints and then converts it into a VQ-VAE without additional training. For conversion, GQ generates random Gaussian noise as a codebook and finds the closest noise vector to the posterior mean. Theoretically, we prove that when the logarithm of the codebook size exceeds the bits-back coding rate of the Gaussian VAE, a small quantization error is guaranteed. Practically, we propose a heuristic to train Gaussian VAEs for effective conversion, named the target divergence constraint (TDC). Empirically, we show that GQ outperforms previous VQ-VAEs, such as VQGAN, FSQ, LFQ, and BSQ, on both UNet and ViT architectures. Furthermore, TDC also improves previous Gaussian VAE discretization methods, such as TokenBridge. The source code is provided in https://github.com/tongdaxu/VQ-VAE-from-Gaussian-VAE.

</details>


### [449] [A Multivariate Bernoulli-Based Sampling Method for Multi-Label Data with Application to Meta-Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.08371)
*Simon Chung,Colby J. Vorland,Donna L. Maney,Andrew W. Brown*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种考虑标签依赖性的多标签数据加权采样算法，通过估计多元伯努利分布参数并计算标签组合权重，在保持目标分布特征的同时缓解标签频率不均衡问题，实验证明该方法能增强少数类别的代表性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多标签数据集中标签频率差异大且标签间存在依赖关系，传统采样方法难以在已知偏差下获得包含足够稀有标签样本的代表性子集。

Method: 以多元伯努利分布建模多标签问题，利用观测到的标签频率估计分布参数，为每个标签组合计算权重，实现加权采样以获取目标分布特征并兼顾标签依赖性。

Result: 在包括Web of Science中64个生物医学主题类别标注的研究文章在内的多个数据集上，该方法保留了类别频率顺序，缩小了最常见与最不常见类别间的频率差异，并考虑了类别依赖关系，生成了更均衡的子样本。

Conclusion: 该算法能有效增强少数类别的代表性，在多标签数据不平衡场景下具有实用价值。

Abstract: Datasets may contain observations with multiple labels. If the labels are not mutually exclusive, and if the labels vary greatly in frequency, obtaining a sample that includes sufficient observations with scarcer labels to make inferences about those labels, and which deviates from the population frequencies in a known manner, creates challenges. In this paper, we consider a multivariate Bernoulli distribution as our underlying distribution of a multi-label problem. We present a novel sampling algorithm that takes label dependencies into account. It uses observed label frequencies to estimate multivariate Bernoulli distribution parameters and calculates weights for each label combination. This approach ensures the weighted sampling acquires target distribution characteristics while accounting for label dependencies. We applied this approach to a variety of datasets, including a sample of research articles from Web of Science labeled with 64 biomedical topic categories. We aimed to preserve category frequency order, reduce frequency differences between most and least common categories, and account for category dependencies. This approach produced a more balanced sub-sample, enhancing the representation of minority categories.

</details>


### [450] [BUILD with Precision: Bottom-Up Inference of Linear DAGs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.16111)
*Hamed Ajorlou,Samuel Rey,Gonzalo Mateos,Geert Leus,Antonio G. Marques*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BUILD算法，利用等噪声方差线性高斯SEM下观测数据的集成精度矩阵的独特结构，通过自底向上识别叶节点及其父节点并逐步剪枝，从真实精度矩阵精确重建DAG；针对有限数据估计精度矩阵时的病态问题，引入周期性重估计策略提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在等噪声方差的线性高斯SEM下，DAG学习问题是可识别的，但现有方法未能充分利用该设定下精度矩阵的独特结构。作者旨在揭示这一结构特性并设计一种确定性、计算高效的DAG重建算法。

Method: 1) 证明等噪声方差线性高斯SEM中观测数据的集成精度矩阵具有可识别DAG的独特结构；2) 提出BUILD算法，采用自底向上方式：识别叶节点及其父节点，移除叶节点的入射边后迭代进行下一轮；3) 针对有限样本估计精度矩阵的病态问题，引入周期性重估计策略，在剪枝过程中用更少的变量重新估计精度矩阵。

Result: 在具有挑战性的合成基准测试上，BUILD算法与最先进的DAG学习方法相比表现优异，同时提供了明确的计算复杂度控制。

Conclusion: BUILD算法利用精度矩阵的结构特性实现了精确的DAG重建，周期性重估计策略有效缓解了误差累积问题，在性能与复杂度之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: Learning the structure of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) from observational data is a central problem in causal discovery, statistical signal processing, and machine learning. Under a linear Gaussian structural equation model (SEM) with equal noise variances, the problem is identifiable and we show that the ensemble precision matrix of the observations exhibits a distinctive structure that facilitates DAG recovery. Exploiting this property, we propose BUILD (Bottom-Up Inference of Linear DAGs), a deterministic stepwise algorithm that identifies leaf nodes and their parents, then prunes the leaves by removing incident edges to proceed to the next step, exactly reconstructing the DAG from the true precision matrix. In practice, precision matrices must be estimated from finite data, and ill-conditioning may lead to error accumulation across BUILD steps. As a mitigation strategy, we periodically re-estimate the precision matrix (with less variables as leaves are pruned), trading off runtime for enhanced robustness. Reproducible results on challenging synthetic benchmarks demonstrate that BUILD compares favorably to state-of-the-art DAG learning algorithms, while offering an explicit handle on complexity.

</details>


### [451] [How to Square Tensor Networks and Circuits Without Squaring Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17090)
*Lorenzo Loconte,Adrián Javaloy,Antonio Vergari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种参数化平方电路的方法，通过引入正交性和确定性条件，在保持表达力不损失的情况下实现高效边缘化，克服了平方张量网络和平方电路在计算配分函数和边缘概率时的高复杂度问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平方张量网络和平方电路作为表达性分布估计器支持闭式边缘化，但平方操作在计算配分函数或边缘化变量时引入了额外复杂度，阻碍了其在机器学习中的适用性。现有张量网络的正则形式通过酉矩阵参数化简化了边缘计算，但这些正则形式不适用于电路，因为电路可表示无法直接映射到已知张量网络的因素分解。

Method: 受正则形式中正交性和电路中确定性实现可处理最大化的思想启发，作者展示了如何参数化平方电路以克服其边缘化开销。所提出的参数化使得即使在不同于张量网络但编码为电路的因素分解中也能实现高效边缘化。

Result: 实验表明，所提出的平方电路条件在分布估计任务中不损失表达力，同时实现了更高效的学习。

Conclusion: 通过引入正交性和确定性参数化，平方电路能够在更广泛的分解结构中实现高效边缘化，提升学习效率而不牺牲表达力。

Abstract: Squared tensor networks (TNs) and their extension as computational graphs--squared circuits--have been used as expressive distribution estimators, yet supporting closed-form marginalization. However, the squaring operation introduces additional complexity when computing the partition function or marginalizing variables, which hinders their applicability in ML. To solve this issue, canonical forms of TNs are parameterized via unitary matrices to simplify the computation of marginals. However, these canonical forms do not apply to circuits, as they can represent factorizations that do not directly map to a known TN. Inspired by the ideas of orthogonality in canonical forms and determinism in circuits enabling tractable maximization, we show how to parameterize squared circuits to overcome their marginalization overhead. Our parameterizations unlock efficient marginalization even in factorizations different from TNs, but encoded as circuits, whose structure would otherwise make marginalization computationally hard. Finally, our experiments on distribution estimation show how our proposed conditions in squared circuits come with no expressiveness loss, while enabling more efficient learning.

</details>


### [452] [A Logical View of GNN-Style Computation and the Role of Activation Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.19332)
*Pablo Barceló,Floris Geerts,Matthias Lanzinger,Klara Pakhomenko,Jan Van den Bussche*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了MPLang（一种通过线性消息传递和激活函数捕获图神经网络计算的声明式语言）的数值和布尔表达能力。分析了无激活函数的A-MPLang片段，刻画了其行走和特征表达能力。证明了有界激活函数（在温和条件下）所有最终常数激活函数具有相同的数值和布尔表达能力，且其表达能力超越了先前建立的逻辑。最后证明了线性层存在下无界激活（ReLU）与有界激活之间的首个表达能力分离：ReLU在数值查询上严格强于最终常数激活函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解图神经网络（GNN）的表达能力，特别是不同激活函数（如ReLU与有界激活函数）在存在线性层时对数值和布尔查询表达能力的影响，并揭示线性聚合与非线性激活函数之间的微妙交互。

Method: 通过定义声明式语言MPLang及其无激活函数片段A-MPLang，利用行走和特征刻画表达能力；对最终常数激活函数进行统一性证明；通过构造具体查询任务证明ReLU与有界激活函数之间的表达能力分离。

Result: 1) 刻画了A-MPLang的行走和特征表达能力；2) 所有最终常数激活函数在数值和布尔表达能力上等价，且超越先前建立的逻辑；3) 首次证明ReLU在数值查询上严格强于最终常数激活函数（如截断ReLU）。

Conclusion: 无界激活函数（ReLU）与有界最终常数激活函数在GNN表达能力上存在本质差异，ReLU由于线性聚合与非线性交互的微妙机制而具有更强的数值表达能力。

Abstract: We study the numerical and Boolean expressiveness of MPLang, a declarative language that captures the computation of graph neural networks (GNNs) through linear message passing and activation functions. We begin with A-MPLang, the fragment without activation functions, and give a characterization of its expressive power in terms of walk-summed features. For bounded activation functions, we show that (under mild conditions) all eventually constant activations yield the same expressive power - numerical and Boolean - and that it subsumes previously established logics for GNNs with eventually constant activation functions but without linear layers. Finally, we prove the first expressive separation between unbounded and bounded activations in the presence of linear layers: MPLang with ReLU is strictly more powerful for numerical queries than MPLang with eventually constant activation functions, e.g., truncated ReLU. This hinges on subtle interactions between linear aggregation and eventually constant non-linearities, and it establishes that GNNs using ReLU are more expressive than those restricted to eventually constant activations and linear layers.

</details>


### [453] [An Empirical Study of Machine Learning Robustness and Scalability for Imbalanced Tabular Clinical Data in Emergency and Critical Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21602)
*Yusuf Brima,Marcellin Atemkeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究评估了六种模型族在MIMIC-IV-ED和eICU两个急诊/重症数据集上的不平衡表格数据预测性能，发现没有单一模型在所有临床场景中占据主导地位：TabPFN v2.6和TabICL在MIMIC-IV-ED上表现最佳，XGBoost在eICU上持续领先，表格基础模型正在缩小与经典基线的差距但提供了独特的效率-性能权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床数据通常存在严重类别不平衡，导致模型偏向多数类而降低预测性能，亟需开发鲁棒且高效的不平衡临床表格数据建模方法。

Method: 在MIMIC-IV-ED和eICU数据库上，评估决策树、随机森林、XGBoost、TabNet、TabICL和TabPFN v2.6六种模型族；可训练模型使用贝叶斯超参数调优，基础模型在预训练推理模式下评估，使用Macro F1-score、对不平衡增加的鲁棒性和计算可扩展性三项指标衡量。

Result: MIMIC-IV-ED上TabPFN v2.6和TabICL的Macro F1排名最佳，XGBoost竞争激烈；eICU上XGBoost持续领先，树方法紧随其后，基础模型表现居中；TabNet在不平衡增加时退化最严重且计算成本最高；树方法随数据规模扩展最有利，基础模型具有低单任务适配成本。

Conclusion: 无单一模型族在所有临床场景占优，但表格基础模型正在缩小与强经典基线的差距，其独特的效率-性能权衡可能有利于资源受限的临床环境。

Abstract: Every year, millions of patients pass through emergency departments and intensive care units, where clinicians must make high-stakes decisions under time pressure and uncertainty. Machine learning could support prediction of deterioration, triage, and rare critical outcomes, but clinical data are often severely imbalanced, biasing models toward majority classes and reducing predictive performance. Developing robust and efficient models for imbalanced clinical tabular data therefore remains an important challenge.
  We evaluated six model families on imbalanced tabular data from the MIMIC-IV-ED and eICU databases: Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, TabNet, TabICL, and TabPFN v2.6. Trainable models were optimized using Bayesian hyperparameter tuning, while foundation models were evaluated in their pretrained inference regime without task-specific reweighting. Models were assessed using Macro F1-score, robustness to increasing imbalance, and computational scalability across seven clinical prediction tasks.
  Results differed across datasets. On MIMIC-IV-ED, TabPFN v2.6 and TabICL achieved the strongest average Macro F1 ranks, with XGBoost remaining competitive. On eICU, XGBoost consistently performed best, followed by other tree-based methods, while foundation models achieved intermediate performance. Across both datasets, TabNet showed the largest degradation under increasing imbalance and the highest computational cost. Training-time analysis showed that tree-based methods scaled most favorably with dataset size, while foundation models offered low per-task adaptation cost.
  These findings suggest that no single model family dominates across all clinical settings. However, tabular foundation models are narrowing the performance gap with strong classical baselines while offering a distinct efficiency-performance trade-off that may benefit resource-constrained clinical environments.

</details>


### [454] [Beyond Binary: Turning Partial Success into Dense Verifiable Rewards for Reinforcement Learning in Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03525)
*Longwen Wang,Yirui Liu,Xuan'er Wu,Xiaohui Hu,Yuankai Fan,Kaidong Yu,Qizhen Weng,Wei Xi,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VeRPO框架，利用代码生成中测试用例级别的部分成功信号作为可验证的密集奖励，通过动态密度校准局部奖励修正基数偏差，并结合全局执行结果，在多个基准上实现显著性能提升且几乎零额外开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码生成的强化学习中，测试套件级结果奖励稀疏，外部奖励模型存在不对齐和额外开销问题。代码评估天然产生多测试用例结果，部分成功（通过部分测试用例）是内在的、可验证的密集奖励来源，但如何有效利用这一信号是关键挑战。

Method: 提出VeRPO框架：(1) 将部分成功奖励形式化为加权和公式，理论识别出基数偏差（cardinality bias），即策略更新会不成比例地偏好简单测试的成功而非前沿测试的进展；(2) 引入动态密度校准局部奖励（dynamic density-calibrated local reward），显式修正基数偏差；(3) 将局部密集奖励与全局执行结果整合以增强与端到端功能正确性的对齐。

Result: 在多个基准和设置上的实验表明，VeRPO优于基于结果驱动和奖励模型的基线方法，最高实现+8.83 pass@1的提升，时间成本仅增加不到0.02%，且零GPU内存开销。

Conclusion: Verifiable dense reward（可验证的密集奖励）是代码生成RL中一个有效且高效的奖励设计范式，VeRPO通过修正基数偏差提供了可靠的密集监督信号，为未来代码生成RL研究提供了新方向。

Abstract: Effective reward design is a central challenge in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for code generation. Mainstream test-suite-level outcome rewards enforce functional correctness but induce sparsity, while external Reward Models (RMs) provide dense supervision at the cost of misalignment and additional overhead. Since code evaluation naturally yields multiple test-case-level outcomes, partial success, i.e., passing a subset of test cases, offers an intrinsic, verifiable source of dense supervision. In this paper, we propose VeRPO (Verifiable Dense Reward Policy Optimization), an RL framework that systematically turns verifiable partial success into reliable dense rewards. We analyze partial-success rewards using a weighted sum formulation, theoretically identifying a critical cardinality bias that causes policy updates to disproportionately favor gains from easy-test successes over progress on frontier tests. Based on this, VeRPO introduces a dynamic, density-calibrated local reward that explicitly corrects this bias and provides robust dense supervision from partial success. To enhance alignment with end-to-end functional correctness, VeRPO further integrates the local dense reward with global execution outcomes. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and settings demonstrate that VeRPO outperforms outcome-driven and RM-based baselines, achieving up to +8.83 pass@1 gain with negligible time cost (< 0.02%) and zero GPU memory overhead.

</details>


### [455] [Approximate Equivariance via Projection-based Regularisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05028)
*Torben Berndt,Jan Stühmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于投影的正则化方法，通过将线性层分解为等变和非等变组件，在算子层面惩罚非等变性，相比现有基于样本的方法在SO(3)等连续群上具有更低的样本复杂度和更好的计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有近似等变方法通常使用基于样本的正则化器，依赖训练时的数据增强，在连续群（如SO(3)）上样本复杂度高，计算效率低。

Method: 利用线性层的正交分解，将其拆分为等变和非等变组件，在算子层面（而非逐点）对全群轨道上的非等变性进行惩罚，并给出了空间域和谱域中精确高效计算非等变惩罚项的数学框架。

Result: 实验表明该方法在模型性能和效率上均持续优于先前的近似等变方法，相比基于样本的正则化器实现了显著的运行时加速。

Conclusion: 基于投影的算子级正则化在保持近似等变能力的同时，有效降低了样本复杂度和计算开销，是处理非完美对称性实际应用的有效方案。

Abstract: Equivariance is a powerful inductive bias in neural networks, improving generalisation and physical consistency. Recently, however, non-equivariant models have regained attention, due to their better runtime performance and imperfect symmetries that might arise in real-world applications. This has motivated the development of approximately equivariant models that strike a middle ground between respecting symmetries and fitting the data distribution. Existing approaches in this field usually apply sample-based regularisers which depend on data augmentation at training time, incurring a high sample complexity, in particular for continuous groups such as $SO(3)$. This work instead approaches approximate equivariance via a projection-based regulariser which leverages the orthogonal decomposition of linear layers into equivariant and non-equivariant components. In contrast to existing methods, this penalises non-equivariance at an operator level across the full group orbit, rather than point-wise. We present a mathematical framework for computing the non-equivariance penalty exactly and efficiently in both the spatial and spectral domain. In our experiments, our method consistently outperforms prior approximate equivariance approaches in both model performance and efficiency, achieving substantial runtime gains over sample-based regularisers.

</details>


### [456] [ORLoopBench: Solver-in-the-Loop Benchmarks for Self-Correction and Behavioral Rationality in Operations Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21008)
*Ruicheng Ao,David Simchi-Levi,Xinshang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ORLoopBench基准，将不可行模型修复形式化为求解器在环的马尔可夫决策过程，通过RLVR训练使8B模型在LP修复上超越前沿API（95.3% vs 92.4% RR@5），并揭示了全模型代码再生中的语义漂移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM基准将运筹学问题视为从描述到求解器代码的一次性翻译，忽略了实践中关键的迭代诊断与修复循环（即IIS识别、冲突排查、模型修正），无法评估LLM在真实调试场景中的推理与修正能力。

Method: 将不可行模型修复形式化为求解器在环的MDP，每次动作触发求解器重新执行和IIS重计算，产生确定性可验证的反馈；构建ORLoopBench（含OR-Debug-Bench 5,362个LP/MILP修复实例和OR-Bias-Bench库存决策基准），采用求解器验证的RLVR训练。

Result: 8B模型在LP修复上达到95.3% RR@5，超越前沿API的92.4%；训练改善了诊断行为且迁移到MILP修复；同时发现全模型代码再生存在语义漂移——可行再生MILP可能求解错误的问题。

Conclusion: 基于求解器oracle的过程级评估能实现针对性的OR自修正训练，推动LLM在运筹学调试中的可靠应用。

Abstract: Operations Research practitioners debug infeasible models through an iterative process: inspecting Irreducible Infeasible Subsystems ( IIS), identifying constraint conflicts, and repairing formulations until feasibility is restored. Existing LLM benchmarks mostly treat OR as one-shot translation from problem descriptions to solver code, omitting this diagnostic loop. We formalize infeasible-model repair as a solver-in-the-loop Markov Decision Process in which each action triggers solver re-execution and IIS recomputation, yielding deterministic, verifiable feedback. We introduce ORLoopBench, a benchmark suite with two components: OR-Debug-Bench releases 5,362 LP/MILP repair instances, while OR-Bias-Bench evaluates closed-form operational decision rationality across inventory settings. Solver-verified RLVR training enables an 8B model to surpass frontier APIs on LP repair (95.3% vs 92.4% RR @5), improves diagnostic behavior, and transfers to MILP repair. The same evaluation exposes semantic drift in whole-model code regeneration: feasible regenerated MILPs can solve the wrong problem. Process-level evaluation with solver oracles enables targeted training for reliable OR self-correction.

</details>


### [457] [ECSEL: Explainable Classification via Signomial Equation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21789)
*Adia Lumadjeng,Ilker Birbil,Erman Acar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ECSEL是一种可解释分类方法，通过学习符号回归形式的符号方程（signomial equations）同时实现分类与解释，在标准基准上恢复更多目标方程且计算量更小，分类精度与经典模型相当，并满足全局特征行为、决策边界分析和局部特征归因等理想性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多符号回归基准存在紧凑的符号结构，但现有方法在可解释性与计算效率上存在不足，因此需要一种既能保持高分类精度、又能提供结构化闭式表达式作为解释的分类方法。

Method: ECSEL直接构造符号方程（signomial equations）形式的闭式表达式，同时充当分类器和解释器；通过符号回归技术学习紧凑的数学表达式结构。

Result: 在标准符号回归基准上，ECSEL恢复目标方程的比例高于现有最先进方法，且计算量显著更低；分类精度与经典机器学习模型相当；在电商和欺诈检测等真实案例中，所学方程能够暴露数据集偏差、支持反事实推理并产生可操作的洞见。

Conclusion: ECSEL在保持可解释性的同时实现了与经典模型竞争的分类精度，满足全局特征行为、决策边界分析和局部特征归因等理想可解释性属性，在实际应用中有助于检测偏差和提供可操作洞察。

Abstract: We introduce ECSEL, an explainable classification method that learns formal expressions in the form of signomial equations, motivated by the observation that many symbolic regression benchmarks admit compact signomial structure. ECSEL directly constructs a structural, closed-form expression that serves as both a classifier and an explanation. On standard symbolic regression benchmarks, our method recovers a larger fraction of target equations than competing state-of-the-art approaches while requiring substantially less computation. Leveraging this efficiency, ECSEL achieves classification accuracy competitive with established machine learning models without sacrificing interpretability. Further, we show that ECSEL satisfies some desirable properties regarding global feature behavior, decision-boundary analysis, and local feature attributions. Experiments on benchmark datasets and two real-world case studies i.e., e-commerce and fraud detection, demonstrate that the learned equations expose dataset biases, support counterfactual reasoning, and yield actionable insights.

</details>


### [458] [Constrained Meta Reinforcement Learning with Provable Test-Time Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21845)
*Tingting Ni,Maryam Kamgarpour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种在元强化学习测试阶段保证安全性的算法，具有可证明的安全性和样本复杂度保证，并推导出了匹配的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有元强化学习在测试任务上提高了样本效率，但许多现实应用（如机器人、医疗）要求测试时的安全性，而如何在不牺牲样本效率的前提下保障测试任务中的策略安全性尚未解决。

Method: 提出一种在训练阶段学习策略后再精炼策略的算法，能够在测试任务上以可证明的安全性和样本复杂度保证学习近最优策略。

Result: 该算法具有可证明的安全性和样本复杂度保证，并推导出匹配的下界，表明样本复杂度是最优的。

Conclusion: 该方法填补了约束元强化学习中测试安全性与样本效率之间权衡的理论空白，为安全关键应用提供了理论保障。

Abstract: Meta reinforcement learning (RL) allows agents to leverage experience across a distribution of tasks on which the agent can train at will, enabling faster learning of optimal policies on new test tasks. Despite its success in improving sample complexity on test tasks, many real-world applications, such as robotics and healthcare, impose safety constraints during testing. Constrained meta RL provides a promising framework for integrating safety into meta RL. An open question in constrained meta RL is how to ensure safety of the policy on the real-world test task, while reducing the sample complexity and thus, enabling faster learning of optimal policies. To address this gap, we propose an algorithm that refines policies learned during training, with provable safety and sample complexity guarantees for learning a near optimal policy on the test tasks. We further derive a matching lower bound, showing that this sample complexity is tight.

</details>


### [459] [Graph is a Substrate Across Data Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22384)
*Ziming Li,Xiaoming Wu,Zehong Wang,Jiazheng Li,Yijun Tian,Jinhe Bi,Yunpu Ma,Yanfang Ye,Chuxu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出G-Substrate框架，将图结构视为跨模态和任务的共享结构基板，通过统一结构模式与交错角色训练策略，实现图表示的持久化与积累，实验表明其优于任务隔离和朴素多任务学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图结构学习是模态和任务隔离的，每个任务独立构建图表示，任务结束后即丢弃，导致跨模态和任务的结构规律被反复重建而非在中间表示层面积累，缺乏持久化和共享的图结构组织方式。

Method: 提出G-Substrate框架，包含两个互补机制：(1) 统一结构模式（unified structural schema），确保异构模态和任务的图表示兼容；(2) 交错角色训练策略（interleaved role-based training strategy），让同一图结构在学习过程中承担多种功能角色。

Result: 在多个领域、模态和任务上的实验表明，G-Substrate优于任务隔离学习和朴素多任务学习方法。

Conclusion: 图结构应作为持久化的共享基板来组织，G-Substrate通过统一结构模式和交错角色训练有效实现了跨模态和任务的图表示积累与复用。

Abstract: Graphs provide a natural representation of relational structure that arises across diverse domains. Despite this ubiquity, graph structure is typically learned in a modality- and task-isolated manner, where graph representations are constructed within individual task contexts and discarded thereafter. As a result, structural regularities across modalities and tasks are repeatedly reconstructed rather than accumulated at the level of intermediate graph representations. This motivates a representation-learning question: how should graph structure be organized so that it can persist and accumulate across heterogeneous modalities and tasks? We adopt a representation-centric perspective in which graph structure is treated as a structural substrate that persists across learning contexts. To instantiate this perspective, we propose G-Substrate, a graph substrate framework that organizes learning around shared graph structures. G-Substrate comprises two complementary mechanisms: a unified structural schema that ensures compatibility among graph representations across heterogeneous modalities and tasks, and an interleaved role-based training strategy that exposes the same graph structure to multiple functional roles during learning. Experiments across multiple domains, modalities, and tasks show that G-Substrate outperforms task-isolated and naive multi-task learning methods. The codebase, model, and datasets are available at https://github.com/zmli6/G-Substrate.

</details>


### [460] [Over-Alignment vs Over-Fitting: The Role of Feature Learning Strength in Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00827)
*Taesun Yeom,Taehyeok Ha,Jaeho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现深度网络中特征学习强度（FLS）存在最优值（既不过大也不过小），该最优FLS能显著提升泛化性能，并通过理论分析揭示了这一现象源于过对齐（FLS过大）与过拟合（FLS过小）之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有理论主要在渐近条件下研究FLS对优化动力学的影响，缺乏对实际训练场景（如达到目标训练风险即停止）下FLS如何影响泛化的理解。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 通过实证研究观察最优FLS现象，并基于梯度流动力学对使用逻辑损失训练的两层ReLU网络进行理论分析，其中FLS由初始化尺度控制。

Result: 发现最优FLS的存在：FLS过大导致"过对齐"现象降低泛化能力，FLS过小导致过拟合。

Conclusion: 最优FLS源于过对齐与过拟合之间的权衡，挑战了"更强的特征学习普遍提升泛化"的传统直觉。

Abstract: Feature learning strength (FLS), i.e., the inverse of the effective output scaling of a model, plays a critical role in shaping the optimization dynamics of neural nets. While its impact has been extensively studied under the asymptotic regimes -- both in training time and FLS -- existing theory offers limited insight into how FLS affects generalization in practical settings, such as when training is stopped upon reaching a target training risk. In this work, we investigate the impact of FLS on generalization in deep networks under such practical conditions. Through empirical studies, we first uncover the emergence of an $\textit{optimal FLS}$ -- neither too small nor too large -- that yields substantial generalization gains. This finding runs counter to the prevailing intuition that stronger feature learning universally improves generalization. To explain this phenomenon, we develop a theoretical analysis of gradient flow dynamics in two-layer ReLU nets trained with logistic loss, where FLS is controlled via initialization scale. Our main theoretical result establishes the existence of an optimal FLS arising from a trade-off between two competing effects: An excessively large FLS induces an $\textit{over-alignment}$ phenomenon that degrades generalization, while an overly small FLS leads to $\textit{over-fitting}$.

</details>


### [461] [Probing the Knowledge Boundary: An Interactive Agentic Framework for Deep Knowledge Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00959)
*Yuheng Yang,Siqi Zhu,Tao Feng,Ge Liu,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个交互式智能体框架，系统性地提取和量化大语言模型中的参数化知识。通过四种自适应探索策略、三级知识处理流水线，发现递归分类法最有效，存在知识缩放定律，并揭示了通用模型与领域模型在知识提取中的不同表现特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型可被视为压缩的知识库，但其实际包含的知识内容及知识边界仍不明确。现有基准大多为静态数据，对系统性知识探测的支持有限，因此需要一种能够动态、自适应地提取和量化LLM知识的方法。

Method: 提出一个交互式智能体框架，包含：(1) 四种自适应探索策略（其中递归分类法最有效），用于在不同粒度上探测知识；(2) 三级知识处理流水线：基于向量的去重过滤、LLM裁决消除语义重叠、领域相关性审计保留有效知识单元。

Result: 递归分类法是最有效的探索策略；存在知识缩放定律，即更大模型能恢复更多知识；存在Pass@1与Pass@k的权衡：领域专用模型初始准确率高但衰退快，通用模型在扩展提取中保持稳定性能；不同训练数据构成导致不同模型家族具有可测量的独特知识分布。

Conclusion: 本文提出的框架能够有效系统性地提取和量化LLM的参数化知识，验证了知识缩放定律的存在，揭示了模型架构、训练数据与知识分布之间的关联，为理解LLM的知识边界提供了新的工具和视角。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can be seen as compressed knowledge bases, but it remains unclear what knowledge they truly contain and how far their knowledge boundary extends. Existing benchmarks are mostly static and provide limited support for systematic knowledge probing. In this paper, we propose an interactive agentic framework to systematically extract and quantify the knowledge of LLMs. Our method includes four adaptive exploration policies to probe knowledge at different granularity. To ensure the quality of extracted knowledge, we introduce a three-stage knowledge processing pipeline that combines vector-based filtering to remove strict duplicates, LLM-based adjudication to resolve ambiguous semantic overlap, and domain relevance auditing to retain valid knowledge units. Through extensive experiments, we find that Recursive Taxonomy is the most effective exploration strategy. We also observe a clear knowledge scaling law, where larger models consistently recover more knowledge. In addition, we identify a Pass@1 versus Pass@k trade-off: domain-specialized models achieve higher initial accuracy but experience rapid degradation, while general-purpose models maintain stable performance over extended extraction. Finally, our results show that differences in training data composition lead to distinct and measurable knowledge profiles across model families, reflecting how pretraining shapes each model's parametric knowledge.

</details>


### [462] [ECHO-2: A Large-Scale Distributed Rollout Framework for Cost-Efficient Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02192)
*Jingwei Song,Meng Chen,Jie Xiao,Qingnan Ren,Jiaqi Huang,Yangshen Deng,Chris Tong,Wanyi Chen,Suli Wang,Zhisheng Chen,Ziqian Bi,Shuo Lu,Yiqun Duan,Xu Wang,Rymon Yu,Lynn Ai,Eric Yang,Tianyu Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ECHO-2是一种分布式强化学习框架，通过结合集中学习与分布式推理、容忍策略过时性、重叠式流水线设计及对等辅助广播，显著提升了LLM后训练阶段的成本效率，同时保持奖励性能与强基线相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL后训练中，将rollout执行分布到远端推理worker可以利用更经济的推理资源，但会引入广域协调和策略分发延迟的挑战。现有方法未能有效解决这些瓶颈。

Method: ECHO-2采用集中学习+分布式rollout架构，将策略过时性作为可控参数，实现rollout生成、策略分发与训练的重叠执行；提出基于重叠的容量模型给出维持learner利用率的资源配比规则；使用对等辅助的流水线广播降低分发瓶颈，并基于成本感知激活异构worker。

Result: 在4B至32B参数规模的LLM上、真实广域带宽条件下的GRPO后训练实验中，ECHO-2在保持与强基线相当的RL奖励的同时，显著提升了成本效率。

Conclusion: ECHO-2证明了在非可忽略的分发延迟下，通过重叠执行和感知成本的worker调度，可以有效实现分布式RL后训练的成本优化，为大规模LLM的分布式RL训练提供了实用的工程框架。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a critical stage in post-training large language models (LLMs), involving repeated interaction between rollout generation, reward evaluation, and centralized learning. Distributing rollout execution offers opportunities to leverage more cost-efficient inference resources, but introduces challenges in wide-area coordination and policy dissemination. We present ECHO-2, a distributed RL framework for post-training with remote inference workers and non-negligible dissemination latency. ECHO-2 combines centralized learning with distributed rollouts and treats bounded policy staleness as a user-controlled parameter, enabling rollout generation, dissemination, and training to overlap. We introduce an overlap-based capacity model that relates training time, dissemination latency, and rollout throughput, yielding a practical provisioning rule for sustaining learner utilization. To mitigate dissemination bottlenecks and lower cost, ECHO-2 employs peer-assisted pipelined broadcast and cost-aware activation of heterogeneous workers.
